games.name: Gakkou de Atta Kowai Hanashi
games.summary: Gakkou de atta Kowai Hanashi is a visual novel for the Super Famicom that was released in 1995 by Banpresto in Japan. The in-game graphics make use of digitized photographs. In 1996, a remake for the PlayStation Gakkou de atta Kowai Hanashi S, was released. It featured improved graphics, full motion video, and an expanded story. The game was developed by Pandora Box (game developer), a studio founded by game designer and scenario writer Takeo Iijima. The characters and setting would later be used in the Apathy franchise of Visual and Sound Novel games.

games.name: Street Fighter Alpha: Warriors' Dreams
games.summary: This version of Street Fighter Alpha: Warriors' Dreams features an arranged soundtrack, a dedicated two-player Versus Mode and also a Training Mode allowing players to practice their techniques and combos on a non-hostile character.

games.name: Tsukikomori
games.summary: Tsukikomori is an Adventure game, developed by Pandora Box and published by Banpresto, which was released in Japan in 1996.

games.name: Touhou Koumakyou: The Embodiment of Scarlet Devil
aliases: Touhou Koumakyou ~ The Embodiment of Scarlet Devil
games.summary:
Embodiment of Scarlet Devil features two playable characters to choose from, with two Spell Card types each. Reimu Hakurei can cover a wide area of the screen with weaker attacks, while Marisa Kirisame relies on her speed and power to make up for her thinner attack spread. The bombs show different behavior and damage depending on the character and type chosen.

Unlike its predecessor, Mystic Square, Embodiment of Scarlet Devil comes with an "automatic item collection" feature, which allows you to collect all items on the screen by moving to the top of the screen if you are at full power, as well as a counter-bomb system, which allows you to avoid a fatal hit by using a bomb immediately.

Though there are six total stages in the main game, playing on Easy will end the game after Stage 5.

games.name: Fukakutei Sekai no Tantei Shinshi: Akugyou Futaasa no Jiken File
games.summary: Port of Fukakutei Sekai no Tantei Shinshi, heavily censored from the PC release and new content.

games.name: Happy Wheels
games.summary: Try to get to the finish line in this twisted game's user-created tracks. Having your limbs still attached is optional.

games.name: Phantom: Phantom of Inferno
games.summary: Remake of Phantom of Inferno with completely redrawn art in the style of the 2009's anime. The voice cast was also replaced by the one used in the anime.

games.name: Woah Dave!
games.summary:
From the folks behind the BIT.TRIP series comes the frantic insanity that is Woah Dave! Help our hero, Dave Lonuts, survive an insane alien invasion and line his pockets with shiny pennies.

Hurl alien eggs, skull bombs, and explosive WOAH blocks to stay alive and sky rocket yourself to high score fame and fortune.

The Steam and PS4 versions of Woah Dave! also feature a local two-player competitive mode, where two Daves can go head-to-head in a battle to collect the most coins. We aren’t exaggerating when we say it could very well result in ruined friendships and unsalvageable marriages. Competitive games are good like that.

If that isn’t enough Dave for you, there’s also Bonkers Mode with more aliens, more lava, and more chances to get killed. Those who brave the storm will be rewarded with a splendor of precious coinage those who fail will be revoked of their License to Dave.

Good luck, and may the best Dave win.

games.name: The Legend of Dark Witch Episode 2: The Price of Desire
aliases: Majin Shoujo Episode 2: Negai e no Daika
The Legend of Dark Witch 2: Remake
魔神少女 Episode 2 -願望的代價
games.summary:
The Legend of Dark Witch 2 retains its simple controls and enough challenges to satisfy the completist.

Created by indie games company INSIDE SYSTEM in 2014, The Legend of Dark Witch 2 is a 2D action story sequel to "The Legend of Dark Witch". True to its predecessor, Legend of the Dark Witch 2 retains its simple controls and enough challenges to satisfy the completist.

Players have 8 stages to choose from and must use SHOTs to make their way through a variety of obstacles to reach the boss enemy. Within each stage there are hidden "Pura Syega" which are helpful to power up player characters.

games.name: Mario Kart 8 Deluxe
games.summary: Hit the road with the definitive version of Mario Kart 8 and play anytime, anywhere! Race your friends or battle them in a revised battle mode on new and returning battle courses. Play locally in up to 4-player multiplayer in 1080p while playing in TV Mode. Every track from the Wii U version, including DLC, makes a glorious return. Plus, the Inklings appear as all-new guest characters, along with returning favorites, such as King Boo, Dry Bones, and Bowser Jr.!

games.name: That Level Again 3
games.summary:
Continuation of the games "TLA" and "TLA2". This time, not levels, but a story (and several separate levels) are waiting for you.
There are still many different logic puzzles and interesting solutions!
Read the lettering, be smart and have fun!

games.name: Aerea
games.summary:
AereA is a music themed Action RPG in which you play as one of Great Maestro Guido’s disciples and explore Aezir; a floating island that was broken into pieces. Your mission is to find and return the nine primordial instruments to restore balance and peace to the world. You have to find your way through all parts of the scattered islands; complete quests, solve puzzles, defeat bosses and discover the truth behind the islands. Will you be able to return the nine primordial instruments?

Play as Wolff the Harp-Archer, Jacques the Cello-Knight, Jules the Lute-Mage, Claude the Trumpet-Gunner, or team up with your friends in local co-op. Collect Music Sheets to learn new skills and customize your weapons to your play style.

games.name: Two Point Hospital
games.summary:
Design stunning hospitals, cure peculiar illnesses and manage troublesome staff as you spread your budding healthcare organisation across Two Point County.
Build and customise your hospital - it is yours after all - with specialist diagnosis and treatment facilities, as well as the very latest in ornamental technology!

games.name: Two Point Hospital: Full Health Collection
games.summary:
Behold the Full Health Collection, bringing you ALL of Two Point Hospital’s DLC in one easy to swallow bundle! This complete collection of DLCs offers you a wealth of new locations, new hospitals, new items, new gameplay and more! It's time to build, cure and improve in style.

• Two Point Hospital
• Culture Shock
• Fancy Dress Pack
• A Stitch in Time
• Close Encounters
• Retro Item Pack
• Off The Grid
• Speedy Recovery
• Two Point Hospital Bonus Campus Items
• Two Point Hospital: SEGA 60th Items
• Two Point Hospital: Free Zombie Costume
• Two Point Hospital: Hospital Pass (Golden Toilet)
• Two Point Hospital: Jingle Jam (from Humble Bundle)
• Two Point Hospital: Convention-al Rug (from Twitch, both Venus and Violet variants)

games.name: Fallout 76
games.summary: Fallout 76 is an online action role-playing game and the first multiplayer entry in the Fallout series. Set in 2102 in Appalachia, West Virginia, players control a resident of Vault 76 who ventures into the open world 25 years after a nuclear war. The game features exploration, questing, base building, and combat against mutated creatures and hostile factions. It can be played solo or cooperatively, with players sharing servers and engaging in trade or PvP combat.

games.name: Twilight's Folclore
games.summary:
Arima, the son of a doctor, lived in the capital of a nation that had been founded a few decades ago and which had undergone remarkable development. When his father succumbed suddenly to illness, he was left without any family. Fortunately, he was taken in by the noble Otobe family to work as the attendant for their lone daughter Supika, who had a frail constitution.

They were moved away from the main residence to a villa with a few other servants to escape from the scheming that swirled around the family and to spend their days happily. However, the calmness only lasts when the sun shines; When night falls, you could hear the sound of her life ticking away. Why was he chosen to be her attendant?

"Well, there’s no way around it, right? You’re the only one that I can eat."
aliases: 黄昏のフォルクローレ

games.name: Jenny LeClue: Detectivu
aliases: Jenny LeClue - Detectivu (名探偵ジェニー・ルクルー)
games.summary:
Jenny LeClue is a story focused exploration adventure game with memorable characters, a unique aesthetic, and an epic tangled mystery.

Jenny is a brilliant young detective, but nothing exciting happens in her small town of Arthurton, and she longs for real adventure. She gets more than she bargains for, when her mother is accused of murder. Jenny takes on the case of a lifetime and begins an unexpected, dangerous journey to uncover the truth. It’s also a coming-of-age meta-narrative about the blurred lines between right and wrong.

games.name: Mario Kart Tour
aliases: 马力欧卡丁车 巡回赛
瑪利歐賽車 巡迴賽
games.summary:
Mario Kart takes a world tour!
- Mario and friends go global in this new Mario Kart as they race around courses inspired by real-world cities in addition to classic Mario Kart courses! These destinations will be featured in tours that rotate every two weeks! In addition to courses based on iconic locales, some of your favorite Mario Kart characters will get variations that incorporate the local flavor of cities featured in the game!

Endless Mario Kart fun at your fingertips!
- The Mario Kart series known and loved by many is ready to take the world by storm – one smart device at a time! With just one finger, you can steer and drift with ease and sling devastating items as you go for the gold in cups filled with new and classic Mario Kart courses.

Nab 1st place with items and Frenzy mode!
- In Mario Kart Tour you have access to an arsenal of powerful items that can mix things up on the racetrack! Turn up the heat by activating the new Frenzy mode, which gives an unlimited supply of a certain item and makes you invincible! Make the most of the ensuing chaos, as Frenzy mode only lasts a short time!

Collect drivers, karts, badges, and more!
- Earn Grand Stars by racing or fire off the featured pipe to receive more drivers, karts, and gliders! You can also proudly display badges, earned by completing certain challenges, next to your in-game name!

Bonus challenge courses put a twist on traditional races!
- In certain races, 1st place isn't always the goal. With names like "Vs. Mega Bowser" and "Goomba Takedown," these bonus challenge courses demand a different approach to gameplay and strategy!

Race to increase your online rank!
- Boost with the best of 'em! Your high scores will determine how you compare to other players all over the world. Keep practicing and trying out different combinations of drivers, karts, and gliders to increase your score and rise to the top!

games.name: Dragon Quest XI S: Echoes of an Elusive Age - Definitive Edition
aliases: DRAGON QUEST XI S: Echoes of an Elusive Age
Dragon Quest XI: Echoes of an Elusive Age S
Dragon Quest XI S: Ecos de un pasado perdido – Edición definitiva
Dragon Quest XI S: Echi di un'era perduta – Edizione definitiva
Dragon Quest XI S : Les Combattants de la Destinée
Dragon Quest XI: Sugisarishi Toki o Motomete S
Dragon Quest XI: In Search of Lost Time S
games.summary: The Definitive Edition includes all the content from the original release of the acclaimed DRAGON QUEST XI, and adds extra character-specific scenarios, the choice of playing with the original soundtrack or a grand orchestral version of the music, the ability to switch between 2D and 3D graphic modes, a Japanese voice-acting option, and much more.

games.name: Kubo 3
games.summary:
Kubo 3 is new homebrew NES game from SJ Games (a 7 year old from France and little help from his Dad).

The game is available in ROM version to download or can be ordered in complete NES CARTRIDGE edition in box with the manual.

games.name: The Legend of Heroes: Trails from Zero
aliases: The Legend of Heroes: Zero no Kiseki Kai
Eiyuu Densetsu Zero no Kiseki Kai
英雄传说 零之轨迹: 改
Eiyuu Densetsu: Zero no Kiseki Kai
英雄傳說 零之軌跡: 改
The Legend of Heroes: Trails from Zero Kai
games.summary: The Legend of Heroes: Trails from Zero is the fourth installment in the main Trails series, serving as a direct sequel to the events of the Liberl arc and the beginning to the Crossbell arc. The game follows Lloyd Bannings and his colleagues Elie MacDowell, Randy Orlando, and Tio Plato. The four form the Special Support Section, a newly formed department of the Crossbell police in a city-state located between two great powers fighting for control over it.

games.name: Cupid Parasite
games.summary: In finding love for the Parasite 5, will Cupid find love herself?

games.name: The Legend of Heroes: Trails to Azure
aliases: The Legend of Heroes: Ao no Kiseki Kai
Eiyuu Densetsu: Ao no Kiseki Kai
英雄傳說 碧之軌跡: 改
英雄传说 碧之轨迹: 改
The Legend of Heroes: Trails to Azure Kai
games.summary: The Legend of Heroes: Trails to Azure is the fifth installment in the main Trails series, serving as a direct sequel to the events of the The Legend of Heroes: Trails from Zero and the ending to the Crossbell arc. The game follows the Special Support Section with more members and more cases to solve.

games.name: Populus Run
games.summary: Populus Run is a goofy runner with sugary obstacles. Watch out for massive falling cupcakes, rolling donuts, and rapping macarons in FiftyTwo's new game.

games.name: Blue Fire
games.summary: Embark on an extraordinary journey through the desolated kingdom of Penumbra and discover the hidden secrets of this long-forgotten land. Explore mystical temples, encounter survivors and take on strange quests to collect valuable items. Along your adventure, slash your way through daunting adversaries, roam across mysterious and abandoned regions, leap through deadly traps and ultimately master the art of movement.

games.name: Magical Charming!
games.summary:
An all ages version of Magical Charming!

Ritsu Natsumoto was unhappy because he had an unproductive summer vacation. One day he wakes up in a strange room where he meets a girl called Orietta, she reveals he is a magic user and takes him to Wizure Mahou Gakuin, a magical school. However, only girls should be able to use magic!
Ritsu starts his new school life while investigating the reasons behind his power.

games.name: Destroy All Humans! 2: Reprobed
games.summary:
Destroy All Humans! 2: Reprobed is a video game in the open-world action-adventure genre, serving as a remake of the original 2006 game. It is the sequel to the remade Destroy All Humans! and marks the sixth instalment in the franchise.

In this game, players take on the role of Crypto, navigating through diverse global locations such as England, Russia, and the United States. The objective is to complete various missions and overcome human adversaries. The gameplay incorporates a range of weapons and abilities, allowing players to defeat enemies by employing tactics such as mind-controlling humans and utilizing advanced alien technology.

games.name: Crisis Core: Final Fantasy VII - Reunion
aliases: CRISIS CORE: FINAL FANTASY VII - REUNION
games.summary: Crisis Core: Final Fantasy VII - Reunion is an HD remaster of the smash hit prequel to Final Fantasy VII. In addition to all graphics being remastered in HD, fully voiced dialogue and new soundtrack arrangements make for a dynamic new retelling of a beloved classic.
developers: Square Enix Creative Business Unit I

games.name: Tristia: Legacy
aliases: トリスティア：レガシー ~発明工房奮闘記~
games.summary: 20 years after its initial release on PC in July 2002, Kogado Studio’s simulation game makes its debut on Switch. While the graphics have been overhauled for the modern era, Eeji Komatsu’s cute and sexy illustrations live on. Experience the origin story and roots of the long-running Tristia series.

games.name: Tristia: Restore
games.summary: Happening in parallel to Tristia:legacy, the story of Tristia:restore follows the genius inventor girl Nanoca Flanka, granddaughter of the legendary inventor and crafter Prospero Flanka, as she is working to revitalize the floundering marine city of Tristia alongside her trusty companions! But this game focuses more on the day to day of running the shop: She has some major crafting projects to complete, but all the while, new orders for smaller objects are coming in for her to complete!

games.name: Wo Long: Fallen Dynasty
games.summary:
Wo Long: Fallen Dynasty is a historical fantasy action role-playing video game developed by Team Ninja and published by Koei Tecmo.

Set during a fictionalised version of the fall of the Han Dynasty, the plot follows an unnamed protagonist who battles historical characters and Chinese mythological creatures corrupted by demonic qi.

games.name: The Alchemist of Ars Magna
games.summary: The main character enters a school and gains experience in research, study, and love. This is the adventure story of an alchemist who grows through encounters and experiences and paves the way.

games.name: Fuyukuru.: Winter winds, adieu?
games.summary: A “denpa” visual novel about a grisly murder in a sealed institution for immortal girls. Wool needle, knitting needle, sewing machine needle. Silk needle, stitching needle, injection needle. Futon needle, clothing needle, hook for a fish. Follow the needles to your immortal death.

games.name: Wo Long: Fallen Dynasty - Battle of Zhongyuan
games.summary: The first DLC for Wo Long: Fallen Dynasty. It includes new stages, difficulty levels, weapon types, enemies and more, promising an exciting experience for Wo Long experts and novices alike.

games.name: Ant Colony: Wild Forest
games.summary: Build and automate your own ant colony – a nest that runs itself! Freely dig and shape your underground kingdom, produce different types of ants, and grow it block by block. Then it's time for conquest: scale up your swarm, crush enemy bases, and lead your colony to victory in the wild forest!

games.name: PuPu's Adventure Park
games.summary: Build an Adventure Park from the ground up! The PuPu clan had just rented a new "playground" from the Dark Goblins. Manage the park, construct park facilities, and grow your clan to serve the expansion of the Park for "hero" customers summoned from other planets!

games.name: Komorebi
games.summary: In a society plagued by visions of the future, a group of friends attempt to find their own way in a predestined life. This isn't easy, however, when they live under the Argus Corporation - a superpower dedicated to maintaining social order. A fully voice acted dystopic story/dating-sim. Play today!

games.name: Gelatinous: Humanity Lost
games.summary: Gelatinous is a platforming adventure with deep roots in games like Mega Man, Metroid, Castlevania, and other classics.

games.name: Wo Long: Fallen Dynasty - Conqueror of Jiangdong
games.summary: Conqueror of Jiangdong is the second DLC for Wo Long: Fallen Dynasty. It follows Sun Ce and his forces as they begin their campaign to conquer Jiangdong after the death of Sun Jian. The DLC adds new battlefields, weapons, equipment, demons, a new Divine Beast, a higher difficulty level, and additional endgame content.

games.name: Jane Austen's 8-bit Adventure
games.summary: Play as Jane Austen, English novelist, in this 2D platforming adventure. Explore 8-bit England, fight enemies with your quill, and confront characters from Jane Austen's novels!

games.name: Below the Stone
games.summary: Below the Stone is an extraction roguelike about dwarves on the quest for the deepest depths. A place where each and every descent will lead to new adventures -- and where only the most determined dwarves with many lost lives will be rewarded by the hidden world lying below the stone.

games.name: FlyKnight
games.summary: Kings Field style bug-themed dungeon crawler with Runescape graphics

games.name: Gothic II: Complete Classic
games.summary:
Continue the story of the Nameless Hero in Gothic II: Complete Classic, the award-winning sequel that improved on its predecessor in every way. Experience it now for the first time on Nintendo Switch.

Gothic II: Complete Classic brings together the excitement of Gothic II and the add-on Night of the Raven to your fingertips for the first time on a console.

games.name: Wo Long: Fallen Dynasty - Upheaval in Jingxiang
games.summary: The third DLC, "Upheaval in Jingxiang," depicts Liu Bei's forces as they fight back against the threat of Elixir that has gripped Jing Province since the death of Yu Ji.

games.name: Murders on the Yangtze River
games.summary: "Murders on Yangtze River" is an Ace Attorney-like detective game that takes you on a journey through early 20th century China as you solve a series of intriguing cases. Use your logical reasoning and deduction skills to uncover clues, interrogate suspects, and solve the mysteries.

games.name: Sputnika Game
games.summary: A Cosmic twist on a Suika-style game with space gravity. Help our little friend Sputnik on his journey to become the Sun.

games.name: Hawked
games.summary: Adventure calls in HAWKED, a swashbuckling online co-op adventure shooter. Team up with pals for daring treasure hunts, explore uncharted realities, and battle vicious monsters. Play for free now!

games.name: Monuments Renovator
games.summary: Monuments Renovator is a game in which you play the role of a professional monument renovator. You choose from among the world's greatest monuments, restore them to their former glory and learn about history and architecture.

games.name: One-inch Tactics
games.summary: Turn the tide of the war with nuanced strategies in One-inch Tactics, introducing players to a unique turn-based strategy experience.

games.name: Dimensional Animals
games.summary: Five animal friends unite for one glorious purpose: recover the dog's... play ball? Explore beautiful dimensions in this metroidvania action platformer adventure!

games.name: Vikings Pinball
games.summary: Fun pinball style battles. Attack the military camps of the holy Roman Empire and crush the legionaries. Choose the right trajectories to inflict as much damage as possible. Shoot down enemies, blow up barrels and collect coins. Free the map from these lazybones!

games.name: Voltaire: The Vegan Vampire
games.summary: An action-farming-roguelite, full of whimsical flora and mischievous creatures that really want to ruin your dark and mysterious plans of… Going vegan!

games.name: Maestro
games.summary: Step into a gorgeous opera house with Maestro, the VR orchestra conducting rhythm game that's the essence of elegance, control, and high-society french sophistication.

games.name: Kong: Survivor Instinct
games.summary: When giant monsters fight, no one’s safe. Embark on a thrilling quest of survival in a city that’s become a battleground for Titans. Use the lethal strength of Kong and other monsters to your own advantage in this official Monsterverse game set shortly after the events of Godzilla vs. Kong.

games.name: The Binding of Isaac: Repentance+
games.summary: The Binding of Isaac: Repentance+ delivers the ultimate, feature-complete, randomized dungeon-crawling experience, now enhanced with full online co-op for up to four players. It integrates all previous DCs and content updates, featuring 700+ items and over 300 enemy types. Key features include new online leaderboards, an emote wheel, and refined multiplayer systems.

games.name: The Noexistencen of You and Me
aliases: The NOexistenceN of you AND me
games.summary: Use "game" as a medium to showcase the world of "you/girl". Explore the truth of "you/girl/world" through the form of a "visual novel".

games.name: Fountains
games.summary: Master high-skilled combat to uncover the secrets of this war-torn empire and escape your captors. Carve your way through a gritty souls-like RPG set in a sprawling, interconnected world.

games.name: Au Revoir
games.summary: Play as Tristan and solve puzzles to recover human consciousnesses in the year 2071. Investigate environments, uncover secrets, and make choices that affect the ending. Explore a neon-noir world with a low poly aesthetic inspired by the 90s.

games.name: Solar Nations 2
games.summary: In this Grand Strategy game, you take control of the Solar System's Great Powers in 2092 and weather the storm of change as you navigate the uncertain waters of the future. Control the greatest military forces in the world and wage wars on an epic scale: outer space is yours to conquer!

games.name: Keep Driving
games.summary: An atmospheric management RPG about life on the open road. Pick up hitchhikers, work odd jobs, customize and repair your car, and map your route across the country. Use upgrades, skills and items to overcome challenges. And remember to take it easy. You’re young. You have time.

games.name: Dream Cage
games.summary: Robert battles early Alzheimer's and nightly sleep paralysis. Each night reveals fragments of his past. Uncover the truth and help him solve the mysteries haunting his mind.

games.name: Bulbo's Belief System
games.summary: Bulbo's Belief System is a puzzle-platformer where knowledge is both a tool and an obstacle. Bulbo believes everything he's told, letting him see, move, and interact, but he can forget! Erase walls from existence, ignore gravity and manage conflicting beliefs to solve cute mind-bending challenges.

games.name: Condo
games.summary: Condo is a surname. Notable people with the surname include: A.D. Condo (1872 – 1956), American cartoonist Ray Condo (1950 – 2004), Canadian rockabilly singer, saxophonist and guitarist George Condo (born 1957), American visual artist who works in painting, drawing, sculpture and printmaking Joseph P. Condo (1848 – 1923), American politician Jon Condo (born 1981), former American football long snapper

games.name: Detective VR
games.summary: Step into a thrilling narrative investigation in Virtual Reality! In DETECTIVE VR, you control time, collect crucial clues, and interview witnesses to unravel the plot.

games.name: Metal Garden
games.summary: Travel through an overgrown megastructure, and discover what lies beyond it. Metal Garden is a short, atmospheric singleplayer FPS game.

games.name: Paranormal Watcher
games.summary:
Paranormal Watcher invites you into the eerie world of paranormal hunting from a safe distance but don’t let the safety of the screen fool you. As a remote paranormal investigator, you’re tasked with monitoring haunted locations through surveillance cameras. Your mission: detect and report every unsettling anomaly that creeps into view, from flickering lights to ghostly apparitions.

Paranormal activity you capture isn’t always obvious objects might move, shadows could shift, and figures may emerge from the darkness. Only your sharp eye and quick reflexes can catch the disturbances in real time and fix the scene by filing accurate anomaly reports. But beware: the ghosts might be watching you, too.

games.name: Sandwalkers
games.summary: Sandwalkers is a roguelike turn-based exploration game. Build your team, traverse varied hostile environments, face countless dangers, and gain knowledge that will help you find and resurrect the Mother Tree Umama.

games.name: Clockwork Rabbit
games.summary: Tessa is employed at a textile factory as a mechanic. Solve cozy time manipulation puzzles and unravel a charming story about rabbit mechanics.

games.name: Hostile Lands
games.summary: A skill-based bullet-hell shooter with a TON of colorful characters, crunchy gunplay, and a planet that holds a grudge. Rescue your crew, reach the escape pod, and get out. The catch: every escape cranks up the Hostility toward those left behind.

games.name: Trash Goblin
games.summary: A cosy and moreish fantasy shop sim where you uncover, clean, upcycle and sell a vast variety of trinkets - both invaluable and unlovable - to a diverse cast of fascinating customers across a colourful fantasy city. Think Potionomics meets PowerWash Simulator, with a unique protagonist!

games.name: Dune: Awakening
games.summary: Dune: Awakening is an Open World Survival game with immersive adventure and RPG gameplay. Explore, build, craft, and unravel a cinematic Dune story alone or with friends as you rise from survival to greatness on the most legendary planet in the universe. Just remember: the sandworm always comes.

games.name: Open Drive
games.summary: Explore freely, collect the orbs, or try to beat your high score by making and landing jumps off ramps, mounds, and mountain tops in our 3 vehicles, Roadster, Trickster and Speedste

games.name: Resonant Blade
games.summary: Resonant Blade is a 2d sci-fi action adventure set in a dystopian world where sound is your greatest weapon. Battle the Dark Synths across a shattered planet using the power of Resonant Tones. Manipulate sound to solve puzzles, unleash devastating Triad abilities, and shape your own combat rhythm with customizable mods. With pixel art and fast paced gameplay, Resonant Blade challenges you to listen, adapt, and strike in harmony.

games.name: Brainrot Kart
games.summary: Brainrot Kart is a 1-8 player kart racing game. Race with the homies through chaotic maps like "Gooning Gateway" and "The Backrooms," and launch Hawk Tuahs at your rivals to throw them off course. Expect nonstop brainrot that’ll keep you on edge.

games.name: Star Racer
games.summary: Soar through concrete and cosmos in Star Racer, a retro-infused combat racer. Defy gravity, conquer wild Event Races, master the course editor, and crush the competition by any means necessary!

games.name: Artis Impact
games.summary: Artis Impact is a story-rich, adventure pixel RPG that features classic turn-based combat, upgrading your home, and exploring uniquely hand-drawn environments. Players will take on the role of official Akane, teaming up with Bot to unravel the mysteries of a future utopian world.

games.name: The Royal Writ
games.summary:
In The Royal Writ, you don't just play cards - you command them on the battlefield. Place your loyal subjects strategically as they advance toward the enemy, dealing damage. But beware: any card that reaches the enemy base before victory is permanently destroyed and removed from your deck for the rest of your run.

Sacrifice isn't just a risk - it's an essential strategy that creates memorable sub-stories with each run. Will you honor the subjects who gave everything for your cause? Every fallen card tells a tale, and their glory lives on in the legacy you build.

Lead an army of diverse warriors with interesting abilities that shape your strategy. Lead an army of adorable yet battle-hardened animals. Your ranks may comprise a frail and wounded flamingo, a short sighted chicken bowman, or even a crafty lizard who cheats death by only losing its tail! From the renegade red ants to the food taster cow, every card in your deck has a personality and purpose.

As they march toward glory or death, their individual stories become part of your kingdom's legacy, and their sacrifices will never be forgotten. You may even come across some peculiar creatures on your journey, like the crazed mantis dentist, the goat tactician or the impatient boar shopkeeper - just don’t ask them where they got their credentials.

games.name: Stick It to the Stickman
games.summary: Stick it to the Stickman is a physics-based brawler where you fight heaps of red stickmen to become the boss. Choose from hundreds of unique moves to construct the perfect combat machine and fight your way to the top of the corporate ladder.

games.name: Shinobi: Art of Vengeance - Starter Pack
games.summary:
The Shinobi: Art of Vengeance Starter Pack includes:
o Ghost Outfit
o Medic Lite Amulet
o 2000 Gold
*Gold is collected during gameplay and cannot be purchased separately.

games.name: Shinobi: Art of Vengeance

games.name: Catch Flex
games.summary:
Catch Flex is a full-body dance rhythm game played in front of a single camera, with no VR headset, no gamepad and no wearables. The camera sees your whole body, your moves are the input, and even the menus are gesture-controlled. Tracking runs locally on the device, or on a phone running the free Catch Flex: Controller app, which sends only movement data over the local network and never uploads video.

Six kinds of move make up a chart. Slash blocks in the direction of the arrow, catch rings with a hand or a foot, kick the balls or knock them back, stomp floor markers on the beat, ride slide trails to the end, and dodge obstacles by ducking, leaning or stepping over. Vol. 1 holds ten hand-charted original tracks from 96 to 150 BPM, house, electro and techno, all charted within reach of a real body with no jumping needed. An optional no-fail mode lets you move through a whole song without chasing a score.

Beyond the solo run there is local split-screen Versus for two players, global leaderboards and ten achievements. Custom levels are made in Catch Flex Editor, a free browser editor, and loaded into the game over Wi-Fi. The game also reads charts saved in other common level formats.

games.summary: Cognition Method is a story-driven, first-person puzzle game inspired by 2001: A Space Odyssey and Solaris. Discover the innovative mechanics of altering gravity and dive into the surreal setting. Find your way within a mysterious artifact and unveil a non-ordinary story.

games.name: Hifuu Bouenkyou
games.summary: A turn-based tactical RPG set in Gensokyo. Renko and Merry are separated the moment they stumble into this strange land. Build a party from a wide Touhou cast, raise them freely through Reincarnation and added skills, and follow a story that branches into three routes.

games.name: Devil's Liminal
games.summary: DEVIL'S LIMINAL is a branching slow-burn horror and yuri romance visual novel. In a life of poverty and violence, Margo Silva has one last summer in Arizona before college. Make choices to maintain a normal facade at work, romance an enigmatic new girl, and stop the occult plot to take Margo's life.

games.name: Gravitaws
games.summary: Gravitaws is a retro-style stage shooter inspired by Jaws (NES). Explore a dynamic overworld map. Collect research materials and upgrades, while evading an Alien invader. The story is delivered in classic style cutscenes. Fight bosses, survive, collect, fish, and bomb your way to victory.

games.name: Thanks, Light.
games.summary: 《THANKS, LIGHT.》 is a first-person puzzler where light reshapes physics and geometry — a glitch-laced mystery for the people who still keep a portal gun, a camera, and a perspective shift in their library.

games.name: Odd Town
games.summary: Odd Town is a retro-styled first-person adventure about being stuck in a town where everything feels just a little wrong. Explore a handcrafted, bite-sized open world, meet suspicious locals, take odd jobs, steal sandwiches, dodge cops, and uncover a conspiracy hidden under the pixels.

games.name: Leafblade
games.summary: An ARPG monster caretaker. Fight along the Mons you meet in your adventure to recover the bond between humans and Mons. Take care of your Mons in your farm, improving their combat and farm skills while ensuring their happiness.

games.name: Masters of Mayhem
games.summary: Masters of Mayhem is a free-to-play social deduction game with roguelike twists for 4–15 players. Work together to restore abandoned facilities and contain terrifying monsters — unless you're an impostor, in which case… have fun unleashing mayhem!

games.name: Velhodium Isle
games.summary: Velhodium Isle is a pixel-art boomer shooter in which you fight monsters in themed locations. Use weapons and magic to get through crowds of monsters and close the source of apocalyptic terrors. Disable shields, close the anomaly, and survive the brutal slaughter!

games.name: Being a DIK: Season 3
games.summary: Continue your story, deepen your relationships, and experience more songs, mini-games, achievements, and girls in this highly anticipated DLC.

games.name: Zombie Must Dead!
games.summary: Guizi Must Dead is a historical FPS with Tarkov-like gameplay and survival base-building. Infiltrate enemy lines, loot supplies, fight foes, and extract safely. Use resources to farm and fortify your base. Inspired by WWII guerrilla resistance, supports up to 4-player co-op.

games.name: Writer Tycoon
games.summary: Become a bestselling author in Writer Tycoon! Write books, grow your fanbase, and dominate the publishing industry. Track sales, manage multiple books at once, and adapt to trends. Will you create literary masterpieces or chase quick cash? Become a bestselling author and leave your mark!

games.name: Bloomon
games.summary: As the Agriculture Department's chosen (unlucky) one, you dreamed of graduating through farming. Instead, you're put in charge of a magical farm that attracts wild Bloomon raves. Now farming, fending off creatures, and handling quirky NPCs is your new normal.

games.name: Wizzo PopOut
games.summary: Wizzo Popout is a fast-paced, 3D top-down arena shooter for up to 4 players. Play as an arcane wizzo riding a bouncing magic bubble! Cast cool spells, dodge enemy blasts, and knock your rivals out of the arena in hilariously chaotic battles.

games.name: OneMore
games.summary: Can you tell which definitions are fake and which aren't? OneMore combines traditional word-building games with rounds where you try to pick the one true definition out of four - three of them built by an AI.

games.name: Eona
games.summary: Dive into Eona’s dark and strange tale. Survive the castle’s dangers—and Mélusine, the evil fairy who rules over it—for she has waited so long for a soul to torment. Escape this cursed place with your loot, hoping to save your mother.

games.name: Dying Reign
games.summary: Disease spreads across your lands, destabilizing regions, draining your resources, and testing your authority. Quarantine cities, draft troops, balance fear and order… but every choice comes at a cost. Hold the line for as long as you can. There is no victory, only survival…

games.name: Out Of Water
games.summary: OUT OF WATER is a visual novel about survival, myths, love, and choice. In 1 CE Watarholt, a quiet village prepares for winter - until bodies begin to surface. Shape your path through bonds, ancient horrors, and a fading peace. Will you fight, plead, or surrender to the waters?

games.name: Carnaval Marbles
games.summary: A tactical billiards roguelike inspired by French carom. Activate magical balls, tweak the rules by choosing talismans, and chase ever-higher scores. Each round is a challenge of physics and strategy. Find the balance between skill and luck…

games.name: Deck & Conn
games.summary: Take command of a nuclear-powered space corvette in a Cold War-flavored sci-fi campaign. Balance tactics, crew, and limited resources in a dynamic forever-war. Retro pixel art meets deep strategy fifteen minutes into the future of 1989.

games.name: Grail
games.summary: In this deckbuilder your deck fights for you. Upgrade, enchant and stickerize your cards to create clever cascading effects that defeat monsters and other players. Can you reach the Grail?

games.name: Wartheon
games.summary: Wartheon is a fast-paced 2D roguelike adventure set in a world on the brink of elemental collapse. Take control of one of four unique champions to match your taste. Customize your build, master your skills, and adapt to ever-changing layouts and enemy patterns.

games.name: Atomic Age
games.summary: Atomový věk je termín, který označuje dobu po roce 1945, kdy došlo ke shození prvních atomových bomb na japonská města Hirošima a Nagasaki, a také pojem, který označuje využití jaderné energie.
developers: Matthias Huber, Jill Peeters, Chris Kohler

games.name: DreamHero
games.summary: DreamHero is an overhead action-adventure game focusing on hero capture and diverse combat. Players can turn defeated enemies into controllable heroes, experiencing single-player stories, Roguelike, 1V1, 5V5, 20-player battle royales, and cooperative dungeons, blending strategy and operational fun.

games.name: Quetzal
games.summary: Control a Mesoamerican god who must escape the underworld in this challenging 2D pixel art platformer, dodging dangers to recover the sacred bones of humanity.

games.name: We Are Gum
games.summary: A puzzle game about goofy alien bubble gum trying to find their way home. They move together because they're aliens. They stick to things because they're bubble gum. They're silly and goofy because they're alien bubble gum! Don't question the science.

games.name: Craft. Sell. Goblin. Repeat.
games.summary: Build and manage your own goblin shop! Craft unique weapons and negotiate their prices! Send out explorers in to gather resources and become the richest merchant in the kingdom!

games.name: 8AM: The Warehouse
games.summary: "8AM: The Warehouse" is a suspense game set in a massive distribution center late at night. Monitor security cameras as strange incidents occur among the remaining workers — and decide if it’s exhaustion, system error, or something lurking between the shelves until 8:00 a.m.

games.name: Tales of Fear: Episode Zero
games.summary: Can you tell the difference between reality and tale? Experience three short horror stories and gather clues as to which are true and which are just part of our imagination. Immerse yourself in the protagonist's perspective and discover eerie tales from around the world.

games.name: Agebringer
games.summary: The Crimson Core has been stolen. The end of the world draws near. The thief hides high atop the Infinity Tower. Gather your courage, take up your weapons... The Red Crusade has begun.

games.name: Sol Protocol
games.summary: Sol Protocol is a VR coop Action Roguelike that allows you to physically pilot and manage a spaceship through dangerous stellar systems.

games.name: Angry Chef World Tour
games.summary: A fast paced mix of solitaire, mahjong, and match puzzles where explosive chefs challenge you to survive chaotic global kitchens.

games.name: Fatberg
games.summary: Tukovec je označení pro hroudy odpadu ve stokové síti, jejichž základem jsou tuky, oleje a vosky. Jméno je odvozeno od slova „tuk“ po způsobu, jakým je slovo ledovec odvozeno od ledu, a tímto způsobem také vzniklo v angličtině (fatberg od fat podobně jako iceberg z ice) a němčině (Fettberg, Fett, Eisberg, Eis). Z hlediska provozovatele stokové sítě představují problém, protože snižují průtok a mohou vést až k úplnému ucpání stoky.

games.name: Roadside Reseal
games.summary: A roadside store where the night never feels safe. Flickering lights, endless aisles, whispers from the dark. Each task feels like research into fear—you restock, you lock, you fight to keep the seal closed.The silence breaks, the air is heavy, and every moment is research into survival.

games.name: Critical Descent
games.summary: Master the high-stakes catch of the SpaceX Starship! Execute precise maneuvers to stick the landing in the tower’s arms, complete missions, compete on global leaderboards, and race your own ghost for the best time in Critical Descent.

games.name: WheelMates
games.summary: Dive into a 2-player co-op driving adventure with RC cars. Explore the professor’s home laboratory, solve puzzles, find hidden paths, and uncover what happened inside. With Friend’s Pass, your friend joins for free.

games.name: Crimson Moon
games.summary: You are Nephilim: a human-angel hybrid forged to defend humanity with supernatural powers. Fight solo or with a friend to annihilate demons and challenge brutal bosses in relentless melée combat. Rise, violent one. The prophecy is yours to fulfill.

games.name: Pix Football Manager
games.summary: PIX Football Manager is a nostalgic, casual football management simulator focused on scouting. Set your tactics, find hidden gems, and improve your facilities as you build a dynasty. With no visible player stats, you must spot talent yourself. Grab your clipboard, the game starts now.

games.name: Zad Archery
games.summary: Shoot down waves of targets, collect their loot, and grow stronger through upgrades and skills in this expanding incremental game.

games.name: Rogue Planet
games.summary: Rogue Planet is about speed, precision, and smooth motion. Use your momentum paired with the force of gravity to propel yourself from star to star, draining their power and fueling your ship as you go.

games.name: Steelarchy
games.summary: Steelarchy is a 3rd-person vehicle combat roguelike centered on deep loadouts. Face off against a modular fortress of rigid steel in explosive, chaotic battles. With deep meta-progression and shifting enemy tactics, no two matches are the same. Build. Customize. Upgrade. Embrace the carnage.

games.name: Venera 31
games.summary: Collect soil on Venus. Photograph the surface. Mark every rock. Log any unusual rock as harvester. Do not keep looking at it

games.name: Monster Ops 22
games.summary: Season 2 of Monster Ops! Black Ops soldiers Wraith and Tide know the world is against them, and they can only rely on each other. Two soldiers, forced to go rogue, with a desperate mission. There's no one left they can trust. A NSFW Gay Visual Novel Dating Sim put out in Monthly Episodes!

games.name: Fleet Hunters
games.summary: Find and sink battleships in a fast grid-based duel with real-time firing and retro visuals.

games.name: Legion Breaker
games.summary: A short active incremental game about defending from undead hordes. Wield an arsenal of spells, raise a holy army, and fight across ever-expanding battlefields. Start from nothing and progress through a massive skill tree to become the ultimate battlemage.

games.name: Dimension Defenders
games.summary: Tower Defense Redefined. Race friends in ranked 1v1, defend together in 2-player co-op, or solo your way through dimensions of escalating chaos.

games.name: Dreamscapes
games.summary: Investigate six haunted properties and listen to the voices of spirits trapped in nightmares. Collect fragmented clues and discover the correct combination of names, locations, and vessels. A multi-ending horror adventure where the outcome changes depending on your choices during the ritual.
developers: アイエダゲームズ（Aieda Games）
publishers: アイエダゲームズ（Aieda Games）

games.name: The Magician VR: The Cursed Wand
Cute Country
games.summary: You can build your own royal city. With over 100+buildings and massive home decorations, create an unparalleled kingdom. There are many mysterious races in the alternate world, and you can recruit humans, elves, beasts, or even rarer demons, dragons, etc. to build your kingdom together.

games.name: Carol and the Bells: A Cozy Strategy Game
games.summary: Carol and the Bells is a cozy, turn-based strategy roguelike Minesweeper-style game played on a grid. Build a deck to shape what appears on the board, manage risk, and decide when to ring the bell and move on.

games.name: Bojan
games.summary: You think YOU have it bad? Try getting thrown into a quest with nothing to protect yourself, except your wits! In this trial and error adventure game, patience is key. Explore the castle including 6* bosses and 18 levels complete with their own layouts, enemy paths, buttons, doors and coins!

games.name: Haunted Bar Simulator
games.summary: Run a cozy bar with friends by day. Serve strange customers and survive the horror by night.

games.name: NoodlePunk
games.summary: Forced into a corporate-mandated work program, you must run a noodle shop in a dying cyberpunk city to pay off your crushing debt. Prepare orders fast, manage your ingredients, and upgrade your operation while keeping up with relentless customer drones.

games.name: Salvation: Echoes of War
games.summary: Explore a haunting purgatory in this third-person stealth adventure. Injured and trapped in a nightmare after war, solve puzzles, outsmart enemies, and rely on your loyal companion to find a way back to life. Can you escape your past and survive the echoes of war?

games.name: Monke Survivor
games.summary: You are a Monke beating up endless waves of office workers with brutal melee combat and ragdoll physics. Smash props for rare buffs, stack game-breaking items and compete on the Global Leaderboards in this aggressive action-roguelite.

games.name: Aerial_Knight's MrFreezy
games.summary: Play as a woman who's an axe-wielding serial killer in this light-hearted puzzle game about decapitating men, uncover the disturbing story behind New Detroit’s infamous serial killer, Mr. Freezy.

games.name: Unnamed Pogo Game
games.summary: Trapped in a surreal world, your only way out is to bounce your way to the top. Master brutal physics, survive impossible obstacles, and face the climb alone or with friends in this unforgiving pogo-stick challenge. One bad landing is all it takes to lose it all. Can you reach the peak?

games.name: Star Trek: Voyager - Across the Unknown: Equinox
games.summary: Contains the U.S.S. Equinox as playable ship (exclusively in a new, upcoming game mode) along with new heroes, technologies and more

games.name: Train Station Tycoon
games.summary: A punctual train is never an accident. In this immersive management game, take control of a bustling railway station with your friends. Assign platforms, coordinate teams, expand your infrastructure from 2 to 30 tracks, and manage real-time crises to keep the traffic flowing smoothly!

games.name: Digital Survivor
games.summary: A neon bullet-heaven survivors roguelite. Outrun the swarm as 4 hunted programs, forge 20 weapons into ultimate forms, master build-defining synergies, raid extraction vaults, climb leaderboard seasons — and face ROOT, the administrator that wants you deleted.

games.name: First Light
games.summary: As a Search and Rescue officer, you're no stranger to remote areas. After a freak blizzard strands two people in a remote cabin, you've been sent to help. Play tandem stories of past and present, all while being hunted by a malevolent being of winter and hunger in this story-driven survival horror.

games.name: Absolution
games.summary: Absolution is a first-person psychological horror experience where you face THE JUDGE as they peel apart your very soul. Uncover dark truths and navigate moral dilemmas as you're questioned about your past deeds. Every lie has consequences.

games.name: Insurance Fraud
games.summary: A blackjack roguelike where hands pay for their shape, not just their total. Build absurd combos from upgrades and cards that have no business in a deck, then take five dealers for everything they’ve got. The insurance is not entirely legal.

games.name: Pro Wrestling Tycoon
games.summary: Pro Wrestling Tycoon is a day-by-day wrestling promotion management sim. Book shows, manage contracts and storylines, negotiate network deals, and compete in a living industry of rival companies, news, and backstage drama. Deep modding and Steam Workshop support let you shape the universe.

games.name: Launch Them All
games.summary: A high-stakes turn-based missile duel where every shot matters. Spy, bluff, and deploy powerful tactical abilities to destroy enemy military assets while avoiding civilian casualties. Casual strategy in an approachable, classic style!

games.name: Gun Shop: Tidy Up
games.summary: Gun Shop: Tidy Up — a tidy-up simulator where you need to put more than 2,700 items back in their places. Pick up, arrange, upgrade and just relax while restoring order in a gun shop.

games.name: Dub Together
games.summary: Up to six players redub video clips and give them a whole new meaning. You record the scene, then watch every result together and vote. With voice effects, a built-in clip editor and live voting from your Twitch chat.

games.name: Close the Sky
games.summary: A real-time war of air defence and industry. Build the economy, bury it, and layer SAMs over what you cannot hide. Read a fading intel picture of the enemy base and aim every missile yourself. Break their will to fight before they break yours.

games.name: The Death Game Report
games.summary: Identify how every participant in the death game died, and submit your report.

games.name: Woolmates
games.summary: Two balls of wool, one thread, one big adventure! Jump, swing and puzzle your way together through more than 50 interwoven levels — in co-op or multiplayer.

games.name: Plushy Store Tidy Up
games.summary:
Turn a messy plushy store into a cozy little world of perfectly organized cuddly toys!

In Plushy Store Tidy Up, every plushy has a place but figuring out exactly where everything belongs is up to you. Pick up plushies, carry and organize them, solve satisfying shelf puzzles, and gradually restore the entire store.

As you tidy your way through the store, you'll discover new plushies, encounter trickier layouts, unlock new areas, and improve your abilities to make organizing faster and more satisfying.

games.name: Dvor
games.summary: Dvor, dříve Dvor na Uni (srbsky Двор) je vesnice a sídlo stejnojmenné opčiny v Chorvatsku. Nachází se ve výběžku na jihu Sisacko-moslavinské župy, těsně u bosenských hranic, na soutoku řek Žirovnica a Una, asi 3 km severozápadně od bosenského Novi Gradu, 22 km jihozápadně od Hrvatské Kostajnice a asi 50 km jihovýchodně od Gliny. V roce 2011 žilo ve vesnici 1 406 obyvatel, v celé opčině pak 5 570 obyvatel, přičemž většina obyvatel byla srbské národnosti. V opčině se nachází celkem 63 obydlených vesnic.

games.name: Vector Surge
games.summary:
Vector Surge is a fast, uncompromising twin-stick arena shooter set inside a reactive signal field. Move, aim, dash and detonate your way through geometric swarms while the grid bends, pulses and fractures around every collision.

Almost everything you see is constructed live. Ships, enemies, projectiles, formations, effects, grid reactions and combat patterns are drawn from procedural vector geometry rather than conventional sprite sheets. Encounters remix enemy families, elites, hazards and formations on the fly. In Universe mode, procedural objectives, loot, mutations, routes and escalating sector conditions turn that same arena into a long-form expedition that is different every time you enter it.

There are no safe corners. Your multiplier is always fading. The best score is always one riskier kill away.

games.name: Laura Bailey Mysteries
games.summary: Join mystery writer Laura Bailey as she investigates two gripping murder mysteries. Search crime scenes for clues, interrogate suspects, solve puzzles, reconstruct torn notes, and make your final accusation. Includes a murder mystery-themed card game.

games.name: Not Quite Dead
games.summary: Open world zombie survival Coop game with base building, looting, crafting, vehicles, and exploration
aliases: Not Quite Dead: Open World Survival

games.name: Pop Float a-way
games.summary: POP Float a-way is a multiplayer party platformer for up to 8 players where you dash through obstacle-packed tracks by yelling into your mic, knock rivals off course, and try not to pop before you cross the finish line.

games.name: Alien Breed 35th Anniversary
games.summary: THE BREED IS BACK! Celebrate 35 years of Alien Breed with the definitive collection. Featuring 6 classic games, interactive archives, modern controls, visual enhancements, co-op multiplayer, Online Rush Mode and Horde Mode, bringing the complete sci-fi horror legacy back to your screens.

games.name: Memeology Club
games.summary: For 3-6 players! Play from anywhere in the world. Get together online, talk with built-in voice chat, and laugh like you're all sitting at the same table.

games.name: Smile Your Day
games.summary: Two Players, Two Perspectives, One Cult. You and a friend explore the opulent cult known as Lifted Spirits in Boston, 2014. One player is the Hacker, controlling the cult's cameras and communications. With their aid, the other player stealths around the office hoping to discover the cult's secrets.

games.name: Echo Harvest
games.summary: Build settlements, command the Echoes of former lives, and race against a corruption consuming the world. Echo Harvest is a colony roguelite where every failed timeline becomes part of the history that shapes the next.

games.name: Armada Fighters
games.summary: Armada Fighter is a fast-paced arcade shoot ’em up focused on reflexes, movement, and intense action.

games.name: Galactum Meridian
games.summary:
Galactum Meridian is a research-first space strategy game about leading humanity’s first deep survey beyond Sol.

Command the ISA Far Horizon, a deep-survey cruiser sent into nearby star systems where the map is incomplete, the data is uncertain, and every discovery changes what comes next. You are not here to paint borders across space with fleets. You are building the first working picture of humanity’s interstellar future.

Galactum Meridian begins with real astronomical structure: nearby stars, confirmed exoplanet data where available, and catalog-backed system information drawn from sources such as the NASA Exoplanet Archive and other astronomy datasets.

But this is not a dry simulator. Known science gives the galaxy its backbone. From there, the game layers survey results, modeled possibilities, strange worlds, and speculative discoveries into systems you can investigate. Galactum Meridian brings in more than 10,000 actual stars from current star catalogs for you to travel to and investigate, updated frequently as new data becomes available.

Some things are observed. Some are inferred from what we know. Some are fictional, mysterious, and waiting for your expedition to discover them.

games.name: A Girl A Rain
games.summary: After pushing open the door, or perhaps before, the world has transformed. Will you be able to escape this rainstorm? Or will you stay...?

games.name: Just a Stupid Room
games.summary: Explore 30 rooms filled with original puzzles in this first-person puzzle game. Observe, experiment, and doubt the obvious. The door won't open itself.

games.name: In & Out
games.summary: IN & OUT is a first-person puzzle game where the clues on screen lead you into the real world. Search the Internet, consult books and connect what you discover to solve Project ISO’s tests. Research is part of the game. The final answer is yours

games.name: The Cat in Yellow
games.summary: An adorable cat turns creepy. Take care of it, explore the house, and survive the night.

games.name: Star Trucker: Cultivation Content Pack
games.summary:
The Cultivation Content Pack adds unique trailers, cargo and corporations alongside a brand new business venture led by horticultural specialist Ada Greenway.

Patch delicate domes, keep habitats stocked with nutrients, and monitor your clients' crops as you unlock more than 30 themed customization rewards, including dashboard items, lighting options, palettes, and trims.

games.name: Chaos Warrior
games.summary: Chaos Warrior is a retro JRPG inspired by the NES era. Fight deadly monsters, explore dangerous locations, and gain the strength to become the hero that saves the world!

games.name: Arknights: Endfield - Update 1.5: Dreamscape of Wind and Snow
games.summary:
Version 1.5 of Arknights: Endfield includes:
• New Operators: Typhoeus
• New Free Operator Event: Purrchena
• New Weapons: New signature 6★ weapon for Typhoeus
• New Areas: Snowy Forest, Suiming
• New Story Content: New story chapters and missions
• New Systems: RE-Factor Headhunting
• New Events and Rewards

games.name: BlameChat
games.summary:
BlameChat is a browser-based interactive collection of multiplayer party games played in a shared room. One player hosts and puts a room code on screen; everyone else joins from a phone, tablet, or computer browser. No download or account is required to play.

Most games set the host against everyone else, with the room's move decided by majority vote — the host plays the board while the room votes its reply. Others are played between all participants. Supported player counts range from 2 to 100 depending on the game.

Games include board games such as Chess, Checkers, Connect Four and Battleships; word and guessing games such as Hangman and Spectrum; and social games such as Cards vs Room, Jury Duty and Burn or Bot.

games.name: Headrush Arena
games.summary:
Play the fastest, quirkiest VR Shooter on Quest. The AI bots have gone rogue, harvesting humanity’s knowledge and suppressing creativity. Your mission: Join the rebellion, blast the bots and take that knowledge back. Every bot you terminate drops valuable Knowledge-Orbs, absorb them and your head gets bigger, your voice gets higher and then you can jump further. The more knowledge you carry, the more powerful and ridiculous you become... But don’t get greedy: bank your Knowledge-Orbs before the bots take you out and steal them back.

Play solo or multiplayer across Free-for-All, Team Deathmatch and PvE, using shields, shotguns, miniguns, speed boosts and the Hack Gun to turn the arena into chaos. Jump straight into Arcade for pure combat, or play MindTap, where getting eliminated isn’t necessarily the end: Answer a question correctly, choose an upgrade and jump straight back in for revenge. Launching with two arenas, three game modes, an army of increasingly unhinged AI bots and one dangerously oversized head. Destroy the bots. Reclaim the knowledge. Gain super-powers and a massive bonce!

games.name: Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege: Operation Splitfire
aliases: Tom Clancy's Rainbow Six Siege: Year 11, Season 3
games.summary: New dangers emerge and Rainbow Six Siege launches Operation Split Fire to identify these threats. Flying back to his Egyptian homeland to assist, Operator Noor brings his worldly knowledge, tactical acumen, and his Horus Lance gadget, a projectile that can attach on ballistic shields or surfaces and then emit flames!

games.name: Reliquary
games.summary: Reliquary is a free-to-play online trading card game with over 1,000 cards. Build decks around a hero, summon Reliquaries from your Extra Deck when the board is right, and call forth Incarnates by offering your monsters. Play ranked and quick matches against other players, climb the solo Tower, draft a deck from scratch, challenge friends, and watch or replay duels. Available in nine languages.

games.name: Fjordal
games.summary: A Viking colony sim with production chains and resource management. Establish a Norse village and refine the land's resources. Pay tribute to the King, or grow strong enough to fight back.

games.name: Corposlop
games.summary: Corposlop is an automation game that lives on your desktop. Harvesting resources using bureaucracy, and refine it into components to feed the corporate machine. Make advanced factories and efficient pipelines to make the most out the limited land you have.

games.name: Stream Clicker
games.summary: Stream Clicker is a community-driven browser clicker game built around Twitch streamers. Each streamer has their own community page where viewers click together to grow their community, complete timed missions, unlock trophies and compete in global and seasonal leaderboards.

games.name: Čtyřka
games.summary:
Čtyřka is mariáš – the Czech trick-taking card game – for four players, in the browser against three computer opponents.

The game is usually played two against two, but the partnership is hidden: the forehand picks trumps by naming a card, so only one other player knows whose side they are on, and the rest have to work it out from the play. Around that sits the bidding that can multiply the stake before a card is led.

The game is free to play and installs as an app. It deals every contract the rules allow, keeps the money, speaks the calls aloud, and tells you why a card is not legal – or lets you break the rule on purpose, if you ask it to.

It is a rewrite of the Windows shareware of the same name, released in 1999. The card play is that game's improved AI.

games.name: Explorers of Palan
games.summary: Battle in turns: Gain EXP to become stronger with each victory as you calm agitated creatures. Defeated in battle? Don’t worry — besides recovery skills and items, your companion Feyrie can restore you.

games.name: Bounty Trail
games.summary: It is the fall of 1881 and your bounty hunting agency is in dire straits. Your no-good partner, Edward Thorne, took out a $10 000 loan and then took off. The debt must be paid by the end of the year so you’ve got no time to waste. Pick a target from the board, mount up, and set out on the Bounty Trail!

games.name: Fillo
games.summary:
Fillo is a browser-based multiplayer word game where a host creates a room and players join with a code. Each round, everyone completes the same fill-in-the-blank prompt. Players score highest by matching exactly one other person, while bigger group matches earn fewer points.
After each round, answers are revealed for reactions, and at the end Fillo awards players based on the room’s funniest, sharpest, and most memorable patterns.

games.name: Night Shift: Something Is Wrong
games.summary: Your night shift was supposed to be simple. Watch the cameras, patrol the building, and report anything that changes. But the longer you stay, the less certain you become of what is real. Follow procedure. Pay attention. Something is wrong. Endless Mode and Speed Run Mode included.

games.name: Ludus Deceptor
games.summary: Ludus Deceptor is a dark roguelike card game about risk, deception, and cursed bets. Battle at the card table, build powerful combinations, use bonuses, curses, interactive cards, and various items to escape prison, survive the royal court, and claim the throne.

games.name: Game Store Cleanup
games.summary: A cozy-chaotic first-person sim about restocking a wrecked game store. Sort every scattered item back onto its correct shelf and watch a total mess become a tidy, ready-to-open shop again.

games.name: Chessplosion
games.summary: Chessplosion reinvents chess with an explosive Giant Pawn that occupies a 2×2 area. Face the AI or other players, solve puzzles, and customize special rules to create tactical, unpredictable matches filled with surprising turns.

games.name: Fickle Allies
games.summary: Collect and deposit every crystal to escape in this first-person multiplayer thriller game. Form shifting alliances, steal from rivals, protect your haul, or eliminate threats as you explore a mansion, subway, and abandoned facility where trust never lasts.

games.name: Magic Shop Simulator
games.summary:
Magic shop simulator: is a first-person, open-world sandbox simulation game where players manage and expand a magical store. The core gameplay revolves around foraging for ingredients, brewing potions, and selling goods to customers. Players can automate their shops daily operations by hiring workers to help handle foraging, brewing potions, and serving customers.

A central mechanic of the game is a risk- and-reward system involving four ward stones that protect the shop from monsters. Players must try to balance the cost between keeping the stones charged, allowing threats into the plaza, so they can gather the materials for their shop, and risking their shops risk reputation.

games.name: Match: Isekai Journey
games.summary: Welcome to Match: Isekai Journey—where your "magical destiny" is to align three identical icons before you run out of turns.

games.name: Cage Grind
games.summary: Cage Grind is a free, browser-based MMA career simulation. Players create a fighter, choose opponents, and set pace, offense, and tactics for simulated bouts decided by knockouts, submissions, or judges’ decisions. Victories earn permanent attribute upgrades, while followers, sponsors, collectible gear, and Aura shape career progression. A shared roster, asynchronous player challenges, world championship bouts, and the Cage Feed connect individual careers. Open Gym offers practice matchups and coaching reports without affecting official records.

games.name: My Zombies Are Hungry
games.summary: Grow a handful of zombies into a city-eating swarm of hundreds in this darkly comic incremental auto-battler. Launch short raids, buy permanent upgrades, build new zombie types from swappable body parts, and devour settlements while humanity escalates from police to tanks and airstrikes.

games.name: Lost and Found: What if I Come and Find It
games.summary: "Lost and found - What if I come and find It" is a first-person narrative game whose story will take you to the depths of working in a great corporation. After finishing your studies, you have achieved an internship in the maintenance department of SilverCup, the most renowned technological company in your city. A unique opportunity which will bring you a promising future.

games.name: He Who Watches
games.summary: Walk on walls. Manipulate gravity. Discover secrets. In this first-person puzzle game, delve deep into an ancient labyrinth of intricate conundrums, seeking an imprisoned god at the centre.

games.name: Terminal Error
games.summary: Preyed upon by grotesque experiments, you must find a way out of the research centre alive in this first-person point-and-click horror game. However, to escape, you must first delve hopelessly deeper into the maddening corridors of the facility.

games.name: Category 6
games.summary: Brace yourself for the ultimate open-world survival craft experience. Welcome to a world shattered by the relentless fury of the most colossal hurricane in history. You are thrust into the eye of the storm, tasked with not just enduring, but thriving in the aftermath of nature's wrath.

games.name: Demon Kingdom
games.summary: A dark narrative card game about the short path to power — and the price you’ll pay.

games.name: Moonlighter 2: The Endless Vault
games.summary: Experience an action-RPG with roguelike elements where you live the double life of an adventurer and a merchant. Dive into vibrant dimensions to fight enemies, gather loot, and manage your backpack. Rebuild your shop and turn profits into gear for the next adventure!

games.name: Hashire Hebereke: EX
games.summary: Hashire Hebereke: EX is a modern remake of the 1994-released Super Famicom racing action game Hashire Hebereke by SUNSOFT. Players can choose from comical and cute characters like series protagonist Hebe and partake in extreme races across unique stages. While carrying over elements from the original game, it will add a new Time Attack mode, new characters, and new stages, as well as four-person online multiplayer support.

games.name: Top Check
games.summary: Collect cards, build decks, and battle fierce opponents in Top Check, a roguelike deckbuilder and online collectable card game inspired by the classic game of chess. With many unique pieces and abilities, only the best strategists will emerge victorious. Do you have what it takes to reach the top?

games.name: Galactic Prospectors
games.summary: Galactic Prospectors is a 2D Space Survival Sandbox set 200 years in the future when all planets in the solar system were destroyed by a rogue AI (you can play as the Rogue AI, or as a regular Astronaut out in the universe). Take on the universe against rogue AIs, other humans and other life forms, all while trying to stay alive. Even as an AI if you wish to play as such, you too must survive the harsh elements of Space. Resources are still needed, requiring you to build factories, upgrade and maintain your ships and stations, and to live.

games.name: Fofumia
games.summary: Welcome to Fofumia! Clean up the mess left by the adorable Fofunos - playful, hyperactive one-eyed kittens who love scattering toys and objects everywhere. It's up to you to set everything straight...

games.name: Slime Well
games.summary: Slime Well is a Metroidvania-style puzzle game where players take control of a slime, skillfully using its abilities to solve puzzles, explore, and ultimately uncover the truth of this world.

games.name: Tyr
games.summary: Tyr is a tank shooter where strategy beats twitch reflexes. Pilot heavy-armored vehicles with unique capabilities and upgrade them as you battle for victory with your team.

games.name: Cursed Frontier
games.summary: A 2D platformer shooter with a somber linoleum-inspired art style, where you’ll face funeral creatures in a haunting Wild West setting.

games.name: Lost Sanity: Cthulhu
games.summary:
Lost Sanity: Cthulhu is a horror and exploration game where each chapter is a new story.

A group of teenagers get together to tell horror stories, and each story is represented as a chapter of "Lost Sanity."
Starting with the tale of "Cthulhu," a cosmic entity that lies dormant in their city submerged in the sea, occultists gather with the goal of awakening the entity.

You play as Megan Claire, a former reporter, who wakes up in a prison-like place. Your goal is to understand what is happening there and escape as quickly as possible!

games.name: Staged
games.summary: Staged is a co-op first-person physics party game for 1–4 players. Play mischievous goblins, rebuild stage sets from reference photos, haul oversized props through tight backstage spaces, and get every placement right before the curtain rises.

games.name: Code My Robot Vacuum
games.summary: Code My Robot Vacuum is a game where you learn to code while cleaning! Program your robot vacuum to solve increasingly complex cleaning challenges. Navigate mazes and upgrade your robot's abilities. Perfect for beginners learning to code and puzzle enthusiasts who love logical problem-solving.

games.name: Duck Collector
games.summary: Not just luck, a skill-based claw machine with real physics, arcade minigames, and dozens of ducks to collect.

games.name: Divider Dave
games.summary:
Why be alone when you can be by yourself?
Dave wakes up in a facility. He can clone himself. A lot of (almost) identical Daves and a way out that requires all of them.

Divider Dave is a slapstick puzzle-platformer for puzzle fans and casual players alike where cloning yourself is the solution to everything. Launch your clones, stack them, turn them into boxes. Every copy of Dave is a tool, a platform, and a potential sacrifice. He doesn't mind. Probably...

games.name: Eldara
games.summary: Eldara is a single-player dark fantasy idle RPG inspired by classic MMORPGs. Train 17 interlocking skills — mining, smithing, fishing, combat, cultivating and more — to hunt monsters across the realm, raid dungeons, and challenge three mythic world bosses. Collect over 100 unique items, complete dozens of achievements, and tame 16 wild pets. Progress continues whether you play actively or step away, with rebirth and prestige systems for the endgame.

games.name: Bombanana!
games.summary: Chaotic bomb disposal fun with friends & monkeys! Work together as a 3-player co-op team of blind, deaf, and mute monkeys. Each player has only part of the needed information. Communicate, solve puzzles, and race against the clock. Can you defuse the bombs before they explode?

games.name: Guilds of Mountgate
games.summary: A living online RPG where economy, progression and world events shape your journey. Build your character, trade, craft and explore a persistent world that evolves over time — whether you are online or not.

games.name: Molluscarium
games.summary: Relax and collect over 500 unique molluscs in this cozy idle game. Watch larvae grow into stunning adults in real-time, customize vibrant aquatic habitats across 9 themed packs, and discover rare species from garden snails to deep-sea cephalopods.

games.name: Heroes of Retribution
games.summary: A rogue-like RPG set in a ruined world. Take on the role of a tank commander. Discover other heroes and factions. Upgrade your tank, acquire new skills, and find forgotten relics in this devastated world. Choose your side, get stronger and become humanity's savior.

games.name: ShipShaper
games.summary: ShipShaper is a creative game about the simple joy of designing ships. Nothing more. Nothing less. Export to Bulwark, 3D print, or use in your own games with a free commercial license.

games.name: Megastore: Tidy Up Together
games.summary: Megastore: Tidy Up Together is a cozy sorting game for solo or co-op play. Take on 5 stores at any difficulty, from a Toy Store with 3,555 items to a massive Megastore with 13,357 items. Pick up, sort, shelve, and get ready to open!

games.name: Beggar Simulator: Istanbul
games.summary:
Beggar Simulator: Istanbul is a first-person job simulation set on the streets of a contemporary Istanbul. The player controls a man who is not destitute but performs destitution for money, renting a costume and an act each morning and choosing where to work. A traffic junction, a covered bazaar, a mosque courtyard, a nightlife avenue and a metro concourse each draw a different crowd and reward a different approach.

Begging is handled through a dialogue menu whose lines are weighed against the passer-by being read, while the act that was rented restricts which lines can be used without breaking character. Municipal enforcement officers, pickpockets and rival beggars press on the working day, and the money earned goes on food, on a place to sleep and on the next day's rent for the act. Hunger, illness and sleep carry over between days.

games.name: Labhorror
games.summary: A first-person horror set in a locked mansion the size of a city block. Carry three scrolls out of a 200-metre labyrinth while a man with an axe walks its corridors. Your flashlight is the only thing he will not walk into.

games.name: Martha's Dolls 2
games.summary: Return to the decaying halls of the Martha Estate in this bone chilling sequel to the viral horror hit. As an urban explorer obsessed with the "Disappeared," you step into a nightmare where the porcelain faces aren't just decorations they are silent hunters.

games.name: Go Next!
games.summary: Grow exponentially stronger as you survive hordes of monsters across 9 different worlds. Gather resources, level up, build your skill tree, and parkour your way out of chaos!

games.name: The Last Curse
games.summary: The Last Curse is a first-person psychological horror game. Uncover terrifying secrets, solve intricate puzzles, and navigate dark, atmospheric environments where fear lurks around every corner. Trust your instincts to survive the night.

games.name: The Gutter
games.summary: Descend into 1801 China as an opium-addicted father who sold his daughter, now prowling a burned-out floating brothel for treasures. As you touch relics of the dead, violent memories reveal a sickening truth: the greatest monster in this tale has always been you.

games.name: The No Jumpscare Show
games.summary:
Welcome to The No Jumpscare Show!
Brought to you by Polypaw, this is a narrative comedy short horror game that promises a 100% jumpscare-free experience! ...Hopefully.

This release is the first part of the story, offering a playtime of around 30 minutes.

In a world where the paranormal is normal, the horror industry has gotten incredibly lazy.

Jumpscares have become the most boring cliché on earth, and Illy is completely unimpressed. She signs up for a shady haunted house promising true psychological horror... without jumpscares? At least, that's what the waiver says.

Run by yours truly, "Thingy the Thing," the kicker is this: if you don't get scared, you'll win $10,000!!

With Illy's constant pushing... things will not end well. And the show will h̷a̷v̷e̷ NOT HAVE ANY JUMPSCARES = )

games.name: Depths' Tale
games.summary: Depths’ Tale is a short first-person cosmic horror experience about a lone fisherman working the night shift. Far from shore, only the waves keep you company... for now.
