games.summary: You and up to 4 players are victims of a horror show, having to collaborate to solve multiple puzzles and use cooperative dynamics to find your way out, while surviving the creatures lurking around, hunting you, watching out for haunted events that can be a blessing or a bane for your survival.

games.name: The Walking Dead: Streets of Survival - Arcade Apocalypse Pack
games.summary:
The Arcade Apocalypse Pack includes:
• 2 Weapon Skins - Tactical Magnum and Unlockable Mystery Weapon Skin
• 1 Character Skin - Civic Republic Military Rick
• The Walker Pit - Endless Survival Combat Mode
• HELL ON EARTH Difficulty mode - Hardcore Mode without Checkpoints
• Digital Soundtrack

games.name: NASCAR 26
games.summary: The official game of NASCAR is back and better than ever with NASCAR 26! Battle your way through all four NASCAR National Series in Career, Quick Race, Championship, Multiplayer, or our all new mode featuring The Chase!

games.name: Amanatsu Location
games.summary:
You visit a private resort on a southern island.
There, you find several girls enjoying their vacation...
The character creation feature has been revamped!
The feel remains the same, but even more beautiful girls await your encounter!

In addition to normal communication, you can tease them with massages and water guns, and sometimes share intimate moments to deepen your bond with each other.
You can fully enjoy a sweet and stimulating summer!

games.name: Paver: Tidy Up Together
games.summary: Transform a chaotic area into a satisfying work of art. Follow the paver layout plan and place 4,064 pavers in their correct locations. Work alone or together with friends, develop useful skills, and restore the plaza piece by piece.

games.name: Cat a Loop
games.summary: Lead a cat in a tactical roguelike auto-battler! Fight your way through 4 dangerous biomes, combine 200+ items to create powerful synergies, and unlock passive abilities. Unravel the mystery of the portal, defeat unique bosses, and save the feline world from the encroaching evil!

games.name: Olimpia OT
games.summary: Olimpia OT is a Greek mythology-inspired MMORPG that combines classic Tibia-style gameplay with modern RPG systems and original content. Players explore a dangerous world inspired by the myths of Olympus, choose their vocation and divine allegiance, fight monsters and powerful bosses, discover dungeons, craft and upgrade equipment, and develop their characters through unique progression systems. Olimpia OT features eight distinct vocations, Divine Paths, a Devotion system, custom combat mechanics, ranked monsters, crafting, item upgrades, arenas, PvE and PvP content, and a persistent online world.

games.name: Neural Maze
games.summary: 2 neurons. 2 joysticks. One brain must control both at the same time: yours. Guide your lost neurons through increasingly convoluted mazes – reversed controls, power cuts, memory mode – under the watchful eye of an overwhelmed doctor. Is your brain ready?

games.name: Pillagers: The Poisoned Throne
games.summary: Lead a band of goblin rebels through a brutal turn-based tactics campaign. Train your roster, rebuild your fortress, manage scarce resources, and survive a war where every mistake can leave your army weaker than before.

games.name: Black Hole Grow Forever
games.summary: Shatter drifting matter, feed a growing black hole, and build a sprawling web of permanent upgrades. Every short run unlocks wilder skills, from screen-wide lasers to chain lightning, bombs, and gravity.

games.name: Medieval Squad Tactics
games.summary: This game is focused on turn based tactical combats. The complexity of the game comes from having to carefully manage your various formations in order to defeat your enemies. Carefully plan your actions to win the battle.

games.name: Runner Gunner
games.summary: Race through the streets in this third-person action runner, dodging obstacles or shooting them out of the way. Collect points, buy powerful upgrades, and optimize your run to beat your high score.

games.name: Catskill Mine: 10,000ft Below
games.summary: A single-player horror game set in a decrepit roadside mine attraction. Descend to uncover the mine's dark history, and find a way to escape from the lurking horrors within.

games.name: Youkashi no Haitokuai: Junshin Tenshi ha Dakarete Iromeku
Backlot: Hollywood Studio Tycoon
games.summary: A deep Hollywood studio simulation, 1930 to the streaming age. A back lot, a million dollars and no pictures. Commission scripts, sign stars to seven-year contracts, book dates against rival studios, and survive television, home video and everything else that came for the movies.

games.name: Cozy Fishing Life
games.summary: A cozy little fishing game that lives on your desktop. Adorable animals fish on your wallpaper while you work — collect 300+ fish, grow an aquarium, build your boat fleet, and relax. Idle-friendly, wholesome, always cozy

games.name: Eternity Lost: Mystery of Aurum - Collector's Edition
games.summary: Follow a mysterious girl into a hidden underground city built centuries ago by a secret order of Alchemists. Reveal a dangerous conspiracy, search for clues and items, solve puzzles and mini-games, and uncover the secrets of a forgotten world. Will you bring truth to the light?

games.name: The Rhapsody of Zephyr Remastered
games.summary: 28 years later, Cyrano’s tragic journey of revenge begins anew. The War of Genesis: The Rhapsody of Zephyr returns in a remastered edition with HD 16:9 widescreen, full voice acting, and quality-of-life improvements. Rediscover an epic tale of tragedy and destiny.

games.name: Megastore Chaos
games.summary: Turn massive messes into perfect order. Sort 30,281 items across 6 unique stores — from supermarkets and bookstores to electronics, games, wine and shoes — while unlocking skills that make organizing faster and more satisfying.

games.name: Skyreach
games.summary: Climb a 960-metre tower in this single-player 3D precision platformer. Every platform moves, crumbles or blinks on a rhythm you can learn. There are no checkpoints and no fall damage: one misjudged jump can drop you all the way back to the ground.

games.name: Aetherfall
games.summary: Jump, explore, and master new mechanics as you make your way deeper into the world of Aetherfall.

games.name: Dead Margin
games.summary: Survival is optional, rent is mandatory. Team up in Dead Margin, a brutal 1-4 player co-op horror. Whisper to survive, avoid anomalies, and scavenge scraps. Sell it to pay the greedy customer. Out here, everything has a price. Especially you.

games.name: Poopy's Playland
games.summary: Play as a grieving mother whose child went missing in a playland one year ago. Use your trusty flashlight to navigate through the dark, solve replayable puzzles to progress forward, and hide from the unstable killer mascots! Investigate the mysteries and find out the truth...

games.name: We Are Sisters
games.summary: We Are Sisters is a psychological horror experience that takes you deep beneath the forests of Eastbane. Solve puzzles and uncover dark secrets as you venture further underground, drawing ever closer to discovering what happened to your childhood friend, Aleks

games.name: Day Off Simulator
games.summary: Unwind and have a blast in the "Day Off Simulator"! Give your boss a slap, relax with interactive musical instruments, and enjoy various leisure activities. A unique blend of excitement, relaxation, and creativity awaits you!

games.name: Toonsouls
games.summary: Create, play, and share your own chaotic 2D platforming levels! Inspired by classic cartoons, powered by your creativity, and fueled by one simple truth: My game is good. The algorithm just ignores me.

games.name: Sperme d’Éros: Garden of Earthly Delights
games.summary: This DLC will expand the universe of the original Visual Novel, Gardens of Earthly Delights. We will follow this story from the point of view of the couple Eros and Venus. We will follow their materialistic and carnal desires as they delight in pleasures in our real world.

games.name: Rusted Awakening
games.summary: A gothic horror shooter set in a rusted industrial nightmare. Inspired by John Romero, David Lynch, and Doom 64.

games.name: Trash Wars
games.summary: Your turrets don't fire themselves. A tower defense clicker where every shot is yours to take. Build defenses, manage your island economy, and send pollution crashing into the enemy island before they bury you.

games.name: Panic Files: Buried Sanity
games.summary: Your first day at the local mine got a hell of a twist when the tunnels caved in. Can you escape when the only way out is going deeper? Avoid the deadly creatures, push through hallucinations and remember: Don't panic.

games.name: Night of the Living Bubble
games.summary: NOT YOUR AVERAGE NIGHT SHIFT... When clocking into work, you find that your business has been overrun by monsters borne from the products on the shelves. Constructed by a mad scientist bent on world domination, only YOU can stop them and save the world by shooting monsters with your Nailgun.

games.name: Server-Admin Simulator
games.summary: Build your datacenter empire from scratch. Buy hardware, manage contracts, hire staff and outsmart rivals. Face random events, hack the competition and survive the market. Moddable. Multiplayer. No two runs alike.

games.name: The Options Menu
games.summary: The Options Menu is a game where you play as a 'Player' and experience a life filled with Options. Explore countless endings to uncover a game that may surprise you as the real friend all along was your Options Menu in this Comedic Story.

games.name: Night Record: Thin Walls
games.summary: Vadim, a maintenance worker in a decaying post-Soviet apartment, leaves town to care for his sick mother, asking his wife to take over his duties. As she settles into the routine, the building begins to feel off quiet in all the wrong ways.

games.name: The Furry Protocol
games.summary: Survive and escape from the scientific research complex in the Siberian forests and uncover the secrets of the corporation that built this complex.

games.name: Red Hallways: Horror
games.summary: The exit is right there... but you can't leave.

games.name: Parkour Obby: Magma Run
games.summary: Keep moving!

games.name: Bound by Destiny
games.summary: Control a dark dungeon as the Viber Lord, in an attempt to trap Princess Mistynail. Place and trigger traps, unleash creatures, and strike at key moments to block her path as she tries to find the exit. Prevent her escape and pave the way for your rebirth and revenge on her bloodline!

games.name: That Cloud Looks Like
games.summary: Huh? This cloud looks like... something! What do you see in a randomly generated cloud? The drawer adds clues inside the cloud, while the other players try to guess the answer from as few clues as possible. Compete using your imagination and intuition in this online drawing quiz game.

games.name: Deep Nightmare: Phobias
games.summary: Travel between the real world and your dreams, dive into your subconscious, and survive your own fears. In this mix of Survival Horror and Psychological Horror, you'll play through a collection of the scariest phobias out there while being constantly hunted by fear itself.

games.name: Emberwall
games.summary: Emberwall is a roguelite tower defense game where you reshape enemy paths with tetromino walls, harvest resources, reveal a fog-covered wilderness, and combine powerful towers and elemental upgrades to defend your castle.

games.name: Screw It
games.summary: Screw It is a cozy, realistic organizing simulator where you sort 777 nails + 1 screw and tidy up your workbench. Use different tools to fix and organize various types of nails. No abilities No pressure, just fix, sort, stock and enjoy the satisfaction of stocking nails in a relaxing environment.

games.name: Darby is Here Forever
games.summary: Help our little vampire Darby getting out from his eternal prison. Log on into a difficult 2D pixel platformer, find out secret rooms, defeat great bosses and end up discovering why Darby has been imprisoned in his own castle!

games.name: SpongeBob SquarePants: Battle for Bikini Bottom Deluxe
aliases: SpongeBob SquarePants: Battle for Bikini Bottom DELUXE
games.summary: Battle for Bikini Bottom Deluxe is a full game mod of Battle for Bikini Bottom created by Gravity. It is an expansion of the original Battle for Bikini Bottom featuring 200 Golden Spatulas, over 30 new areas, new collectables, Game Options, and so much more.

games.name: Dear Journey...
games.summary: Run your own little travel agency. Plan itineraries with the cards you are dealt. Satisfying traveller moods and needs to help grow your agency’s reputation.

games.name: The Confined: Basement
games.summary: Wake up in a dark basement as a victim with no memory of your past. Can you uncover your true identity and solve the mystery of your past by collecting the cryptic notes left by your captor? Face the brutal truths and find a way to escape this nightmare alive.

games.name: Lumiric Stage
games.summary: Create musical content with real-time MIDI visualization, Magic Piano, real-time sheet music, built-in camera tools, and cinematic Stages. Design and share custom particle effects as portable .mvfx files. Built for creators, pianists, educators, performers, and streamers.

games.name: DIY Dadish
games.summary: Create your own adventure and share it with the world! Everyone's favorite radish dad is back, but this time the story is up to you! in DIY Dadish gives players the ability to design any Dadish level they can imagine.

games.name: The Rabbit Haul
games.summary: The Rabbit Haul is a tower defense farming game with roguelite elements where you grow a healthy ecosystem of plants that yield crops during the day and that will help defend your farm from the Trash Panda Posse at night.

games.name: Soggy Beans
games.summary: Fish will come, fish will go. Take photos, collect beans, decorate your seascape, then relax or do other things while your friends swim by in this calming side-idler.

games.name: Delverium
games.summary: Explore, Build, Farm, Craft and Fight in this survival sandbox adventure for 1-8 players. Delve deep to uncover the secret of the invading 'Faults' and restore stability to the land.

games.name: Ghoul Fright
games.summary: Ghoul Fright is a physics based FPS Survival Beat em up with a 90/2000s cartoon vibe, fight dangerous Ghouls as you cause destruction and chaos in your way while hell unleashes in heated Ghoul waves. ¿Ready to Fright?

games.name: Invasion Survivors
games.summary: A fast paced bullet heaven with roguelike elements where you must fight and survive an alien invasion. With the help of a mysterious little robot called Zippy, you will have endless combinations of weapons, items and skills. Use your creativity, craft your perfect build and crush the enemy waves.

games.name: Brave New Wonders
games.summary: Automate, optimize, and build vast factories in a post-apocalyptic automation game for those who have evolved beyond conveyor belts. Command intelligent robots that obey your plain-text commands in any language, explore the ruins of a lost civilization, and rebuild humanity one machine at a time.

games.name: The Stickman
games.summary: The Stickman is a movement-based FPS inspired by Titanfall 2 and Trackmania! Shatter PvE leaderboard records, battle friends in PvP, or create custom stages with the built-in Level Editor!

games.name: Backframes: Escape Together
games.summary: Backframes: Escape Together is a cooperative horror game for 1–4 players. Explore dark levels, solve dangerous puzzles, and escape from sinister entities. Use your voice to interact with objects, uncovering unexpected paths to survival.

games.name: Normal Golf Game
games.summary: A very normal golf simulator. Hit anything. Shoot from anywhere. But remember: you’re not leaving until Luke Muscat himself (Fruit Ninja, Jetpack Joyride) is satisfied.

games.name: Echoes of Mora
games.summary: Embark on a mysterious journey, filled with intriguing interactions and meaningful encounters, as you explore a sunken village and travel through time to help Mora find her lost brother. Playable in VR and non-VR on PC.

games.name: Dressmaker
games.summary: A dressmaker, also known as a seamstress, is a person who makes clothing for women, such as dresses, blouses, and evening gowns. Dressmakers were historically known as mantua-makers, and are also known as a modiste or fabrician.

games.name: Deified
games.summary: Forge your strategy around powerful relics in this turn-based tactical roguelite. Choose your slots, manage their constraints, and face formidable bosses.

games.name: Roadhouse Simulator
games.summary: Pour beer, break up brawls, distill your own liquor, run pig races, deal with gangs and keep the cops off your back as you turn a rundown Route 66 bar into one hell of a Road House.

games.name: Fruitbearer
games.summary: A visceral reimagining of the Suika-style physics puzzler, rebuilt as a punishing dark fantasy roguelike deckbuilder. Awaken as forgotten deity of bounty, stripped of grandeur, now facing sunless barrens and monsters. To restore balance, you must grow. To grow, you must sacrifice.

games.name: IGTAP: An Incremental Game That's Also a Platformer
games.summary: Amass an army of clones to follow your tightly-optimised path. Generate massive amounts of power to upgrade your production and movement abilities.

games.name: Citadel
games.summary: Citadel is a computer game developed by Michael Jakobsen for the BBC Micro, and released by Superior Software in 1985. It was also ported to the Acorn Electron. Centred around a castle, this platform game with some puzzle-solving elements requires players to find five hidden crystals and return them to their rightful place. It also features some outside areas external to the castle (including a wasteland, a pyramid, a sea and an island). Upon returning the crystals, the player must teleport to a separate set of locations to complete the game.

games.name: Guys with Magnets
games.summary: Guys with Magnets is a co-op physics parkour game about using a supercharged magnet to move through island courses with up to 8 players. Pull, repel, swing, explode, solve magnetic puzzles, and try to reach the finish together, even when everything goes wrong.

games.name: Yandere Virus
games.summary: An online co-op horror game for up to 4 players. Play solo or with your friends to collect Platonic Pumpkins and save your precious friend infected by the terrifying Yandere Virus.

games.name: Veil of the Damned
games.summary: Beyond the veil of the damned, face danger and treasure. Master your skills to survive the labyrinth.

games.name: Eon Survivor
games.summary: Harvest vital resources behind enemy lines and survive relentless waves! Deploy from a carrier forced to retreat, collect fast, and secure your cargo before time runs out. Push your luck in this fast-paced rogue-lite space shooter—or be left behind.

games.name: Lootborne
games.summary: Lootborne is a dark fantasy desktop autobattler. Build your character, loot gear, push through PvE stages, and challenge other players in async PvP duels while battle rages at the edge of your screen.

games.name: Escape Simulator 2: Apocalypse DLC
games.summary: The Apocalypse DLC adds 4 new escape rooms set in a near-future world devastated by an unknown catastrophe. Civilization has gone quiet. Cities are overgrown, systems are failing, and the only way forward is through the clues left by those who came before you.

games.name: Thanks for the Soup
games.summary: The job's simple: Go around town and satisfy your customers with some nice and hot soup. Hop on your bicycle and go around town, make some money, buy items, take care of your cat, and much more in this immersive horror simulator.

games.name: Guinea Pig Gunner
games.summary: Guinea Pig Gunner is a run-and-gun platformer with boomer shooter DNA. It fuses skill-based action platforming with a massive arsenal of weapons.

games.name: Backrooms: Code Yellow
games.summary: An online 1-6 player co-op game about investigating and collecting data in the infinitely massive Backrooms with your fellow employees. Explore. Do your job. Return alive.

games.name: The Decree
games.summary:
The Decree is a 1–3 player cooperative horror game about hunting souls, surviving a relentless 90-second clock, and making impossible choices when The Button appears.

Track wandering souls, capture them under pressure, fight Soul Drainers, and fulfill each Order before time runs out.

When The Button appears, choose PROCEED or STAY without knowing what either choice will cause.

Push your run further, survive the Orders, and decide when to extract—or keep going until the Decree breaks you.

games.name: Sylv and the Ancient Tree
games.summary: The balance of Sunroot Island is fading. Join Sylv, guardian of the Ancestral Tree, in a vibrant platforming RPG adventure. Reclaim the elemental energy stolen by the egocentric Umbra before the biomes collapse and the corrupted wildlife takes full control.

games.name: Museum Disarter
games.summary: The Museum is a complete disARTer! Organize hundreds of paintings, figure out which absurdly informal description belongs to each artwork, and restore order to the gallery. Deduce and sort in this cozy single-player first-person simulator.

games.name: Core Keeper: Riders of the Underground
Little Ghost
games.summary: Chill metroidvania maximizes non-linear exploration & puzzle-platforming. Frequent checkpoints, no currency, no combat. Gain friends & abilities. Collectables-as-media; tarot cards, weird podcasts, and songs from over 20 bands; all found within a surreal papercraft world.

games.name: Curve Fever
games.summary: Curve Fever is a high-energy, multiplayer snake game with powers. Survive each round and battle-it-out online against opponents, utilizing your own customized ship to win. Climb the ranked ladder and level up, earning new powers with each new level!

games.name: Nighthawks
games.summary:
"Nighthawks is the brand new urban fantasy RPG from Wadjet Eye Games (The Blackwell Legacy, Unavowed, Technobabylon) and writer/designer Richard Cobbett (Sunless Sea/Sunless Skies, The Long Journey Home)."

"Nighthawks is a mix of story-driven RPG and undead life-simulation, where every decision you make is another move in your chess game against the world. Invest your time into learning new skills or honing your fighting style as you uncover the city's mysteries and venture deep into its darkest secrets. Gather fellow outcasts to your side, binding them with favours and choosing when to cash in. Manage your eternal thirst, legitimately, or balancing the risks of being caught stalking unwary victims and working the black markets."

games.name: Nocturne
games.summary: The afterlife is now digital. Discover that eternal life comes with sacrifice in a genre-defying RPG with unique rhythm combat.

games.name: Obscurity: Unknown Threat
games.summary: Obscurity: Unknown Threat is a horror shooter game where a team of soldiers must survive against a hidden foe. The game contains both conventional symmetrical FPS game modes as well as asymmetrical battles vs the Obscurity.

games.name: EbiTapes
games.summary: Set off on a musical journey with Ebi, navigating through challenges to save the Annual City Festival from the threats of the Shushinator. Meet friends, collect sounds, and hold your own live concerts & remixes!

games.name: False Hero
games.summary: False Hero is a fast-paced soulslike adventure where you steal your enemies’ attacks and chain them into deadly combos. Explore the corrupted Land of the Gods and put your combat skills to the true test in challenging boss fights. Will you fight for the Gods or become an apostle of Death?

games.name: PSI: Pressure Climbing
games.summary: A movement-based climbing game where you ascend on a suicide mission to save an amphibian cargo cult.

games.name: Stuntboost
games.summary: Blast through cardboard tracks, master your momentum and shave off milliseconds to earn medals and challenge friends on a fingerboard with no speed limit.

games.name: Ved: Recure
games.summary: "Ved: Recure" is a fast-paced action roguelite where you find yourself trapped inside the 1000th game you bought but never played. You’ll wield fully customizable buff chains to face off against formidable foes and strategic builds to conquer this 1000th game and make your way back to reality.

games.name: True Vikings
games.summary: Choose your own path: become a powerful jarl or a legendary king, or perhaps switch sides and follow the path of a knight, reliving the story of the Duke of Normandy.

games.name: Galvatein: Adventurer’s Guild
games.summary: "Welcome, adventurer! What quest have you completed today?” A classic fantasy guild reception simulation — 『Galvatein: Adventurer’s Guild』

games.name: Packed Lair
games.summary: You are an evil lord with a hero problem and not nearly enough floor space. Draft buildings, pack them into your cramped lair, toil to earn money to expand, create powerful monster synergies, and send your chaotic army of minions to repel wave after wave of heroic do-gooder pests.

games.name: Important People of History: Presidents - Abraham Lincoln
games.summary:
Learn all about Abraham Lincoln in this visual novel biography containing rare photos of Lincoln’s hat from the day he was shot, the Lincoln Memorial, where he gave the Gettysburg address, and much more. Lawyer, President, Emancipator - this is Abraham Lincoln!

Part of the Important People of History series:
1. George Washington
2. Thomas Jefferson
3. Abraham Lincoln

All three games about US Presidents releasing in 2026 to commemorate the 250th anniversary of the signing of the Declaration of Independence back in 1776

Proudly made in the Washington DC area
aliases: Important People of History - Abraham Lincoln

games.name: Well Dweller
games.summary: Well Dweller is a dark fairy-tale metroidvania, full of charming characters living in a wretched kingdom. Play as Glimmer - a tiny bird armed with a matchstick - who must burn the wicked queen to save his family.

games.name: Panzer Deck
games.summary: Panzer Deck is a tactical card-based war game. Deploy resources to recruit units and equipment. Use maneuver cards to reposition forces, maximize their potential, and synergize units for powerful combos. Secure victory on WWII’s Western Front battlefields.

games.name: Slay the King
games.summary: Lead a tribe of warriors to defeat a corrupt king and reclaim your land

games.name: Woman Simulator
games.summary: Experience life as a woman - cleaning, cooking, laundry, and no time to rest. Full immersion into the world of everyday chaos!

games.name: Rivage
games.summary: Rivage is an immersive sci-fi puzzle adventure set aboard the A.R.E.S. space station trapped in a space phenomenon. Wake up as Miranda, forced to explore, solve intricate puzzles to unravel the fate of your missing crew.

games.name: Terminator: Dark Fate - Defiance: Evolution
games.summary: Evolution is the next major story expansion for Terminator: Dark Fate – Defiance, the gritty real-time strategy experience set in the dark future of Dark Fate.

games.name: Isernsmith
games.summary: Isernsmith is a gothic action-adventure RPG where you have to explore dungeons, gather resources, and forge new weapons and tools to overcome a tyrannical order.

games.name: It's Fine
games.summary: It’s Fine is an active incremental/upgrade clicker game about releasing v1.0 of your game on time.

games.name: Rogue Hanafuda
games.summary: A roguelike deckbuilding game meets Hanafuda. Never played Hanafuda before? No problem. Jump right in and discover an addictive roguelike card game that's easy to learn but impossible to put down.

games.name: Gunclone Arena
games.summary: Gunclone Arena is a top-down looter-shooter roguelite. Fight as a super-clone that can wield 6 weapons, a Beam and Shield in a dystopian TV show! Loot thousands of weapon variants with ricochet, detonate, shock, pierce and more. Stack build-changing Mods. Notice: Escape is grounds for perma-recycle.

games.name: Dash Dot Die
games.summary: Dash Dot Die is a first-person Morse puzzle game set in a maze of forgotten rooms, hallways, and airducts. Your past has caught up with you. Someone is determined to make you suffer just as they once did. Trapped in their twisted game, you must endure the same fate and overcome every challenge.

games.name: BuGarden
games.summary: 《BuGarden》 is a cozy idle flower-growing game that lives in the corner of your desktop. Plant seeds, water and fertilize them at your own pace, harvest cute flowers and fruits, and deal with a few playful bugs—nothing messy, just a calm little garden keeping you company.

games.name: Realindustry
games.summary: Realindustry is a hyper-realistic industrial automation simulator that blends deep strategy with authentic scientific principles, challenging players to build, automate, and optimize complex production chains using 236 real-world materials and 354 production processes. Developed by AssemblyPrime, the game features a unique "mystery" theme where your industrial expansion is monitored by an unknown entity, adding narrative tension to the core loop of resource management, automation, and technological progression. Across multiple technological tiers, players must master genuine chemical engineering, metallurgy, and increasingly advanced automation systems to transform basic elements into advanced products, offering an exceptional level of technical depth for fans of the automation genre on Windows and macOS.

games.name: Graveyard Keeper II
games.summary: The most inaccurate medieval cemetery sim is back! Restore The Town, manage the graveyard, automate production, lead your undead army into battle and turn the zombie problem into a thriving business! Graveyard Keeper 2 is the grotesque sequel that's deeper than six feet, and more unhinged than ever!

games.name: Seekers Alliance: Hero's Journey
games.summary: Seekers Alliance: Hero’s Journey is a roguelite deckbuilder where every run expands your strategic options. Recruit Heroes from 3 rival Factions, unlock Talents, upgrade Skill Cards, forge Artifacts, and master each Hero’s unique abilities to create powerful synergies as you uncover their stories.

games.name: Crown of Hispania
games.summary: Rewrite the Reconquista in a grand strategy game set in 11th-century Iberia, where population, religion, and war evolve dynamically based on your decisions. Move armies freely across 300 hand-built provinces, manage a deep medieval economy, and face an AI that actually fights back.

games.name: DinoBones: Tidy Up the Museum
games.summary: Dino Bones: Tidy Up the Museum! is a cozy skeleton restoration sim. Identify, collect, and piece together around 2,000 scattered dinosaur bones. Feel chaos turn into order, and with every skeleton you rebuild, the museum reveals another secret.

games.name: Breakout Garage
games.summary: Breakout Garage is an open-world driving and racing simulator built around old-school American muscle, deep tuning, drag racing, and the garage life.

games.name: Medieval Dynasty: Hunting Pack
games.summary: Demonstrate your hunting skills with the Hunting Pack DLC! Choose between special outfits, grab one of the unique weapons, and prove to everyone you are the best hunter around. Let the hunt begin with the set of new legendary items.

games.name: Dune: Awakening - Filmic Archive
games.summary: Bring the Imperium to Dune: Awakening with gear inspired by Dune: Part One and Part Two. Wear iconic armor and stillsuits, build a Sardaukar base with 73 construction pieces, and finish it with exclusive décor, weapons, and emotes.

games.name: Teaching Assistant Life: Song Ha-Yoon
games.summary: Teaching Assistant Life: Song Ha-Yoon je hra z kategorie Simulace / Indie od studia AFTERTIME.INC pro PC (Microsoft Windows). Termín vydání: 22. 9. 2026.

games.name: Somnius
games.summary: Somnius is a chaotic co-op extraction game for up to 6 players. Dive into collapsing dreams, turn anything into ammo, feed the portal to buy more time, and save the Dreamer before the dream burns away.

games.name: Jarred Defense
games.summary: A difficult maze-building tower defense about Yuki, a cat trapped in a teleporting jar. Protect it from robots and endure its unhelpful comments. Build your own paths, adapt as levels change, unlock powerful items, and uncover Yuki’s story. A love letter to Warcraft III custom maps.

games.name: Astromental Incremental
games.summary: Mesmerizing idle clicker incremental game where you build your own star systems and mine matter amid the ever-rising chaos of colliding asteroids, comets, and planets. Upgrades, Skill Tree, Abilities, Research, Perks, crits, chain lightning, burns, and more. Idle build or clicker build - you choose.

games.name: Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition - The Viking Sagas
games.summary:
The Viking Sagas is an expansion for Age of Empires II: Definitive Edition that adds the Danes, Saxons, and Varangians, each with distinct technologies, units, and strategies. New shared units, including Varangian Guards, Mounted Crossbowmen, and Longships, expand the options for land and naval warfare in campaigns and multiplayer.

The expansion also includes three interconnected campaigns following Harald Hardrada’s rise from exiled prince to Viking ruler. Fight across Scandinavia, the Mediterranean, the Kyivan Rus, the Byzantine Empire, and England as Harald pursues wealth, power, and a return to the throne.

games.name: Nomori
games.summary: Nomori is a mind-bending adventure game where you control time and space to journey through a whimsical spirit world. Take shortcuts through portals, rotate your perspective, and control the flow of time to solve puzzles that are out of this world.

games.name: Ghost Villa
games.summary: In Ghost Villa you farm and cook during the day, by night you fight hordes of ghosts that want to haunt and take possession of your home.

games.name: Evergrow: Shards of Tomorrow
games.summary: Explore the ruined world of Evergrow, where echoes of a lost civilization whisper through the remnants of a once-thriving planet. Solve puzzles to piece together the truth of what led to its downfall. Can you restore what was lost, or will the shards of tomorrow shape its fate forever?

games.name: Thalia
games.summary: Ariadna Thalía Sodi Miranda, celým jménem Ariadna Thalía Sodi Miranda (* 26. srpna 1971 Mexico City) je mexická zpěvačka a herečka. Je známa pod jménem Thalía a byla několikrát nominována na cenu Grammy a Billboard Latin Music Awards.

games.name: Silky Road
games.summary: Take on a roguelike adventure along the dangerous Silky Road. Build your train with unique carts, fight tough enemies, and collect new weapons for your character. Each run is full of strange events and deadly zones. Can you make it to the end, or will the Silky Road defeat you like so many before?

games.name: Otterly Lost
games.summary: Play as Otto, a curious sea otter swept far from home. In this story-rich adventure, explore wild forests, dive underwater, glide over rocky canyons, and climb your way back. Meet friendly animals, complete heartfelt quests, and enjoy soft challenges, at your own pace!

games.name: Yami Kids
games.summary: Play as "The Yami Twins" and uncover the mystery behind your family's killers. Yami Kids is a tale of tragedy, familial bonds, and revenge. Face off against trainers in "Shadow Duels", and make contracts with Oni to aid you on your quest.

games.name: The Piper of Dawn
games.summary: Welcome to Diamond City—a sealed-off “Paradise”. You play the role of an alchemist running a one-stop empire: farming, "people farming," shopkeeping, and alchemy. Choose your companion and set out on a fantastical journey where rich storytelling blends seamlessly with deep simulation gameplay.

games.name: Monitor State
games.summary: You are an operator in a dystopia world, watch and punish citizens. Experience a deep narrative with moral dilemmas. Obey, resist or find another path.

games.name: Lawn Mowing Simulator 2
games.summary: Head to the USA and grow your own business with a realistic and relaxing lawn mowing experience! Featuring brand new grass tech, the addition of leaf-blowing plus reworked systems based on player feedback to the original - including licensed equipment from Kubota, STIGA and SCAGⓇ!

games.name: Stunted Gravity
games.summary: Stunted Gravity is a hovercraft stunt-driving game set in a neon-dystopian future. Race, jump, and improvise lines across arenas where gravity pulls in any and every direction. Execute stunts, evade hazards, and battle enemy drones as you pilot though the interplanetary Stunted Gravity Circuit.

games.name: Tattoo Shop Simulator
games.summary: Run your dream tattoo shop! Provide tattoo and piercing services, customize your shop, and manage staff. Unlock new skills and roam the living city freely on your motorcycle. Buy real estate, fight off thugs, and grow from a small shop into the city's biggest brand!

games.name: Idle Monkey Theorem
games.summary: **Idle Monkey Theorem** is a charming idle/clicker game that brings the famous *Infinite Monkey Theorem* to life. Watch as your adorable team of monkeys frantically type away on their typewriters, randomly producing words that against all odds slowly but surely recreate the complete works of William Shakespeare.

games.name: Corpus et Spiritus
games.summary: Corpus et Spiritus is a roguelite deckbuilder about alchemy. You signed a pact with a Homunculus, and it was a bad idea: it will guide you on the path of alchemy, but as the cost of your life force. Use your workshop to craft new cards, transmute metals and discover magical talismans. Become smarter than your dangerous partner before it kills you!

games.name: Bait Soul
games.summary: Bait Soul is a top-down Dungeon Crawler Roguelike. It blends dungeon exploration with Survivors-style auto-attacks. Accessible yet deep, it retains the thrill of looting, with unique, game-changing mechanics hidden everywhere.

games.name: Island Restoration
games.summary: The ecological restoration of islands, or island restoration, is the application of the principles of ecological restoration to islands and island groups. Islands, due to their isolation, are home to many of the world's endemic species, as well as important breeding grounds for seabirds and some marine mammals. Their ecosystems are also very vulnerable to human disturbance and particularly to introduced species, due to their small size. Island groups, such as New Zealand and Hawaii, have undergone substantial extinctions and losses of habitat.

games.name: Gobble
games.summary: GOBBLE is a 2D action platformer with eating as its central theme. Venture out into the world searching for your missing family, armed with a “sickle” that devours monsters to get stronger.

games.name: Big Dig
games.summary: Big Dig is a short incremental narrative game about digging up artifacts to help Mayor Dog win the election! Recover artifacts, grow your museum, and upgrade your tools while building a highway spanning the entire Animal Republic!

games.name: Union Max
games.summary:
Union Max is a Gay Adult / Yaoi Visual Novel that features the adventures of Max, the unlikely hero chosen to become the next Light of the Kosmos!
Join Max on his journey across the Realms of the Kosmos, gathering the sparks of Romance, Desire, Angst and Happiness.
Reclaim the lost sparks – together as one!

games.name: Absolutely Nothing Good
games.summary: Do you believe that on Halloween night, the line between the world of the living and the dead becomes thinner? If not, then youre probably used to simply buying children off with candy. But imagine being stuck on a night shift in an ordinary roadside minimarket...

games.name: Bibi & Tina: Ready, Set, Ride!
aliases: Bibi & Tina – Auf die Pferde, fertig, los!
Bibi & Tina – À vos marques, prêts, galopez !
Bibi & Tina – In sella, pronti, via!
Bibi & Tina – На старт, внимание, верхом!
Bibi & Tina – Na konie, gotowi, start!
games.summary: A summer full of friendship, tournament excitement and horse-filled happiness: Ride with Bibi, Tina and Alex as they compete for the cup, stand together against unfair rivals – and dive into varied horse-riding adventures. Action-packed carriage races are among the special highlights.

games.name: Stella Supernova: The Astral Vale
games.summary: Jump, dash, dodge, and battle numerous stellar bosses in a 2D action-platformer playable solo or with up to 8 players locally, featuring unlockable powers, upgrades, cinematic QTEs, and an emotional story.

games.name: Genshin Impact: A Rekviem for the Underworld
games.summary:
Version 7.1 of Genshin Impact. This update includes:
• New characters: Vesna and Vodyanitsa
• New main story quests: "White Night, Like a Dream Upon Waking" and "A Rekviem for the Underworld"
• New main event: Silverwing in Pursuit of the Moon
• 6th anniversary celebrations

games.name: Sin: Reloaded
games.summary: Nightdive Studios and 3D Realms have joined forces to bring you SiN: Reloaded, a completely remastered experience of the classic 1998 shooter from Ritual Entertainment. SiN was a groundbreaking story driven FPS brimming with memorable characters, horrific enemies and a devastating arsenal that pushed the Quake II Engine to its limits. Now in 2020 SiN has been Reloaded!

games.name: Goofy Dungeon
games.summary: Goofy Dungeon is a light-hearted puzzle game built from the ground up for VR. Explore dungeons, interact with objects and the environment, solve puzzles, complete quests and collect trophies!

games.name: Silent Hill: Townfall
games.summary: Returning to an island town to ‘put things right’, Simon Ordell descends into a world of tense evasion, explosive confrontations, and mind-bending puzzles that slowly surface the truth of St. Amelia.

games.name: Control Resonant
games.summary: Explore a warped Manhattan on the brink of paranatural annihilation in this thrilling action-adventure RPG. Unleash the extraordinary powers of Dylan Faden as he fights for his humanity and our survival against a reality-bending cosmic threat.

games.name: Doggy Don't Care
games.summary: What does your dog get up to when you're not home? In this bone-afide adventure, unleash adorable chaos, solve puzzles, and leave your mark (literally!) as a mischievous pup on the loose.

games.name: Hack 'n' Stack
games.summary: Physics meets tower defense in this chaotic party game up to 4 players. Craft barricades and turrets with whatever you can find. But beware: relentless waves of enemies are coming to tear down everything you build.

games.name: Dragon Shelter
games.summary: Dragon Shelter is a farming sim set in a fantasy world. Become a hero who'll reignite the long-lost friendship between humans and dragons. Care for wondrous creatures, explore the magical world, and cook enchanted dishes together!

games.name: Babelomania
games.summary: A technogothic horror where a beautiful wedding turns into a death trap... Who will survive?

games.name: 3-Bit Explorer
games.summary: 3-Bit Explorer follows its predecessors, being a game focused on world exploration. This time you find yourself lost in a forest that seems to have even more bits than you, making this world even stranger to our hero. Once more, the world does not need saving, but you need to find your way home (and also a good adventure).

games.name: American Truck Simulator: South Dakota
games.summary: Welcome to the Mount Rushmore State! From the wide-rolling plains to the rugged beauty of the Badlands and the forested peaks of the Black Hills, South Dakota’s landscapes are as diverse as they are breathtaking.

games.name: Land of Glarefall
games.summary: An action-adventure survival game where every night could be your last. Explore a vast, dangerous world where survival depends on smart resource management, tactical combat, and what you choose to do before night falls.

games.name: WinMon
games.summary: Raise, feed, and farm your cute little monster—right on your desktop! A relaxing idle game to help you unwind, even on stressful days.

games.name: Futa Slug EX
games.summary: Futa Slug EX is a top-down shooter roguelike where you collect and fuck beautiful dickgirls. Build your team and discover powerful upgrades as you pilot your SLUG through procedurally generated dungeons.

games.name: Card Conquest
games.summary: Card Conquest is a Tower Defense game with Deckbuilding and Roguelite elements. Combine spells, towers and units to create a deck and defeat your enemies. Spend your resources wisely and find balance between offense and defense. Gather powerful relics that will enhance your cards.

games.name: Among Shadows
games.summary: Among Shadows is an intense blend of fast-paced combat and identity-based deduction. You are sent to stop a deadly infection from spreading across a corrupted land, but traitors have infiltrated your team. With the Blood Moon rising, can you escape from this place under the conspiracy?

games.name: Total War: Warhammer III - Lords of the End Times
Farming Camp
games.summary: Every summer, Evertree Farming Camp searches for the next best Evertree Farmer, someone ready to raise the bar in agriculture. In hopes of a better future, young Alessandra enters the contest to claim the title, but she will have to face her peers and discover what it means to be an Evertree Farmer.

games.name: BanG Dream! Our Notes
games.summary: In BanG Dream! Our Notes, players will be thrown into the stories of MyGO!!!!! and Ave Mujica, two aspiring bands discovering their voice. Guide each group from rehearsal studios to stadium shows, as you master tight, rhythm-based gameplay set to original, high-energy pop. As their journey unfolds, three more bands - Mugendai MewType, millsage, and Ikka Dumb Rock! - join the stage, weaving a multi-route tale of youth, friendship, and musical passion. Featuring 25 characters across five bands, the game showcases their growth both on stage and in everyday life.

games.name: Oh!Ware
games.summary: Sow the seeds of victory, forge alliances, and carve your own destiny. A spiritual Mancala roguelike where every marble shapes the board and your fate. Every pit is a choice and every marble, a desperate prayer.

games.name: Reel Talk
games.summary: Cast your line, catch some fish, and make real connections. REEL TALK is a cozy multiplayer fishing game where you hang out, customize your character with pride, and chat with friends old and new. No pressure, no competition-just good vibes by the water.

games.name: Unanchored Spaceshooting
games.summary: Welcome to the most counter-intuitive shooter arena! In Unanchored Spaceshooting, your guns ARE your thrusters—dodge left by firing right! Every battle defies physics. Blast enemies, rack up high scores!

games.name: All Roads Connected
games.summary: Explore an endless world, build countless settlements, discover lost artifacts, and lead your nation into a new dawn of industry.

games.name: Coin & Cauldron
games.summary: The Kingdom of Valoria is in grave danger - The King has sent his most trusted Alchemist to help fight off the monster hordes near the town of Elyzium. Fight monsters, craft potions, cast spells and live the life of a powerful sorcerer fighting to repel the monsters from the defenseless town...

games.name: Cozy Game Restoration
games.summary: Cozy Game Restoration is a soothing simulator where you gently bring forgotten video game cartridges back to life. Tear wrapping paper, peel old stickers, lift away grime, and transform dusty relics into cherished collectibles. No pressure or failure, just the quiet joy of restoring memories.

games.name: Kingdom Rush 6: Genesis TD
games.summary:
Kingdom Rush 6: Genesis brings a new chapter to the beloved tower defense saga, packed with the charm fans fell in love with.

Journey back to the very beginning of the Kingdom with the mission to rewrite history, and stop young Vez’nan before darkness takes hold!

Return to the original Kingdom Rush lands, at a time when legends were just beginning. Recruit familiar faces, revisit iconic battlefields, and build strategic defenses to outsmart relentless enemy waves through careful planning.

The beloved tower defense gameplay comes back with bold new twists, epic fights, and the signature Kingdom Rush humor. Along the way, you’ll encounter surprising returns, memorable challenges, and the most ambitious Kingdom Rush adventure yet.

Defend the past to change the future.

games.name: Frog Pond Simulator
games.summary: Frog Pond Simulator is an idle incremental game where you'll see new frogs coming along continuously, each unique, funny looking and unusual. The only objective that matters is to relax and let yourself be transported by the music and the mood. An un-frog-ettable experience!

games.name: Kalanoro
games.summary: Kalanoro is an action-adventure platformer where you build a band of lemur artists. Explore Lemuria, recruit lemur musicians, grow your band and use platforming and combat to fight the witch Raneny, one song at a time.

games.name: Love All My Girls
games.summary: What would you do with infinite resurrection and time travel? Predict the future, save the world, get rich overnight… or date six girls at once? You’ve lived every man’s dream but stepped into a fatal trap. You’re just trying to make them all happy—what’s wrong with that?

games.name: Garfield: Escape from Monday
games.summary: Wake up Garfield from this nightmarish veggie filled 3D Platformer! The laziest cat is about to work hard in Garfield - Escape from Monday!

games.name: Sender Unknown
games.summary: Work the night shift in an underground sorting facility. Weigh packages, compare their contents, and meet your quota by 6 AM. But beware, some packages hide dark secrets. Identify bad batches, earn cash, and survive the night in this tense PSX-style horror job simulator.

games.name: Qliphah in Providence's Shadow
games.summary: Tokyo has fallen. In the wake of the 'Collapse,' time is your ultimate weapon. Unleash real-time skills, predict enemy moves, and deliver devastating counters in this high-stakes Tactical Timeline RPG.

games.name: Misha
games.summary: Play as a hacker backing up Misha—whose brain has been transplanted into a sexyroid—as you face off against all threats that stand in your way in this cyberpunk FPS.

games.name: Courier
games.summary: He woke up with nothing. The city is about to have the same problem.

games.name: Fusty Dungeon
games.summary: Travel the land and explore a dungeon with two beautiful ladies to find the cure to your childhood friend’s curse in this JRPG by Vitamin Gohan!

games.name: Prisoners Chess
games.summary: You know how the pieces move. You don't know how they die. A chess roguelike where every piece bleeds. Level them, perk them or lose them forever. Take the enemy King's head, or bleed their army dry. One path saves you. One damns you. Hell keeps score.

games.name: Sockpuppet Noir
games.summary: Step into the shoes of Frank Sockowski, private detective, and explore the gritty world of New Drawer, a wolly unsettling and corrupt city.

games.name: Tomboy Adventure 2
games.summary: Start a relaxing adventure together with your (girl) friend!

games.name: Magic Realm
games.summary: The story of Magic Realm begins in a small town nestled in a dangerous misty forest, where a series of mysterious events take place that propel the protagonist to the town's hidden truth.........

games.name: Lunar Drifter
games.summary: Lunar Drifter is an Arcade First Person Shooter, your mission is to tear, blast, and crush an entire legion as fast as possible within the time limit. Featuring 4 playable characters with their own gimmicks and arsenal, more than 15 unique hand-crafted levels, and includes online Co-Op!

games.name: Bug Cleaners
games.summary: Are you ready to stop the bug invasion? Fight off the invaders either solo or cooperatively with your team using extraordinary tools! Enjoy fun moments in chaotic missions — bug hunting has never been this exciting!

games.name: Luminescence
games.summary: Illuminate the path in this Parkour experience across the constellations of Space

games.name: Lobstar: Arcade Version
games.summary: Punch through the cosmos! An arcade-inspired shoot-em-up where you play as an immortal lobster speeding through space.

games.name: Decklings
games.summary: Tame magical creatures called decklings and lead them into challenging battles in this survival deck-building card game. Explore wild biomes, gather resources, and craft to build your base as you shape your path to become the deckling champion.

games.name: Nightmare Invasion
games.summary: Nightmare has set its sights on this world, and as the will of the world, you will rely on cards, tower defenses, and urban construction to destroy Nightmare's invasion in the dream

games.name: Black Cat Book Club
games.summary: A magical library you can place on your desktop. Help the black cat study ancient tomes and learn spells in this cozy idle game.

games.name: Fallosophy
games.summary: Use just two buttons to climb a colossal pinball table spanning the history of western philosophy. Fallosophy is a minimalist game that turns pinball into a quiet struggle against gravity. No score. No tilts. No savers. Falling down means climbing back up again. Why climb? What does it all mean?

games.name: Glue Blocks
games.summary: Glue your falling blocks to create your own shapes and achieve monster scores in wells of all shapes with dynamic gravity. Compete with friends or have funds in coop.

games.name: Sandwich +1
games.summary: A cozy idle clicker where every click drops a random ingredient with a satisfying plop. Stack towering sandwiches, automate your kitchen, unlock rare fillings. Your customers watch every move and react.

games.name: Sayagatari: Promise of the Cursed Blade
games.summary: "My love for you began with that kiss." Ex-Kendo practitioner Kanemori Tōya, comes across Saya who seals demonic blades. Saving him from his murderous impulse curse is a kiss from Saya!? The two begin living together, battling with demonic blade in hand. Break the curse with a kiss from this beauty!

games.name: Scapewatch
games.summary: 28 skills. Three combat styles. Clans, raids, hiscores, pets, capes. Set up your queue, close the tab, come back richer. Scapewatch is the idle MMO for people who actually like the grind.

games.name: Online: 404
games.summary: An open-world survival simulator where even seasoned veterans of the genre will have to rethink their typical survival approach and how they interact with the world around them. Play solo or with friends, follow the story or simply explore — just don’t forget your most important gadget.

games.name: Retrieval
games.summary: RETRIEVAL is a first-person psychological horror game where you explore a looping house, collect scattered memory fragments, and search extracted keywords in an old computer terminal to uncover a tragic truth.

games.name: CoLane
games.summary:
”CoLane" is a PC rhythm game where the lanes switch according to the color of the background spotlight.
It features a variety of fingerings, making it a game where you improve through trial and error.
A practice mode is implemented, allowing you to try out various fingerings.

games.name: EA Sports FC 27
games.summary: Welcome to The World’s Game in EA SPORTS FC™ 27. Step into The Grounds to experience a football playground where the streets meet the stadium, and feel greater control in every mode as community-driven innovations deliver more true-to-football gameplay.

games.name: Immortal Chess
games.summary: Chess game with classes, Mana, spells, traps and skills. Build your strategy, disrupt your opponent and compete across platforms in tactical matches. Choose the class that suits best your play style.

games.name: Museologist: Tidy Up the Museum!
games.summary: Museologist: Tidy Up the Museum! A single-player simulation. The whole collection has fallen apart. Find where each fragment belongs, piece it back together like a puzzle, and restore 428 objects from 3,105 scattered pieces.

games.name: Smoke Keeper
games.summary: A cozy first-person organizing simulator where you sort 4,316 scattered items throughout a two-storey Victorian tobacconist. Put every item on its proper shelf, unlock helpful skills, and restore perfect order at your own pace—or race the clock.

games.name: Observation Protocol
games.summary: Observation Protocol is a first-person psychological horror game set in a liminal office space that exists outside normal space. From an external observation post, you must monitor camera feeds and identify discrepancies within the facility. When the power cuts, protocol requires you to enter the facility yourself, photograph every discrepancy, and return before the passage closes at 6 AM.

games.name: Gay It Loud
games.summary: Dating in the dreamy shopping mall of 1995! Hang out at the food court, have sloppy makeouts in the dressing room, loiter in the arcade, and collect nostalgic toys.

games.name: Cozy Farm: Tidy Up!
games.summary: A cozy organizing simulator about sorting 2500+ adorable fruits, vegetables and other crops into greenhouses. Perform satisfying sorting combos, earn money for helpful upgrades and explore the farm at dawn or night. Take your time and tidy the farm, one shelf at a time!

games.name: Mortality... Please
games.summary: Penelope falls for a nineteen-year-old who has not aged in over a century. His face survives in yearbooks, VHS tapes, and dead forum pages. Then an elderly woman arrives with a photograph of herself beside him. A short psychological horror VN about eternal youth and the people it leaves behind.

games.name: Murders & Mistresses
games.summary:
Murders & Mistresses is a dark, choice-driven adult detective thriller about sex, power, judgment — and consequences.

You play a brilliant ex-conman turned police consultant — cocky, charismatic, dangerously persuasive — surrounded by women you shouldn't be sleeping with, and given far too much freedom.

A character-driven prestige drama: the story will force you into uncomfortable places, and your choices will have severe consequences.

games.name: Stella Astrum
games.summary: Stella Astrum is a whimsical factory game where you manage elemental resources to form Stars, Planets, and more. Use your skills to unlock upgradable factories, nurture colorful celestial bodies, and shape an expansive galaxy. Sit back, relax, and amplify the universe beyond its artistic limits!

games.name: Stranded With You
games.summary: In this survival game, you are stranded on an tropical island with your lovely friend Mitsuki. Explore your surroundings together, build a small shelter, and hunt for supplies. Have fun keeping up with all the heat!

games.name: Missed Class: Horror
games.summary: Some schools should stay abandoned.

games.name: Parkour Obby: Ice Escape
games.summary: Can you escape the frozen course?

games.name: Billion Egg Farm
games.summary: Billion Egg Farm is a first-person automation game where you put chickens to work laying eggs and build production lines for eggs, meat, and processed goods.

games.name: Sincognito
games.summary: A social deduction investigation horror game where one of you is secretly possessed by a Deadly Sin. Use stealth and proximity chat to cooperate or deceive as you gather clues and compare findings to deduce which Sin is haunting the castle.

games.name: Ammossum
games.summary: Build an endlessly upgradable weapon! Evolve projectiles into unstoppable firepower in this action roguelike. Fight through hordes of infected beasts, hunt down the source of the plague, and feel the thrill of bloody shootouts filled with bullets, explosions, and acid. Can you survive the madness?

games.name: Drop Command
games.summary: '90s Mech combat at a grand scale! Build an empire across the stars. Pilot Mechs, Tanks, Infantry and Aircraft in combined arms combat on many worlds across the star cluster. Rise to command entire battalions throughout a sandbox campaign.

games.name: One Fenix Down
games.summary: A retro-inspired, classic turn-based RPG for those with nostalgia for the '90s golden era. Explore a vast world with 14 playable characters, fight hundreds of unique enemies, and delve into an epic story of war, betrayal, and redemption.

games.name: HR: Human Remains
games.summary: In a broken world ruled by demons, the gears of productivity still turn. Complete tasks, solve puzzles, and explore a society under demonic regime from the perspective of an ordinary office clerk.

games.name: Replay Value: Second Hand Games
games.summary: Run a second-hand game store from scratch! A Job Simulator where you buy and sell used games, negotiate with colorful customers, make profit and upgrade your shop! Clean up retro finds, and stack your shelves with the most popular game with replay value!

games.name: Tour: Chess Puzzles
games.summary: Elegant, varied and challenging chess-themed puzzles. No prior knowledge of chess is needed.

games.name: Space Cat Solitaire
games.summary:
Space Cat Solitaire is a euphoric and satisfying puzzle card game adventure. With cats.

Stack, organize and pros-purr! Hone your puzzling skills as you create epic combos, beat your high score and find your fortune among the stars! Use your wits & your winnings to unlock customizations, trophies, and elite story-driven missions featuring the eccentric locals of the Whiskerfang Expanse.

games.name: Unshine Arcade
games.summary: An arcade full of secrets, a sentient virtual pet in the prize cabinet, a stealth shooter roguelite arcade machine and one way to escape: win tickets.

games.name: The Hero Is Too Powerful so Let's Pleeeease Settle This Peacefully!
games.summary: How strong is too strong? Find out from the hero's victims in this adventure RPG as you talk things out (or destroy everything) on your way to save the hero's childhood friend!

games.name: Antivirus Survivors 2003 Professional
games.summary: The family computer is infected again and it’s your job to fend off waves of viruses and adware foes with an arsenal of nostalgic Y2K-inspired weapons. Antivirus Survivors 2003 Professional is a survivor-like auto-shooter filled with nods to the days when computers were actually fun.

games.name: Radiotext
games.summary: Radiotext is an interactive story set in the near future, where communication without intrusion requires radio-waves. Dive into a cryptographic radio-net in this text-based rpg, where you need to think carefully before typing your answers.

games.name: AE: Archeological Expedition
games.summary: Explore dig sites inspired by real locations, from Petra to Pompeii, and unearth artifacts spanning 10 historical eras. Brush away the centuries, discover the stories behind each find, and fill your journal one careful dig at a time

games.name: Galactic Bounty
games.summary: Play as a droid bounty hunter for hire. Accept contracts, deploy into dangerous locations, eliminate targets, break into secure systems, and get paid. Spend your rewards on weapons, gear and software upgrades for your droid.

games.name: Armory Keeper
games.summary: Restore order to a massive armory. Find and sort over 1,500 weapons, ammunition, grenades, and military equipment scattered throughout the facility, placing every item on its correct rack. As you organize the armory, unlock abilities that help you sort faster and more efficiently.

games.name: Battle Meating
games.summary: Survive without getting burned! BATTLE MEATING is a local multiplayer party game for 1–4 players. Become a Meat and fight to be the last one standing. Bring your controllers and battle with up to 4 players locally. Enjoy a wacky, chaotic meat party!

games.name: Nivalis Nights
games.summary: Grow your business, manage restaurants and nightclubs, make friends and enemies, buy and decorate apartments, go fishing and maybe even find love in a cyberpunk city that stretches from the ocean to the clouds.

games.name: The Merlies
games.summary: Meet the Merlies, a tiny birds community trying to find harmony in a cute post-apocalyptic world filled with the remains of a long forgotten civilization. Gather your birdies, explore this wild world with your tiny bird squad and complete your village out of collected scraps!

games.name: Unwell
games.summary: Descend into your own broken mind in this psychological survival horror. Survive twisted manifestations of your psyche, defend your shelter, and shape your fate through choices that lead to multiple endings.

games.name: Toem 2
games.summary: Step back into the shoes of a curious photographer and set off on a brand new adventure all about uncovering hidden details, helping friends along the way, and documenting the world’s little wonders in TOEM 2, the sequel to the acclaimed TOEM.

games.name: Transport Fever 3
games.summary: Transport Fever 3, the ultimate transport tycoon returns, bigger, deeper, and more dynamic than ever. Build the routes that transform the world across land, sea, and sky using over a century of evolving transport options. Design and build your ideal transport network.

games.name: King's Guard
games.summary: The King's Guard (called Queen's Guard and Queens's Life Guard when the reigning monarch is female) are sentry postings at Buckingham Palace and St James's Palace, organised by the British Army's Household Division. The Household Division also mounts sentry postings at Horse Guards, known as the King's Life Guard. An infantry contingent, typically one of the Household Division's five regiments of foot guards, mounts the King's Guard, while the King's Life Guard is usually provided for by the Household Cavalry Mounted Regiment.

games.name: American Truck Simulator: Ford Car Pack
games.summary: Engines at the ready! Hit the highways of American Truck Simulator like never before with the Ford Car Pack, a DLC add-on for the new Road Trip gameplay module!

games.name: Frutiger Home
games.summary: Decorate your dream frutiger home in this cozy co-op frutiger house decorating game. Pick a home layout, add from a wide range of frutiger-themed decor and hang out with your friends!

games.name: Escape from 8-Bit High
games.summary: When a cursed cassette awakens a sentient Pomodore 64, Cloudydale High is overrun by 8-bit villains! Join alt-rock trio Blueberry Finn—Hank, Duck, and Alex—as they battle mole men, aliens, dinosaurs and more in a bizarre, musical quest to save the world!

games.name: Minecraft Dungeons II
games.summary: Drop the pickaxe, grab a sword, and charge into a new adventure in Minecraft Dungeons II. Pre-order today and get 2 hero skins, the Twisted cape, and the Twisted chicken pet!

games.name: Dog in the Machine
games.summary: A tactical roguelite where you help an AutoDog escape a dystopian mecha-city and get back to their exiled humans. Teach the dog custom tricks to tackle strategic challenges through devastating chain reactions. Break the Machine in your path to freedom!

games.name: Car Factory Tycoon
games.summary: Build cars step-by-step in a factory sim. Design vehicles, build your garage layout, hire and train workers, manage parking inventory, and sell cars through customer orders or walk-in buyers as you expand your operation.

games.name: Endless Rails
games.summary: Protect your train with your drones as it rolls through a monster-infested wasteland. Reach new stations to buy new weapons, wagons, and upgrades. Keep rolling until you or the game crashes. Isometric bullet heaven roguelite.

games.name: Minecraft Dungeons II - Deluxe DLC
games.summary:
Includes:
• Soul Cape
• Blub Pet
• 4 Hero Skins

games.name: Tempest Rising: The Vetis Wrath
games.summary: Take command of the fractured Veti to reclaim what is rightfully yours. Subjugate your foes and use them as tools to sacrifice for your goals in the conquest for vengeance against enemies both new and older than humanity itself.

games.name: Crack the Pack
games.summary: Open booster packs, buy upgrades, and collect over 600 cards and their variants. Build a true automated booster factory by endlessly multiplying production until you unlock cloning and nuclear fusion !

games.name: Tiny Flock
games.summary: From the creators of Human Fall Flat – Tiny Flock, a cosy, physics-based VR puzzle game for all ages. Help guide your adorable wayward sheep through beautiful hand-crafted diorama puzzles using the environment around you to get them to safety!

games.name: The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt Remastered
games.summary:
Coming on September 29, this is the definitive way to experience Geralt of Rivia’s legendary adventure. The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt — Remastered features an array of improvements, bringing upgrades to visuals, gameplay, and more.

Remastered is a free upgrade for players who own The Witcher 3 on GOG, Steam, Epic Games Store, PlayStation 5, and Xbox Series X|S, and includes both Hearts of Stone and Blood and Wine expansions. It is also available for pre-purchase on Battle.net and Nintendo Switch 2.

games.name: Cancel Subscription Simulator
games.summary: Cancel Subscription Simulator is a dark comedic puzzle game about navigating 30 levels of absurd corporate dark UX patterns, evasive buttons, impossible CAPTCHAs, and manipulative chatbots.

games.name: Creep
games.summary: Experimental dark platform game that takes place inside a struggled man's inner world represented as the worm world. You control the worm form of this man as he shows why this world exists and how it's like to live there. You also visit past memories/analogies and gain new abilities.

games.name: They Are Here: Alien Abduction Horror
games.summary: A first-person alien abduction horror game inspired by cult sci-fi thrillers. In this cinematic, story-driven experience, play as local journalist Taylor Fox, sent to investigate chilling reports of unexplained phenomena at a remote family farm.

games.name: Songs of Glimmerwick
games.summary: Become immersed in a musical woodland fantasy world where casting a spell is as easy as playing a song. Attend classes, grow the university garden, make friends with classmates and townsfolk, and explore the island’s many oddities and mysteries in this story-driven witch academy RPG.

games.name: Demon Spore
games.summary: Blast your way out of tentacle hell as a failed lab experiment gives birth to a rapidly growing viral horror in this intense action rogue-lite inspired by 80s Monster movies. Use the lab to your advantage and improvise an escape plan before this constantly evolving life form spreads out of control.

games.name: There's no way that tsundere girl I met in the infirmary will be my girlfriend
games.summary: "B-baka! Who said you could get in!? I'm not prepared yet!" "Oh well... since you're already here, why not stay for a while?" "D-don't misunderstand, okay? It's not like I asked you to stay because I like you or anything..."

games.name: Vice Undercover
games.summary: VICE Undercover is a point & click narco-thriller set in an alternate 1980s Miami - where every choice matters. You play as undercover agent Vida, and for one hour per day, you're taking control over a cartel-run computer using Amigo OS, a fully-functional 1980-inspired operating system.

games.name: Lucid
games.summary: Discover your own legend in LUCID. Platform through a crystalline world torn apart by calamity, absorb powerful abilities that expand movement and enhance combat against a diverse cast of enemies and bosses, all in gorgeous pixel art inspired by the golden age of 2D sidescrollers.

games.name: The Human Story
games.summary: Learn to listen to the melody of this singing world and explore an ongoing slice of life story of my personal experience seeking refuge in the woods, befriending trees, talking with mysterious doomer owls, burying a butterfly and grieving the dying of species and forests.
aliases: Burial for a Butterfly - a Singing World

games.name: Mion and the Cursed Killer Hamster
games.summary: The Magnificent Mion is a warrior queen from Wharevarland. She battles a malignant verse-making kraken, tries to win the love of Count De Loboda, studies at an ordinary magical school, and she's also... crazy! Absurdism. Ridiculousness. Idiocy.

games.name: Anomalistic Revolution
games.summary: You stand before a pit at the city's heart, then your gaze drifts to a deeper void, one you fear even more. Wield your invention to unravel mysteries, reclaim lost memories, strengthen your skills, and battle nightmare-born horrors in this multi-ending RPG.

games.name: Illegal Plantation
games.summary: It’s time to leave it all behind and do a dance with the law. Build your own illegal plantation, cultivate your weed, water the plants, maintain good air temperature and good lighting. Deliver your goods or hire local dealers for it. Get rid of the competition and build your own monopoly.

games.name: Midnight Horde
games.summary: Leap, slash, and soar through gothic ruins in Midnight Horde, a high-mobility auto shooter where parkour meets reverse bullet hell. Battle through swarms of monstrosities, upgrade deadly weapons, and build strongholds to push back the creeping dark.

games.name: Industrix
games.summary: Step into the world of industrial production and become a master in factory-building! Create efficient production lines and manage your resources. As you progress through the game, you'll need to complete challenges for a certain company in order to rank up and unlock new technologies!

games.name: Vexlands
games.summary: Vexlands is a realm of surprises. Every newly opened space brings a surprise: loot, resources, dungeons, monsters and disasters! Build your village where you craft new equipment before you explore uncharted areas, and find relics that explain who came before and why these lands are cursed.

games.name: Spaceman Memories
games.summary: Spaceman Memories is a retro JRPG built by one person who loves old stories. Set in a retro-futuristic Japan haunted by ancient folklore, play as Ichiro-94, an astronaut who wakes from hypersleep to piece together the remnants of a forgotten past full of wonder, nostalgia, and strange spirits.

games.name: Time To Wake Up
games.summary: You're stuck in a dream. Blink and change your surroundings to escape the shadows of your past.

games.name: Neo Junk City
games.summary: Sinister tides are rising in the Drowned City. Dive into a Point and Click action-RPG with fast-paced shoot-outs and retro arcade racing. Uncover the truth behind a murder you don't remember committing!

games.name: Veredilia: The Sacred Forest
games.summary: Discover the large forest of Veredilia with three different characters as you fight your way like a pro in your quest to save The Sacred Forest from impending doom in this 2D bloody combat action platformer.

games.name: Mikene's Aspects
games.summary: Guide Mikene in the search for the 7 Aspects of Balance to achieve Omnipotence and put an end to the problem plaguing the city of Farzin once and for all. Dive into hordes of enemies in this frantic hack n' slash in the best Soulslike style!

games.name: EVE Vanguard
games.summary: EVE Vanguard is an extraction-adventure FPS set on the ruthless planets of New Eden. Raid crash sites, assault forward bases and seize exotic tech before colossal Nemesis Drones hunt you down. Every mission is a race against time. Every extraction shapes a larger war. This is only the beginning.

games.name: Weefager
games.summary: Embark on this Metroidvania with Weefager! Master the art of soul extraction as a charming pink creature, animating objects into powerful allies with unique abilities. Overcome epic challenges and explore a world teeming with magic, mystery and a great soundtrack.

games.name: Nowhere
games.summary:
Nowhere is a Nordic inspired narrative mystery/horror game, revolving around Nordic mythology and what happened to these Gods after Ragnarök and how the rise of Christianity impacted them and their worship.

Featuring the mixing styles of detective gameplay and survival horror, It's going to appeal to people who love a good mystery and also love to be scared, wandering through these haunting atmospheres, feeling something watching them at every turn while the tension builds and builds until the world turns into a nightmare and its fight or flight.

games.name: Black Mesa: Classic
games.summary:
This is a GoldSource project aimed to recreate Black Mesa: Source feel within Half-LIfe 1 and its assets.

Our main goals for this project is to give a new feel, look to the original Half-Life, with adding more features, improved level design that many people love from Black Mesa remake but with additional things, to make it a bit more unique. Black Mesa: Classic aims to be capabile on any PC without high requiremnts, with better visuals and effects to make your Half-Life 1 campaign experience the best!

games.name: Mithra
games.summary: Investigate the world's first cult in a cryptic mystery adventure that blurs the lines between fiction and reality. We've been keeping an eye on you. Follow us further down the rabbit hole...

games.name: Endless Tactics
games.summary: A turn-based tactics roguelite about defending a planetary mining expedition, upgrading your starship, and extracting before alien hordes overrun you.

games.name: Lost in the Roots
games.summary: A 2D adventure with psychological thriller elements exploring guilt and fear. A young girl wakes in a stranger's attic, lost in the middle of nowhere. Who took her—and why? With no way out and something lurking in the shadows, escape may be just an illusion.

games.name: Radiosol
games.summary: RADIOSOL is a journey through a desolate world burned by a planetary cataclysm. In search of answers, you will have to navigate through the ruins of megastructures and abandoned cities, avoiding the scorching rays of the Sun.

games.name: A Dungeon Is You
games.summary: Tower defense X Incremental idle! Design your own dungeon (maze). Summon and place different defenders against hundreds of personally designed waves. Explore multiple systems, including an arpg like item system with every system improving each other. No resets or prestige! Continuous combat!

games.name: Under Canopies
games.summary: Forget the stress of survival. In this cozy open-world sim, you don't fight nature, you join it. Build your dream cabin piece by piece, cook complex meals with crops you watered yourself, and fill your photo album with rare wildlife. A serene experience where the only enemy is inefficiency.

games.name: Countryballs: The Heist
games.summary: Climb from rookie thief to top secret agent in a humorous countryball stealth and casual strategy adventure. Customize your ball with national flags, infiltrate countries, learn fun facts, steal iconic artifacts in heists full of political satire. Create and play custom heists with Steam Workshop!

games.name: Alpha Nomos
games.summary: It's time to wield the beat! Play as Cello and slice through an army of rogue puppets in a vibrant, melody-twisted world. Combat pulses to the soundtrack - time your moves to the beat to unleash show-stopping combos and perfectly choreographed chaos!

games.name: Burn With Me
games.summary: Burn With Me is a story-centric deckbuilder filled with cozy dread and occultic mysteries. In order to summon a Personal Demon you'll master inventive gameplay with position-based synergies, and permanently burn your cards and your soul.

games.name: Acts of Blood
