games.summary: Acts of Blood is a third-person beat ‘em up action game about revenge that focuses on fast-paced, brutal hand-to-hand combat. Set in the fictional city of Bandapa.

games.name: Footsy
games.summary: Footsy is a chaotic multiplayer soccer party game set inside grandma's house! Smash furniture, shatter bottles, and tumble TVs as you compete in wild, goal-scoring action. Customize your characters, challenge your friends, and make every room look like a battlefield!

games.name: Sauna Simulator
games.summary: Run your own sauna: buy a room, equip it with an oven and start earning money from it. Hire employees, ensure safety and, of course, have fun!

games.name: Codebreakers VR
games.summary: Codebreakers is a chaotic VR Action Shooter that takes place in a dystopian future where various organizations are fighting for control of the world order.As a breaker, you will have to infiltrate, defeat enemies and avoid security systems to extract data.

games.name: Pao Pao
games.summary: Welcome to PAO PAO, a charming seaside town waiting for you. Cook up culinary delights, go fishing, grow crops and create your own cozy home here.

games.name: Reality Drift
games.summary: Reality Drift is a strategic roguelike racing game. Race through a series of strange worlds, choose upgrades, cards and relics, and decide which track will be next - your decisions are just as important as how you drive!

games.name: Deserter
games.summary: An immersive isometric stealth RPG about a thief surviving in a decaying totalitarian city. Plan every move, evade traps, and pull off daring heists right under the Party's nose.

games.name: Panzer Strike
games.summary: Panzer Strike is a 1988 tactical wargame that simulates small unit actions during World War II. It was made for Apple II and Commodore 64 and was released by Strategic Simulations. Panzer Strike spawned the follow-up titles Typhoon of Steel and Overrun!, which reuse the game's engine and mechanics. In 1995, Grigsby released Steel Panthers to revisit design concepts from his earlier titles like Panzer Strike.

games.name: Medix
games.summary: You are not here to win the war, but to save whom you can before the line breaks. A narrative real-time strategy where you lead a unit of war medics across hand-drawn battlefields and race to reach the wounded as your army retreats before an overwhelming foe. Keep hope alive amidst the chaos.

games.name: A Forest Tale: Porasy
games.summary: Embark on a journey through a new mythological realm as Porasy, an Indigenous warrior. Explore uncharted landscapes, unleash the power of Muiraquitãs, unravel your story, and vanquish the Seven Legendary Beasts to carve your own legend. Are you ready to dive into this epic adventure?

games.name: Collapsed Horizon
games.summary: Travel between galaxies, dig planets, collect ores, sell them, upgrade your equipment, and earn your ticket back to Earth.

games.name: PhantomZone Labyrinthos
games.summary: ”The nightmare that never allows waking lasts forever.” You wake up from bed and a girl appears before you. She calls herself “Entourfe,” a management support android. The stage is a strange facility, and you will explore the inside of the strange facility with her.

games.name: 100 Caliber Dash
games.summary: A short, fast-paced Boomer Shooter. Blast and Dash through the Cult of the Serious and their curious lair to save your dog, Lucky.

games.name: Hats and Guns
games.summary: Become a cardslinger in this roguelike deckbuilder with tactical elements. Fight, gather weapons and items, face unexpected events and upgrade your cards for hundreds of possibilities. Every run is unique and so are you, the best shot of the Far West looking for your upcoming revenge.

games.name: Puppeteer: No Strings Attached
games.summary: In a world controlled by strings, YOU are not attached. Fight your way through champions of ancient fairy tales in this action packed boss-rush game, escape the grip of The Puppeteer, and write your own ending.

games.name: Aspiel: Edge of Chaos
games.summary: Aspiel: Edge of Chaos is a third-person fantasy Action-RPG. Explore numerous locations ravaged by the dark power of Death, face various creatures consumed by Chaos, and harness the power of Life to save the continent of Aspiel.

games.name: Exoshock
games.summary: Exoshock is a 1-4 co-op sci-fi PvE shooter driven by one vision: to deliver the most visceral combat. Built from the ground up for both VR and PC with full cross-play.

games.name: Penguin Festival
games.summary: You are a penguin! Lend a helping flipper to your community as it prepares for an annual festival. Complete some last-minute festival to-dos during the day while you explore the vibrant penguin town. When night falls, join everyone and enjoy the festivities with games and music!

games.name: Okko the Exiled
games.summary: Okko The Exiled is an action-packed adventure where you stomp, launch and bash your way through Kutala, a land of demons, on a quest to defeat the Demon Lord Yalda and link Okko’s isolated world with the heavens.

games.name: Nomad Drive
games.summary: Repair your rundown RV and hit the road solo or in 1–4 player co-op through a procedurally generated post-apocalyptic world. Gather resources, customize your RV, and survive as long as you can.

games.name: The Blue Cut Hook
games.summary: The Blue Cut Hook blends cozy tavern management with subtle adventure. You're no hero, just a humble tavern keeper, but your food, gear, and advice quietly shape the adventurers who pass through. They make the choices, take the glory, and face the danger, but your influence might keeps them alive.

games.name: Take Them Down
games.summary: Combine weapons and abilities in this fast-paced, violent action game to take down necromancers, demons, and betrayers while avoiding being cleaved and crushed by blades, traps, and mines sprawled across nightmarish, macabre levels. NOT A ROGUELIKE, game features handcrafted levels.

games.name: The Devil's Due
games.summary: You lost your soul in a poker game against the Devil. Now, trapped in the infernal depths, your only hope is to fight your way back to freedom. You’ll face a diverse gallery of monstrous foes in nearly impossible poker battles - but luckily, you’re a cheater.

games.name: Local Supermarket Tycoon
games.summary: Design the perfect neighbourhood supermarket! Research customer needs, carefully stock your shelves, and plan every aisle to maximize traffic and boost impulse sales

games.name: Deep Pixel Melancholy
games.summary: You're stuck in a time loop inside a far northern city. Unravel the mystery, and decide whether escaping is really worth it.

games.name: Gunny Ascend
games.summary: A Roguelite Block-Stacking Adventure. Stack, Adapt, Escape!! Gunny Ascend is a high-speed puzzle game where every falling block is a chance to escape. Build clever loadouts, adapt to ever-changing hazards, and outsmart the Collectors in this chaotic, dimension-hopping adventure.

games.name: Homepage
games.summary: A horror anomaly finder where you are contracted to observe websites and report errors and changes. But there is more to your clients than meets the eye.

games.name: Spinning My Wheel
games.summary: Build a physics‑powered hamster‑wheel, master rocket‑boosted moves, to lead a brain chipped enhanced hamster through puzzles, mining, and laboratory‑runner mayhem.

games.name: GTL Schedule
games.summary: In a post-apocalyptic world where food has become contraband and hope is on the brink of extinction, you quietly ignite a revolution to warm the world with a spatula and love.

games.name: Tiny Delivery
games.summary: It’s a cozy adventure about a small delivery robot on a short but unforgettable journey. Deliver your package through a vibrant town, meet new people, stumble upon both funny and touching moments, discover hidden treasures, and soak in the world around you.

games.name: Exofactory
games.summary: Awaken as a forgotten AI on an alien world, your every choice reshapes your technology, environment, and identity. Automate deeply transformative factories in a chill open world, where the story evolves uniquely around you.

games.name: DungeonBox
games.summary: A new Dungeons & Dragons Party Game! Let our Dungeon Master take you and up to 8 players on an adventure, where you control the next move by answering and voting from your phones

games.name: Fatal Train
games.summary: Murder on the train? It doesn't matter, it's no longer our concern! Ladies and gentlemen, don't worry, we have four detectives who can handle this! After all, there's nothing complicated about murder investigations, right?

games.name: Sketchy Driver
games.summary: An arcade, roguelike endless racer where you dodge traffic, jump ramps, perform tricks, earn points, and level up to make the run more entertaining, aiming for the best score. No story. No brakes. No problem.

games.name: Cinema Theater Tycoon
games.summary: Tycoon game where you manage your movie theater through more than 100 years of history. Build and customize your cinematic empire without being overtaken by the evolution of the 7th art.

games.name: Pigeon Guild
games.summary: Pigeon Guild is a non-combat, single-player action RPG where you play as Jules Corso, a rookie cadet in Cassandria's most prestigious airborne postal service. Navigate your flying cargo boat through a world of floating islands, where every delivery tells a story.

games.name: Dimenshot
games.summary: An intense, fast-paced FPS that seamlessly blends parkour and shooting. Master fluid movement, engage in dynamic close combat, and unleash devastating firepower across diverse worlds and unique themes, each filled with dangerous enemies and epic battles.

games.name: Project Octavia
games.summary: A stylized third-person spy action game with infiltration, gunplay, Close Quarter Combat (CQC) and innovative and dynamic sabotage gadget crafting with brand new science-fiction based stealth action multiplayer gameplay!

games.name: Economic Miracle
games.summary: Economic miracle is an informal economic term for a period of dramatic economic development that is entirely unexpected or unexpectedly strong. Economic miracles have occurred in the recent histories of a number of countries, often those undergoing an economic boom or described as a tiger economy.

games.name: He-Man and the Masters of the Universe: Dragon Pearl of Destruction
games.summary: Take control of He-Man, Man-At-Arms, and Teela in a fast-paced, magic-brawler that blends the crunch of arcade classics with the high-fantasy action of the animated series.

games.name: Rhythm Rat Rampage
games.summary: Rhythm meets bullet heaven in a genre-smashing fusion. Strik-9 challenges you to dodge to the beat and shred your enemies in a music-driven gauntlet of chaos, speed, and style.

games.name: FrogSpin
games.summary: A wind-up frogventure bursting with colorful platforming and roguelike surprises. Spin the slots, master precision jumps, and rack up points. Ready to leap into action? 🐸

games.name: Micro Titans Wrestling
games.summary: Micro Titans Wrestling is a nostalgia fuelled roguelike deck builder themed on the golden age of professional wrestling. Prepare to step into the ring with a roster of era defining characters and take it to the mat with a unique card battle system.

games.name: War of Banners
games.summary: War of Banners is a sandbox turn-based tactical RPG set in a medieval open world. Recruit companions, lead your army, and claim victory across brutal battlefields. From a wandering mercenary band to an empire-ruling sovereign — your fate is shaped by strategy and choice.

games.name: Astra Bestiary
games.summary: Raise Beasts from eggs into powerful Champions in this 2D monster-raising/taming RPG. Feed, train and evolve your partners to explore a perilous, non-linear world. Master fast-paced, tactical battles, uncover the secrets of a fading world and pass on the Beasts' legacy across generations.

games.name: Souls Alive: Origins
games.summary: Souls Alive: Origins is a Lovecraftian survival horror game set in a dark sci-fi future. Explore a world where reality bends, ancient cults return, and Cthulhu stirs once more. With a strong focus on story, atmosphere, and visual detail.

games.name: Potions of Veldenkeep
games.summary: Run your own alchemist shop in the fantasy City of Adventurers! Grow plants, brew potions, set prices, and serve curious villagers. Earn gold, build reputation, and expand your craft in this cozy first-person herbalist simulator.

games.name: Appa
games.summary: Appa is a surreal narrative-driven card battler about two siblings dealing with the death of their father. Predict, counter, and outmaneuver manifestations of grief while uncovering a heartfelt story somewhere between dreams and reality.

games.name: IPS 13: All Signals Lost
games.summary: Take command of the massive VOD(Vehicle of Destruction) and journey across planet Gaiganthra with your IPS(Inter-Planetary Squad)-13 crew to uncover the mystery of humans there. Be prepared for the worse and ready to fight. Upgrade your VOD, hire new crew factions, to be the ultimate War Machine.

games.name: Raccoon Valley Tycoon
games.summary: Raccoon Valley Tycoon is a cozy clicker tycoon game about rebuilding your village with help from a mysterious new friend. The King is missing, and it’s up to you to restore what was lost. Click, collect, upgrade, and delegate your hard work to cute raccoons.

games.name: Armada Pet Wars
games.summary: Armada Pet Wars is a 4X-lite asynchronous turn based space-themed strategy game... with pets. Design Starships, make or break alliances, setup your fleets for victory in this strategic, space-themed, auto-battler.

games.name: Pelican Empyrean
games.summary: Food is love! In this fantastical roguelike card game share the magic of abundance by cooking delicious meals for all who come to Pelican's kitchen.

games.name: Hemobloom
games.summary: A psychological horror game where you explore a twisted realm of nightmares, confront grotesque monsters and piece together the mystery of the Hemobloom.

games.name: Another's Memories
games.summary: Another's Memories is a first-person psychological horror video game located in Argentina. Explore a sinister country house, solve puzzles, and survive ruthless enemies in an immersive experience where every shadow hides a disturbing story.

games.name: Rolla
games.summary: Play as the monster from the movie series that never existed, ROLLA. ROLL. EAT. REPEAT. Fast paced arcade game with chunky old school 3d graphics: eat people, destroy whole cities and battle with cops, army and government agents! Uncover the secrets of what ROLLA is and where it is from.

games.name: Dear Poe
games.summary:
You have received a mysterious email! After the death of an underworld citizen caused by a strange letter, Poe and Arthur are called in to investigate the case and prevent further tragedies. But what appears to be a simple crime soon reveals something much bigger, involving wandering demons and a much more complex dark plot.

Dear Poe is a spin-off of Dark Light, set 6 months before the main events of the game.

games.name: Five More Minutes
games.summary: Build your deck and strategize to defeat foes as you traverse videogame worlds. Choose between 3 unique starting genres, and combine them to create unstoppable combos! Five more minutes is a love letter to growing up with the emotional support of our best friend: videogames.

games.name: Deorum
games.summary: Descend into the forsaken dungeon and fight the horrors in the dark. Gather occult materials, craft nightmarish coins, and settle your debt to the cosmic powers. Obey the Divine Festival.

games.name: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba - The Hinokami Chronicles: Tanjiro Kamado (Infinity Castle) Character Pack
Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba - The Hinokami Chronicles: Shinobu Kocho (Infinity Castle) Character Pack
Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba - The Hinokami Chronicles: Giyu Tomioka (Infinity Castle) Character Pack
Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba - The Hinokami Chronicles: Doma Character Pack
Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba - The Hinokami Chronicles: Akaza (Infinity Castle) Character Pack
Solaria
games.summary: Solaria is a genus of South American plants in the family Amaryllidaceae, subfamily Allioideae, tribe Gilliesieae, native to Chile and Argentina. Kew treats Solaria as a synonym of Gilliesia. The genus is named in honor of Chilean mathematician Francisco Borja de Solar. Species Solaria atropurpurea (Phil.) Ravenna - Chile (O'Higgins, Santiago) Solaria attenuata Ravenna - Chile, Argentina (Neuquén) Solaria brevicoalita Ravenna - Chile (Maule) Solaria curacavina Ravenna - Chile (Santiago) Solaria cuspidata (Harv. ex Baker) Ravenna - Chile (Coquimbo) Solaria miersioides Phil. - Chile

games.name: Drillbound
games.summary: Drillbound is a short incremental game about mining your way to the planet’s core. Crush layers of rock, gather resources, upgrade your drill, and unlock powerful technologies as you descend into the depths.

games.name: Diffusion
games.summary: Tower defense / Roguelike / Sci-Fi / Pixel Art game with boomer games aesthetics. Mine resources and shoot those disgusting aliens right in their faces. Unlock new technology, develop new strategies and explore the planet. A modern old-school Pixel Art experience with the vibe of 90s classics.

games.name: Starlet Disorder
games.summary:
A psychological horror visual novel/RPG hybrid set inside a neon-noir reality television competition about fame, romance, surveillance, and public collapse. Players take the role of Adam, a rising entertainer with an uncertain past, as he enters the second season of Starlet Disorder alongside seven other contestants.

Each week combines life simulation, investigation, relationship-building, broadcast manipulation, and timed social combat in the Live Chamber. Through the PRISM system, player stats shape perception, access, and pressure choices as relationships turn into comfort, rivalry, scandal, evidence, or weapons in the show’s official narrative.

games.name: Torii: Beyond the Gates
games.summary: The spirit realm has broken. Your brother has gone missing. Forge the path you were destined for. Explore the gates and find out why there has been broken links inside the spirit realm. Battle, discover and find the secrets, and make new connections in a beautiful hand-drawn 2D style.

games.name: Fortunato
games.summary: Draw a pair of aces, use them as poker hands or to eliminate your opponents? A poker roguelike battle card game. Build a deck of jokers, defeat bosses, modify cards, and conquer challenges across the ever-changing islands. At the table of four, win by chips or remaining health, your call...

games.name: Bruisers 2D Boxing
games.summary: Bruisers is unlike any boxing game before it. Climb from amateur bouts to the top of the pros. Train, eat, fight, dope, and deal with anyone who wants a piece of you on the way up — but tread lightly. Some consequences here are fatal

games.name: Redhowl
games.summary: Social deduction game for 4 to 15 players, inspired by Little Red Riding Hood. 3 factions clash: use your unique powers, unmask them or be devoured before the Blood Moon turns against you.

games.name: Wrongly Accused
games.summary: Explore historical locations, find and analyse evidence. Unmask the real perpetrator so that justice can be served and the Wrongly Accused can be found innocent. Use problem solving, deduction and critical thinking skills to uncover the truth and maybe even expose a conspiracy in your own time.

games.name: City Party
games.summary: City Party is an 8-player simultaneous turn-based party game. All players act at once—no waiting! Roll dice on beautifully crafted global city maps, use skills, control special tiles, play combo cards, challenge opponents, and collect legendary treasures. Win this urban adventure your way!

games.name: Moorestech
games.summary: Factory automation meets anime-style RPG. Harness gears and shafts to power machines and conveyors, building an automated factory. Produce items and research tech, evolving from windmills to fusion as you trace humanity’s tech evolution, then launch a rocket home to uncover the truth of your exile.

games.name: Codex Arcana: Grimoire of Monsters
games.summary: Summon an army of Monster Girls to face your enemies in strategic battles! Defeat the Dark Lord's minions and expand your collection with cool, fierce and cute Monster Girls of all variety in this "Capsule Monsters" inspired game!

games.name: Myth of Valderit
games.summary:
Myth of Valderit is a psychological horror experience set in the cursed village of Valderit, inspired by the abandoned Catalan village of La Mussara. You wake up as Nil, separated from your friends Julia and Enric, and soon uncover the dark secrets lurking within the village…

This single-player, first-person experience combines exploration, survival, and puzzle-solving. Nil must endure and remain alive, evading the fanatical devotees of an unimaginable entity.

games.name: Pepper the Giant Purple Dog
games.summary: In this twist on a harmless pet simulator, take care of Pepper, who happens to be a giant purple dog. But when things go awry, you will have to decide: how many lives is one good boy worth?

games.name: Tom Lander: The Exiled King
games.summary: Pilot wacky aerial vehicles with silly key-based controls through an epic action packed campaign. Struggle to stay airborne while performing deliveries, rescues, firefighting missions, bombing runs, and chaotic dogfights. This game will remind you that flying is hard, but landing is harder.

games.name: Wukong Survivors: God Slayer
games.summary: Wukong Survivors" is a TPS + ROGUE game where players control Sun Wukong and his friends, sweeping through all visible enemies and rescuing their captured master.

games.name: AGX GP
games.summary: AGX is a heart thumpingly fast, Anti-Gravity racing game. It's lightning‑fast action and Xtreme ability‑based gameplay, will push your reactions and skills to the limit! Welcome To AGX!

games.name: InterViolence
games.summary: Wander through a secret lair. Help a young supervillain move out of his lifelong home. Think about your past, and his uncertain future. The third entry in the Violence series.

games.name: Eye of Syn
games.summary: Summon and combine demons to battle against zombie hordes in Eye of Syn, a lane based tower defense game where you must protect two dimensions at once. Uncover dark secrets and powerful demon synergies as you try to save Earth from an eldritch apocalypse.

games.name: Essentia: A Monster Catching Adventure
games.summary: Isometric dungeon crawler with procedurally generated levels. A wide variety of cute monster characters to collect. A turn-based battle system with unique mana mechanic. Uncover the secrets of the calamity that has left this world in chaos.

games.name: Farming With Lasers
games.summary: Incinerate various pests with your giant laser, as you grow your farm. Purchase incremental upgrades to expedite the process.

games.name: Beyond The Cupola: ISS Simulator
games.summary: You are the ISS crew, where the station's fate depends on everyone. Oxygen leaks, system failures, meteorite threats — repair with your own hands and make real-time decisions. Complete missions, perform spacewalks. Experience life in orbit: in space, nothing goes according to plan.

games.name: Local Zombies
games.summary: Death is just a career change. Shape unique characters in this turn-based life sim, then resurrect them as zombie companions. Transform their past talents into tactical advantages to take over the city.

games.name: No More Pesticide
games.summary: No More Pesticide is an active incremental game about a cute frog exterminating swarms of mutant bugs, building a farm, and taking down an evil pesticide manufacturer.

games.name: Michael Test
games.summary: This is a test about sin. An audio-driven horror mystery where you reconstruct the hidden timeline inside a painting through sound and expose the sin concealed within.

games.name: Reel Tiny
games.summary: Welcome to Critters Crick! Catch fish, upgrade gear, and explore the mountain’s creek in this loveable micro-fishing game! You play as The Shrew, a mammal with a burning passion for fishing. Bask in the variety of rods, lures, reels, and fish that keep folks in this cozy community busy year-round!

games.name: Barefort
games.summary: "The fewer defenses you have, the more you become yourself." On the board, the score spreads over time, and corruption erodes. Stack units to create chain effects and turn the tide with minimal placement. Placing too many units will destroy you, while placing too few will prevent you from defending.

games.name: Freelance Dead
games.summary: A roguelite top‑down twin‑stick shooter. Rain, shine, or zombie outbreak—nothing stops a Courier on a deadline. Shoot, loot, and scoot through hordes of undead with ridiculous item synergies. Earn cash, unlock weapons, and grow from broke gig worker to a walking apocalypse.

games.name: PGA Tour 2K25: Clubhouse Pass Premium Season 8
Purrfect Tanks: The Yarnpocalypse
games.summary: Command adorable cats in chaotic cardboard tanks and battle for the last yarn on Earth! Explosions, lasers, catnip-fueled madness — and lots of cardboard.

games.name: Flipper on Recoil
games.summary: Flipper on Recoil is a fast-paced 3D platformer where a fish with legs and a shotgun takes on gravity. Use recoil, power-ups, and absurd tricks to blast through handcrafted levels and chase your best times.

games.name: Oiran Survival: Edo Yokai Rush
games.summary: An alluring oiran dances through the blood-soaked nights of Edo. Where beauty and violence collide — a dopamine-fueled survival action.

games.name: Wrecked
games.summary: Choose your vehicle, install weapons and protections, and launch yourself in the biggest multiplayer challenge ever seen!

games.name: Dream Delirio's
games.summary: Blast through waves of children’s nightmares with Magnus, a cereal mascot fighting to free the children from their fears. Weaponize your breakfast, build game-breaking card synergies and show these nightmares that crunch time is over.

games.name: The Postman Cometh
games.summary: Deliver mail in a strange little town in the middle of nowhere. Meet a colorful cast of villagers as you try to figure out what happened to the previous postman.

games.name: Southbound
games.summary: "SOUTHBOUND" is an oldschool 2D JRPG with the flavor of some classic JRPGs.

games.name: Good Catch!
games.summary: Good Catch! is a relaxing fishing game about cozy fishing spots, rare catches, small quests and friendly characters you unlock along the way.

games.name: Chinese Strange Stories
games.summary: Step into a living Chinese painting that blends the mystical, supernatural, and the struggles of daily life in the final years of the Ming dynasty. Experience a unique mix of classic turn-based RPG mechanics and dynamic card battling, where strategy and fate intertwine.

games.name: Rules: Motel Horizon
games.summary: Start your job as a night administrator at the mysterious Horizon Motel, where visitors from another world try to pass as ordinary people, and the rules have the highest priority — breaking them leads to… undesirable consequences.

games.name: Polydangerous
games.summary: Build and defend a mining operation on a distant planet in this tower defense bullet heaven shooter. Build and upgrade defenses, fight off waves of enemies from a rival corporation, and earn enough credits to buy your body back and escape this deep space hellhole.

games.name: Pool Loop
games.summary: You are trapped in a looping indoor swimming pool. Inspect the pool carefully and decide whether it is safe or not. If anything feels strange, get out. Now!

games.name: Beware of the Cartographer!
games.summary:
A young cartographer is sent out by his hierarchy into the rural land of his childhood to redraw a frontier: he will gradually discover that this place, which for him was just a set of inky territories, is actually steeped in stories, inhabited by people who have no idea what's going on around them and whose relationship to space is radically different...
The player embodies a land surveyor who explores a rural territory and must make choices that will have an impact on diplomacy, but also on the local population. The game combines visual novel phases and observational puzzles — the two aspects nourishing each other to modify the plot of an interactive story.

games.name: Scrappy Craft
games.summary: Scrappy Craft is a shopkeeping game where you run a small forge. Scavenge trash and combine it to craft over 10000 absurd weapons like banana swords or Frisbee shields, buy upgrades, unlock new recipes and sell your bizarre creations to quirky customers like tie-wearing otters or spaghetti monsters.

games.name: Silberheim Evolving Card Game
games.summary: Silberheim ECG (Evolving Card Game) is a fantasy trading card game. Cards—called Fragments—can evolve based on a player’s actions and playstyle, creating a personalized experience within the expanding world and lore of Silberheim.

games.name: Fame or Folly
games.summary: In a world where wars are fought on stages, compete for a single royal request from the King. Fame or Folly is a deckbuilder of deckbuilders where you draft a new trouper every turn. Recruit wisely, unlock powerful synergies, and survive the critics in this handcrafted pixel-art strategy roguelite

games.name: Red Howl
games.summary: Social deduction game for 4 to 15 players, inspired by Little Red Riding Hood. 3 factions clash: use your unique powers and unmask them before the Blood Moon turns against you, or be devoured.

games.name: The War Disorder Hexa
games.summary: War consumes the Kingdom of Node as an empire marches forward. Six protagonists stand on different sides of the conflict, each driven by their own motives, struggles, and paths to survival.

games.name: Gridlords
games.summary: Gridlords is a strategic async-PvP autobattler set in a fantasy pixel-art world. Build your ultimate castle, command legendary heroes, and outsmart rivals to prove your strategy reigns supreme.

games.name: Salvation Denied
games.summary: Salvation Denied is a chaotic co-op building sim for 1-4 players. Team up to build wild constructions with heavy machinery and crazy tools. Each mission brings a completely new challenge, while physics and disasters push your creation to the limit.

games.name: Obey Me! Sinner's Choice: Lucifer
games.summary: You are the magistrate, and Lucifer stands trial as the defendant. Judge the fallen angel in this dark romance visual novel. Decide whether he is worthy of salvation, or doomed to destruction.

games.name: Click & Mine
games.summary: Click & Mine is a relaxing incremental mining game. Mine various resources and use them to buy upgrades, allowing you to descend deeper and deeper while unlocking new biomes, ores and skills.

games.name: Sadko
games.summary: Monsters are closing in from all sides, and all you've got is a gusli… and the letter O? Dynamic combat with Slavic folk music, hero progression, and building a unique build to take on each location and its boss - so you can finally face Koschei himself.

games.name: SnowRunner: Season 19 - Research & Restore
games.summary: Research & Restore Season of Snowrunner. Included in the Year 5 Pass. Requires the base game SnowRunner to run.

games.name: Worlds Explorers
games.summary: Explore alien planets with carefully designed ecosystems, weather, resources, dangers and unique phenomena. Hunt animals for food and collect resources to craft equipment and repair devices on your ship. Escape each unique planet and unlock crew members and new ships.

games.name: The Last Inquisition
games.summary: The witch hunt begins. Command your followers in a dark roguelike strategy experience. Evolve spells and units without limits through blood and faith. Shape formations, adapt tactics, and uncover the conspiracy in ever-changing battles.

games.name: Mayfly
games.summary: Mayfly was an American Christian metal band from Dayton, Ohio, formed in 2011. They have released one extended play, Vereor Deus, Non Dogma, in 2014, with Voluminous Records. On March 14, 2017, the band announced that had disbanded.

games.name: Folders on the Run
games.summary: Escape the factory reset! Control two adorable folders in a failing OS. Play solo or coordinate your movements with a friend. Master shifting mechanics to survive. Perfect for testing your skills and friendships!

games.name: Czar Ry
games.summary: Physically interactive adventure where you must escape a strange abyssal structure inside a batholith by learning its secrets. Use fully interactive physical hands: reach, grab, drag, hold. No action buttons, no clicks, no hotkeys. Every door, lever, and chain requires your hands to move further.

games.name: TideBroker
games.summary: A story-rich role-playing game, TideBroker will take you to a fantasy world of secrets and machinations of three opposing factions. You will play the part of an envoy and determine the outcome of a peace conference through dialogue, letters and books.

games.name: Stamperor! The Jester's Decree
games.summary: A city builder where you play as an alien jester who becomes a temporary emperor and must make unusual decisions by stamping decrees, trying at all costs to keep everything from collapsing.

games.name: Airport Control 27
games.summary: Airport Control is a next-generation 3D ATC simulation. Take the positions at airports worldwide—marshalling taxis, sequencing departures, and spacing arrivals. Remember: Safe, orderly, expeditious.

games.name: Echoes of the Scourge
games.summary: Every year, a festival is held to celebrate the founding of Springure, a small and quaint town. Odette, a girl grieving a dear friend, suddenly finds herself in an empty, distorted version of her hometown.

games.name: Dravenmoor
games.summary: A fantasy sidescroller to search your missing friend in a mysterious town. Inspired by Alice in Wonderland and various punk artworks.

games.name: Celestay Craft&Slowlife
games.summary: CELESTAY is a calm idle building game where you fish for materials and grow your home toward the sky. In a world sunk beneath the sea, you stack pieces of a house and spend quiet days fishing and watching the stars. The higher you build, the more constellations and memories fill your world.

games.name: Charming Hill
games.summary: Charming Hill is a small experimental game where creating beautiful paintings feels easy and natural. No artistic skills are needed; it’s a space to relax, paint, and discover a heartwarming story, or better yet, paint your own.

games.name: Exorcist Hotline
games.summary: The world is full of ghosts. So who you gonna call? The Exorcist Hotline! A multiplayer investigative survival horror puzzle game for up to 4 players. One operator. Three exorcists. And a demon. Work together or die trying.

games.name: Keysaster
games.summary: On your way to meet a friend at a cafe, you suddenly black out for reasons unknown.... awakening in a place that is clearly not the human world. If you want to survive, evade hostile entities and search for key items to escape.

games.name: Orbit to Riches
games.summary: Orbit to Riches is a short, relaxing incremental space game where you mine asteroids, upgrade ships, and grow stronger over multiple runs - no timers, no rush.

games.name: Video Game Menu: The Game
games.summary: A short game about the very best part of video games: the menus.

games.name: ProTax 98
games.summary: A short 90s bureaucratic horror game where you process impossible tax forms for the living, the dead, and the unborn.

games.name: Required Synergy Workshop: Deja Damnation
games.summary:
Mandatory orientation at a corporate hellscape. The loop never ends. A psychological horror visual novel where your accumulated choices build a hidden profile and the world around you adjusts accordingly.

Public demo available on Steam. Full release is currently in development.

games.name: Plobania 47/B
games.summary: Immortality is not a blessing, it is a burden. As Milton Clarke, you work at the 47/B Mandatory Sleep Hospital, review documents, surf the internet, and decide who will no longer exist. You don’t kill anyone. You only “put them to sleep.” The rules are clear. Every decision has consequences.

games.name: Teddy Is Coming
games.summary: A 1–6 player online co-op horror game where you steal rare medicine from an abandoned children’s hospital while being hunted by a relentless Teddy that grows more aggressive with every passing minute !

games.name: Alpha Spectrum
games.summary: Alpha Spectrum is a cyberpunk RPG set in a dystopian 2030, where a massive cyberattack pushes humanity into systemic collapse. You are a CIA agent with psionic abilities caught in the chaos. Shape an immersive storyline through choices guided by your playstyle and intuition.

games.name: Bomb the Hill
games.summary: BOMB THE HILL is a cinematic VR downhill skateboarding experience inspired by the outlaw spirit of 70s freeride culture. Race through dangerous mountain roads, slide through traffic at insane speeds, discover hidden shortcuts, and survive brutal crashes

games.name: Otpisani: Nightingale
games.summary: A retro shooter game inspired by old TV show. You play as a part of resistance movement and fight German occupation in a set of explosive missions while experiencing exciting story.

games.name: Shepherd
games.summary: Lead a small herd of sheep through the desert. Ensure their survival by managing their needs. Protect and save them from various environmental hazards, as well as their own silly decisions. Bond with them over the course of your journey by fulfilling their wishes, and be their Shepherd.

games.name: EmbeRogue
games.summary: EmbeRogue is a real roguelike: turn-based, grid-based and boom-based, where everything can burn. Make your escape or tame your inner flames to defeat the FireLords.

games.name: Broadside Bets
games.summary: This isn't a casino. This is war! Command the crew, upgrade your deck and collect rule-bending Booty. Discover devastating combinations and destroy your enemies as you navigate a branching map full of encounters, islands and treasure.

games.name: Stellar Breach
games.summary: Blast through massive waves and tough bosses in this chaotic sci-fi roguelite shooter. Guide the charming duo, Barnaby and C.A.T., through a branching narrative via multiple-choice interactions where your story decisions directly alter randomized loadouts and abilities on every run!

games.name: Junkyard Stories: Rebirth
games.summary: A dystopian sci-fi adventure where you're a broken robot carrying the consciousness of a legendary hacker. Cross landscapes shaped by war, scavenge supplies, hack systems and solve puzzles as your battery drains. Infiltrate Block-07 to find the person who can save your mind before it's lost forever.

games.name: Crewed
games.summary: Crewed is a 2–6 player cooperative spaceship management game. Players take on the role of corporate workers operating a fragile, poorly maintained spaceship for a megacorporation. The objective is to keep critical ship systems running, repair dynamic disasters, and complete procedurally generated missions while coordinating with the crew.

games.name: Wheel Make It
games.summary: One wheelchair. Two players. Infinite chaos. Solo or co-op physics-based game about teamwork, clumsiness, and the unstoppable power of friendship.

games.name: Order 13 VR
games.summary: A psychological horror VR experience where you work the night shift inside a mysterious warehouse while taking care of your cat. Fulfill orders, survive the darkness, and uncover what hides between the shelves.

games.name: Grisaia: Shuuketsu no Hyakka - Les Rassemblement Cent Fruits de la Grisaia
games.summary: A gacha game sequel to Grisaia no Rakuen.

games.name: Catnip Cosmos
games.summary:
A short incremental shooter.
Shoot. Upgrade. Incrementally progress further. Pilot cat-operated spaceships on timed Zoomies runs in this space shooter. Combine pilots for powerful synergies, defeat boss challenges to unlock new weapons and improve exponentially.

games.name: Please, Spin
games.summary: The wheel of fate roguelike where you spin for your life. Customize your wheel, discover game-breaking relics, survive twisted side events, and outsmart rigged bosses to beat the lunatic host and escape the broadcast!

games.name: Dark Bros
games.summary: A chaotic online multiplayer arena brawler focused on physics-driven combat, bizarre abilities, and fast matches with friends.

"Who do you want to save? Or rather... who are you prepared to abandon?" A midnight "Unsend" trapped them in a rift in time, and awakened the dead "You." Become a "Ghost" inhabiting screens and surveillance feeds. Pry into perfect disguises and rotting hearts.

games.name: Minesweeper: Next-Gen
games.summary: This isn’t the Minesweeper you’re used to! In Minesweeper: Next-Gen, you’ll explore boards built from a variety of geometric tessellations. Boundaries can wrap around, tiles can split, and parts of the map can even contain the map itself. Rely on pure logic to gradually uncover all safe areas.

games.name: For The Cat! Sorcerer's Revenge
games.summary: They killed your cat. Fatal mistake. In this magic-infused bullet-heaven roguelike, develop your wizard, upgrade and evolve spells, collect items, and create unstoppable builds while battling hordes of enemies.

games.name: Okurek
games.summary: Tend the farm, the chickens, the grieving jars. The trees murmur while the cancer grows with every passing day. A 90-min folk-horror experience set in the rotting mountains of Czech Switzerland. Preserve what you couldn't save.

games.name: Queueue
games.summary: An abstract, tile-based puzzle game where the moves you make are for turns not-yet done. Dodging through traps you will arrive at 2 turns in the future quickly becomes a mind-bending puzzle as the levels grow more complex. How hard can a level with only 6 tiles be?

games.name: Thieves and Gold
games.summary: Smash containers, grab the gold, uncover hidden keys, and recruit a crew of thieves in this medieval loot-heist incremental. Race the clock in Heist Mode or play relaxed in Casual Mode.

games.name: The Birdsong Tree
games.summary: A cozy building and light simulation game where you observe birds, create custom birdhouses, and help a living urban tree grow. Balance sound, diversity, and neighbor reactions as you shape a calm, reactive environment.

games.name: They Stop for Gas at Night
games.summary: A first-person horror simulation game. You owe money. So you work nights at a gas station in the middle of nowhere. Serve whoever shows up, and try not to think about what's watching from the dark. Something ancient is watching, and it isn't planning to leave.

games.name: Warlordocracy: Chapter 6
games.summary: 20 years after the Unwritten Revolution, the wild animals of the frigid Viridi Northlands have begun attacking human settlements, and the krugen are uniting against Frostgate. Lead your aging party through the biting snows on a final journey.
aliases: Warlordocracy Chapter 6: The Path of Glass

games.name: Look Up and Go
games.summary: Wishlist this fast paced, fps, score attack where every run is a risk. Use your points to bet on your own survival or make other players' runs harder. Get combos by stabbing, shooting, and doing tricks. Ascend the tower. Climb the leader board. Wishlist now.

games.name: Mobius
games.summary: Mobius is a 5v5 First-Person Melee game being developed with Unreal Engine 5. Its core pillars include a high-skill ceiling, competitive gameplay, and user-created content.

games.name: OneStarHotel
games.summary: Run a chaotic one-star hotel with your friends. Cook meals, serve guests, manage the restaurant, and survive the night while hiding the hotel's darkest secret

games.name: Guild of Three
games.summary: Guild of Three is a turn-based deckbuilding RPG where you command a party of three characters — each with their own deck. Combine different classes, pass relay cards between allies, and position your party across the front and back lines to create your own combat strategy.

games.name: Colorfall
games.summary: A chaotic 1-4 player co-op match-3 game where you and your friends each control only 1 color. Survive the falling grid by pulling and throwing orbs to trigger chains and finish tasks before time runs out. If your color piles up, it’s on you to clear the path.

games.name: Growing My Manhole
games.summary: Consume the universe, grow from Manhole to Black Hole in this insatiable incremental game.

games.name: Beatcore Zero
games.summary: Try Beatcore for free! A simple rhythm game where you hit beats as they come down the lanes. This version does not permit access to the workshop.

games.name: Dearbnb
games.summary:
Dearbnb is a cozy management game where you build a real estate empire one room at a time.

Start your journey by renting a small apartment in a modest neighborhood. Carefully decorate rooms, place furniture freely, set prices, and welcome tenants and customers. As you gain experience and reputation, unlock new zones — from poor districts to luxury neighborhoods and expand into residences, shops, and massive commercial properties.

Every room matters.
Every decision shapes your path to becoming a true property tycoon.

games.name: Broom Racer
games.summary: Broom Racer is a first person, multiplayer party racing game on flying brooms. Race your friends or players world wide through mountains, tight tunnels, forests and more. Evade enemies, pickup items to gain an advantage and fly risky maneuvers to gain a speed boost. Don't fall of your broom!

games.name: Clawless Coin
games.summary: Ever won something from a claw machine? Neither has this one. Clawless Coin is a cozy incremental arcade idler where you run a neon-lit claw machine arcade, chase six tiers of trophy plushes, and prestige into trillions of tokens. Grab big. Grip harder. Grow your empire.

games.name: Where Control Ends
games.summary: Where Control Ends is a psychological visual novel about Astra, a young girl trying to hold herself together after a night she cannot fully remember.

games.name: Fluff Up
games.summary: Fluff Up is a charming yet challenging game where you control a chubby little bird flapping through a fantastical sea of clouds. Master your speed, manage your stamina, and ride the clouds to reach the highest skies.

games.name: Interred
games.summary: He never blinks. You wake up across from a presence in a room with no exit. Play a distorted, stat-based strategy gamble on a 5x5 grid. Draw from the chest, upgrade your stones, and outsmart an opponent who learns from your fear. Every move is a sacrifice. Don't keep Him waiting.

games.name: Renegade Run
games.summary: Renegade Run is a rogue-lite deckbuilder that puts you in the pilot seat of an experimental starship. Discover anomalies, carve your path, and face powerful enemies as you battle your way back to Sector 0.

games.name: Murder Castle
games.summary: You are trapped inside a masterpiece of madness. Unravel the chilling mystery of H.H. Holmes Murder Castle. In this atmospheric true crime escape simulator, every room is a puzzle and every document a shocking discovery. Can you escape the architect of death?

games.name: Hang Out
games.summary: Hang Out is a visual novel with multiple gameplay elements. You awaken in a bizarre town ruled by the “Sea of the Sky,” guided by a familiar yet unreadable figure. As residents mutate and factions clash, you uncover buried memories and a truth meant to stay forgotten

games.name: Medium Chronicles: Room 644
games.summary: You must speak to survive. But speaking might kill you. Whisper rituals into your microphone — while a demon hunts every sound you make.

games.name: Backrooms Dream With Tung Tung Tung Sahur
games.summary: Backrooms Dream with Tung Tung Tung Sahur is a first-person psychological horror game about a lonely man trapped in a surreal dream loop. Explore strange levels, solve eerie puzzles, survive terrifying chases, and uncover why Sahur keeps appearing in your nightmare.

games.name: The Crimson Hunt
games.summary: You play as Victoria, a vampire hunter haunted by her past, and Eleanor, a young woman trapped in a nightmare that has only just begun. Together, they must endure grotesque creatures, hidden traps, and a presence that seems to know them better than they realize.

games.name: Traffic Stop Anomaly
games.summary: You're a traffic cop on endless patrol. Pull over drivers. Shine your flashlight and spot the anomalies. Let the normal ones go... or turn back before it's too late.

games.name: Homo Sovieticus
games.summary: Homo sovieticus (sovětský člověk) je pejorativní pojem označující typ člověka zformovaný marxistickým sociálním experimentem. Slovní neologismus se začal více používat v 60. letech 20. století, ale doba jeho vzniku není přesně známa. Základní rysy nového sovětského člověka načrtnul např. Michail Bulgakov v románu Mistr a Markétka, do širšího povědomí se výraz dostal díky knize Homo sovieticus ruského emigranta, spisovatele a sociologa Alexandra Zinovjeva (1923–2006). Tato kniha vyšla v roce 1982.

games.name: Inner Rooms
games.summary: Wander through vast, unsettling liminal spaces as a quiet presence grows alongside you. Inner Rooms is a psychological atmospheric exploration game set in a world that appears calm and peaceful, yet constantly radiates unease.

games.name: Do Disciplinary Committee Members Dream of Succubi?
games.summary: Become part demon and fight in the demons' proxy war, conquering your rivals to help your species claim dominance!
aliases: 风纪委员会梦见魅魔吗？

games.name: Onigashima: Awakening
games.summary: A predictive deck-building RPG! Build your strategy from over 300 cards! Form powerful formations with unique animal companions! Master countless combinations and claim overwhelming victories! Your adventure to defeat the ONI begins now!

games.name: Stinker Golf
games.summary: An online 1-16 player destructive golf game where you edit the course while you play. Annoy your friends without ruining the hole for yourself, all inside a fully physics simulated pixel world.

games.name: Proto Zero
games.summary: There is no point in looking back. The only way left is forward. - O. Escape the mega complex and find out what happened to the world our protagonist Yuuto once knew after his long slumber, in this new generation 3d action sci-fi brawler.

games.name: MarsCity3026
games.summary: Climb, swing, fly. Play as a robot that solves grappling hook puzzles and flying car puzzles. Each puzzle brings the terra-forming machines back online so that the humans can wake from cryo-sleep.

games.name: Warhammer 40,000: Rogue Trader - Processional of the Damned
games.summary: Venture into the Processional — a massive, otherworldly graveyard of ships lost to the void. What begins as a search for riches turns into a descent into the unknown. Navigate shifting corridors, avoid ancient traps, and uncover strange truths that defy logic. A new companion joins your crew — someone shaped by this impossible place. This expansion introduces new story, a mysterious new region, unique enemies and some fresh gameplay mechanics.

games.name: Blackout
games.summary: Normal. Or Paranormal. A job sorting through ghost photos. Five days to finish. But it won't end there. Mysterious visitors. A fear that bleeds into reality. And—— Can you escape this curse?

games.name: Dinerz
games.summary:
Dinerz is a diner simulation game, where you manage you own diner.
Cook meals, server customers, clean tables, wash dishes and hire staff, you can play alone or with your friends.

games.name: Demersus
games.summary:
Demersus is a first-person walking sim and psychological thriller experience that explores the horrific reality of alcohol addiction and how that influences the people around you, through environmental storytelling and immersive atmosphere. Navigate the protagonist's fractured psyche, rendered as a beautifully haunting, hand-crafted clay mindscape.

Created for the ZTGK game dev contest by a two-person indie team.

games.name: A Maze in Labyrinth
games.summary: Get lost... in the labyrinth. Explore the interconnected maze to find the "exit." Race, climb, and slide through the multiple areas, and try solving the mystery of the “Amazing Labyrinth” in the process.

games.name: Gun Monkey!
games.summary: Help your fellow monkeys escape back to the jungle by gunning your way through obstacles and challenges. Test your skill in a open environment and find your way home! Choose how you want to play, save companions (or don't) and unlock guns that help you traverse the world!

games.name: Resurface
games.summary: Escape the ocean depths in this casual incremental mining game. Mine, upgrade, and explore biomes as your strength grows to crazy proportions!

games.name: Electric Sheep
games.summary: Electric Sheep (česky: elektrické ovečky) je volně šiřitelný geneticko-evoluční spořič obrazovky. Pojmenování je narážkou na Román Philipa K. Dicka Sní androidi o elektrických ovečkách? (původní název: Do Androids Dream of Electric Sheep?).

games.name: Switch Shapes
games.summary: A rhythm and reflex game where thinking means death. Switch shapes, dodge obstacles, and immerse yourself in a cyberpunk audiovisual experience powered by dynamic music that evolves with your performance.

games.name: Fairy Springs
games.summary: Fairy Springs is a suburb of Rotorua in the Bay of Plenty Region of New Zealand's North Island. It is located south of Ngongotahā, west of Koutu, east of Selwyn Heights, and north of Mangakakahi. A major arterial road, Fairy Springs Road, runs through the centre of the suburb. The busy road has been used for political protests. Motorists continued to use the road during severe flooding in April 2018. Rainbow Springs Nature Park on Fairy Springs Road closed in 2022. The land was bought by a collective of Ngāti Whakaue, which developed it as Rotorua Heritage Farm and 3D Trick Art Gallery.

games.name: TankFall Arena
games.summary: TankFall Arena is a fast-paced top-down tank combat game where precision, ricochets, and weapon mastery decide every battle. Fight solo or with a friend, adapt to changing arenas, and outmaneuver opponents using unique weapons and environmental strategy.

games.name: Human Resources
games.summary: Lidské zdroje (angl. human resources, HR) jsou specifická činnost v rámci organizace, která se zabývá řízením lidského kapitálu v organizaci, tedy řízením zaměstnanců jako celku. Liší se od manažerského řízení tím, že řídí zaměstnance jako celek a poskytuje manažerům „nástroje“, kterými mohou přímo i nepřímo působit na růst a udržení produktivity práce.

games.name: The 4 Masked
games.summary: A 4-player co-op FPS adventure where you swing through trees using vines, escape wild animals, and survive dangerous biomes. Each player has a unique role, and teamwork is the key to survival.

games.name: Rune Tavern
games.summary: This is an asynchronous PVP auto chess game. Arrange your runes and components, use energy transfer to activate as many rune skills as possible, and build a powerful lineup! In the face of randomly matched opponents, be the first to smash the enemy's elemental blocks and win more!

games.name: Art Studio Simulator
games.summary: Bring your wildest imagination to life in your art studio. Paint, sell, build your own gallery, and invite friends to admire your art.

games.name: Garden Cleanup Simulator
games.summary: Turn overgrown, messy gardens into clean and beautiful spaces. There is no rush. No stress. Just you, your tools, and the simple pleasure of turning chaos into order.

games.name: Hack 42: Typing Incremental
games.summary: Hack 42 is a short typing incremental game about crafting powerful hacks and smashing computers for fun and profit.

games.name: FleetLord
games.summary: A space RTS about decisions, not menus. Conquer planets, link them to fuel your war machine, and level up your empire with randomized perk cards. Crush all opposition.

games.name: Marie Android
games.summary: Do you like Marie‑chan? You play as Marie Android, a small girl‑like robot who meets many friends. Using mysterious powers, she can become muscular, flatten into a paper‑thin form, or transform into a giant tank to fight enemies. Borrow your friends’ abilities and save Akacha Town.

games.name: The Bed Above My Head
games.summary: Youre playing a game in the dark. Something in your room is not. In this Sit & Survive type psychological horror game, you're a child playing on your console, while something roams your room. Observe your surroundings, listen carefully and manage your stress to survive this nightmarish night.

games.name: Card City Nights Forever
games.summary: It's cards! It's a city! It's night! And this time it's forever! Card City Nights Forever is the third and final installment of the series, with the best core TCG gameplay yet, a whole new huge 3D adventure, and an online mode that will last forever!

games.name: Yots
games.summary: Cooperative survival horror for up to 4 players. Complete the Quota, fight the creatures birthed by City of Mist, and build your own powerful loadout using unique artifacts.

games.name: The Sinkhole
games.summary: Experience claustrophobic cave horror powered by your webcam. In this psychological nightmare, a massive underground sinkhole hides a sinister entity. Ditch the mouseyour real head movements control your view, and your actual hands are used to climb, grab, and scramble through the dark.

games.name: Vessels: Noiret Mansion
games.summary: A retro-inspired PSX survival horror game set in the mysterious Noiret Mansion. Explore a cursed estate, solve puzzles, uncover the fate of the Noiret family, and survive the horrors lurking within its walls.

games.name: Lisia
games.summary: Lisiya is an almost abandoned village in Blagoevgrad Municipality, in Blagoevgrad Province, Bulgaria. It is situated in the foothills of Vlahina mountain. On January 29, 1944, thirteen Bulgarian Partizans died in a battle near the village. Lisiya Ridge on Graham Land, Antarctica is named after the village.

games.name: Kwad
games.summary: KWAD (920 AM, "Classic Hit Country") is a radio station broadcasting a classic country music format. Licensed to Wadena, Minnesota, United States, the station serves the Wadena area. The station is owned by Hubbard Broadcasting, Inc. (through licensee HBI Radio Brainerd/Wadena, LLC) and features programming from Westwood One. The KWAD signal is rebroadcast in the FM band on 101.7 MHz by co-owned Translator Station K269HE. Hubbard Broadcasting announced on November 13, 2014, that it would purchase the Omni Broadcasting stations, including KWAD.

games.name: Susanoo
games.summary: Susanoo (japonsky スサノオ) nebo Susa no wo (スサノヲ), uctivě nazývaný Susanoo no Mikoto (須佐之男命), je japonské božstvo moří a hromů, také zvané kami (神). Jméno Susanoo je doslova překládáno jako „chrabrý, statečný muž“. Jeho život a činy jsou popsány v posvátné knize šintoismu Kodžiki a kronice Nihongi. Společně se svoji sestrou Amaterasu Ómikami (bohyně Slunce a pramatka všech japonských císařů) a bratrem jménem Cukujomi (bůh záhrobní říše a Měsíce) patří mezi tři vznešená božstva.

games.name: BloodJack
games.summary: BloodJack, a 2-4 player PvP blackjack battler where every player hides card, manipulates opponents, uses rule-breaking items, and bets the blood keeping them alive as the stakes rise.

games.name: Football Club Builder
games.summary: Build, manage, and grow your own football club from Division 4 to European glory. Expand your stadium and facilities in 3D, compete in league and cup competitions, and create a football dynasty by making the right decisions in this fast-paced football manager game.

games.name: Select Eleven
games.summary:
The best in class management game for cricket. Take charge of the club and lead them to glory.

Major features include Scouting, Transfers, Youth academy, 180 clubs across 7 nations

games.name: Tower of Insolence
games.summary: Grab your smithing hammer, pack your gear, and get ready to conquer the ominous Tower of Insolence in this cozy little puzzle game.

games.name: Last Rites
games.summary: "We are food, but not for long." The Zombie apocalypse has come, and your squad is the last line of defense. Command a Special Forces unit with high-tech weaponry in this mission-based FPS with sprawling indoor and outdoor environments.

games.name: Galaxy Critter Co.
games.summary: Galaxy Critter Co. is a cute chaotic roguelike where tower defense meets top-down shooting: build by day, fight by night, and craft broken synergies to survive the Swarm.

games.name: The Missing Threads
games.summary: Erased memories, scattered clues. What will you uncover, and what will you leave buried?As an amnesiac detective, investigate crime scenes with limited focus. You can't analyze everything. Strategically choose your leads to shape the case and reclaim your lost past.

games.name: Blindfold: Hide and Seek
games.summary:
Blindfold: Hide and Seek is an asymmetric online hide-and-seek game where one blindfolded seeker hunts several fugitives. Instead of relying on vision, the seeker tracks players through footsteps, echoes, and other environmental sounds, turning every tiny noise into a clue.
Fugitives can move around freely, but every movement and decision carries risk—sprint to escape faster, stay quiet to reduce your chances of being found, or use the environment to deceive the seeker. What starts as simple hide-and-seek becomes a tense psychological battle of sound, timing, and mind games.

games.name: Monster Museum: Tidy Up the Collection!
games.summary: Step into the relaxing world of Monster Museum! Team up with your favorite creature companion and begin your journey to restore the museum by sorting 2614 monster figurines.  Unlock new abilities, collect badges and uncover hidden secrets along the way. Cozy, single player, no timers.

games.name: Pokémon Monomyth
games.summary: Pokémon Monomyth is an original character-driven GBA game set in the Pokémon world, with an emphasis on exploration, storytelling, and complex Pokémon gameplay.

games.name: Magic Shop Chaos
games.summary: A fun co-op organization simulator for 1-4 players. Team up as witches to bring order to a chaotic shop by sorting 6,000+ magical items back to their rightful places. Serve incoming customers, level up unique magical skills, and transform magical chaos into perfect order!

games.name: So Close
games.summary:
So Close is a cooperative platformer for one to four players in which a team escapes a linear level filled with unpredictable traps. The players wear explosive collars that detonate if they move too far apart, and the death of a single player restarts the run for the entire team. Two modes are available: Realism, which restarts the full level after each death, and Easy,
which resumes from the last checkpoint. The game is hosted by an in-game gamemaster named Proxxy.

games.name: Still Rooms
games.summary: A cozy, pixel-art decorating game where you design and furnish unique homes across 7 themed locations — from modern apartments and rustic houses to retro 80’s interiors, student rooms, rooftops, and even a spaceship.

games.name: Seven Minutes in the Closet
games.summary:
You're pushed into playing 7 minutes in heaven at a party with a stranger. Everything goes wrong and you are stuck in there with him.

Warnings: Depictions of murder and violence, screen shaking.

games.name: Oath of Stigmata
games.summary: In a world shattered by the Starfall Calamity, sanctuaries, city-states, and surviving factions fight for their last hope. Lead characters with unique beliefs and abilities on a perilous journey. Build your deck, deploy your units, and make tactical decisions that can turn the tide of battle.

games.name: Endless Mall
games.summary: Endless Mall is a roguelike city-builder card game. Carefully select your shops, mind your layout, build a powerful economic engine, and rake in profits beyond your wildest imagination!

games.name: Needle In A Haystack
games.summary: The original game. Find a needle hidden in millions of hay pieces with your friends.

games.name: Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve
games.summary: Soar through the skies and rise above every challenge to earn your place among the elite. Engage in intense aerial combat to dominate the battlefield with powerful weapons. Experience a breathtaking campaign filled with high-stakes missions, hard choices, and deep squad connections.

games.name: World of Warcraft: Forever
games.summary: World of Warcraft: Forever is an invitation to take your first steps in a legendary world of untamed frontiers, warring factions, untold perils, and unseen mysteries. Experience an Azeroth that grows from the roots of WoW’s first age, continually evolving through regular content patches and updates that promise never-ending adventure.

games.name: Cute & Dead
games.summary: You might look like a typical nerd, but even a zombie apocalypse won't stop you from asking the girl of your dreams out on a date. All you need to do is find and rescue her from hordes of the living dead.

games.name: Tandem Together
games.summary: Two idiots. One tandem. A load of suspicious cargo. Deliver the goods, sample the merchandise for wild power-ups, and try not to crash while you make your way across tricky terrains in this two-player co-op adventure with lots of physics-based chaos that will test your friendship.

games.name: Ruptured Floor
games.summary: Ruptured Floor is a puzzle horror game set in surreal office spaces. It tells a story about depression and work. The protagonist needs to find a way to escape, and uncover dark secrets in the process.

games.name: Heroes of Anirea
games.summary: Heroes of Anirea blends turn-based tactics with roguelite progression in a character-driven strategy experience. Assemble your squad from a diverse cast of heroes, each with unique skills, and evolve your approach as new challenges arise.

games.name: Wind Runners
games.summary: Wind Runners is a high-speed bullet-hell dogfighting roguelite where you start as a lone pilot, turning each flight into a fight for freedom. Face the ruthless technotheist Realm, take on relentless fleets and colossal bosses, and let your victories ignite a growing resistance across the star system

games.name: Swapdown
games.summary:
Step into the pulsating world of Swapdown, where every second counts and your wits are tested to the limit! In this exhilarating "match three" extravaganza, players are given a thrilling 60 seconds to slide shapes in all directions - left, right, up, and down, with the goal of aligning the perfect trio of colors.

But that's not all! Feel the board has become too predictable? Hit the "Space Bar" and watch as Swapdown's dynamic arena reshuffles, throwing an array of fresh combinations your way. The clock is ticking, but if the pressure becomes too much, the trusty hint button awaits to give you that gentle nudge in the right direction.

Compete against friends or challenge yourself to beat your personal best. As the seconds dwindle, the pace intensifies, and the adrenaline soars. Only the sharpest eyes and quickest reflexes will emerge victorious with the highest score.

With vibrant visuals, an addictive soundtrack, and nail-biting gameplay, Swapdown guarantees a heart-racing experience from start to finish.

Are you geared up for a minute of mayhem? Dive into Swapdown, where the clock is your biggest rival, and glory awaits the swiftest swiper!

games.name: 9 Dystricts
games.summary: Build your own flying vehicles in this action-packed roguelike dystopia.

games.name: Department of Collections
games.summary: A tasked based fully procedural online co-op sci-fi horror game that can be played both casually or more hardcore. Descend further into the facility using the elevator to discover truths about the facility while avoiding hazards and threats and completing tasks for the Department.

games.name: Avante! Atlantis
games.summary: Lead the world's greatest Strategists through a virtual war. Decide how humanity will approach the mysterious island of Atlantis.

games.name: Petal Crash 2
games.summary: The freshest in arcade puzzle action blossoms again! Crash blocks together into dazzling chain reactions in a puzzle like no other - now completely refreshed with refined gameplay, arcade graphics, brand new game modes, and dazzling special attacks!

games.name: Wild West Pioneers
games.summary: Wild West Pioneers is a city-builder adventure about leading settlers into the untamed frontier. Build and manage growing settlements, establish production chains, and explore the world. Follow a story of gold rush dreams, dangerous encounters, and the search for your family.

games.name: Computer Manufacturer
games.summary: Develop your computer empire, control costs, and increase profits. Decide whether to develop hardware in-house or purchase it, and whether to prioritize cost-effectiveness or pursue higher profits. The choices are all up to you.

games.name: Sproutmart: Farm & Grocery Sim
games.summary: Run your own grocery store. Stock shelves, scan items at the checkout, and keep the store moving — solo or with friends. Farm, process, and fish for goods to expand what you can sell.

games.name: Rogue Reigns
games.summary: Rogue Reigns is a dark fantasy roguelike deckbuilder about trust and sacrifice. Lead selfish antiheroes through a world where death is no more, and something still hunts them. Build synergies that bind them or rivalries that break them. Nobody dies, some are sacrificed, but everybody is condemned.

games.name: Monastery: Ora et Labora
games.summary: Lead your monks in prayer and labor to build a thriving medieval monastery. Manage resources, brew ale, craft manuscripts, and face trials like war and weather. Customize, expand, and guide your brotherhood to achieve spiritual and economic prosperity.

games.name: Garden and a Goat
games.summary: Garden and a Goat is a single-player animal collecting and ecosystem recovery game! You play as a friendly robot, eager to help a series of ecosystems in need. Clean up the environment, revive plants, and entice the local wildlife to return, unlocking ever more animals and decorations along the way!

games.name: Hirotonfa's American Revolution Smuggler
games.summary: A historical trading and dating sim set during the American Revolution. Manage a trade ship hauling goods between colonial ports, profit from volatile daily market swings, and navigate faction dangers, from militias to pirates, while choosing sides that affect regional quests. Along the way, romance charming colonial “state-chans” across territories like Louisiana and Quebec, blending economic strategy, risk-filled navigation, and character-driven narrative.

games.name: Jupiter
games.summary: A survival adventure on a mysterious Jupiter-like planet. Explore, gather resources, overcome dangers, and uncover hidden secrets in the depths of an alien world.

games.name: Dimond Hunt
games.summary: A co-op horror game about searching for items to build a spaceship to escape a dying galaxy.

games.name: Super Flying Vroom Vroom
games.summary: Drive, boost, take off, and navigate spectacular aerial challenges!

games.name: Arcany
games.summary: Arcany is a cozy persistent online world set in the mysterious Realm of Gravenmoor. Train skills, explore a magical land, craft powerful items, and uncover the story behind the forgotten cataclysme.

games.name: Nion Forge
games.summary: Your ship is your build. Put it together in the hangar from 50+ modules and enter the games: 9 districts, 9 bosses, one time limit - and beyond them, freedom. Run went sideways? Come back with scrap and build it better. 100+ upgrades, 30+ cores, countless builds.

games.name: Bonetox
games.summary: A fast-paced arena shooter where you grind demons into piles of bones and meat. Choose your favorite weapon and unleash uncompromising carnage. Survive as long as you can, break your limits, and drown the arena in blood.

games.name: The Starfallen Prince
games.summary: The Starfallen Prince, an action-RPG bullet heaven where an invasion shatters Belden’s world, Losing everything he held dear. Driven by loss, he escapes into the wilds to begin a journey of survival, revenge and the fate of his people.

games.name: Nero
games.summary: Become a chain-smoking, tax-dodging restaurateur on the brink of ruin. Sail blood-churned seas to feed starving killers who demand fine dining. Expand your empire from beach shack to world-class dining, or die trying.

games.name: Soul Maze
games.summary: Soul Maze is a 1-2 player Horror game. Run through the mazes collecting the souls of the monsters within in order to escape before you get caught and trapped forever

games.name: Sol and Mani the Artifact
games.summary: Visual novel that combines elements of fantasy, romance and adventure. The story of the adventures of one young accidental traveler named Max, told from the perspective of the inhabitants of another world. Сharacters would join a team of adventurers and search for the artifact that grants any wish.

games.name: Frukt
games.summary: A voxel-based death sandbox. Shoot, dismember, and crush NPCs with realistic body physics.

games.name: Wavecrashers
games.summary: Wavecrashers is a 3-player co-op strategy game where heroes unite to fend off relentless waves of enemies. Master unique heroes and dive into a deeply replayable experience built for teamwork.

games.name: Harbingers of Destiny
games.summary: When Strata is unwittingly caught up in an international incident, she is forced to team up with border guard Leonel and escort a mysterious yet timid mage to the capital city. But as tensions rise between nations, they soon realize there’s more at play than they could have ever imagined.

games.name: Slendyjan
games.summary: Slendyjan takes place on a planet devastated by a war that has been consuming all the races that inhabit it for years. The player controls Jan, an exceptionally powerful mercenary who fights on the side of the Nuggets, an advanced civilization from an unknown planet.

games.name: Ascenders: Beyond the Peak
games.summary: ASCENDERS: BEYOND THE PEAK is a turn-based exploration roguelite where survival is vertical. Lead a team of alpinists to recover ancient artifacts from cursed peaks, prepare your expedition, evolve your climbers, master rope mechanics, and face H.P. Lovecraft-inspired horrors within the mountain.

games.name: Substrate: Emergence
games.summary: Grow fluorescent cells that create mesmerizing emergent chaos. Simple mechanics hide deep complexity as cells evolve survival strategies through synergistic interactions. Catalogue successful lines and culture them to develop your own unique biology.

games.name: Desolation Arcanist
games.summary: Craft your own magic in this action roguelite. "Program" your wands with varied Spell Cores (Fireballs, Flying Swords... or Watermelons?) and Runes. Raise your companion Dragon, command a Puppet army, and abuse physics to knock enemies off cliffs. Your build is your destiny.

games.name: Furyball: Rogue Revenge
games.summary: Furyball is a fast-paced action roguelite where your only weapon is a bouncing bullet ball. Control the chaos, shatter enemies, and survive sport-themed arenas inspired by pinball and grindhouse cinema.

games.name: Frontier Wars: Online
games.summary: An old-school MMORPG featuring multiple NPC factions vying for control over territory. Explore the chaotic frontier of Zagros and fight in tactical turn-based battles with other players and NPC allies. Build your own character and fight against enemy factions to gain loot, EXP, and power.

games.name: Total Victory
games.summary: A grand strategy World War II wargame engine. The main scenario is World Conflict 1939-1945. Players get to play any combination of the big 8 major powers during World War 2.

games.name: Reel Greed
games.summary: Reel Greed is a slot machine incremental game where players spin reels, earn payouts, choose temporary run cards, and buy permanent upgrades to increase payouts, unlock patterns, and scale future runs.

games.name: Only Humans On Board
games.summary: Buy supplies and manage your resources. Serve customers quickly from your trolley, but stay sharp: be aware of the unknown. Some passengers are only pretending to be human...

games.name: One Dumb Wizard
games.summary: One Dumb Wizard is an action roguelike where you play as a wizard hell-bent on getting their money back from the Bartender. Find charms to power up your wand, parts to craft new wands, and strategically sling spells in your singular mission to get your money back.

games.name: Dodgebrawl
games.summary: An FPS reimagining of the best gym class sport, DODGEBRAWL is a transformation of iconic shooter game modes into the context of an athletic activity. It's a multiplayer PvP dodgeball-themed FPS, full of maps, game modes, equipment, and chaos.

games.name: Creovia
games.summary: Creovia is a 2D sandbox MMO with RPG elements. Build your own worlds, craft powerful gear, trade with other players, and carve out your place in a persistent, player-driven universe.

games.name: The Guild Manager
games.summary: Recruit your team, forge a legendary guild! In this unique management simulation, you won't play as a lone hero—you'll become a Guild Master, leading a group of flesh-and-blood, distinct personalities from rookies to conquerors of epic raids.

games.name: Posthumors
games.summary: Have you ever wondered what happens to people after they die? We created “Posthumors,” an online project that allows you to experience death and communicate with the afterlife through words. Now then — take up your pen, and face death.

games.name: Antropeo
games.summary: Antropeo is a geography trivia game focused on exploring, training, and competing through world-based challenges. Players can test their knowledge of countries, flags, shapes, places, and geography facts across solo modes, multiplayer duels, and marathon-style challenges. The game combines quiz gameplay, world exploration, profile progression, room-code multiplayer, and a space-themed visual style.

games.name: Rogue Kingdom
games.summary: In Rogue Kingdom, Online Roguelike meets Settlement Building! Clear dungeons, claim them, fill them with NPCs, and defend them in an online world. Grow stronger through loot, mining, crafting, magic, and help from other players.

games.name: Industronaut
games.summary:
Industronaut is a first-person survival engineering game set on a hostile, radiation-heavy planet.

You were left behind after a failed evacuation. Alone on the surface, you must build a sealed habitat, produce oxygen, water, and food, mine raw resources, and turn them into the systems that keep you alive.

Expand from a small survival shelter into an industrial base. Process resources through production chains, unlock new machines, manage power, storage, and logistics, and use drones to scan for ore deposits and move materials between machines and storage.

There is no combat and no rescue waiting for you. Survival depends on engineering, automation, and your ability to keep the base running.

games.name: Dark Stream
games.summary:
A desperate livestream. A house that shouldn’t be entered. A Twitch chat that won’t stay quiet. Survive the subathon as a disgraced creator, as the haunting awakens and your audience decides your fate.
