In Dark Stream, you play a fearless content creator chasing clout by livestreaming from a house rumored to be haunted for decades. But this isn’t just exploration, you’re stepping directly into active paranormal events. Armed with your laptop, a flickering flashlight, and a live chat feed, you’ll push deeper into the house, uncover its violent past, and survive the encounters that react to you.

games.name: Sandwich Shop Simulator
games.summary: Run your own sandwich shop! Stock your ingredients, prepare delicious sandwiches, take payments, customize and expand your store, and become the best sandwich shop in town!

games.name: Back to 21
games.summary: A narrative RPG life-sim about the dreams you talked yourself out of. You’ve been given a chance to go back to 21. Build relationships, explore new paths, and pursue the passion you once buried. Beneath it all lies a deeper truth about the world that contains you. Or perhaps… that you contain.

games.name: Unknown Horizon
games.summary: Retro styled, top-down, space exploration adventure where you will meet new alien races, learn their secrets and build their trust to get their help to find a way home.

games.name: Sayonara, Space Rocks
games.summary:
Sayonara, Space Rocks is a supercharged retro-modern homage to the classics that upends the experience with a bonus roulette system with each level.

You're a new Star Pilot recruit for the Earth Space Federation's (ESF) Sayonara, Space Rocks Program. You have been tasked with clearing the Egam-Oter Asteroid Belt of asteroids and a host of other unidentified anomalies by piloting a series of Class-A ESF drones supported by onboard clients of the HALICE hive computer.

The program features one or two player simultaneous expanded arcade action. With each level, the speed and your score multiplier increases, and you enter Bonus Time; a roulette system with thousands of combinations and over 50 unique gameplay perks and prizes. Over the course of a game, you'll face strange enemies and bosses, save humans, blast a lot of asteroids, and hopefully score a lot of points. In additions to the core game experience, you'll earn a slew of achievements, can visit "My Room" to customize your player card and view your rank and trophies, and sharpen your skills in the two-player Practice Mode.

As you progress, you can further customize your experience with unlockable player ship sprites, backgrounds, music, and asteroid color themes for thousands of combinations.

games.name: Salt and Spice
games.summary: From Mogadishu to Calcutta, master the bustling trade networks of the Indian Ocean during the golden age of maritime commerce.

games.name: Rover’s Radventure: The New Millennium
games.summary: After a regular day at work transforms into a bizarre trip that turns his life upside down, a washed-up park ranger named Rover needs to step up and go on a journey that will take him far beyond his wildest fantasies and lead him to confronting uncomfortable truths about himself and his past.

games.name: Godreaper
games.summary: Godreaper is a dark third-person action-adventure where the fate of your homeland hangs in the balance. As the bogatyr Zaremire, explore every corner of a world inspired by East Slavic mythology. Defeat the creatures of Navi, battle almighty gods and save your homeland from inevitable destruction.

games.name: Time Heroes
games.summary: Time Heroes is a free multiplayer idle pet-collecting game by Timelands that runs in a desktop web browser. You mine, hatch and evolve a collection of pets across ten worlds, then pool that progress into a player-run colony.

games.name: Japanese Ramen Simulator
games.summary: Japanese Ramen Simulator is a ramen shop management sim for up to six players. Prepare ingredients, cook noodles, and arrange toppings to craft the perfect bowl. Create original dishes, design your kitchen and dining area, and build your ramen restaurant with friends or on your own!

games.name: Mercyrail: Havenbound
games.summary: Command one of Britain's last working trains. Build an evacuation route from London to Glasgow across the real UK rail network, manage a community under pressure, and decide who gets passage as infection and collapse transform every journey.

games.name: Knightbane
games.summary: Survive 12 minutes. Then the final boss arrives. Shatter the terrain to escape, loot its contents, or funnel the horde into a killing trap. Cleanse the lands for boons and ASCEND your abilities: not merely empowered, but altered. An action survivor-like.

games.name: Sans Filtres
games.summary: A card game with friends: prepare your scenarios and responses, the funniest one wins.

games.name: Open Nectar
games.summary: A native, experimental, and open-source port of Pikmin (GameCube, 2001) for PC and Android.

games.name: Prop Revolt
games.summary: A prop hunt where being seen is a resource. Hide as an everyday object and survive - or let the hunter stare, charge the Revolt, and fight back as a team. There's often a fine line between hiding and attacking. Will you defeat the Hunters, or will you hide until the end? You decide!

games.name: Ghosted
games.summary: A 1-5 player co-op horror comedy where YOU'RE the ghosts. Haunt the living, possess objects, and make your friends say ridiculous custom voice commands to trigger scares.

games.name: Red Galaxy
games.summary:
Red Galaxy is a massively multiplayer online space shooter for Windows, Android and iOS. Players pilot a customizable ship on behalf of one of three rival corporations, Orion, Helios and Nova, and compete for control of contested map sectors.

Gameplay combines player versus player combat, cooperative raids through multi stage gates, NPC hunting, and resource collection. Ore gathered in space can be refined into enrichment that boosts damage, shielding or speed for a limited time. Ships are configured through hangars with modular weapons, generators, drones and rockets, and progression is driven by a research tree, ranks and a quest chain.

Players can form clans, take part in auctions, and trade through an in game economy built on credits, red matter and a premium currency. The game is free to play with optional purchases and is in early access, with content and balance still being expanded.

games.name: Ace Combat Zero: The Belkan War
games.summary: The sixth installment in the Ace Combat series explores the Belkan War, a devastating conflict alluded to in Ace Combat 5. In the game's main story mode, the player takes control of a mercenary pilot, callsign "Cipher", taking part in the Belkan War by advancing through aerial combat, escort, assault, and defense missions. The story is told through the eyes of a reporter, 10 years after the conflict, uncovering secrets of the war by interviewing some of the pilots the player shoots down.

games.name: Star Conflict
games.summary: Star Conflict is a Free to Play online space combat game featuring multiple Objective-Based Team Gameplay modes, three main factions with 2 respective sub factions each, and an array of ship customization and three types of ships complete with there own ship tree and skill tree.

games.name: Kingdom Hearts Final Mix
games.summary: Originally released only in Japan on December 26, 2002, Kingdom Hearts Final Mix is finally brought to the global scene as an HD Remaster in the collection "Kingdom Hearts HD 1.5 ReMIX". It has several events and a number of gameplay tweaks that are not in previous releases. New scenes, clarifying certain plot points, such as Riku's journey and foreshadowing of Kingdom Hearts II, were included, but no new dialogue was recorded. A gameplay option allows the player to skip cutscenes. The optional bosses are included, along with a new fight against "Unknown Man."

games.name: Kingdom Hearts Re:Chain of Memories
games.summary: Kingdom Hearts Re:Chain of Memories is a full remake of Kingdom Hearts: Chain of Memories, originally released on the Game Boy Advance. It was originally remade for the PS2, and eventually remastered in the collection "Kingdom Hearts HD 1.5 ReMIX". The game was also changed in that completing the "Kingdom Hearts 358/2 Days" cutscenes would unlock additional Enemy Cards that would have been unlocked in the original by having save data from "Kingdom Hearts II: Final Mix"

games.name: Kingdom Hearts Birth by Sleep Final Mix
aliases: KINGDOM HEARTS Birth by Sleep FINAL MIX
games.summary: Originally released exclusively in Japan. An HD remaster of Kingdom Hearts Birth by Sleep Final Mix was finally released globally for the collection "Kingdom Hearts HD 2.5 ReMIX."

games.name: Kingdom Hearts II Final Mix
games.summary: An HD remaster of Kingdom Hearts II Final Mix, which was originally exclusive to Japan. It was released globally for the first time as part of the collection "Kingdom Hearts HD 2.5 ReMIX".

games.name: Minecraft
games.summary: Minecraft focuses on allowing the player to explore, interact with, and modify a dynamically-generated map made of one-cubic-meter-sized blocks. In addition to blocks, the environment features plants, mobs, and items. Some activities in the game include mining for ore, fighting hostile mobs, and crafting new blocks and tools by gathering various resources found in the game. The game's open-ended model allows players to create structures, creations, and artwork on various multiplayer servers or their single-player maps. Other features include redstone circuits for logic computations and remote actions, minecarts and tracks, and a mysterious underworld called the Nether. A designated but completely optional goal of the game is to travel to a dimension called the End, and defeat the ender dragon.

games.name: Kingdom Hearts HD 2.8 Final Chapter Prologue
aliases: Kingdom Hearts HD II.8: Final Chapter Prologue
KINGDOM HEARTS HD 2.8 Final Chapter Prologue.exe
games.summary:
Kingdom Hearts HD 2.8 Final Chapter Prologue is a compilation that brings the popular Kingdom Hearts [Dream Drop Distance] to the PlayStation4 computer entertainment system platform remastered in high definition.

Originally released in 2012, Kingdom Hearts [Dream Drop Distance] HD is a full-HD remastered version of Kingdom Hearts 3D [Dream Drop Distance]. Series protagonists Sora and Riku take on the Mark of Mastery exam in preparation for coming threats. The signature action of the Kingdom Hearts series has evolved, allowing players to experience faster-paced battles and exploration at a blistering pace.

games.name: Kingdom Hearts 0.2: Birth by Sleep - A Fragmentary Passage
games.summary: A short sequel to Kingdom Hearts Birth By Sleep that partially takes place during the events of the first Kingdom Hearts, A fragmentary passage gets its name from a hidden ending to BBS and tells the story of Master Aqua's ten-year journey through the Realm of Darkness. 0.2 acts as a prologue to the upcoming Kingdom Hearts III, and also as a demo of Kingdom Hearts traversal, combat, and graphics in Unreal Engine 4 as it will appear in KH3. This game is only playable as part of the collection Kingdom Hearts HD 2.8 Final Chapter Prologue.
aliases: KINGDOM HEARTS 0.2 Birth by Sleep - A Fragmentary Passage -

games.name: Kingdom Hearts Dream Drop Distance HD
games.summary:
Kingdom Hearts Dream Drop Distance HD is a full HD remaster of Kingdom Hearts 3D: Dream Drop Distance designed for the PlayStation 4. It was released as part of a package of three games entitled Kingdom Hearts HD 2.8 Final Chapter Prologue.

The game is largely the same as its Nintendo 3DS counterpart, but includes some additional features as well as alterations designed to adapt the game to the PS4. The conversion from two screens to one is the most notable of the changes seen. Little has changed in terms of gameplay. However, three new Dream Eaters have been introduced and minor game features have been altered to adapt to the PS4.

games.name: Kingdom Hearts HD 1.5 + 2.5 Remix
aliases: Kingdom Hearts HD I.5 + II.5 Remix
games.summary: Kingdom Hearts HD 1.5 + 2.5 Remix is an HD remastered collection of 6 unforgettable Kingdom Hearts experiences. Kingdom Hearts HD 1.5 + 2.5 Remix is the perfect opportunity to start wielding your Keyblade to save the Disney worlds from darkness.

games.name: Earth Defense Force 5
games.summary: Stand and fight for humanity. This arcade shooter takes place in the year 2022, as the Earth Defense Force fends off an all-out attack by unknown life forms. Become an EDF soldier, battle against endless hordes of immense enemies, and restore peace to the earth.

games.name: Octopath Traveler
aliases: オクトパストラベラー
games.summary: A role-playing game from the Bravely Default team is being developed exclusively for the Nintendo Switch. They have brought a new world to life through a mix of CG, pixel art, and "HD-2D" visuals.

games.name: Kingdom Hearts III
games.summary:
Kingdom Hearts III is the third main installment in the Kingdom Hearts series developed and published by Square Enix. It was initially released January 2019 for the PlayStation 4 and the Xbox One. An expansion, Kingdom Hearts III Re Mind was released in January 2020.

The story takes place after the events of Kingdom Hearts 3D: Dream Drop Distance. It features an older Sora as the main protagonist, who sets forth on a new adventure to search for seven guardians of light in an attempt to stop Xehanort from bringing about a second Keyblade War. Sora is joined by Donald Duck, Goofy, Mickey Mouse, Riku, Kairi, and others. Along the way, Sora travels to many worlds from Disney and Pixar intellectual properties, and cross paths with the real Organization XIII.

Kingdom Hearts III features hack and slash combat reminiscent of Kingdom Hearts II, with elements from later handheld entries, allowing the player to control Sora in a party with Donald, Goofy, and up to two other Disney characters from the various worlds he visits. A major addition compared is the Formchange mechanic, which allows his currently equipped Keyblade to grant him special abilities and change shape. Sora can equip up to three Keyblades at a time, and cycle between them to use his abilities. Another addition is the Attractions mechanic, which occasionally allows Sora to summon and pilot a vehicle inspired by Disney theme park attractions. At certain points throughout the game, the player will be able to control other characters.

games.name: Resident Evil 2
games.summary: Resident Evil 2 is a remake of 1998's Resident Evil 2. The game was not developed with the intent of improving the original, but rather a reimagining of the original story with redesigned maps, characters and story elements. Gameplay mechanics are more similar to Resident Evil 7: Biohazard though with the use of an over-the-shoulder camera.

games.name: Afterbeat
games.summary: A musical bullet-hell where all things beautiful are deadly. Dodge well little nanobot, you don't have much time.

games.name: Kingdom Hearts III: Re Mind
games.summary: Kingdom Hearts III: Re Mind is a downloadable expansion to Kingdom Hearts III, released in 2020. Set during and after the game’s climax, it adds new story scenarios (“Re Mind,” “Limitcut Episode,” and “Secret Episode”), challenging boss battles, and extended lore connections. Two editions were made available, with the deluxe version including a recording of the Kingdom Hearts Orchestra -World of Tres- concert. A free patch released alongside the DLC also added the Oathkeeper and Oblivion Keyblades.
developers: Square Enix Creative Business Unit I

games.name: Resident Evil 3
games.summary: Resident Evil 3 is a remake of the original Resident Evil 3: Nemesis released in 1999. It updates the story and gameplay for a modern audience. Like the Resident Evil 2 remake, the game uses over-the-shoulder third person point of view similar to Resident Evil 4 and later installments. Players will spend most of their time playing as Jill Valentine, although on some occasions they will assume the role of Carlos Oliveira, giving him more screen time as a deuteragonist.

games.name: Kingdom Hearts III + Re Mind
games.summary: KINGDOM HEARTS III + Re Mind (DLC) brings one chapter of the series to a close. Travel to exciting new Disney and Pixar worlds, and prepare for the final showdown.
developers: Square Enix Creative Business Unit I

games.name: It Takes Two
games.summary: It Takes Two is a cooperative action-adventure game designed exclusively for two players, playable in local split-screen or online. Players control Cody and May, a married couple transformed into dolls, as they travel through fantastical environments based on their home and relationship. Gameplay combines platforming, puzzle-solving, and action sequences, with each level introducing new mechanics and giving the two characters different abilities that must be used together to progress. The game frequently changes its core mechanics from chapter to chapter, incorporating sections involving shooting, racing, flight, and other genres.

games.name: Octopath Traveler II
games.summary:
This game is a brand-new entry in the Octopath Traveler series. It takes the series’ HD-2D graphics, a fusion of retro pixel art and 3DCG, to even greater heights.
In the world of Solistia, eight new travelers venture forth into an exciting new era.
Where will you go? What will you do? Whose tale will you bring to life?
Every path is yours to take. Embark on an adventure all your own.

games.name: Resident Evil 4
games.summary:
Resident Evil 4 is a remake of the 2005 original Resident Evil 4 reimagined for 2023 to bring state-of-the-art survival horror. Resident Evil 4 preserves the essence of the original game, while introducing modernized gameplay, a reimagined storyline,
and vividly detailed graphics to make this the latest survival horror game where life and death, terror and catharsis intersect.

games.name: Usagi Shima
games.summary: Usagi Shima (うさぎしま, Rabbit Island) is a free-to-play 2023 mobile rabbit-collecting game developed by Jess Yu (pank0). The game is developed using the Godot engine, with gameplay inspired by Neko Atsume. The player builds up a selection of toys and structures in the game to attract rabbits to a tropical island. It was released on September 1, 2023 for iOS and Android and has received several updates since then, with a release on Steam anticipated in 2026.

games.name: Final Fantasy VII: Ever Crisis
games.summary: Relive the most memorable moments from FFVII and experience the journey of a young hero Sephiroth in FINAL FANTASY VII EVER CRISIS.
developers: Square Enix Creative Business Unit I

games.name: The Crew: Motorfest
games.summary: The Crew Motorfest is an open-world racing game set on scaled-down versions of the Hawaiian islands of Oahu and Maui. The third entry in The Crew series, it is structured around a festival theme with "Playlists" consisting of staged races, side activities, and challenges built around topics like specific car brands or motorsport disciplines. Players can control cars, boats, and planes across the open world, and multiplayer modes include the Grand Race and Demolition Royale. The game originally started development as DLC for The Crew 2 before becoming a standalone title, and draws comparisons to the Forza Horizon series for its festival-based structure.

games.name: Resident Evil 4: Separate Ways
games.summary:
The mission requires secrecy. Failure is not an option.

Play as Ada Wong in this additional scenario and experience the events of Resident Evil 4 from her perspective, filling in unanswered questions posed in the main story.

In addition to the action available in the base game with Leon, a grappling gun can be used to get to various locations, as well as take down enemies from a distance and launch a ranged melee attack. This allows for a more exciting and fast-paced gameplay experience.

games.name: Goodboy Galaxy
games.summary: A vibrant sci-fi platform adventure game where you help Maxwell the dog explore unfamiliar worlds, make strange new friends and contend with mysterious forces - by jumping, shooting, slicing, shrinking, warping and drilling.

games.name: Rocket Racing
games.summary: From the developers of Rocket League comes Rocket Racing, a supersonic arcade racer that lets you drift, fly, and boost your way to the finish in a rocket-powered car! Climb the ranks and test your skills in Ranked or pull up to Casual Racing and enjoy the thrill of racing without high stakes. Want to race against the clock? Drop into Speed Run and put your best time on the leaderboard.

games.name: House Flipper 2
games.summary: It's time to dust off your hammer - House Flipper is back in a brand-new fashion! Buy and renovate run-down houses! Or maybe you want to build new ones? Now you can! Start as a rookie Flipper and make a fortune by helping out the community of the charming town of Pinnacove.

games.name: Enshrouded
games.summary: You are Flameborn, last ember of hope of a dying race. Awaken, survive the terror of a corrupting fog, and reclaim the lost beauty of your kingdom. Venture into a vast world, vanquish punishing bosses, build grand halls and forge your path in this co-op survival action RPG for up to 16 players.

games.name: Dragon's Dogma II
games.summary:
Dragon's Dogma is a single player, narrative driven action-RPG that challenges players to choose their own experience – from the appearance of their Arisen, their vocation, their party, how to approach different situations and more.

On your journey, you’ll be joined by Pawns, mysterious otherworldly beings, in an adventure so unique you will feel as if accompanied by other players while on your own adventure.

All of these elements are elevated further by the latest in graphics, artificial intelligence (AI) and physics technology to create a truly immersive fantasy world in Dragon's Dogma 2.

games.name: Octopath Traveler + Octopath Traveler II Bundle
games.summary: Two HD-2D RPGs from SQUARE ENIX’s Team Asano, OCTOPATH TRAVELER and OCTOPATH TRAVELER II are now available as a bundle! This series features distinctive HD-2D graphics that combine pixel art with 3D.

games.name: MyPopgoes
games.summary:
Popgoes is an official Five Nights at Freddy's spinoff series, produced by Scott Cawthon and developed by fans as part of the "Fazbear Fanverse Initiative".

MyPopgoes is a short and simple resource management minigame, where you take care of an extremely needy weasel named Popgoes. Housed in an adorable plastic LCD toy, your new pixelated best friend will need pizza, fizzy drinks, and only the best entertainment provided by Freddy Fazbear himself. And if Popgoes doesn't receive what he desperately needs, he passes out. Or maybe he straight up dies. Up to your imagination.

games.name: Under the Red Sky
games.summary: Under The Red Sky is a 3D parkour game where speed is king! Your goal is to get to the end of each level as quick as possible by taking one of the many different routes possible, or by finding your own. Watch out though, this isn't all fun and games. You may accidentally fall into the past and uncover dark secrets, slowly deciphering the hidden propaganda behind it all and how to get back above. As you look up, you may find that you're Under the Red Sky.

games.name: I Am Your Beast
games.summary: I Am Your Beast is a shortform covert revenge thriller FPS about getting hunted across the North American wilderness by the military-industrial complex--and turning the tables.

games.name: Reka
games.summary: Start your life as an apprentice witch to the legendary Baba Jaga and venture across a mysterious, natural landscape with your companion, chicken-legged cottage. Develop your magical powers, customise your home, craft potions, help or hinder villagers find your way in the world.

games.name: Epic Mickey: Rebrushed
games.summary: Embark on a magical journey in Disney Epic Mickey: Rebrushed! Shape your adventure with the stroke of a brush and transform Wasteland as Mickey Mouse in this beautifully recreated 3D platformer.

games.name: Eclesiar
games.summary: Eclesiar is a free online multiplayer strategy game. Build nations, run economies and wage war with thousands of real players, right in your browser.

games.name: Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves
aliases: FATAL FURY City of the Wolves.exe
games.summary: 26 years on, a brand-new entry in the Fatal Fury series is set to arrive on the scene! FATAL FURY: City of the Wolves features a unique art style that stimulates the senses and an innovative REV System that supercharges the excitement. Here, at long last, a new legend is about to unfold…

games.name: 9 Kings
games.summary: A fast-paced roguelike kingdom builder. Grow your empire and fight massive battles against powerful rival kings. Break the game with thousands of insane builds to become the King of Kings.

games.name: Tales from the Dancing Moon
games.summary: Tales from the Dancing Moon is a life-sim RPG set in a parallel universe inspired by UK culture and fantasy novels. After the events of a shadow-beast invasion on a seaside town, complete villager quests and collect hidden diaries to understand your role in this mysterious character-driven story.

games.name: Mycopunk
games.summary: A ragtag squad of robot rejects is hired by the SAXON corporation and given one last shot at profitable glory (and avoiding the scrap heap). They are the New Atlas Hazard Crew, a ramshackle squad of exterminators sent to uncover the mysteries behind a planet-wide fungal catastrophe.

games.name: Neon Abyss 2
games.summary: Dive into the cybermyth roguelike chaos of Neon Abyss 2! Now featuring up to 4-player online co-op, more combat styles, and unlimited item synergies, every run delivers a dramatic, action-packed experience you won't forget.

games.name: Back to the Dawn
games.summary: Back to the Dawn is a story-rich RPG set in a high-security prison ruled by factions and buried secrets. Investigate two conspiracies from the inside, gather evidence, and outsmart a system designed to silence you. Make friends (or foes) with fellow inmates and with their help, break out of prison.

games.name: Frosthaven
games.summary: From the creative mind of Isaac Childres, the highly acclaimed board game moves to the digital realm in the video game adaptation of FROSTHAVEN! The dark fantasy tactical RPG features deep mechanics and challenging yet satisfying gameplay both in Single Player and Co-Op Online Multiplayer.

games.name: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba - The Hinokami Chronicles 2
aliases: Guardianes de la Noche -Kimetsu no Yaiba- Las Crónicas de Hinokami 2
鬼灭之刃 火之神血风谭2
鬼滅之刃 火之神血風譚2
games.summary:
Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba - The Hinokami Chronicles 2 is an action fighting game based on the Demon Slayer series.

It follows the events of the anime, continuing the story of Tanjiro Kamado and his companions. Players take part in arena-based battles using characters with distinct moves and abilities. The game includes a story mode and versus modes for local and online play. It expands on the mechanics and roster introduced in the original Hinokami Chronicles.
series: Demon Slayer: Kimetsu no Yaiba - The Hinokami Chronicles

games.name: Hell Is Us: Hollow Walker Pack
games.summary: Choose the Deluxe Edition of Hell is Us to get the Hollow Walker Pack and other bonuses. The Hollow Walker Pack includes an exclusive skin for Remi and his drone KAPI.

games.name: Hell is Us: Phol Guard Pack
games.summary: Choose the Deluxe Edition of Hell is Us to get the Phol Guard Pack and other bonuses. The Phol Guard Pack includes an exclusive skin for Remi and his drone KAPI.

games.name: Hell Is Us: Military Pack
games.summary: Choose the Deluxe Edition of Hell is Us to get the Military Pack and other bonuses. The Military Pack includes an exclusive skin for Remi and his drone KAPI.

games.name: Hell is Us: Secret Code
games.summary: Choose the Deluxe Edition of Hell is Us to get the Secret Code DLC and other bonuses. With the Secret Code DLC, you start the adventure with a mysterious code in your pocket. What does it open?

games.name: Moros Protocol
games.summary: Your mission is not just to survive, but to face yourself, your past and prepare for "a world full of darkness and monsters". A stylized pixel painted FPS roguelike game, that combines the feel of early action-adventure games, with innovative mechanics.

games.name: Ratatan
games.summary: Ratatan is a rhythm roguelike action game that combines rhythm games and side-scrolling action, with online co-op gameplay supporting up to 4 players. An intense battle unfolds with over 100 characters fighting in a massive melee. Let's defeat the enemies together!

games.name: 9 R.I.P. Sequel
aliases: ナインリップ シークエル

games.name: Heroic Songs: The Remix!
games.summary: Travel through fantasy worlds and build an idol sanctuary! An idol × city-building simulation game where you create your very own fan sanctuary alongside adorable idols to restore the lost connections between worlds!

games.name: Tormented Souls II
games.summary: Caroline Walker returns in the sequel to the award-winning survival horror classic. Explore the decaying remains of the secluded Villa Hess, use improvised weapons to confront terrifying creatures, and bend the fabric of reality to save your sister from a twisted cult.

games.name: Once Upon a Katamari
aliases: ワンス・アポン・ア・塊魂
games.summary: Keep the good times rolling with a new entry in the Katamari Damacy series! In this puzzle action-adventure game, you'll roll your Katamari through time itself. Journey through the Jurassic Period, Ice Age, historic Japan, and more eras to rebuild the starry sky.

games.name: The Séance of Blake Manor
games.summary: The Séance of Blake Manor is a supernatural detective mystery, set in 1897 Ireland, where you investigate the disappearance of Evelyn Deane in a remote hotel full of secrets and other-worldly occurrences.

games.name: A Dark Cave
games.summary: A Dark Cave is a story-driven survival, settlement-building, and incremental adventure where every decision matters. Inspired by the minimalist incremental classics, A Dark Cave trades flashy graphics for intense atmosphere, discovery, and meaningful choices. Build a thriving village, uncover ancient secrets, and descend ever deeper into a world that becomes more dangerous the stronger you grow.

games.name: SpongeBob SquarePants: Titans of the Tide
games.summary: Prepare to be scared! A clash between the Flying Dutchman and King Neptune has unleashed ghostly mayhem all over Bikini Bottom. Switch seamlessly between SpongeBob and Patrick, combine their unique skills and save Bikini Bottom from total ghostification!
aliases: Губка Боб Квадратные Штаны: Гиганты глубин
Bob Esponja: Titanes de la Marea
Bob l'éponge: les Titans des marées
海綿寶寶：海洋巨頭之亂

games.name: Nientum: Opus Zero
games.summary: Nientum - Opus Zero is a 2D action game that brings platformer, runner and music interactive genre all together. A fantastic journey of the director and singer, and the storytelling of music from the world. Run through the stage to complete their fate!

games.name: Pardon My French Toast
games.summary:
In Pardon My French Toast, you play as a Toasty (a talking slice of brioche) who dreams of participating in the new edition of the bread wrestling competition. To be physically up to the challenge, he decides to follow a training program organized by the previous champion of the discipline, which will take him all over the world and make him meet a bunch of wacky weirdos.

Pardon My French Toast is an adventure / platform game in 2D top view in which the player explores different worlds, solves puzzles and meets a whole bunch of fun characters. Bread wrestling is a... special sport. We will introduce the discipline later.

games.name: Gear.Club Unlimited 3
games.summary: The Gear.Club series is back! Customize and set up your favourite cars to race at top speed along the roads of the French Mediterranean coast and Japan. Don't just win – show off your style!

games.name: Gear.Club Unlimited 3: Performance Cars Pack
games.summary: The Performance Cars Pack includes the Nissan GTR R-35 Nismo, Nissan 370Z Nismo and Bugatti Mistral.

games.name: Gear.Club Unlimited 3: Customization Pack
games.summary: The Customization Pack includes 3 carbon-fibre bonnets for 7 Japanese cars, 5 themed neon lights for all cars (including themes for both France and Japan).

games.name: Gear.Club Unlimited 3: Career Start Pack
games.summary: The Career Starter Pack includes 200,000 GCU3 Dollars, 50 "Alloy" resources, 50 ""Electronic Circuit"" resources, 50 "Component" resources and 2 Engineers for the Story mode.

games.name: Spica Adventure
games.summary:
From the arcade legends, TAITO, experience this formerly Japan-exclusive 2D action jump & run filled with charm and cartoonish delight on modern consoles for the very first time! Reminiscent of the parasol from Parasol Stars: Bubble Bobble III, this yellow parasol will become your favorite accessory and best weapon. Use it to take down a wild mix of enemies that come straight out of a toybox!

Whether it's slashing combos, shooting, jumping off platforms, gliding, or floating, Nico and her parasol have an arsenal of moves that are as varied as her colorful foes. Don’t forget to use the parasol for protection—and we don’t mean against the sun! Defend, parry, and reflect the enemy projectiles in up to 8 directions!

Tackle the challenge of 28 stages spread across multiple paths. With each playthrough, choose a new journey through the universe of Spica!

games.name: Velocity: Midnight Run
games.summary:
Velocity - Midnight Run is an arcade survival racer where every run is a high-speed pressure test through endless midnight traffic. Highways open up. Streets squeeze tighter. Alleys punish hesitation. Cops close in if you slow down. Rival racers pull alongside and dare you to hold the line.

Your goal is not to finish first. Your goal is to keep going.

Scrape through gaps. Thread near misses. Switch cameras. Burn out at the line. Blow the engine if you abuse the redline. Push acceleration, grip, or top speed when the run demands it, then live with what you drained to get there.

games.name: Village in the Shade
games.summary: Enjoy quiet, countryside living in a Japanese village in this brand new farming sim! Just make sure you follow the rules—or else!

games.name: Paw Patrol: Dino World
games.summary: Join the PAW Patrol and Rex on colossal missions across Dino Island. Create roar-some looks, play minigames with friends and more.

games.name: The Last Admiral
games.summary: A 2D roguelite turn based space adventure. You play as the last admiral commanding your fleet as you make your journey into the unknown! fleet and weapon customization will give you near limitless combinations of skills and abilities as you fight vast fleets of enemies from planet to planet.

games.name: Steins;Gate Re:Boot
games.summary: STEINS;GATE returns! Rebooted for the modern era! Featuring fully updated visuals, UI, and an all-new story that breathes new life into the streets of Akihabara.

games.name: RetroSpace
games.summary: Immersive, disco-punk, space horror where you can be a sneaky chap or a mutant action hero as you try to survive on a space station swallowed by a black hole. A mind-bending ride with weird creatures, immersive features, time jumps, and '70s mustaches!

games.name: Mystic Land: The search for Maphaldo
games.summary: An old-school RPG inspired by Wizardry 7, Might and Magic and Eye of the Beholder series. 2d grid-based movement, strategic turn-based combat and lots of places to visit and puzzles to solve.

games.name: Don't Fret
games.summary: Don't! Fret is stylized first-person psychological mascot-horror game set in a musically themed world. Play as a guitar named Fret to solve puzzles, escape from foes, and uncover the mystery behind Harmonic Heights.

games.name: Ominous Recall
games.summary: Ominous Recall: A chilling survival horror game set in a photorealistic Middle East. Confront a terrifying Jinn possessing Stephen and unravel its dark power in this intense psychological thriller.

games.name: Calvar: The Darkest Gate
games.summary: First-person horror survival game that plunges players into a dark and disturbing world. As Leonard Valentin, you must fight against supernatural threats while uncovering the mystery behind the cursed piano and the sinister plans of a dark cult.

games.name: Decksplorers: Into the Shell
games.summary: Dive into the world of Decksplorers: Into the Shell, where deckbuilding card combat meets real-time action in a thrilling roguelite adventure! Master the art of strategic card play, swift reflexes, and exploration as you venture into the mysterious ever-changing caves of "The shell"

games.name: Fiefdom
games.summary: Clash swords, cast spells, rain down arrows & more in FIEFDOM: a multiplayer medieval slasher where players change the world, one battle at a time in a dynamic world. Bring your realm to glory in battles of up to 100 players both by land & by sea!

games.name: Dancing Wings: The Aerobatic Simulator
games.summary: Team aerobatics flight simulator - do it solo. Fly, save the replay, fly in overlay mode, save the new replay, and repeat it up to six aircrafts. Realistic aerodynamics and landscape. Step-by-step training. Share your replay online.

games.name: End of Abyss
games.summary: Play as the young combat technician, Cel, as she uncovers the truth behind the facility's derelict areas and confronts the monstrous creatures that roam them.

games.name: Steel Ark
games.summary: A first-person survival sandbox game where you explore a post-apocalyptic world, scavenge resources, craft production chains, and keep your train base running against all odds.

games.name: Dynasty Warriors 3: Complete Edition Remastered
games.summary: A striking modern revival of "DYNASTY WARRIORS 3" and "DYNASTY WARRIORS 3: Xtreme Legends," which established the foundation of the entire series. The complete cast of more than 40 officers and numerous battlefields will be beautifully recreated using Unreal Engine 5. Aim for the peak of 1 vs 1,000 action in this even more enjoyable and thrilling revival.

games.name: Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds - Avatar Legends Pack
Corinne
games.summary: Corinne is a female name, the French and English variant of Corina, of ancient Greek origin, derived from κόρη (korē) meaning "beautiful maiden". It became popular following the publication of Corinne, or Italy, an 1808 novel by Madame de Staël. Various spellings of the name exist, although some attest that "Corinne" is the most appropriate and age-old spelling. Other spellings include: Corrine, Corin, Corine, Corinn, Coryn, Corryn, Koryn, Korryn, Korin, Corinna, Korinna, Corrin, and Korinne.

games.name: Occult Hand of the Blood Lily
games.summary: A Gothic-Punk yuri visual novel about a magician on the run and her mysterious vampiric guardian. Journey by airship across a war-torn Europe and search for a legendary flower with the power to destroy nations.

games.name: Hollow Faces
games.summary: Hollow Faces is an atmospheric narrative horror where you step into the role of creators documenting paranormal phenomena. The game blends an intense walking simulator with environmental observation, careful listening, and reacting to threats.

games.name: Oathwood Realms
games.summary: Oathwood Realms is a dark fantasy strategy card game focused on careful planning, tactical decisions, and calculated risk. Luck plays a role, but victory favors players who read the board and commit to their choices.

games.name: Anomalous Cleaning Detail
games.summary: A first-person cleaning simulator where you scrub, vacuum, and restore a troubled town plagued by supernatural disturbances. Complete contracts and use environmental clues to prepare for the exorcism, because when the mess is paranormal, a standard clean won't be enough.

games.name: Bravery
games.summary: BRAVERY is a third-person 3D adventure game in which players guide a fragile matchstick character through vast, detailed environments that appear enormous in scale. Gameplay focuses on exploration, tense chase sequences, and interactive fire mechanics that allow objects to be ignited. Throughout the journey, players discover hidden areas and capture enigmatic orbs that are sealed within restored magical mirrors, shaping progression through the world.

games.name: Castle Wars: Legacy
games.summary: Strategy card game where you need to crush enemy caste or raise yours by playing the right cards. With 3 types of cards, build, attack and magic players need to balance their resources and manage castle and wall better than the opponent in order to win. This is version of castle wars has both single player mode for playing campaign levels or vs the AI and multiplayer and advanced multiplayer mode in daily tournaments.

games.name: Sullyland Nursery Rhyme
games.summary: Sullyland Nursery Rhyme je hra z kategorie Vizuální novela od studia Otomate pro Nintendo Switch. Termín vydání: 1. 10. 2026.

games.name: Spline: Part One
games.summary: A narrative-driven psychological horror game in which a man searching for his missing wife becomes trapped within a distorted reality known as the Spline, navigating hostile environments, persistent threats, and fragmented clues that reveal the nature of the world around him.

games.name: The Legend of Chalkvania
games.summary: A bite-sized retro action-adventure set in a quirky, cursed land. Fight monsters, meet strange characters, and uncover hidden secrets in this fast-paced homage to classic 2D side-scrollers. Choose your path—embrace the light or the curse. Your legend begins in Chalkvania.

games.name: If You Stay
games.summary: Winter 1999. Kicked out of your house after being outed by your closest friend, you plan to leave your hometown. Your girlfriend, Mika, wants to see you one more time. Decide whether or not you'll stay together.

games.name: Havoc Heirs
games.summary: A fantasy turn-based RPG in a massive interconnected world. Monsters are everywhere, and you may end up being one of them.

games.name: Red Chat Ritual: Tsumimi Time
games.summary: “Intervene in Tsumimi’s stream” through comments and Mega Chats, then use your deductions to change their fate in this 14-day psychological horror adventure.
aliases: つみみじかん～狂オシイホド愛シテル～

games.name: Ake no Yosuga: Twilight Loop
games.summary:
This is a loop-based psychological horror visual novel.

Every day at 5 PM, a girl named Akane dies.
The protagonist, Keita, becomes aware of this loop and struggles to change her fate.
However, no matter what choices he makes, her death is inevitable.
As the story unfolds, a shocking truth emerges—
Akane has been dying repeatedly to protect Keita.

games.name: Muchi Muchi Pork! & PinkSweets Boosted
games.summary: With this collection, you’re not just getting one fantastic shoot ’em up, but two! This Boosted re-release features a fully arranged soundtrack with brand new tracks from a fresh lineup of arrangers. (These differ from the 2011 console version.) In addition, you get several different game modes, including Arcade and Arrange, Online Rankings that let you compete with players worldwide, and Local Replay Support where you can save your best runs for review. A tasty deal indeed!

games.name: Spooky Market
games.summary: Spooky Market is a co-op shop simulator for 1–4 players set in a world of eternal Halloween. Open your own business, sell a variety of goods, serve vampires, skeletons, and other creatures, hire unusual employees, and gradually grow and expand your store.

games.name: Penguin Weapons
games.summary: Penguin Weapons is a dynamic action roguelite about penguins that collect artifacts, creating absurdly crazy weapons, fight monsters and bosses, unlock stylish clothes, and explore increasingly difficult worlds full of unique combinations and unpredictability alone or with friends.

games.name: Umbral Coterie
games.summary: A dark city simulation with procedural generation and emergent storytelling. Observe, befriend, manipulate, and betray hundreds of fully simulated citizens as they live, work, scheme, and die around you. Shape bloodlines across generations and uncover the sinister forces moving beneath the city.

games.name: Faybound: Veils of Magic
games.summary: An ancient darkness threatens the balance of a magical world. Take on the roles of different fairies and unite their powers. Use their unique abilities to confront the emerging threat. Experience a hand-drawn 2D Metroidvania full of danger and mystical secrets.

games.name: Unending Aqua
games.summary: Explore a mysterious tropical island resort. Collect items and solve puzzles to progress. Survive against dangerous enemies. Piece together the story of the hotel and uncover the dark secrets that it holds.

games.name: D-Extinction
games.summary: D-Extinction is a first-person investigative horror game. A secret experiment went too far. Now the pre-historic predators are loose. Explore, investigate, and survive in a immersive horror experience where one mistake can kill.

games.name: Reversi2048
games.summary: Reversi meets 2048. Every time a piece is flipped, its score doubles. Having more pieces isn't enough if your opponent's total score is higher, you lose. A fresh take on a classic strategy game.

games.name: Clash of Armadas: Koxinga
games.summary: Tower Defense + Auto Chess + Naval Battle Choose from the legendary captains of the Age of Sail – Blackbeard, Francis Drake, Horatio Nelson, Zheng Chenggong… and more. Command 10+ ships. Position your fleet. Broadside fire. Enemies come in waves on fixed routes.

games.name: Labyrinth of the Crystal Princess
games.summary: A horror adventure that tasks you with detecting the Unseen to escape the facility's labyrinths alive.

games.name: Loot Goblins
games.summary: Step into Loot Goblins, a online pvp chaotic realm of greed and gas. Snatch treasures before rivals do, but watch out for their tricks and gassy surprises! Experience an exhilarating frenzy like no other! play with up to 32 players

games.name: Keep Watering
games.summary: Keep Watering is an incremental game with a cozy, hypnotic loop where every drop of water grows into something extraordinary.

games.name: Vertigo Enigma
games.summary: Congratulations! You have been chosen for Vertigo Enigma. A narrative puzzle experiment where your logic and observation are the test. Until it glitches. Until you understand what "chosen" means...

games.name: Goldfish Simulator
games.summary: Goldfish Simulator: “Endless Move” is a meditative idle goldfish simulation game. The goldfish react as if they were alive, and their movements are realistic and elegant.

games.name: Anomalous Veil
games.summary: Anomalous Veil is a psychological horror experience that can be completed in 30–90 minutes and features branching endings.

games.name: Crow's Curated Closet: Shop Simulator
games.summary: Step into the role of a boutique owner with a flair for the unusual. Decorate your shop, unlock new collections, and create a space your customers won’t want to leave. Grow your business, optimise your layout, and watch the numbers climb. Turn your tiny shop into a thriving gothic fashion powerhouse

games.name: Kitty Found a Camera
games.summary: A First-and-Third-Person Photo Shooter (FATPPS) where you take photos to solve problems and get into mischief.

games.name: Hex Tower Boogie
games.summary: Hex Tower Boogie is a tower defense game combined with factory-style automation, played on a hexagonal grid. Players build conveyor belts, splitters and mergers to route ammunition to their towers; towers only fire when supplied by the production line. It mixes logistics and supply-chain management with wave-based defense. Developed with the Godot engine.

games.name: Shady Business
games.summary: Make lamps for villains! As a Villux employee, you create eclectic lamps for ominous clients of the underworld. Receive your design brief, build your lamp, and shape the sinister plans of your customers across a treacherous network of villains.

games.name: How to Destroy a City
games.summary: How to Destroy a City is a casual incremental game where you pilot a giant robot to destroy the city. Upgrade your robot, fight the army, and unlock special abilities and new robots. It's time to turn the city to ashes!

games.name: Bureaucromancer
games.summary: Bureaucromancer is a turn-based tactical shooter set in a floating records office in the sky. A medieval fantasy where rather than magic, they discovered the awesome power of bureaucracy.

games.name: MXGP 26: The Official Game
games.summary: Dominate the track, feel every impact, every rut, every victory. The most intense and realistic motocross experience is finally available. Experience the entire 2026 championship, with its official tracks and riders.

games.name: Black Hollow
games.summary: Black Hollow is a dark fantasy roguelite FPS where you play as a lone plague doctor defending a remote farmstead from waves of plague-stricken villagers. Fight through the night with your staff, lantern, and unstable plague mixtures, then use the remains of the infected to unlock new attacks, potions, and upgrades at an ancient runestone.
aliases: Black Hollow, New South Wales, Australia

games.name: Wingspan: Bird Pack - Birds of Continental Europe
games.summary:
Expand your bird sanctuary with Wingspan Bird Pack: Birds of Continental Europe, featuring species from across mainland Europe!

Enhance your wildlife preserve with the 25 fan-designed, distinctive European bird cards with unique powers, and listen to their songs with this digital Bird Pack.

Add new favorites to your collection with bird species from diverse European habitats never before seen in Wingspan Digital, and unlock an exclusive player portrait.

Enjoy the variety of familiar and lesser-known species, each with its own call and charm.

games.name: Aetheris Core
games.summary: A fast-paced sci-fi action roguelite where you battle escalating enemy waves, combine powerful abilities, and take on challenging boss encounters.

games.name: Sanasana
games.summary: To bring her deceased sister back to life, a young girl sets out to steal the Golden Apples from three witches. Dodge beautiful yet merciless bullet patterns in this dark fantasy bullet hell shooter filled with madness.

games.name: Let's Tidy Up!: Konbini
games.summary: Let's Tidy Up! Konbini is a cozy organizing simulator where you need to return scattered products their proper place in a Japanese convenience store. Completing shelves unlocks new skills and abilities that you can use to help you stack over 5000 unique items as quickly as possible!

games.name: No Return Address
games.summary: Night shift at a distribution center. Ordinary packages go forward, strange ones go to reject. Just dont make a mistake when the boxes start containing things that should never be there.

games.name: Down Pit

games.name: BeBalance

games.name: Hauntasy
games.summary: Do you believe in ghosts? A wealthy baron offers you $1,000,000 to take part in the Hauntasy, a seven-night challenge inside his family's supposedly haunted estate. Keep watch, manage your limited resources, and survive until dawn to claim the reward.

games.name: Not Monsters
games.summary: A medieval themed party game for 4-15 players where social deduction becomes ragdoll combat and monsters hide in plain sight.

games.name: The Roach Hotel: Chapter 2
games.summary: Continue the story of The Roach Hotel, descending deep below, where the air grows heavy and the shadows feels alive. Down here, the cockroaches are the least of your concerns… something far worse is waiting to play.

games.name: Ghost of Yotei: Complete Edition
games.summary:
The award winning epic returns. Become a different kind of warrior in this definitive edition of the standalone Ghost of Yotei experience.

The Complete Edition includes:
• Ghost of Yotei
• Echoes of Sekigahara - A New Story Expansion
• Most Wanted - A Combat Survival Mode
• In-game Mask
• Charm of Hokkyokusei
• The Snake Armor
• Digital Deluxe Armor Dye
• Digital Deluxe Horse & Saddle
• Sword Kit
• Traveler’s Maps (Early Unlock)
• Charm of Amaterasu

games.name: Tile & Error
games.summary: A word-game roguelite. Place words to crack escalating score targets, enchant single tiles until they detonate, freeze or pay gold, and tilt the whole board when nothing fits. Bosses rewrite the rules, the shop rebuilds your bag, and every run digs deeper into the alphabet.

games.name: The Gastarbeiters
games.summary: The Gastarbeiters is a 1-5 player co-op game about building when the whole world is against you. Raise a house through explosions, assaults, and raging storms. Will you complete the construction and survive?

games.name: Seven Nights With Hanako
games.summary: Ancient Leylines, a once in a 10 millennia blood moon, and one seriously bratty ghost! Seven Nights, Seven Challenges, Seven Hearts; Survive a week in Hanako's Hell realm or become her eternal play-thing!

games.name: Infested DX
games.summary: Escape a space nightmare as the sole survivor of an alien infestation. Search for clues and solve puzzles as you avoid deadly encounters with zombies, mutants, robots and unseen alien pathogens. Find a cure and a way home in this retro point and click adventure!

games.name: Extravalence
games.summary: Lead a party of living chemical elements through a fractured world where every bond changes the battle. Switch between unique heroes, combine their abilities, manage volatile reactions and restore the stability.

games.name: Enarian: Orbital Command
games.summary: A spaceship based RTS/RPG Hybrid, take command from your own outpost and lead wings of fighters, bombers, frigates and more, against powerful enemy fleets. Defend, Assault, Hack, Repair and Recover cargo for corporations and pirate factions building the strength of your ship and notoriety.

games.name: Groovekeeper: Sort the Record Shop
games.summary: A first-person record-sorting game: no customers, no economy, no time pressure. Shelve the records that come out of the crates by genre, put rare ones on the turntable and listen. As the shelves fill up, we guarantee relaxation.

games.name: Flippy the Spider
games.summary: Jump, glide, and swing your way through increasingly challenging levels, eating flies and searching for your way home. Master tight, physics-based controls, explore 5 distinct worlds, and collect trophies along the way!

games.name: Grape by Grape
games.summary: A cozy vineyard idler with no clicking and no game-over. Hover to water your vines, then turn grapes into wine, raisins, vinegar and pekmez across your own little estate and sell them at your shop. 14 grapes, gentle automation, and a vineyard that works while you're away.

games.name: Beefy Boi
games.summary: A job simulator horror. Gather ingredients, assemble orders, and hand them to customers. Your boss is a massive meat monster and we intentionally broke him. Pay your bills when you get back to your room.

games.name: Gran Turismo 7: Spec IV
games.summary:
The Spec IV Update includes:

October:
• A new circuit, 'Sportsland SUGO'
• Six new cars
• A new 'Spec IV' opening cinematic
• Vintage: a section featuring cars not available to purchase as new
• Car Concierge: a service for ordering Used and Legend cars
• Experience: a mode featuring brand-specific driving challenges
• Car Viewer: a feature that lets you admire the cars in your garage
• Collector Level cap increase.

December:
• A new circuit, 'Autumn Ring'
• Six new cars
• Family: a new mode to be enjoyed by the whole family, from kids to adults
• Shuffle Race: a luck-based race with randomly selected cars
• Online Drift Trial: a new mode where players can test their drifting skills against others worldwide
• The next evolution of Gran Turismo Sophy
• New difficulty level in Power Pack for advanced players.

games.name: Puckoff: Reloaded
games.summary: Puckoff: Reloaded is the latest, and greatest, version of the (in)famous game, Puckoff, previously available only for personal computers. Enter the world of no-rules hockey as a total newbie and work on your skills and attitude to meet with the mythical terrorizer, Dominator. Build your team of has-beens and legends while learning different playstyles to defeat a plethora of colorful characters around the globe. Team up with the ever cheerful Sarah, the best beer-league goalie Eddie, and the ever grumpy seen-it-all Coach. So grab your skates and Puck off!

games.name: Did You See That?
games.summary: A 2 player psychological horror game where not every player sees the same reality. Explore a carnival trapped in an endless transformation, detect anomalies, verify with your friend if they see the same thing and make the right decisions before the clown Bobby loses his temper...

games.name: Pusheen's Place
games.summary: Pusheen’s Place is a cozy casual game centered around collecting, caring for, and spending time with different versions of Pusheen. Players can create their own little Pusheen paradise by decorating rooms with hundreds of items and mixing furniture and decorations from different themes. More than 100 Pusheens can be collected, ranging from Common to Legendary, including special variants such as Pusheenicorn, Laptop Pusheen, and Pancake Pusheen. Players can feed, pet, and play with their Pusheens while completing a variety of bite-sized minigames and puzzles. With its relaxed pace, colorful rooms, and emphasis on collecting and customization, Pusheen’s Place offers a simple and cozy place for fans of Pusheen to unwind and make their own home for the beloved cats.

games.name: Crown Of Blight
games.summary: Crown of Blight is a dynamic top-down 3D metroidvania. As an elite Hunter of the Church, descend into cursed dungeons to find the source of the Blight. Annihilate hordes of enemies, unlock new paths, and uncover the grim truth hidden in the depths.

games.name: Obstacle Overdrive
games.summary: Cruise through a world of colorful retro inspired toys in Obstacle Overdrive, a cozy off-roading toy car adventure! Navigate fun, challenging courses, tumultuous tumbles, and enjoy the charm of a miniature world where the obstacles are as playful as the ride itself.

games.name: Bloodspill
games.summary: Bloodspill is a fast-paced, pvp retro fps with one hit combat, featuring classic gamemodes like deathmatch, capture the flag and conquest!

games.name: Ace Combat 8: Wings of Theve - Playable Aircraft: F-14A
aliases: ACE COMBAT 8: WINGS OF THEVE - Playable Aircraft: F-14A
games.summary:
Grants Playable Aircraft: F-14A for ACE COMBAT 8: WINGS OF THEVE.

The initial model of the carrier-based fighter series that would later be upgraded to the Super Tomcat.
Its role of using long-range missiles to outrange and eliminate threats to the fleet has remained consistent from its creation. Its nickname is Tomcat.

games.name: Bering Tonnage
games.summary: Build and automate a cargo fleet across over 250 real-world ports in this maritime tycoon. Route ships through strategic canals, navigate tropical cyclones and geopolitical sanctions, and grow a small shipping company into a global logistics empire.

games.name: Dual Protocol: The Case of Eva & Miles
games.summary: Play as Agent Eva to follow the trail, or as Analyst Miles to manage the operation. Dual Protocol is an asymmetric noir puzzle game where two players progress only through conversation. Without seeing each other’s screens, combine the data you have and uncover the truth behind the Castellari murder.

games.name: Rally & Hypercar Bundle
games.summary: Enjoy 2 games in 1 with this irresistible speed games pack!

games.name: Ball Picker: Clean Up the Golf Yard
games.summary: Collect +1,000,000 golf balls, earn money, buy new vehicles, and clean up the golf yard. Ball Picker - Clean up the Golf Yard is an active incremental game centered on an organizing and relaxing experience.
aliases: BALL PICKER - Clean Up the Golf Yard

games.name: Screaming Halls: Horror
games.summary: The halls never end...

games.name: Podstakannik Rails
games.summary:
Podstakannik Rails is a first-person social co-op game set aboard an overnight sleeper train. One to four players board the same car, take their berths, and spend the trip together. There are no quests, scores, or progression systems: the host sets the trip to 10, 15, or 20 minutes, the train pulls into the station when time runs out, and nothing carries over to the next trip.

Players talk over proximity voice chat, so voices are clear inside a compartment and fade down the corridor. Around the car, they can fill a glass of tea at the samovar and carry it in a metal glass holder called a podstakannik, tune the radio by hand through the static, make up a berth and lie down for a nap, and work the reading lamps, ceiling lights, and compartment doors. Non-player characters include the sleeping car attendant, a police officer, and passengers who tell stories to anyone who sits down to listen, while the countryside passes outside the window by day or by night.

games.name: Penis Bird
games.summary: Slide into the role of arcade gaming's first feathered phallus! Dodge attacking wildlife, poke through tight spaces, and chase high scores across frantic danger filled runs. Collect all the power-up costumes! Features full controller support and a stream-safe Eggplant Mode.

games.name: Tunnel Escape Fates Entwined
games.summary: Fight through a zombie-ravaged city as Olivenia, a daring cop on an escort mission in this rogue-lite RPG/ADV. Use various weapons and upgrade your gear to survive brutal gunplay and deadly encounters where every choice counts. Fail, and very bad things might happen to you…

games.name: Let's Tidy Up!: Treasure
games.summary: Let's Tidy Up! : Treasure is a cozy organizing simulator about tidying up a Dwarf treasure room after a particularly lucrative year. Complete full shelves to unlock skills and abilities. Sort, stack and shelve 8,888 unique items as you slowly unravel the secrets beneath...

games.name: Lord Liberty Quest II: Pure White
aliases: ロードリバティクエスト2 ~純白~
神官木叶之自由征程2 ~纯白~
games.summary: Someone is secretly hastening the revival of the "Black Devil" that assaults the Disodart Continent every few decades. Taking the situation gravely, the royal capital entrusts the tower's investigation to a church priestess. But that priestess is a young, innocent maiden…

games.name: Jolly: Anniversary Edition
games.summary: "Jolly: Anniversary Edition" is a fan-remake made from the ground up of the original "Jolly 1" by IvanG. This is designed to give the original game a fresh new coat of paint with better polished gameplay and a new story that helps it connect to the wider Jolly story.

games.name: FAFO Executive Order Simulator
games.summary: F around and find out! A ruthless no F's given dark comedy where you play the president of the United States of America, abuse executive power, crank up the FAFO meter, deal with robot overlords, alien invasions, drain swamps, flip off allies, crush protests, and destroy all that oppose you!

games.name: Chill Cat
games.summary: Chill Cat is a cute and chaotic 3v3 multiplayer top-down shooter where adorable cats battle for turf with colorful paint blasters!

games.name: Tidy Backpack: In the Faraway Lands
games.summary: Tidy Backpack: In the Faraway Lands is a relaxing puzzle game where you must organize found futuristic loot in your backpack in a tidy way. Find unknown artifacts and learn details about the faraway lands... at least supposedly!

games.name: Gears of War: E-Day
games.summary: Experience Emergence Day – the brutal origin story of one of gaming’s most acclaimed third-person shooter franchises.

games.name: Star Wars: Galactic Racer
games.summary: STAR WARS: Galactic Racer™ is a ​runs-based, ​high-stakes reinvention of racing born in the lawless Outer Rim. With the Empire gone and the galaxy rebuilding, The Galactic League is created: an underground, unsanctioned circuit where syndicates bankroll chaos and champions are forged.

games.name: Witch Cabin Cleanup
games.summary: Witch's Cabin Cleanup is a cozy organizing simulator where you sort 5,313 curios in a cluttered witch's cabin. Clean, learn spells, and restore order in a calm and atmospheric environment.

games.name: Forever Ago
games.summary: Following a tragic stroke of fate, Alfred embarks on a journey north in search of redemption in this single-player road trip adventure.

games.name: Calx
games.summary: Calx is an atmospheric 3D action adventure inspired by visionary sci-fi art. Explore planet Syro - vast landscapes filled with crystal structures and ancient technology. Find out what the WARP did to the Quoths civilization. The environment guides you, revealing secrets through exploration.

games.name: Echo Weaver
games.summary: Time is your greatest resource and secrets are your only upgrades. Master an unraveling time loop in this knowledge-based Metroidvania. As the last Weaver, exploit time-altering anomalies and use what you learn to break the cycle. Explore what remains. Uncover the mystery. Perfect the loop.

games.name: Silver Pines
games.summary: Silver Pines is a survival horror metroidvania set in small town America. Fight nightmarish terrors and solve puzzles, while carefully managing your scarce resources as you uncover the mysteries that could hold the key to redemption.

games.name: Penguin Colony
games.summary: Cosmic horror, through the eyes of a penguin. Rival human factions have come to your home in the Antarctic, seeking an ancient and inconceivable being. Observe their descent into insanity in this faithful re-imagining of H.P. Lovecraft’s At the Mountains of Madness, and other stories.

games.name: Clive Barker's Hellraiser: Revival
games.summary: Experience a new chapter in the legendary horror series like never before. Clive Barker's Hellraiser: Revival takes first-person action horror survival to the next level. Wield the powers of the Genesis Configuration puzzle box to survive your bargain with the infamous Pinhead.

games.name: Order of the Sinking Star
games.summary: From director Jonathan Blow (Braid, The Witness), Order of the Sinking Star is a massive puzzle adventure set in a realm of magic and enigma. Solve over 1000 interconnected, hand-crafted puzzles, discover unique playable heroes, master evolving gameplay mechanics, and decipher a grand mystery.

games.name: Kingdom Hearts Collection [I-III]
games.summary: Play Kingdom Hearts I–III together in one unforgettable collection. A value‑packed bundle featuring three collections: Kingdom Hearts -HD 1.5+2.5 ReMIX-, Kingdom Hearts HD 2.8 Final Chapter Prologue, and Kingdom Hearts III + Re Mind (DLC).

games.name: Harold Rabbit 3: The House of Mysteries
games.summary: Harold Rabbit and Maud Bumblebee have been invited to the mansion of Archibald Squirrel, for a great game of wits. Can Harold and Maud solve the riddles and puzzles Archibald Squirrel has prepared for them?

games.name: Rainbow Islands CS
games.summary: Experience 6 different versions of the magical world of Rainbow Islands! That comical place full of dreams is back!

games.name: PlantUp
games.summary: Grow plants, process your harvest, and serve impatient customers before chaos takes over your shop. PlantUp blends cozy farming with fast-paced time management, clever upgrades, and a campaign full of challenges.

games.name: Once Upon A Katamari: Rolling Live Highlights
games.summary: This paid DLC features ten stages originally featured in "Katamari Damacy Rolling Live", twelve new songs, six new cousins, and 18 new accessories.

games.name: Boku to Tsuri Nikki
games.summary: Boku to Tsuri Nikki is a freshwater fishing game set in a peaceful, nature-filled world, where players can enjoy an immersive fishing experience.

Two Point Museum: Rides & Relics
games.summary: Step right up! We’re searching for Funfair Experts to transform the new location Riquetti Gardens into a one-of-a-kind mix of museum-meets-amusement park, or as we like to call it, a museum-ments.

games.name: Paperhead
games.summary: In the cute cardboard world, something went horribly wrong... Use the magical pencil, a good old shotgun, and various other weapons as well as the strength of your mighty boots, to uncover the dark truth and find out WHY WOULD CARDBOARD... BLEED?

games.name: True Love For Her
games.summary: True Love For Her (TLFH) is a Yandere game inspired by Yandere Simulator and Life Is Strange that doesn’t compete with the original games. This game involves murder and other methods of killing, so it is not suitable for kids. We are not responsible for any actions taken by kids replicating activities from TLFH in real life.

games.name: Truckful
games.summary: Drive your pickup truck through seemingly peaceful countryside valleys, deliver much-needed goods to local townsfolk and unravel the small town mystery. Beware, the old forest is watching.

games.name: Kill Your Darlings
games.summary: The kingdom has imprisoned you in the dungeon! Manage your day-to-day life, date your fellow inmates (who are monsters) and fight by their side to escape in this innovative time-management dating-sim RPG where every choice matters and every playthrough is different.

games.name: Flashbound
games.summary: Sam agrees to help his friends by staying the night in their house while they leave for urgent business. Outside, a heavy rainstorm rages, with loud thunderclaps shaking the walls and creating an oppressive atmosphere.

games.name: Lost & Found
games.summary: LOST & FOUND is a free to play dynamic sorting game. Match forms to the right items and build your own warehouse, or compete with your friends in multiplayer mode after your shift is over.

games.name: Lights Out, Run
games.summary: A first-person survival horror game where you must cross your house at night while the fears of your childhood become real.

games.name: Dragon's Dogma II: Dark Arisen Expansion
games.summary:
Dragon's Dogma 2: Dark Arisen enriches the dynamic fantasy world and expansive adventures of Dragon's Dogma 2 with unforgettable new tales and thrilling encounters.

Based on feedback we received after the initial release of Dragon's Dogma 2, we established three goals for ourselves when we set out to update and expand the game:
Enhanced gameplay. Expanded adventures. Enticing value.

games.name: The Hat Man
games.summary: A first-person psychological horror game inspired by The Hat Man urban legend, focusing on sleep paralysis, fear, and the terror of being unable to move.

games.name: Sesame Street: Friends & Fun
games.summary: Welcome to Sesame Street! A place to play, laugh and grow. There’s so much to do with Elmo and your Sesame Steet friends. Enjoy exploring their world, growing beanstalks, cooking tasty food, and helping your new friends throw a big party for the neighborhood.

games.name: WildRoot
games.summary: Build a thriving colony in a mysterious forest where every season, setback, and choice creates a different story.

games.name: Horse Club Ride West
games.summary: Travel to the Wild River Ranch and experience exciting adventures.

games.name: Words of Power
games.summary: A galaxy enslaved by ancient words. Type fast, spell true, and fight back — every word is a weapon. Duel bosses, battle across a neon-vector galaxy, and prove you're eloquent enough to save the universe. Multiplayer coming soon!

games.name: Indoors: Trespasser
games.summary: May 7th, 1951. Five days after the Alston family vanished inside their manor. Local policeman Lucas Smith, never returned from his investigation. Now, his son breaks in to continue the investigation in this short horror and detective escape room.

games.name: Hubert
games.summary: Hubert je mužské jméno germánského původu. Je odvozeno ze jména Hugberaht s významem „duchaplný člověk, skvělé mysli“ (hugu – mysl, bert – jasný). Další podobou je Hugbert i Hugo. V českém občanském kalendáři má svátek 3. listopadu.

games.name: Colorbound
games.summary: In Colorbound, color is more than just hue. As Anku, an Aymara boy with a unique gift, you’ll harness the power of color to shape the environment itself, uncovering hidden paths to navigate challenging and complex puzzles.

games.name: Ghostpunk
games.summary: Investigate paranormal cases using a 1990s CRT terminal. Analyze photos. Decode audio. Interrogate suspects and decide what’s real, what’s fake and who’s lying. But the deeper you go, the more the system starts watching you back.

games.name: Alien Archeologist
games.summary: Alien Archeologist is a chill incremental digging game. Use a variety of upgradeable tools to mine ore, blast through earth, and clean strange artifacts as you journey yet deeper toward the mystery hiding at the planet's core.

games.name: Allogloom
games.summary: Join Nora in this mysterious and macabre point and click adventure game. Find and collect items to solve puzzles. Talk to peculiar people and monsters alike. Explore Gruesome Grove and beyond to uncover forgotten truths and save the people of her town!

games.name: Deep Dish Dungeon
games.summary: A survival exploration game where you navigate through a puzzly hand-crafted dungeon, with metroidvania and crafting elements. Unravel the enigmas of the dungeon’s depths solo or online co-op multiplayer.

games.name: Valor Mortis
games.summary: Valor Mortis is a first-person action soulslike from the creators of Ghostrunner. Rise from death as a former soldier of Napoleon’s army. Wield supernatural powers, battle horrifying monsters, and unravel a conspiracy that threatens all of humanity.

games.name: Planet Zoo 2
games.summary: Build a wilder world in Planet Zoo 2. Create distinctive zoos around the globe filled with awe-inspiring animals, including fully aquatic and flying species, before taking your experience beyond the zoo to release your animals into expansive Wildlife Reserves.

games.name: Atlantis Fantasy: Reborn
games.summary: Dive into Atlantis Fantasy: Reborn! Rebuild an Atlantean capital amid coral and ancient magic. Manage resources, explore the abyss, and revive a sunken kingdom in this unique marine city builder. The legend awaits you beneath the waves.

games.name: Street Fighter 6: Year 4 - Arjun
games.summary: Like an aggressive bull jumping in the dust of the fields, Arjun moves heaven and earth with his powerful breathing techniques!

games.name: Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024: National Championship Air Races
Trash Day

games.name: Attic Antiquities
games.summary: Precious dolls haunted by evil spirits have appeared on your doorstep. Use the tools of the Beaufort Family Workshop to exorcise them and learn why they've come to you.

games.name: Kamigami: Spirits of the Nature
games.summary: Get ready for another card battling adventure on Kamigami! Easy to play, hard to master, collect brand new cards, face over 80 opponents, build your strategies and restore peace to the gods!

games.name: The Witch's Bakery
games.summary: The Witch's Bakery is a 2D Adventure RPG where you live a magical life as a witch-baker in Paris! Serve customers, visit iconic streets and heal people's heart with your croissants! 🥐

games.name: Over the Hill
games.summary: Explore the world in the golden age of offroading. Drive iconic 4x4 vehicles from the 60s to 80s by yourself or with friends through challenging trails and beautiful scenery.

games.name: Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2
games.summary: Obliterate heretics in the name of the Emperor in Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun 2! Play as Ultramarine Malum Caedo or Sister of Battle Nyra Veyrath in this sequel to retro FPS Warhammer 40,000: Boltgun with more enemies, more weapons, and new ways to purge!

games.name: Shipping Store Simulator 2037
games.summary: Run the logistics center of the future! Hire robots, deliver packages via drone, drop off urgent shipments in your truck, and become the biggest package pickup place in sunny Cranelock.

games.name: Thank You Bus Driver
games.summary: Thank You Bus Driver is a chaotic bus driving game where you take on the role of a town’s bus driver just trying to get through the day with minimal rulebreaking and maximum gratitude… in the form of Thank Yous!

games.name: Halley's Big Catch
games.summary: A cartoon cat who loves to fish. Come home to Hidden Pond, fight real fish, and follow a trail of relics to waters around the world. New shores, new tackle, and a story that unfolds one cast at a time.

games.name: CyberPunk Sex Tower
games.summary: The world of the future, modern technologies make it possible to create a super realistic sexual experience ...

games.name: Chained Beasts
games.summary: Chained Beasts is a 1-4 player co-op gladiator roguelike. Fight chaotic battles chained to your friends. Use your chains or the arena to beat up foes in creative ways and win over the bloodthirsty crowd. Endure physical and mental injuries to defeat fearsome bosses and survive the day.

games.name: We Are So Cooked
games.summary: You and your friends are in trouble. Big trouble. You’ve accidentally killed someone, and now you have to get rid of the evidence. "We Are So Cooked" is a 1-4 player co-op physics-stealth game where the objective is simple: Get the body to the exit. The execution? That’s the hard part.

games.name: Castlevania: Belmont's Curse
games.summary: Crimson Curse —Will Your Fate Bloom in Despair or Salvation Set 23 years after Castlevania Dracula's Curse - follow Rose Belmont's journey in an all new 2D Action-Exploration title from KONAMI, Evil Empire and Motion Twin.

games.name: Bluey's Happy Snaps
games.summary: Time to play! Explore, have fun and capture your favorite moments with Bluey and Bingo in this photo-powered game. Look out for familiar spots from the show, create your own scrapbook and turn in-game memories into playful moments for real life.

games.name: Echoes of the Unread
games.summary: Jump and sing to unlock the secrets of the library. Singing will change the world around you and your abilities improve as you explore.

games.name: The Jackbox Party Pack 12
games.summary: It’s the golden age of game nights with The Jackbox Party Pack 12! Play 5 brand-new party games designed to turn your standard bash into a sidesplitting blast. You bring the friends, we’ll bring the fun. Coming this fall to screens near you!

games.name: Harvest Moon: Echoes of Teradea
games.summary: Farm, explore, and discover! Embark on an unforgettable journey in the enchanting world of Teradea, where peaceful farm life meets thrilling adventure!

games.name: Toy Story: Retro Roundup!
games.summary: Step back into Andy’s room with Woody, Buzz Lightyear, and more classic characters in Toy Story: Retro Roundup! This five-game collection features four Toy Story titles and A Bug’s Life. All the games have been upgraded with quality-of-life improvements and behind-the-scenes content.

games.name: Toy Story 3 Complete Edition
games.summary: Toy Story 3 Complete Edition brings the definitive version of the game inspired by the Academy Award-winning film to modern platforms for the first time, including previously platform-exclusive content from the PlayStation 3 version and an enhanced experience with upgraded visuals, higher resolutions and improved performance. Toy Story 3 is best known for its groundbreaking Toy Box Mode, a massive, open-world sandbox that allowed customization of the environment and characters and featured non-linear missions that allow players to unlock new toys, vehicles and characters from other Pixar movies.

games.name: Toy Story: Retro Roundup! + Toy Story 3 Complete Edition Double Pack
aliases: Disney•Pixar Toy Story: Retro Roundup! + Toy Story 3 Complete Edition Double Pack
