games.summary: Get all the toys in the toy chest with this double pack, featuring both Toy Story: Retro Roundup! and Toy Story 3 Complete Edition. Play as classic characters as you navigate familiar worlds and take on challenges inspired by the films. Toy Story: Retro Roundup! includes 11 classic games, with both console and handheld versions of four Toy Story games, along with A Bug’s Life. Toy Story 3 Complete Edition brings back the fan-favorite 3D adventure for modern consoles.

games.name: Stream Train
games.summary: Stream Train is a co-op adventure where up to 6 players livestream their trip through the Uncanny Valley. Grow your audience by taunting cryptid creatures, doing dangerous stunts, and pranking your friends. Can you make it through the valley alive?

games.name: FreshWomen: Season 3
games.summary: FreshWomen is a choice-driven adult Visual Novel focusing on the best parts of life. You're a college freshman who just earned a mansion. Bring girls to your home to romance, date, or fuck them. Your journey will be filled with comedy, love, and lots of sex.

games.name: Castlevania: Belmont's Curse - Bonus Contents Pack
Silent Wounds - The Doll
games.summary: Silent Wounds is an episodic psychological horror anthology. Each episode offers a compact and intense narrative experience. In this first episode, a man returns home and trades reality for the dangerous, silent obsession with a perfect doll.

games.name: Crimson Desert: Charting the Unknown
games.summary: Reclaim power and reach beyond-into the unknown.The story of Pywel continues in Crimson Desert: Charting the Unknown as Kliff, Oongka, and Damiane set out to discover their purpose and shape their futures. However, as turmoil unfolds around them, each must fight to forge a path through the trials ahead. Join them on a new adventure and discover what new possibilities await across Pywel.

games.name: Mimic Busters
games.summary: Model, paint, and mimic everything to hide from the Busters! Mimic Busters is an online multiplayer game where you are either a cube with a sentience or a hunter with no mercy. Mimics create their disguise using simple 3D modeling tools and Busters hunt the Mimics before the time runs out!

games.name: Tenebris Somnia
games.summary: Tenebris Somnia is a 2D retro survival horror adventure game with live action cutscenes created by an award winning film crew from Argentina. Unveil the depths of a disturbing story by solving puzzles and fighting horrible creatures. ...What if they aren't just nightmares?

games.name: DayZ: Badlands
games.summary: DayZ Badlands throws you into the troubled territories of Nasdara Province—267km² of arid expanse. Uncover its secrets, battle for control, forge fragile alliances and rebuild from the ashes of past wars. Survival here isn't just measured in drops of water saved, but in bullets spared.

games.name: Tales of Eternia: Remastered
games.summary: Tales of Eternia returns as a remastered edition! As the threat of world destruction looms, an epic journey begins to determine the fate of two worlds: Inferia and Celestia.

games.name: Solemnfable
games.summary: Fight and forgive in this QTE based RPG, and travel the Earth and stars with those who matter most. SOLEMNFABLE - A journey of acceptance.

games.name: Beyblade X Evobattle: Bey Coating Pattern & Color Add-on Kit Vol.2
Beyblade X Evobattle: Digital Beybooster Vol.8
A Sister's Journey
games.summary: Explore a charmingly beautiful, hand-crafted pixel art world and help Violet on her journey searching for her sister. Uncover its mysteries, face its threatening foes, and run 'n gun your way through this challenging action-metroidvania - which will put your true platforming skills to the test.

games.name: We Were Here Tomorrow
games.summary: You and your partner awaken inside a mysterious Norček facility with little recollection of how you got there. Communicate, cooperate, and unravel the secrets in this asymmetrical co-op adventure. Only together will you decide the fate of Tomorrow…

games.name: Bytes and Knights Adventure
games.summary: Bytes and Knights is a full-scale digital TCG set within an RPG world, packed with deep strategy and unique mechanics. Explore the streets of your new city, collect cards, build your own deck, and battle increasingly challenging opponents. Each new card unlocks new playstyles and brings you closer to uncovering what really lies hidden beneath the city.

games.name: Star Trek: Outposts Unknown
games.summary: Lead your crew across strange new worlds in this narrative driven outpost builder! Research, explore, and build as you face a mysterious cosmic force that threatens a new ally. Your adventure awaits, Captain!

games.name: I Am Your Beast: Quitting Time
games.summary: Remember: you're one of the good guys. Fight a shadow war in Southeast Asia in this story prequel DLC to indie hit I Am Your Beast.

games.name: The House in the Hollow
games.summary: With graphics inspired by the 1920's Art Deco period, and a chilling soundtrack, the "House In The Hollow" will take you on a journey filled with mystery, horror, and magic, where you are the master of your own fate.

games.name: Stupid Never Dies
games.summary: Turn weak zombie Davy stupid strong, stupid fast in this Blazing Fast Growth action RPG! Devour enemies, steal powers, transform, and brave a deadly dungeon to revive frozen Julia.

games.name: Crash Relay
games.summary: Crash Relay is a chaotic multiplayer racing game where 10 players share 5 vehicles in teams of two. One player controls acceleration and braking, while the other handles steering and weapons. Use weapons, special abilities, and teamwork to survive chaotic races and reach the finish line first.

games.name: Demons' Night Fever
games.summary:
Misdeed, Theft, Abduction, Plunder. This is a tale of “Evil,” where anything goes.
Where the hero is a dull boy named Kyoshiro, who hates the world. And a self-proclaimed evil god having lost his powers appears to him. Team up with the evil god and go beyond the limits of evil! Steal! Abduct! Terminate! Let your evil show!

games.name: Nintendo Switch Sports Resort
games.summary: Get up and move in 12 motion-control sports! Gently swing your racket, pull back and aim like an archer, and more in 12 sports with intuitive motion controls. Move together in sports like Bowling and Basketball, duke it out in Boxing, and even battle with one thumb in Thumb Wrestling - there are lots of ways to compete and have fun together!

games.name: Final Fantasy Resonance
games.summary: Return to the pixelart world of FINAL FANTASY, evolved from its classic roots. Travel with companions bound by fate and call on Visions to aid you in battle to uncover the truth behind a force that threatens to bring everything to ruin.

games.name: The World's Shortest Horror Game
games.summary: Press one button. Regret it immediately. A bite-sized analog horror comedy made to be finished in minutes, streamed for reactions, or gifted to a friend as a tiny act of betrayal. Headphones strongly recommended. Friendship not guaranteed.

games.name: Fatal Fury: City of the Wolves - Starter Edition
Death Rabbit
games.summary: The city that never sleeps has taken a sinister turn, and the dark tunnels of the MTA have become the epicenter of a horrifying outbreak. As Alisa, you must navigate through a labyrinthine underground world fraught with danger, where unspeakable horrors lurk around every corner.

games.name: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4
games.summary: War erupts on the Korean Peninsula as North Korea launches an invasion that threatens to destabilize the world in Call of Duty®: Modern Warfare® 4.
aliases: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare IV

games.name: One Piece: Grand Gourmet
games.summary: Hop aboard a delectable management sim in the world of ONE PIECE! Work alongside the Straw Hat Crew to build the greatest floating restaurant of the seas. Collect ingredients, dream up dishes, and decorate to have familiar faces lining up for more!

games.name: Snap & Print
games.summary: Run the cutest little photo & print shop in town! Snap & Print is a cozy job simulator, where you take portraits, edit and restore pictures, and decorate shots with hats, flowers, stickers, and more. Upgrade your studio, unlock new props, and make every customer smile.

games.name: Warrior Cats: Clans of the Forest
games.summary: Create your own Warrior Cat and journey through the Lake Territories in an immersive action-adventure inspired by the beloved Warrior Cats book series. Hunt, explore, battle rival Clans, uncover prophecies, and shape your legacy with every choice you make.

games.name: Warrior Cats: Clans of the Forest - Feral Edition
Where Is My Pet?
games.summary: Where Is My Pet? is a hidden object, sorting, and animal game! Run your cozy shelter: place animals, sell them to loving homes, upgrade your shelter, build your dream house, and search the city for pets. Can you turn a shabby shelter into a profitable business?

games.name: Timeless Rain
games.summary: Explore this foreign world and manipulate time to navigate through the challenges that lie along your path! Meet the inhabitants of this strange realm as they push you towards finding the Timeless Rain...

games.name: Breach Signal
games.summary: Breach Signal is a 1-6 player co-op cosmic horror game. As a recruit of the FNA, lead expeditions into strange places and investigate mysterious anomalies that threaten our reality.

games.name: Fangtopia
games.summary: Sink your fangs into Fangtopia, a cozy and relaxing tile puzzle game where you assemble landscapes to craft a monsterrific paradise for friendly ghouls and ghosts. Design a care-free, scare-free world of gentle chills.

games.name: The Mailroom
games.summary:
A horror job simulator where you work in the mailroom of a small regional office of Hell located in Modesto, California.

You just started working in the mailroom of that weird building on 5th. The job was easy enough at first. Sort the mail and use their creaky old pneumatic tube system to send it to the correct departments. But then shit started getting weird. Can you figure out what's really going on in this place and find a way out?

games.name: Recycling Shift
games.summary: Work at a recycling facility! In this tactile cozy job simulator, sort discarded items into categories, process them into raw material and sell valuable items for money. Could be trash or treasure! Upgrade your workflow, sort and process efficiently.

games.name: Night Plane
games.summary: Night Plane is a job-sim horror game where you work as a flight attendant on a doomed plane. Check tickets, serve passengers, and decide who stays onboard as demons hide among innocent souls. Naturally, management says it’s your problem.

games.name: Last Floor
games.summary: Оne day your life changes dramatically and you become a hostage of your own home. Your task is to survive but to do this you need to get outside.

games.name: Eyes Wide Open
games.summary: Work for a dystopian Inspection Bureau, Determine whether the subjects are humans or not, Uncover secrets, Endure psychological horrors and reach your work quota - or else.

games.name: Space Savory
games.summary: Not that far away, in a galaxy… A diner with questionable hygiene, bubbling with dark secrets and darker humor, in the middle of cosmic nothingness. Welcome to Space Savory. Don’t be fooled by appearances, the best flavor in the universe is cooked right here. (Only within the observable part.)

games.name: Night Train Simulator: Blackout
games.summary: Drive the train. Follow the schedule. Ignore what's outside.

games.name: Ecstatica II
games.summary: Ecstatica II is a dark fantasy action-adventure built from a one-of-a-kind ellipsoid world. Return as a prince to a kingdom sacked by demons under a blood-red sky. Cast spells and trade blows to restore the shattered Elder Sign and free the sorceress Ecstatica.

games.name: Ecstatica
games.summary: Ecstatica is a pioneering survival-horror adventure set in the demon-cursed medieval village of Tirich. Explore a world rendered entirely from ellipsoids, sneak past or fight off nightmarish creatures, solve puzzles, and lift the curse.

games.name: Junkpot
games.summary: A roguelike about bidding blind on sealed storage crates. Read the odds, buy the crate, then stack charms that multiply what falls out. Type combos, rarity bonuses and odds boosts compound into one engine. Build it fast — the quota doubles every round.

games.name: Hunter's Moon
games.summary: Hunter’s Moon is a first-person historical narrative folk-horror set over the course of one fateful night. Meet mummers dressed in folk costumes, evade capture by the witch hunters, and eavesdrop on a characterful cast of regular folk worn down by war and misfortune. Discover the secrets of this dysfunctional village on the brink as you embody an accused “witch” on the run for her life.

games.name: Scopa Sweep
games.summary: Traditional Italian Scopa card game turned roguelike. Play against your rival and capture all the cards on the table while trying to score as many points as possible. Sweep the board with a SCOPA to increase your multiplier and complete objectives for permanent bonuses.

games.name: Vampolitics: Vassals of the Void
games.summary: You have inherited a graveyard, Sovereign. Yet through logistics, diplomacy, and the art of war, the space-vampire age can rise again under your banner.

games.name: Virtue and a Sledgehammer
games.summary: Go back to your hometown and tear it down with a sledgehammer in this narrative exploration game. Confront your past in a devastating story about feeling like you no longer belong in the place you grew up.

games.name: Remothered: Red Nun's Legacy
games.summary: Your daughter has been kidnapped. In the trilogy’s final chapter, enter a nightmare to save her, survive what hunts you, and uncover the Red Nun’s truth through retrocognition, mirror abilities and moth manipulation. A modern return to classic survival horror with an Italian neo-giallo twist.

games.name: Archivist: Tidy Up & Sort
games.summary:
Cozy Archivist Simulator is a first-person organizing simulation game set in an archive. The player works with piles of document folders, reads filing instructions, and places files on shelves according to archive rules.

The gameplay focuses on sorting and arranging documents by parameters such as category, subcategory, date, number, and other filing criteria. Tasks include processing incoming boxes, finding requested files, checking records, cleaning up workspaces, correcting misplaced documents, and restoring order to archive rooms.

The game features Sandbox Mode with selectable levels and archive tasks, and Campaign Mode structured around a series of working days with different assignments.

games.name: Coal Duty
games.summary: Coal Duty is a 1-5 player co-op extraction horror-comedy. Meet the state coal quota in procedurally generated mines, coordinating over proximity voice chat while something in the dark listens in. Spend your tickets, plan your escape. Some miners get out. The state does not confirm this.

games.name: Pidgeon Pocket
games.summary: Pidgeon Pocket is a chill incremental game about a rooftop pigeon-keeper who sends a flock of trained pigeons into a living city park to pickpocket small valuables from park-goers and bring the loot home. Each round the park transforms into a different live event, from a marathon or a street parade to a market, a concert or a dog show, while an intelligent police force reacts to every theft. Progression runs through a skill tree of abilities and rotating talents, growing the flock from a single pigeon into a full squad. Localized into 30 languages, fully playable with mouse, keyboard or controller, and built to run on Steam Deck.

games.name: Magical Girl ER
games.summary: A medical simulation where you examine and treat magical girls injured in kaiju disasters. With limited hospital beds and stamina, decide who to accept, who to refuse, and which treatment to choose.

games.name: Farming Simulator 25: Beans & Alpacas Expansion
games.summary: Build your coffee estate and grow a warmer kind of farm life in Catuaí, a South America-inspired region shaped by coffee terraces, red soil and lush hills. Grow coffee beans, raise alpacas and Brahman cows, start new production chains and operate 25+ new machines!

games.name: Cosplaying in Costalia: The Tororo Sisters!
games.summary: When Souta’s cosplay-filled camera gets broken, the Yamakake sisters volunteer to be cosplay models for him. After gratefully accepting and whipping up a flurry of cosplay outfits for the girls, they head to Costalia, a cosplayer’s paradise. But will their photo shoots go off without a hitch?

games.name: Rolling Stock
games.summary: Kolejové vozidlo je dopravní prostředek způsobilý k jízdě po koleji. Kolej vozidlo nese a vede. Hlavními konstrukčními celky kolejového vozidla jsou: skříň kolejového vozidla včetně tažného a tlačného ústrojí pojezd kolejového vozidla včetně brzdy, případně pohonu Kolej je tvořena kolejnicovým pásem, nebo častěji dvojicí kolejnicových pásů. Kolejnicové pásy jsou vázány pomocí upevňovadel k podpěrám: pražcům, betonovým blokům, prahům, roštům a dalším.

games.name: You Are Empty: Absolute Edition
games.summary: Just in time for the 20th anniversary, You Are Empty has been revitalized for modern systems, with fixes, new features, and QoL additions, including all the official localizations. Our team carefully went through the entire game whilst faithfully preserving the intent of the original release.

games.name: Shift Chess
games.summary: This is a chess variant in which players can “control the board” as a move action. The game supports online play, matches against AI, and local analysis. It also features a usable notation system and several customizable board rules.

games.name: Grimmlins Tale
games.summary: Grimmlins Tale is an action adventure monster tamer where you catch, train, and bond with all fairy tale inspired monsters. Fight alongside your monster friends in deep, real-time strategic combat, and hop on their backs to explore in the whimsical world of Never Everland.

games.name: Usual June
games.summary: Fight monsters, talk to ghosts, and get to the bottom of a mystery threatening to obliterate an entire city in Usual June, a third-person action-adventure game about combat, cupcakes, and community.

games.name: InOut
games.summary: INOUT is a cooperative horror game for 1-4 players. For years, the locals have been afraid of an old mansion in Madyland. A possessed maniac and an ancient evil have settled here. Become a member of a team of exorcists and expel the evil force!

games.name: A Dogs Dream
games.summary: Test your sixth sense. Will you eat a wild rabbit, or tie someone to the train tracks? Every choice is yours to make. May you find a reason to laugh inside your nightmares.

games.name: Hoosegow: Prison Survival
games.summary: Hoosegow — a dark comedy about life behind bars. A random convict, a random charge, a random sentence. One goal: survive at any cost. Every decision opens new paths — or leads to death.

games.name: Anomalith
games.summary: “ANOMALITH” is a survival third-person shooter set in Japan, steeped in the atmosphere of liminal spaces and Showa-era retro aesthetics. To search for her missing friend, a girl steps into a world writhing with anomalies.

games.name: Anomalith: Anomaly Zone Countermeasures DLC Set
Girl & Scarecrow
games.summary: Something rotten roams the night. Venture deep into the woods behind your grandfather's house and track down an aviary lost to time in this fantasy visual novel game set in rural New Zealand.

games.name: Foursavent
games.summary: From cyberpunk futures to medieval ages, from modern-day suburbs to the 1950s, each map delivers its own story, time period, and different gameplay mechanics. No two worlds play the same every map is a different universe, a different time, a different reality.

games.name: Copy Cats
games.summary: Copy Cats, a short-story collection by David Crouse, was awarded the Flannery O'Connor Award for Short Fiction in 2005. Copy Cats was subsequently nominated for the Pen-Faulkner Award in 2006. Copy Cats consists of seven short stories and one extended novella, and takes as its themes issues of identity and alienation. The story "Kopy Kats" is about a world of false images and doubles, as its protagonist—a man who works in a hectic copy shop—seeks authenticity in his life and finds only more and more imitations.

games.name: Backrooms: Splatter
games.summary: The Backrooms got colorful. Suit up, grab your paint, and splatter your way out of the liminal void with up to 4 friends.

games.name: Probably Stolen
games.summary: Probably Stolen is a cyberpunk shopkeeping simulator set in a dystopian space station. Craft, trade, and smuggle goods of questionable origin, navigate faction loyalties, and stop rampant AI by killing those it controls. Earn enough to buy out your shop before rising rent forces your hand.

games.name: The Wake Event
games.summary: The Wake Event is a first-person science-fiction psychological horror and puzzle adventure set aboard the abandoned ARGUS research station. Awakening alone with no memory of what happened, the player must restore station systems, solve interconnected technical puzzles, and uncover the truth behind ARGUS, the station's autonomous intelligence, and their own presence aboard the facility.

games.name: Ironwake
games.summary: A linear single-session psychological horror. Your mind is uploaded into an old Soviet robot sealed inside a dead bunker. Stealth in the dark, puzzles inside dying machines, and one voice on the radio guiding you. Find the clues and change how it ends.

games.name: Phantom Blade 0
games.summary:
Framed for the death of his master and left with a ruined heart, Soul has sixty-six days to live. Alone and hunted by his former comrades, he moves through a world of shifting loyalties and silent blades — determined to unravel the conspiracy that has condemned him.

Rain mixes with blood, mercy entangles with vengeance. Soul's journey is one of love, hate, and the fragile search for what it means to have a heart.

games.name: Terrible Lizards
games.summary: Terrible Lizards is a horror parkour game set against the backdrop of an old Route 66 attraction… with something dark and sinister lurking below. To escape, you’ll need to move fast, navigate challenging terrain, and uncover what Dalton’s Dinos is really hiding. You’d better start running.

games.name: Danchi Days
games.summary: A slice-of-life adventure with a comedic-yet-bittersweet story set in a 2000s Japanese neighborhood! Play as 12-year-old Hoshino, revive a summer festival, reconnect with neighbors, and uncover truths about her grandma living with dementia.

games.name: Hunting Simulator 3
games.summary: This open-world game lets you experience the thrill of the hunt, with your faithful dog by your side! Choose your equipment from official brands, and explore the wilderness in search of your next game.

games.name: Tama In-Between
games.summary: An action-puzzle game where the slime cat "Tama" explores a mysterious, slightly melancholic pixel-art world. Use three unique actions—Absorb to grow, Split to divide, and Swap to switch bodies—to solve puzzles and follow Tama’s hazy, uncertain journey.

games.name: Prophet Margin
games.summary: Turn humble villages into a thriving network of trade and prosperity. Inspired by Euro board games, Prophet Margin is a cozy city-builder, a thinky strategy puzzler where every road, resource, and connection creates new opportunities. Can you maximize the profits and please the gods?

games.name: Ghost Master: Resurrection - Relics of the Past
Cairn: On the Trail
games.summary: New climbing locations, fresh problems, same freedom to climb!

games.name: Planted!
games.summary: Sow. Grow. Throw. Planted! is a chaotic 1-4 player combat game where gardens are arenas, plants are weapons, and grudges are settled one harvest at a time.

games.name: The Wolf Among Us Remastered
games.summary: A dark detective thriller where folklore is real, violence is chilling, and every choice has consequences.

games.name: Hello Kitty: Party Land
games.summary: Featuring a massive roster of more than 145 beloved Sanrio characters, the game invites players into a colorful world of mini-games and adventures.

games.name: Nexus of the Dead God: The Microcosm
games.summary: You will lead a squad—formed solely for the sake of survival—as you continuously push forward across a vast hexagonal map. Recruit companions, adjust your formation, devise tactics, and carve your way out of the Bone-strewn Continent through a series of automatically unfolding battles.

games.name: Black Lily's Tale
games.summary: A Switch port of Black Lily's Tale that includes all previously released additional scenarios, as well as the additional scenario “The Day We First Crossed the Boundary,” which follows Hana Sasamori and Itsuki Omiya after the main story.

games.name: Hot Wheels Infinite Rush: Boost'n'Slide Pack
Hot Wheels Infinite Rush: Power & Pace Pack
Hot Wheels Infinite Rush: Feel the Heat Pack
Hot Wheels Infinite Rush: Bone Shaker Skeletor Edition
Veyrasol
games.summary: Veyrasol is a real-time MMO strategy game set in the Veyra Spiral galaxy. Build colonies, command fleets, forge alliances, and battle for dominance across ~120-day seasons in this free-to-play browser-born strategy experience.

games.name: Bobo and the Chest of Nightmares
games.summary: Jump, glide, and outsmart traps in this spooky 3D platformer! Smash obstacles, solve puzzles, and fend off evil spirits to defeat The Dream Master. Collect hidden treasures and restore joy to a world shrouded in darkness!

games.name: Gray Planet
games.summary: Explore a open world set in a post-apocalyptic background, gather resources to craft various equipment and build your base. Defeat different types of monsters while investigating what happened on this planet.

games.name: Brain Hack Squad
games.summary: Build and lead your own cybernetic hit squad as you battle rival groups. Use real time tactical combat with pause to direct your cybernetic agents in combat. Upgrade your team, brainwash enemy agents, and deploy informants to gain control of the city.

games.name: NodalBastion
games.summary: Defend the last AI core in an abstract minimalist game of incremental progression, powerful skills, and evolving networks.

games.name: Fortune x World: Bokura ga Game wo Tsukuru Riyuu
games.summary: Glovety's 3rd project, about game development.
aliases: FORTUNE×WORLD～僕らがゲームを作る理由～
FORTUNE×WORLD ~Bokura ga Game wo Tsukuru Riyuu~

games.name: Aposis: Infinity Hero
games.summary: Aposis is a minimalist retro JRPG/Roguelike about fighting enemy androids while uncovering the truth about what happened to the world 3,000 years ago.

games.name: Ray's Hotel Adventures
games.summary: Use your handy Ghost Catcher to capture ghosts, solve puzzles, and stop the horny ghost girls that have been causing some trouble

games.name: Stray Sheep and Corpse Love
games.summary: The second and last game in the MOONSTONE's Stray Sheep series.
aliases: Stray Sheep to Shinin no Koi

games.name: The Cat in the Hat: Rainy Day Mayhem
games.summary: The Cat in the Hat once said, “It’s fun to have fun.” Play with him and your favorite characters in 18 exciting minigames or chase him around the house. Whether you play solo or with friends, your house is about to be full of giggles, groans, and glorious mayhem.

games.name: Custom Romance City 3D3
games.summary: Custom Romance City 3D3 is set to be a new entry in the studio’s “Custom” lineage of games, continuing from the Custom Maid 3D2 and Custom Order Maid 3D2 series. Just like in the previous entries, the player will be able to fully customize their dream girlfriend, but this time, they have the whole open world of Romance City to take her on dates and explore their relationship. Of course, the players will first have to skillfully romance the girl, but once they do, the “paradise city created to liberate people from common sense and reason” will be all theirs.

games.name: NVA: No Visitors Allowed
games.summary: A minimalist psychological horror game inspired by The Exit 8, where players must escape a looping post-Soviet-era abandoned hospital corridor by detecting anomalies.

games.name: 10 Hours Before Sunrise
games.summary: A brutal 8-bit-style boomer shooter inspired by the best of ‘80s trash horror. You are Samuel Alvarez, a broken man who discovers a cabin worse than any nightmare. Survive the night and face the forces of Wendakor — or you won’t see the dawn.

games.name: Through the Manor
games.summary: A cozy building sandbox where you craft painterly structures and step inside them in 3rd person. Build whimsical manors, explore every room you design, and reside within your creations in this atmospheric, stress-free experience.

games.name: Project Reprieve
games.summary: A fast-paced FNaF-inspired roguelike first person sit 'n' survive, beat the demons and sins back and repent for you and your friends sins!

games.name: D.C.5 to 4: Luminous Memories
games.summary: A fandisk for Da Capo 4 and Da Capo 5.

games.name: King in the Mountain
games.summary: A calm strategic incremental mining game where you rebuild your Mountain Hall between expeditions. Plan each descent, choose where your dwarves dig, gather gold and rare artifacts, and return home when the torch burns out. Upgrade your crew, dig deeper, and bring your fallen kingdom back to life

games.name: Mad Ever After
games.summary: Happily ever after? Team up in this chaotic 1-4 player co-op roguelike FPS. Journey through twisted fairytale realms, wield shapeshifting magical staffs, combine powerful spells and upgrades, and battle bizarre enemies and corrupted fairytale bosses. Rewrite the story, one chaotic run at a time.

games.name: Shared RC
games.summary: Two players. One RC car. One controls the left wheels, the other the right. Try to reach the top together.

games.name: Put Your Toys Away Together!
games.summary: A cozy co-op game about turning the toy store of your dreams into a perfectly organized world. Sort all 20,000 toys, find the right home for every doll, dinosaur and train, and watch the shelves spring back to life – on your own or with up to 4 friends.

games.name: Sudokiller
games.summary: Sudokiller is a cozy mystery puzzle game inspired by sudoku-style logic. Players use clues to place suspects on a grid, reconstruct the crime scene, and deduce who the killer is.

games.name: Cardsharp
games.summary: Blackjack in a dark room. Solo or with friends. Win the hand and you get paid; lose it and the dealer takes a finger. Rob the other players, burn the card they were saving, push cursed items on them.

games.name: Send Them to Hell
games.summary: Demons want Earth. Bad idea. Smash them back to Hell in a chaotic pixel-meets-3D roguelike of absurd, game-breaking builds. With heroes like a holy Knight, a Corn-Launching Robot, or a Wizard Girlie and her ferocious cat. Play solo or 4-player online co-op. Commence the slaughter. Send Them To Hell.

games.name: Pinballoid Crush
games.summary: In Pinballoid Crush, classic pinball evolves into an arcade experience with adventure and strategy elements.

games.name: A Tiny Ghost Game
games.summary: A tiny ghost game is a platformer that you can finish in an evening or two. Glide and dash your way out of the underground, mess with your enemies and help the ghost see the moon.

games.name: Super Froppings
games.summary: Super Froppings is a jumping frog survival party game for up to 8 players. You are a frog. One button, one move: the humble jump. Pour your heart, soul, and desperate prayers into it, and leap your way up from the depths of the earth.

games.name: Triple Pairing Mini Fandisc
games.summary: After stories for Nono, Eimi and Nazca.

games.name: Freshly Folded: Laundry Shop
games.summary: Run your own dry cleaning shop in a charming, cozy small town. Wash, dry, and press clothes to perfection, serve quirky customers, invest in new machines and upgrades for faster service, and stay organized to carefully complete each order. Mend rips, remove stains, and more.

games.name: God Is Not Here
games.summary: FREE THRILLING FIRST-PERSON HORROR! You will find yourself in a house haunted by ghosts, and there is no help from above. Fear, darkness, and real danger await you, hidden within the walls of the mansion. If you dare to enter, prayers will no longer save you.

games.name: Cutout Village
games.summary: Cutout Village is a narrative, cozy, city-builder game in which you will have to build villages using simple and unique mechanics: cutting, folding and gluing. Restore the family home, revive your village and create spaces filled with fruit trees and histories to live!

games.name: Athanasia
games.summary: Athanasia is an action survival horror immersive sim where you explore a mysterious facility and use everything you have to survive with an arsenal of equipment as well as your wits against time traveling predators from prehistory and the future.

games.name: Monsters & Memories
games.summary: Monsters and Memories is an independently created, niche Fantasy MMORPG that harkens back to the classic MMO era of the late '90s and early '00s.

games.name: Blue Ridge Hunting
games.summary: Blue Ridge Hunting is a co-op horror game set in the Appalachian Mountains. Solo or with friends, investigate, document, and hunt cryptids based on real sightings, legends, and eerie phenomena from the region. Are you brave enough to uncover the truth?

games.name: Emberville
games.summary: Awaken with no memories inside the Vitromotus, a vast underground world created as a magical dungeon where death no longer lasts. Explore its depths, battle dangerous creatures, rescue survivors, and rebuild the ruined town of Emberville while uncovering the truth behind this prison.

games.name: Mimic
games.summary: A multiplayer survival horror game where players must choose their allies carefully to survive imminent danger. In this social-deduction game players won't know who to trust with their lives.

games.name: Milo
games.summary: Fight alone or beside others trapped in the same nightmare. Survive waves of deranged cultists and grow your mischief of rats. The longer you stay, the more you can save, and the more you risk losing before reaching Traang, Milo’s Arcade.

games.name: Pedal Rebel VR
games.summary: Pedal Rebel VR is a adrenaline-pumping cyberpunk motorbike street racing game that completely transforms any exercise bike and any VR headset into an immersive racing experience!

games.name: Fuel Station Simulator
games.summary: Are you ready for the most comprehensive fuel station simulation ever? Manage your fuel station, your shop, the car wash, the workshop, your employees and much more…

games.name: Beat, Heart, Beat
games.summary: Beat, Heart, Beat is a psychedelic action-platformer where every attack is set to a grungy midwest emo soundtrack. Soar across the crumbling Psyche, recruit bizarre party members, and tear a path towards your withering Heart.

games.name: Thyranya
games.summary:
Thyranya is a free-to-play old-style MMORPG with a vast open world to be explored, dangerous creatures, rewarding quests and a lot of social content!

Dive into a world that pays homage to the classics like Diablo, Tibia, and League of Legends, yet stands out with its unique vibe. Thyranya is more than just a game; it's a blend of nostalgia and innovation, crafted from our passion for those unforgettable late-night gaming marathons. Here, you'll find everything from pixel art magic and epic boss battles to smooth animations, crisp graphics, and a fluid combat system designed for today's gamers. Join us on this journey and experience the essence of gaming, right from our hearts to your screen. Subscribe for a front-row seat to all things Thyranya—where every play feels like coming home, yet embarking on an adventure anew.

games.name: Car Park Capital
games.summary: The car industry needs you to design and build the greatest car parks that simple town life hasn't seen before. Introduce the need for car commuting and turn neighborhoods into car parks! Use propaganda to convince people to pay you for it. Fight people that see through your oily business.

games.name: Invokyr
games.summary: A co-op survival horror game about a cursed board game. Play with up to 5 friends. Roll the dice, survive the horrors that are summoned, and beat the Gamemaster to win your freedom.

games.name: Pionero Capital
games.summary: Pionero Capital is a sandbox business simulator where you build your company from zero to millionaire. Drive around an open world, manage employees, expand into different businesses, and become the richest in the city.

games.name: Sound System
games.summary: Soundsystém (také jako soundsystem), známý také jako Tribes kmen/y je uskupení lidí, společně vlastnící techniku a další instrumenty, potřebné k pořádání Freetekno parties, jako je například známý teknival CzechTek. Technikou se rozumí zejména: Nákladní automobil, autobus, nebo dodávka pro převoz materiálu a zásob. Naftový agregát potřebný k výrobě elektřiny, jelikož drtivá většina parties se koná mimo dosah jakékoliv infrastruktury. Výkonné reproduktory, jejich celkový příkon často přesahuje 10 kW.

games.name: The Second Reality Room: Unspoken Truths
games.summary: You can’t understand them—yet. Decode the “Second Reality” through talk, mind read, and translate in an empathy-driven psychological mystery adventure.
aliases: さとり中二病相談室 -第二現実の翻訳者-
中二病咨询室：第二现实译者
中二病諮詢室：第二現實翻譯者

games.name: No Service
games.summary: Uncover, experience, and survive service. Tasked with exploring and reporting any wrongdoing, you are the last train inspector on shift. descend into madness as this surreal comedy sonders your psyche.

games.name: Dawn of Irkalla
games.summary: Dawn of Irkalla is a 4 player co-op horror stealth dungeon-crawler where you have no weapons and no way to fight back. Build your deck, unlock skills, scavenge vital items, and race against the clock to retrieve artifacts for a shadowy government agency. Your survival depends on it.

games.name: The Last Flight
games.summary: Rebuild a forgotten airplane, manage your survival, and soar across a hauntingly beautiful world. Balance your stats, scavenge for parts, and chart your course through a post-apocalyptic sky. Every flight is a step closer to freedom... If your past doesn’t catch up first. Prepare for takeoff!

games.name: Phosphor
games.summary:
Phosphor is a fast-paced sci-fi platformer roguelike where you descend into procedurally generated cyberpunk biomes, battling waves of drones, mechs, and biotech horrors.
Master dynamic combat blending gunfire, melee, dashes, and cyber spells. Stack elemental effects like Burn, Freeze, Shock, and Poison to unleash powerful reactions, then take on massive, pattern-heavy bosses.
Forge devastating builds from hundreds of weapons, passives, and abilities that synergize across runs. Unlock upgrades with persistence cores, tackle daily/weekly challenges, and push deeper with every attempt.
A high-mobility, challenging 2D action game inspired by the intensity of Dead Cells and the emergent chaos of Noita. Currently in active development and beta testing ahead of Steam launch.
Get to the core. The Phosphor still lives.

games.name: Hauntworks
games.summary: Hauntworks is a dark comedy haunted house management sim where you build an automated scare factory. Your undertakers harvest human reactions like screams, vomit, and laughter as physical resources, which you pipe through production chains to appease otherworldly patrons and escape limbo. Releasing in Early Access Halloween 2026.

games.name: No Witnesses
games.summary: No Witnesses is a 2-16 player party game. Play online or with your friends. Somebody in this lobby is a Killer. Nobody saw it happen. Killers hide in the crowd, Bystanders scramble to survive and a Detective works the forensics - while buffs and debuffs drag every round into chaos. Trust no one.

games.name: Prison Legacy
games.summary: What are you in for? Prison Legacy is a social MMORPG set inside a mixed-gender maximum-security prison. Choose one of 12 criminal classes, then fight turn-based battles, craft contraband, trade, steal, chat, and build a clan strong enough to outlast the hilarious darkness rising behind bars.

games.name: Eternal Blade
games.summary: An open-world action RPG set in the Baransu Realm. Play as Emerald, the last of the Murakai Bloodline and daughter of Sensei Lux, fighting to gather the Almighty Gemstones, wield the Eternal Blade, and free her father from an eternal curse before chaos and darkness are unleashed on the realm.

games.name: Knell
games.summary: Knell is a surname, and may refer to: Eric Knell (1903–1987), English Anglican Bishop Gary Knell (born 1954), American broadcast executive Phil Knell (1865–1944), American baseball player Wiebke Knell (born 1981), German politician William Knell (actor) (d 1587), Elizabethan English actor William Adolphus Knell (1801–1875), British maritime painter William Calcott Knell (1830–1880), British landscape painter A knell is also the sound of a bell when being rung for a funeral: Death knell

games.name: The Archivist
games.summary: A psychological horror experience set in the Backrooms. Explore a failed government facility, hack corrupted systems, and descend into a story where memory and reality collapse.

games.name: Space Snatcher
games.summary: 6-player co-op horror chaos where you're trapped aboard increasingly dangerous space stations. Scan every monster the Company demands, scavenge for powerful items to help you survive, and keep the ship's systems repaired. But the biggest threat might just be your friends.

games.name: Escape from Playtime
games.summary: An online 1-4 player co-op horror experience where you and your friends are trapped in an abandoned toy factory. A mysterious voice commands you for an unknown purpose as you explore shifting halls, scavenge for tools, and fight for survival against creatures that lurk in the dark.

games.name: Harvest Exit Plan
games.summary:
Harvest Exit Plan is a first-person collect-a-thon set in an orchard the player has inherited from their grandparents. Fruit is picked up by hand at first, later with a grabber and a fruit vacuum; each tool can be upgraded for reach, speed, yield per grab and basket capacity, paid for from the proceeds of what was sold before.

Six gardens open one after another, each with its own fruit type and an automated harvester that keeps collecting while the player is elsewhere. Collecting without pause builds a streak that raises the pace in stages and culminates in a Frenzy state. Clearing a quarter of a garden keeps it clear and pays a bonus for the rest of the run. Rare fruit variants, per-garden mastery goals and a records screen track how thoroughly a run was played. Emptying the orchard ends the first season rather than the game. Each following season runs faster than the last and opens card slots; cards dealt between seasons modify the next run, for example larger baskets, longer reach, more productive harvesters or cheaper upgrades.

games.name: Fire Up Together
games.summary: Fire Up Together is a physics-based co-op platforming adventure for up to four players. Use pressurized water to launch yourself into the air, extinguish fires, overcome chaotic obstacles, and climb as high as possible with your friends.

games.name: Biodome Bastion
games.summary: Crash-land on a hostile alien world in this classic tower defense game and defend your outpost against relentless waves of evolving insectoid creatures. Build powerful defenses, unlock new technologies, and uncover the mystery behind a species capable of adapting to any environment.

games.name: We Are Cooking
games.summary: Grab your apron and enjoy chaotic cooking action with your friends or solo! Prepare dishes before time runs out and prove yourself a worthy chef.

games.name: Steins;Gate: Octet of Shifting Space
games.summary: A non-canon extension of the True End of the original game. Unlike the modern visual novel format of the original game, this retro game perfectly mimics the style of graphical text adventure games from the 8-bit PC era (e.g. PC-88), with the player typing short commands to interact with and explore the game world. It features all backgrounds and characters drawn in a low-color pixelated style with emulated scanlines, chiptune music played through an emulated FM chip, and no voice acting. Although non-canon, the game contains many easter eggs and references that connect Chaos;Head and Steins;Gate together.

games.name: Yomawari: Night Alone
games.summary: Yomawari is a Japanese horror action game and features a female protagonist that is searching for her older sister and pet dog, while exploring a creepy town at night. She only has a flashlight at her disposal, and using said flash light will let her “see things that shouldn’t be seen.”

games.name: Yomawari: Midnight Shadows
games.summary: The dark is no place to be alone. After a beautiful show of summer fireworks, two young girls begin to make their way home. However, a mysterious attacker separates them, and both must brave the haunting night filled with unspeakable terrors and survive the darkness.

games.name: Earth Defense Force 5: Mission Pack 1 - Extra Challenge
games.summary:
This is the road to hell.
The extraterrestrial life forms the Primers slam this challenge down to any elite EDF soldier: A mission pack of over 10 incredibly difficult missions. Enemies that only appeared in the hardest missions of the main campaign now appear in droves. Aliens with gear they didn't have in the main campaign will assail you. Are you brave enough to take the first step on the road to hell?

Over 30 new weapons!

games.name: Yomawari: The Long Night Collection
games.summary: Traverse the haunting world of Yomawari: Night Alone as a young girl searches for her sister, or share in the terror facing schoolgirls Yui and Haru in Yomawari: Midnight Shadows. Uncover the mysteries plaguing a rural Japanese town, hide from the things lurking in the night, and maybe get home alive...

games.name: Destruction AllStars
games.summary:
Stars and cars collide.

Dominate the glittering global phenomenon of Destruction AllStars – the spectacular prime-time sport for dangerous drivers!
Master the art of intense vehicle-based combat through timing, tactics and skills to cause colossal amounts of damage, destruction and devastation in vibrant arenas across the globe.

Pile-on the destruction from behind the wheel or leap into the arena with a breathtaking reel of parkour action by dodging attacks, taking over vehicles or using abilities to disrupt the onslaught of incoming vehicles.

Cause enough mayhem to power up your AllStars game-changing hero vehicle fueled with special abilities.

A roster of 16 blockbuster Destruction AllStars are revved up and ready to compete in the name of entertainment and demolition. So, strap in for intense, explosive and unpredictable levels of free-flowing action and fight to be crowned the Global Destruction Federation Champion.

It’s time to run, ram and slam. See you in the arena.

games.name: Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy
aliases: Marvel's Guardians of the Galaxy: Encore Edition
games.summary: Fire up a wild ride across the cosmos with a fresh take on Marvel’s Guardians of the Galaxy. In this action-adventure game, you are Star-Lord leading the unpredictable Guardians from one explosion of chaos to the next. You got this. Probably.

games.name: Yomawari: Lost in the Dark
games.summary: Another chapter of the atmospheric horror series has emerged from the shadows! Eerie sound design and shadowy environments set the stage for gruesome and terrifying ghosts never seen before in the series.

games.name: Witch on the Holy Night
games.summary: Set in 1980s Japan, Witch on the Holy Night tells the story of fan-favorite Type-Moon character Aoko Aozaki as she attempts to navigate the complex world of magecraft while also dealing with the everyday struggles of life as a high school student! Players will experience the thrilling origin story of this much-beloved character, penned by Kinoko Nasu, famed creator of the Fate series, himself.

games.name: Metaphor: ReFantazio
aliases: Project Re Fantasy: A Fool's Journey Begins
メタファー：リファンタジオ
games.summary:
From the creative minds of the Persona series – Metaphor: ReFantazio marks ATLUS’ first ever, full-scale fantasy RPG, brought to you by director Katsura Hashino, character designer Shigenori Soejima, and composer Shoji Meguro.

Write your destiny and rise above fear as you step into a fantasy world unlike anything you’ve seen before. Fraught with unsettling mystery, the kingdom stands on a precipice. Now, you must embark on a journey, overcoming obstacles and forging bonds with friends.

games.name: Worship
games.summary: Blindly serve a dreadful god and lead its cult in a fresh take on the roguelike genre inspired by Pikmin. Put on the robe of a cultist and ready your ceremonial dagger to serve the old god of your choosing in the grim universe of Worship.

games.name: Ages of Cataria
games.summary: Set in a new fantastical world, Ages of Cataria is a cozy-friendly town sim. Watch as your village evolves from humble beginnings, with just one family, to a community of multiple families living together across generations of time.

games.name: Kingdom of Night
games.summary:
Kingdom of Night is an 80s-inspired isometric action RPG where coming-of-age drama meets cosmic horror.

When a satanic cult unleashes the ancient evil Baphomet on the small town of Miami, Arizona, high school student John must fight through a night of demonic chaos to rescue his friends before the town is lost forever.

Choose from five distinct classes—Barbarian, Knight, Rogue, Necromancer, or Sorcerer—and customize your build with expansive skill trees, powerful loot, and unique equipment. Explore the town freely, battle terrifying Demon Generals in any order, uncover the stories of Miami's residents, and descend into massive demon lairs.

Face the apocalypse alone or team up with a friend in local co-op to save Miami before the night ends.

games.name: Sintropia Fruits Together
games.summary: In Sintropia: Fruits Together, cooperation is the main ingredient! Control fruits with unique abilities and solve puzzles full of creativity and charm.

games.name: Ranger’s Path: National Park Simulator
games.summary: Begin your park ranger journey in Ranger’s Path: National Park Simulator. Maintain trails, assist visitors, check permits and respond to emergencies. Explore diverse biomes and observe varied animal behaviors across a wide range of species.

games.name: Ballzy: PvP Block Puzzle
games.summary: Build the longest route, solve handcrafted and community puzzles, then outthink rivals in hidden-block PvP. Ballzy is a premium pixel-art strategy puzzler with Classic, Story, Puzzle, and asynchronous Battle modes.

games.name: Zero Parades: For Dead Spies
games.summary: From the creators of Disco Elysium comes ZERO PARADES – an espionage RPG. You're a brilliant but tormented operant on one final desperate assignment. Gather your broken network, untangle a web of lies, and prove yourself on the world stage - or blow it all up again.

games.name: Gas N Cars
games.summary: Run a chaotic gas station sandbox: fuel cars, clean and repair vehicles, buy wild tools, catch wanted drivers, earn reviews, unlock upgrades, climb the leaderboard, or turn every stop into total mayhem.

games.name: Vem, Exu
games.summary:
Vem, Exu is a narrative adventure game about anger, memory and reconciliation. After losing his kite during a fight with his brother, Exu falls asleep carrying his rage and enters a storm where dreams, memories and imagination merge together.

Players progress through the story by interacting with symbolic environments and completing simple activities such as connecting stars, bursting bubbles and rebuilding objects. Inspired by Brazilian culture, cordel art and Afro-Brazilian symbolism, the game focuses on visual storytelling and emotional progression.

games.name: The Count is Down for Blood
games.summary: A puzzle game where you control a vampire trying to get to its crypt by dawn, but on the way through he will need to suck up enough blood from the townsfolk.

games.name: Manala: Equinox War
games.summary:
Manala: Equinox War is a LARP world where you build your combat deck and fight other players. Pick up your foam sword, put on your wizard hat and let's go kill the bad guys.

Depending on your point of view, that's either the person in the orc mask or the dwarf with a glued-on beard. The player characters are modeled on real LARPers' costumes.

If you're losing badly, you can always cheat. Just ignore the rules for a bit and be prepared to live with the shame.

games.name: Young Suns
games.summary: Young Suns is a narrative life sim set after a successful revolution on Jupiter. Explore fantastical planetoids, derelict ruins, and converted stations with a crew of up to three friends or on your own. Help the friendly citizens of Jupiter rebuild!

games.name: Moonlight Knight
games.summary: Moonlight Knight is an action-slasher with RPG elements. Use sword, bow, magic and hook to fight your enemies. Loot gold, upgrade character stats, find unique items and unlock ultimate abilities to make it to the very end!

games.name: Light of Atlantis
games.summary: Explore the depths of the ocean in this 2D-Puzzle-Metroidvania! Control the water levels and switch between various robots to solve the ancient puzzles of Atlantis.

games.name: Pozionista
games.summary: Creates potions with plants gathered in the woods, discover new ways to make potions and sell those potions to stores

games.name: M.E.M.O
games.summary: Observe. Think. Decode.A first-person adventure game focused on code-breaking and puzzle-solving. Lost in a maze of memories, can you find the path to save the future?

games.name: Hillthorn
games.summary: A disappearance in a secluded mountain. A village hiding its secrets. A detective running out of time. Hillthorn's investigation system encourages you to use logic and imagination. Combine actions, clues and characters to uncover the mystery.

games.name: Trifolium: The Adventures of Gary Pretzelneck
games.summary: Discover hidden truths about the world in this 3D adventure about a giraffe with an unreasonably long neck. Figure out the rules, solve strange mysteries, and stumble upon unexpected twists. Choose your own path.

games.name: Kick
games.summary: Kick It is a Jump'n Run with a soccer ball. Navigate your ball with skill and finesse through a happy adventure.

games.name: The False Alice: Retold Tale
games.summary: A visual novel based on the Itsuwari no Alice gacha game. It will features a new scenario and new CGs, backgrounds, BGM, character facial expressions and pose differences.

games.name: Magic Kingdom
games.summary: Magic Kingdom je jedním ze čtyř tematických parků tvořících Walt Disney World Resort v oblasti Lake Buena Vista nedaleko Orlanda na Floridě v USA. Park byl poprvé otevřen 1. října 1971. Struktura parku i atrakce jsou podobné, jako v Disneylandu v Kalifornii. V roce 2006 navštívilo park zhruba 16 640 000 návštěvníků.
developers: Shanghai Lingwen Huanyu Game Co., Ltd.
publishers: Shanghai Lingwen Huanyu Game Co., Ltd.

games.name: Of the Devil: Episode 3
games.summary: Morgan finds herself centerstage as the State conducts a witch trial to exorcise itself of one of its most outspoken critics, but she refuses to play the fool in the oncoming torrent of political theater.

games.name: Everfront
games.summary: A roguelike territory-control strategy game where you continuously expand against AI opponents. Master six doctrines, unlock upgrades, and dominate procedurally generated maps.

games.name: Infinity Ship
games.summary: Combine cards, pilot unique ships, and survive cosmic chaos. A frantic space roguelite where every fusion makes you an unstoppable force. Defeat colossal bosses and prove your worth as the Guardian of the Universe.

games.name: Jigenro
games.summary:
"JIGENRO" is a 3D color-matching puzzle game.

Click to grab and move panels on the field.

If you can connect all panels of the same color, you clear the stage.
Some stages feature fields with side walls or fields with elevation changes.

games.name: Come To My Party!
games.summary: Jimin dreams of finally having her first birthday party, but what begins as a childhood wish unravels into social pressure, fragile friendships, family expectations, and consequences that hit closer than you’d like. Join Jimin in this coming-of-age story where every choice carries weight.
aliases: わたしのパーティにきて!

games.name: Wanderdawn
games.summary: Explore various worlds in a hack-and-slash action game - In a world ravaged by an unknown disaster, face various monsters with the diverse weapons you find.

games.name: Locked in Love: The Office
games.summary: An interactive escape room game where your choices determine your fate. Right before a "long holiday," you find yourself trapped in the office with beautiful women for unknown reasons. Collect clues, cooperate with them, and escape this place!

games.name: Jawed
games.summary: Jawed is a psychological horror game where you play as Adam, a man muzzled by a life of silent torture since the disappearance of his fiancée. Presented with evidence that she may be alive, Adam must confront their strained relationship and face the only thing that can truly set him free: the truth.

games.name: Green Inferno
games.summary: A new kind of horror deduction game that allows you to investigate freely. Examine detailed scenes, collect evidence in the form of clips, and use them to reconstruct events. Connect the clues, build your own theory, and unmask the macabre truth behind a doomed expedition.

games.name: Slotbound
games.summary: A roguelike auto-battler defense where luck meets strategy. Spin a 3x3 slot machine to summon units and grow your army by absorbing others. Use Items and Cores to manipulate the odds and survive challenging judgement waves and boss waves. Every spin and every choice counts.

games.name: Love D3ath Love
games.summary: In 2222, your AI secretly sends over 3,000 job applications worldwide without you knowing. Soon after, three powerful women appear, each insisting you belong with her. You’re thrown into a growing crisis, their ambitions colliding endlessly. What do they actually want from you?

games.name: Tiny Survivors
games.summary: Tiny Survivors is a chill top-down autobattler with lots of enemies and randomly generated synergies.

games.name: Cleanup On Aisle 3
games.summary: You are the only competent employee (or bring a friend). Keep a failing grocery store alive while corporate makes everything worse: hurl crates, chain combos, wrangle cart trains. PlateUp-style escalation, six failing stores, couch co-op and Remote Play Together.

games.name: Die First
games.summary: Die First is a casual, physics-based party game where the first player dead wins! Run, jump, dash, and use items or map hazards to destroy yourself while saving your opponents.

games.name: It's About Pirates
games.summary: Command your ship in an action-packed pirate roguelike. Combine deadly weapons, powerful items, and a fearless captain to create unique builds and survive the dangers of the high seas!

games.name: Groundwork
games.summary: You're a robot sent ahead to ready an uncharted planet for the humans on their way. Chart the world, salvage old landings, build machines and power, and wake the derelict robots scattered in the wilds — each one becomes a neighbor with a voice and a job. No combat, no game over. Just groundwork.

games.name: Plum
games.summary: Plum is a short (about 1h) contemplative 3D collectathon, where you play as a plum, rolling and bouncing your way through a colorful world, searching for your way home. Your journey will take you through lands, caves, snowy mountains and more. Each area with ghost plums to meet, each with a story to tell.

games.name: Meltdown
games.summary: Meltdown is an isometric action-adventure game for the Amstrad CPC published by Alligata in 1986. There are two versions: a 64k version with basic speech synthesis and a 128k version featuring much more speech synthesis. A version was also released in French called Le Syndrome.

games.name: Desiderium
games.summary: A brief essay on desires and the consequences of having them. Feed an insaciable sovereign, explore surreal environments, and seek the hiddens ambitions within those who surround you.

games.name: Drawmi: Card Shop
games.summary: Drawmi: Card Shop is an immersive simulator where you and your friends can draw all the cards you sell and run a thriving card shop together.

games.name: Face the Puzzle: Masked Journey
games.summary: A difficult and cozy sokoban-like puzzle game. Pick up and drop different masks to change the way you interact with the world. Push objects, move machinery as one, reveal hidden paths, uncover secrets, and activate switches. Press every button, solve every puzzle, and light the candle.

games.name: Find All 10: Greece
games.summary: Immerse yourself in an exciting adventure in Find All 10: Greece. You will explore an ancient Greek city, the colorful streets of a historic town and the unique scenery of a modern Greek city. Look for hidden objects and color this mysterious painted world.

games.name: Disney Dreamlight Valley: The Keepsake Sea
games.summary: Become a magical mermaid and plunge into the waters of the Keepsake Sea! Uncover what secrets lie beneath the waves and embark on a thrilling new ocean adventure.

games.name: Spell Unbound
games.summary: One spell. It is a circle. Spell Unbound is a pixel-art roguelite where you bind beasts by looping them with the mouse - no sword, no staff, nothing else in your hand. Draw tight. Something is always crossing your line.

games.name: FFFF: Fatal Five Finger Fillet
games.summary:
Bet your fingers. A physically immersive horror roguelite.
Place your real fingers on the keyboard. Stab the knife between them.
Use rings and stab items to rack up a high score.
Can you keep your cool as the spinning blade closes in?

games.name: Jester Under Pressure
games.summary: Diskarte is a Filipino-inspired visual novel where you play as a nonbinary jester trying to entertain a queen who explodes heads. With 33,000+ words, 60+ Filipino terms, and four branching routes (including romance), it blends humor, danger, and vibrant storytelling. Can you survive her wrath?

games.name: Tarot Tokens
games.summary: The Fools Journey

games.name: DinoBox
games.summary: Drop dinosaurs,merge matching species, and evolve them into something bigger! DinoBox is a physics-based puzzle game where every 20 turns, a meteor strikes the box—destroying one dinosaur and potentially changing everything. Build bigger dinos, fill your encyclopedia, and see how far you can evolve!

games.name: Resettle
games.summary: Resettle is a deep incremental city builder where you develop settlements on islands. Strategically place buildings to maximize resource production, explore 10 different upgrade systems, and create a thriving island city.

games.name: Feed The Frog King: Incremental TD
games.summary: A short incremental tower defense game with a massive skill tree! Recruit a team of cute and deadly animal friends, shop for powerful hats, construct buildings, assign workers, and unlock powerful upgrades to Feed The Frog King!

games.name: Tales of Tonbrook
games.summary: Tales of Tonbrook is a life-sim/RPG hybrid. When you receive an invitation to the prestigious Daverton Adventurer's Academy, you take it! Study, perform missions for the school to pay your way, explore the world, make friends, fish, farm, find hidden ruins, and much more!

games.name: Survive the Apocalypse
games.summary: Turn-based roguelite in a post-apocalyptic world where you will have to make meaningful decisions (sounds familiar, capitalist world maybe). Make your way out of this ruined city, with eleven quarters (levels) and countless zones. Eat well, sleep well, decide well.

games.name: Caaahr!
games.summary: Your voice is the engine. Literally. One player screams to make the car go faster, the other somehow tries to steer it through chaos. A coop friendship test about communication, panic and losing your voice at 2 AM.

games.name: Bolariki
games.summary: The match-3 roguelike. Stack relics, shatter rules, and pull off outrageous combos, all inside a puzzle game that boots like a fever dream from 1995. Crunchy, retro, and dangerously easy to start. Impossible to stop.

games.name: The Ice Is Watching
games.summary: One last GPS pin. One final hope. Following a GPS pin to the cabin, she thought she was coming for a rescue. She didn't know she was stepping into a frozen trap. Stranded and hunted by 'The Ice', you must keep the fire alive to survive the night. Uncover the chilling truth before you become his art

games.name: Bonki D Bonk
games.summary: Survive relentless enemy waves in a fast top-down survival game where your weapons attack for you. Move, dodge, and stack 30+ weapons with 100+ items into screen-filling chaos.

games.name: Southern Lights: Broken Frequency
games.summary: Lead a stranded Antarctic research station where every decision matters. Manage your crew and its scarce resources while an unseen cosmic threat slowly tightens its grip.

games.name: Sunset Artisan Chocolate
games.summary: Run a cozy seaside chocolate boutique! Weigh, melt, and craft handmade treats for your colorful customers, experiment with new recipes, meet locals, grow your chocolate brand, and settle into life in Sunset Town.

games.name: Snot Pop!
games.summary: Trap, pop, and splat your way through slime-choked sewers in this '90s-style vertical pixel platformer! Armed only with snot bubbles, outmanoeuvre vile Mouldlings, Mushrooms, Bog Belchers, Glumbats, and Brutes across fifty+ levels. Chain clears, beat the clock, and rescue the Goblin Princess!

games.name: SpaceShooter
games.summary: Blast through endless waves of deadly meteors in a fast-paced 2D arcade space shooter! Fight through 20 challenging stages, battle powerful bosses, customize your ship, discover unique meteor types, unlock weapons and upgrades, and survive the Endless Mode.

games.name: Mafia Hotel
games.summary: Mafia Hotel is a multiplayer social deduction game for up to 16 players. Talk, lie, accuse, and vote by day, then return to your hotel room at night—where the Mafia may come knocking. Survive the night and uncover who you can trust.

games.name: Blobby and the Milkshake
games.summary: An octopus stole your milkshake. Why? Who knows! Ride robot crabs, fly fire hydrants, sled in bathtubs, and fight power-hungry pirate clams in this goofy, open-ended 2D platformer. Explore dozens of levels, branch your path, and do whatever it takes to get your drink back.

games.name: Angel Guardian
games.summary: Angel Guardian is a sci-fi side-scrolling action shooter set in a space station under attack. Play as Kita, a warrior guardian on a mission to rescue the young prince while fighting hostile enemies. Use shooting, stealth and hacking to face powerful bosses and prove yourself as a true guardian.

games.name: Radiant Starlets
games.summary: Radiant Starlets is a HD2D action platformer in the vein of classic action platformers but you can date all the bosses. Select your boss order and make your way through 8 challenging stages. Try every order and uncover the mysteries of this world.

games.name: Iron Colony
games.summary: After crash-landing on a mysterious island, confront hostile robotic creatures in intense combat and strategic duels. Explore forgotten ruins, uncover secrets, and fight for survival in a world where corrupted technology dominates every corner.

games.name: Wilderdark
games.summary: Something dangerous is lurking in the wilderness. Wilderdark is a first-person survival horror game where you must navigate a strange island inhabited by ectoparasitic dinosaurs and organisms. You must remain vigilant to stealthily obtain evidence, samples, and craft tools to survive.

games.name: Godzilla: Destroy All Monsters Melee Remastered
games.summary: The ultimate Godzilla arena brawler is back, completely remastered. Choose your monster and battle it out with a range of brutal attacks through recreated cities and other locations. Face off against your friends and foes in local co-op or new online multiplayer.

games.name: Sortilège
games.summary: A dice duel with someone on the other side of the table. Roll, hold what you like, and commit. Both players reach into the same pool of powers each turn, so every one you take is one your opponent can't have. Climb a ladder of ten rivals in a solo run, winning their dice as you go, or duel a friend online.

games.name: Let’s Sing 2027
games.summary: Sing your heart out with your friends on your favorite songs in our 1 to 4 players karaoke game.

games.name: Let's Sing Presents: Abba
games.summary: Let's Sing Presents: Abba je videohra pro Nintendo Switch, Xbox One, Xbox Series X|S, PlayStation 4. Termín vydání: 3. 11. 2026.

games.name: TCG Card Chaos
games.summary: TCG Card Chaos is a first-person casual simulation game in which players explore a chaotic card shop and sort more than 5,000 collectible cards. Players inspect card types, rarities, numbers and symbols, open card packs, discover graded cards, and return every card to its correct place.

games.name: Pocket Adventurer
games.summary: Your desktop's tiniest hero. A cozy idle RPG that lives above your taskbar: heroes delve dungeons and haul loot home while you work, companions fill your camp, and every retired legend makes the next hero stronger.

games.name: Light Source
games.summary: Follow Bulb and bring back the light to the dim kingdom of Lumeria, in this dark 2D turn-based RPG. Help the locals and battle your way through increasingly harder odds while uncovering the secrets hidden within the decaying kingdom.

games.name: PeeVPee
games.summary: A chaotic multiplayer party game where you drink, fill your bladder, and compete with your friends to pee on as much as possible. Drink up, aim well, and claim the most territory to win!

games.name: Cat Secretary
games.summary: Welcome to DOX HQ! Manage your lobby, catfish your boss and climb that corporate ladder. But when the sun goes down, the real work begins, because there’s only one thing standing between humanity and total AI automation: one very determined cat! Who's a good Cat Secretary? You are!

games.name: Hull Rupture
games.summary: If the ship stops, humanity ends. Manage a spaceship, treat puny humans as resources, and repel relentless alien assaults in a base-management tower-defense roguelite where every choice seemed reasonable at the time.

games.name: Slots & Skulls
games.summary: A turn-based roguelite built on a slot machine. Spin to attack, open chests for new symbols, strike deals with cats, and risk your symbols at the anvil.

games.name: On The Hook
games.summary: You owe the casino boss a debt you can never repay—one that snowballs with compounding interest, growing heavier by the night. Several young female agents, themselves ensnared in the trap, are ready to take your orders. Make it out of the casino before the debt buries you alive.

games.name: Node Crown
games.summary: Node Crown is a roguelite focused on building a node-based kingdom. Quick runs designed for replayability, deep synergies, hundreds of nodes, and builds that make every run unique - you will find it here!

games.name: Emery Hearts
games.summary: Step into the shoes of Lug, an ordinary boy with the power to shape the fate of humans and machines in a world on the brink. A retro-inspired action JRPG where you explore a vibrant voxel world, battle deadly mechanoids, solve puzzles, and uncover a story of legacy, mystery, and heart.

games.name: Edge of Memories
games.summary: The population of Avaris is ravaged by the Corrosion, a terrible affliction that mutates all it infects into grotesque abominations. Play as Eline, a young nomad, and lead fierce battles alongside your allies to save the world from extinction.

games.name: Glory On Pluto
games.summary: Build the perfect, chaotic rocket engine in this numbers-go-up space roguelite. Load your ship with wacky fuel items, chase the right synergies and pray that it’s enough to get you to Pluto. Push it as far as you can before it all falls apart. Chaotic. Glorious. Human.

games.name: Psycho-Sleuth
games.summary: Psycho-Sleuth is a mystery game where cognitive disorders distort the rules of murder. 13 players, each with a strange condition — like “no lying,” “no left side,” or “no faces” — are trapped in a deadly game. These disorders are contagious, and the killer hides behind abnormal logic.

games.name: Wielders of the Essence
games.summary: Single-player horde survival with a touch of incremental base building. Eight-minute runs. Eight hours to complete.

games.name: Celeste Blue Wizard Luna
aliases: 蒼藍魔導士露娜　～天才魔導士與傳奇魔導士～
苍蓝魔导士露娜　～天才魔导士与传奇魔导士～
games.summary: Help Luna form a resistance to take down Princess Lucia the Black Witch and free the skyborne land of Jupiterno from her tyranny!

games.name: Build a Bot
games.summary: A top-down shooter rogue-like that sees its player take control of a mechanized weapons platform designed for one thing and one thing only: “Take down the corporation, by any means necessary. . .”

games.name: Crymelight
games.summary: CRYMELIGHT is a roguelike action game set in the world of the afterlife, where girls confront their sins as they fight to gain their freedom.

games.name: Bros of Bench
games.summary: Bros of Bench is a chaotic co-op platformer where two players form a dumbbell connected by an adjustable bar. Alternate between lifting each other and flying with jetpacks while mastering coordination, physics, and timing.

games.name: Dominus Gladiatus
games.summary: Dominus Gladiatus is a brutal gladiator management simulator where you recruit, train and equip gladiators and make life or death decisions throughout a deadly 160-day tournament against rival Domini.

games.name: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
aliases: Zelda no Densetsu Toki no Ocarina
games.summary: The evil Ganondorf is scheming to steal the mythical Triforce from the Sacred Realm and take over the world. Now Link must become the hero of time and save the kingdom in this classic tale, built from the ground up for the Nintendo Switch 2 system.
series: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time

games.name: K-Pop Rising: Dream to Shine
games.summary: Make your dream come true and become a K-Pop Star in this exciting life sim and rhythm game! Dance and sing your way through the competition and rise to glory. Customise your character to your image, it is your time to shine!

games.name: Feed Me More Brains
games.summary: A silly first-person incremental game about feeding an ancient god with brains. Grab, throw and automate their delivery as you unlock mutations, summon loyal cultists, and transform your temple into the ultimate brain-feeding machine.

games.name: Manic Miner
games.summary: Manic Miner je plošinová počítačová hra vytvořená Matthew Smithem v roce 1983 původně pro ZX Spectrum. Úkolem hráče je vyvést horníka Willyho z 20 jeskyní obsazených příšerami. Postava může pouze chodit do stran a skákat. Hra se původně měla jmenovat Miner 49'er a původní myšlenka hry nepocházela přímo Matthewa Smithe, ale od jeho partnera ve společnosti Software Projects Alana Matona.

games.name: Where the Seeds Fall
games.summary: Blight has infected the land, forcing humanity to live upon the branches of the World Tree. After a chance encounter with a strange child, your world begins to fall apart. Navigate ruins, read the wind, and take a leap of faith into this thrilling action-adventure game.

games.name: Swarm Harvest
games.summary:
Congratulations, you're hired!
Blast bugs, deploy defensive towers, and command a pack of powerful attack drones to carve through endless alien swarms. Evolve into an unstoppable bug-blasting machine with absurdly overpowered builds to generate massive profits and make the corporation proud.

games.name: Dialshift
games.summary: Dialshift is a single-player score-attack arcade game played on a circular dial. Players control a continuously moving cursor with two directional inputs and time hit attempts against targets while maintaining combos and Stability. Seven modes vary the rules with directional targets, forced reversals, sustained holds, and multi-hit targets. Each mode has its own scores, ranks, and leaderboard.

games.name: Apotheosis Engine
games.summary: An accident causes a lost space probe to become self aware. Apotheosis Engine is a lore-rich incremental game. Grow from a piece of engineering into a galactic superdeity by navigating an alien OS.

games.name: Lost Media Agency
games.summary: A found footage horror game where you need to piece together a timeline in chronological order of a Kaiju incident that occurred.

games.name: Brothel Virgin: The Crimson Reverie
games.summary: Your first night in a brothel. Nervous? Excited? You’ve got one night to pick your companion — or unlock a hidden VIP experience. Animated scenes, wild choices, and more secrets than you can handle.

games.name: Hasbro Games Junior Collection
games.summary: Get ready for a big, colorful game night full of laughs, surprises, and “just one more turn!” moments! This collection brings 3 classic junior board games; Monopoly, The Game of Life, and Clue to life in one exciting video game made for kids and families.

games.name: Pith
games.summary: Traverse a wonderful and strange world, find playful tools, and uncover secrets in PITH, a metroidbrainia/puzzle-platforming adventure full of twists and surprises.

games.name: Boneyard Bounce!
games.summary: All four edges of the board are your paddle — a block breaker unfolded in four directions. Fire a spell-ball into a monster-packed graveyard maze and watch it carom through the horde. Elemental kills chain-detonate straight through walls. Smash the headstones too; the landlord pays for wreckage.

games.name: American Gold Rush
games.summary: Dahlonega, Georgia. 1829. You've got a shovel, a day's food, and a hole in the ground that gets richer the deeper you're willing to go. Every step and every swing costs energy and daylight, so the real game is deciding when to push one more swing of the axe, and when to climb out.

games.name: High Voltage
games.summary: High Voltage is a first-person incremental game about building your power grid. Start with a pedal-powered generator, expand with wind and solar power and keep the city supplied with electricity. Upgrade, complete contracts and see how far you can grow your network.

games.name: Funeral for the Sun
games.summary: Search the ashes of an abandoned Latin American town and uncover 400 years of secrets. An epic non-linear mystery where you travel back in time and untangle the history of a community cursed by generations of supernatural forces.

games.name: Tome of Talis: A Dice Conquest Game
games.summary: Command your dice to glorious victory in this strategic rogue-lite dicebuilder. Cast devastating spells, recruit powerful dice, and prove yourself worthy to challenge the great Commander Talis.

games.name: Ho Ho Ho Sokoban
