games.summary: A cozy Christmas-themed Sokoban puzzle game where Santa must push presents into the right places. Solve 50 handcrafted pixel art levels full of festive charm.

games.name: Borbs
games.summary: Reunite chonky borbs with their flock in this relaxing puzzle game, brought to life by hand-drawn artwork from a longtime bird keeper.

games.name: Mini Mart Survivors
games.summary: SHIFT24 is a mysterious convenience store chain. As night deepens, strange customers swarm endlessly. Ramen, snacks, and coffee become weapons. Fight them off, and clues hidden in branches worldwide begin to emerge. Follow the clues and pay down your debt to uncover the truth behind SHIFT24.

games.name: The Big Suck
games.summary: An incremental game where you ARE the tornado. Destroy fields, cars and buildings, gather wreck to grow, and spend the payday on upgrades in a huge skill tree. Past a certain size the storm stops being weather and picks its catastrophe — fire, flood, winter, or the void — while the county answers with fire crews, bomb squads, tanks and jets.

games.name: Just A Dice Game
games.summary: A relaxing dice rolling roguelike about chasing score targets and trying to break the game. Build up your collection of dice while buying upgrades, relics and other powerups to build wild synergies and laugh in the face of RNG.

games.name: Hope in the City
games.summary: 17-year-old Hope Song returns home from school to find her parents missing. Use Hope’s observant eye as an artist to investigate, piece together clues, and uncover a dark world beneath the surface of her peaceful life in this non-linear narrative mystery game.

games.name: Elixir of Moonglow
games.summary: Ella & Umbra — Ella wakes in a strange world with no memory, just a wolf by her side. Uncover and explore a cozy story-rich adventure as an apprentice alchemist through hand-drawn biomes. Gather ingredients, solve thoughtful puzzles as Ella accepts a world of chaos, wonder, and forgotten alchemy.

games.name: Fragments
games.summary: Your mind is shattered. Step into a first-person psychological horror where you must relive your deepest trauma, uncover fragments of your past, piece them back together and face the tormentors that haunt your mind.

games.name: Patience Balls
games.summary: Patience Balls is a minimalist physics-based puzzle game focused on tilt mechanics and precision. Players navigate one or more balls through intricate labyrinths and mazes to reach designated goal spots. The gameplay emphasizes steady control and logic across multiple themed worlds. It includes global leaderboards and unlockable achievements within a performance-optimized, clean visual style designed for short, meditative sessions.

games.name: Torawase: The Girl in the Mirror
aliases: TORAWASE ～被囚禁的偽妃夢寐以求的幸福～
TORAWASE ～被囚禁的伪妃梦寐以求的幸福～
TO･RA･WA･SE ～囚われの偽妃が夢みる初夜～
games.summary: After his fiancée returns to Japan for work in this visual novel by Dark One!, our protagonist begins dreaming of being a woman in the Middle Ages. The more he has these dreams, the more he becomes a woman in real life. Can he reverse his transformation, or will his life take a different turn?

games.name: Never Sort By Color
games.summary: Somewhere under that mountain of bricks is your floor. Sort the impossible Pile with a magnet glove, sieves, and part-seeking vision. Fill labeled drawers, pull parts, watch MOC builds snap together brick by brick. Cozy, satisfying, and governed by one rule: never sort by color.

games.name: Carve The Cave Together
games.summary: Dig a cave with a friend, one cell at a time. Throw balls into solid rock in zero gravity and they never stop, so the more cave you open the further everything flies. Mine ore, feed the machine, unlock a roster of balls that each dig differently.

games.name: Piggy Monte
games.summary: Three little banks, one golden coin, and a heavy steel hammer. Track the coin through the shuffle, pick right, and crack the bank open. Climb fourteen rooms from a kitchen table to the last table, where nine banks move at once. Play money only.

games.name: Dustbloom
games.summary: Team up with friends in this 1-4 player co-op survival game. Build a massive mobile base, automate your production, and terraform a dead red desert into a lush green world. Craft weapons to survive nightly skeleton attacks and uncover the dark mystery of the lost 14th team.

games.name: Drawmi: Creature Collector
games.summary: A creature collector auto-battler where you can draw all the creatures you collect while battling your way to a Scribble Fighting art degree.

games.name: Clogwork
games.summary: CLOGWORK is a factory-automation game where you turn random pieces into final shapes. Build conveyor belts, glue, cut and rotate parts, wire logic signals, and send the finished shape to the hub to fulfil ever-changing orders.

games.name: It Thinks!
games.summary: Design the chip that powers AI. Start with a single logic gate and build a computer: wire circuits, cast designs into reusable chips, program tiny kernels, and scale your architecture into a working GPU.

games.name: Mythfall
games.summary: Mythfall is a fast-paced bullet hell MMO where skill and strategy determine survival. Battle relentless monsters, loot powerful gear, and grow stronger as you fight to defend your homeland from the mighty wizard Alivarg.

games.name: There's Always a Madman: V.I.C.T.O.R.
games.summary: Secret agent Franklin Benjamin will stop at nothing to save the world. In this single-player interactive spy novel, you play as his greatest adversaries - can the criminal enterprise known as V.I.C.T.O.R. defeat the only man standing between them and world domination? To the VICTOR go the spoils!

games.name: Monomoon
games.summary: In MONOMOON, the way forward is reserved for the knowing and the daring. Guided by moonlight, you’ll uncover hidden truths and wander through a tiny and mysterious open world.

games.name: Wetter
games.summary: Step into the paws of Luna and explore a rain-soaked archipelago. Uncover pieces of your forgotten past and decide which memories will shape who you become.

games.name: Prinny Party: Going Overboard!
games.summary: Get your friends together for Prinny Party: Going Overboard! In this party game, you’ll traverse the board as you take down demons, earn experience, and buy new equipment—all to make sure you’re strong enough to defeat the Supreme Overboard!

games.name: Hill-Z
games.summary: Zombie wave survival meets King of the hill. Survive, Upgrade, and Protect your flag. Face the unexpected through special rounds, endure the constantly growing horde, and customize your loadout. How many rounds will you survive?

games.name: Headshot Holdout
games.summary: Headshot Holdout is a retro styled co-op shooter where squads of 1-4 players slaughter their way across a hand-authored, zombie infested stronghold on a quest to rescue DEATH itself.

games.name: Corridors
games.summary: A shooter / gem collection game that lives in your files. Corridors combines high-score action with a fully functional, intuitive file and media explorer. Play in our preset world for competition, or turn your PC and its files into the setting. Lightweight, portable, runs native on most systems.

games.name: Shadow of the Road
games.summary: Shadow of the Road is a story-driven, turn-based RPG where feudal Japan meets magic and machine. Assemble your team from a diverse set of characters and test your skills against yōkai and steampunk contraptions. Carve your own path through an immersive story and change the fate of the Empire.

games.name: Phantom Gear
games.summary: Gear up in your battle armor and take on the sinister Ocular Force! Become Josephine and put a stop to the power-mad cult and the mysterious phantom force behind their spree of carnage!

games.name: Lost Zion
games.summary: Lost Zion is an atmospheric cyberpunk horror game. Awakened by a faint signal as a service bot, explore the forsaken megacity of Lost Zion. Uncover the Emperor's horrific secrets. Obey your sole command: Activate the Gravity Core.

games.name: Sonic Pico Park
games.summary: The co-op action puzzle game series PICO PARK is back... and this time, we're teaming up with SEGA's legendary Sonic the Hedgehog! This collaboration is packed with co-op gameplay that combines the flair of Sonic with the puzzle teamwork fun of PICO PARK! Play locally or online with 2 to 8 players!

games.name: Barbie Rewind
games.summary: Decorate the DreamHouse through the decades, while playing classic Barbie games. In Barbie Rewind, Barbie invites you into her cozy, creative world and entrusts you to customize her DreamHouse. Barbie also left you her game collection, so you can revisit your favorite Barbie video games.

games.name: The Totemist
games.summary: Run an occult shop in a quietly strange town, crafting totems and talismans inspired by real witchcraft. Help townspeople with their burdens at your own pace while uncovering an ancient darkness beneath the town, one only you can stop.

games.name: Echo 9
games.summary: Echo 9 is a tense first-person horror. You are Yon, a maintenance android. Navigate a failing shuttle through deep space, stabilize the dying reactor, and bring Eva to the evacuation point. Radiation is rising, the evacuation point far. Eva is in stasis. You are all she has.

games.name: ChromaFlow
games.summary: Build a color-powered factory. Extract red, green, and blue, transport them across networks of conveyor belts, and blend them to create an expanding spectrum. Fulfill the demands of the Chroma Core, unlock technology, and optimize every production line.

games.name: Hordia
games.summary: Cut down endless hordes of monsters and become absurdly powerful! Loot, upgrade, and stack augments into wild builds. Hold the island with cannons and traps, hunt down the bosses waiting out on the map, and survive as long as you can. Solo or online co-op!

games.name: Find Kittens 12: Pirates
games.summary: Yo-ho-ho and a bottle of rum! Are you ready to travel on an exciting journey with pirates? What are you waiting for? Explore and find cute cats to fill the black-and-white world with bright colors.

games.name: Pikmin 4: Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Dandori Academy
games.summary: Give Oatchi commands using your voice and put your Dandori skills to the test in Pikmin 4 – Nintendo Switch 2 Edition + Dandori Academy.

games.name: Pro Basketball Manager 2027
games.summary: Take charge of a basketball club and oversee every aspect of its development. Build your roster, discover emerging talent, develop future stars, and implement the tactical vision that will define your team's identity.

games.name: Desktop Plinko
games.summary: An idle incremental plinko game that sits in the corner of your screen while you do other things.

games.name: Metaphor: ReFantazio: Etrian Odyssey Class Costumes (7) & Battle BGM Set
Metaphor: ReFantazio: Persona 2 Seven Sisters High School Uniform (7), Battle BGM & Battle Jingle Set
Metaphor: ReFantazio: Persona 3 Gekkoukan High School Uniform (7), Battle BGM & Battle Jingle Set
Metaphor: ReFantazio: Persona 4 Golden Yasogami High School Uniform (7), Battle BGM & Battle Jingle Set
Metaphor: ReFantazio: Persona 5 Shujin Academy School Uniform (7), Battle BGM & Battle Jingle Set
Metaphor: ReFantazio: Persona St. Hermelin High School Uniform (7), Battle BGM & Battle Jingle Set
Metaphor: ReFantazio: Shin Megami Tensei IV Samurai Garb (7), Battle BGM & Battle Jingle Set
Metaphor: ReFantazio: Shin Megami Tensei V Jouin High School Uniform (7), Battle BGM & Battle Jingle Set
Princessfall
games.summary: Betrayed, broke, and packing twin magic hand cannons, ex-noble Alice is fighting to survive with her one-armed butler in a ruthless world where the strong rule the weak. A dark fantasy JRPG with full voice acting, nostalgic doujin-style visuals, and 20+ hours of story-driven adventure.

games.name: Ball x Pit: Risen Ballbylon
games.summary: Risen Ballbylon is a transformative expansion for BALL x PIT, adding new levels, characters, balls, passives, enemies, bosses, and buildings, to the smash hit ball-bouncing roguelite. Will you rise to the challenge?

games.name: Bonebuilder
games.summary: In this action roguelike you will fight imposing enemies in heavy, deliberate third-person 3D action combat. Collect bones and weapons from defeated enemies to build the most powerful skeleton possible through BONEBUILDER's unique crafting and talent systems!

games.name: Netherwake
games.summary: Experience a nerve-racking adventure as a thick, dark fog begins to roll into the small town from the surrounding forests, and with it come ancient, cosmic beings from outside our reality. Try to survive and pray that you will one day see the sunlight again.

games.name: Powerfuel
games.summary: Powerfuel is an action FPS set in a gritty dieselpunk world. Play as the legendary ex-criminal known as the Cricket, and harness the mystical properties of powerfuels. Fight your way through the gangs of New Lyon and shed light on the conspiracy plaguing the city.

games.name: Fancy Farm Brawl
games.summary: Closed Playtest Now Live! Mix relaxing farming & tower defense. Early testers average over 98 minutes per play session. Click Request Access on store page to apply for limited slots.

games.name: World 23
games.summary: Battle through decaying mega-cities, abandoned metro tunnels, and guarded enemy facilities in this fast-paced top-down hack and slash. As Theo and Leo, you master abilities and switch weapons during combat to match your play style and the challenge ahead.

games.name: Trees Hate You
games.summary: Hike through the worst forest full of the most horrible trees. Do not trust them. The trees will trick you. They will bully you. They will hurt you. If only you could find an axe...

games.name: Milki Delivery
games.summary: Grab your bike and milk bottles, let's hit the road! Explore the countryside in this short cozy delivery adventure. Befriend folks and gently help them rebuild their community, one bottle at a time. Upgrade your bike, your dairy farm, and venture deeper into a once-lively region.

games.name: Zero Sum
games.summary: A hand-drawn twin-stick roguelite where every bullet is an equation and every enemy is a number. Subtract, divide, root, modulo. 7 operators, 22 firing modes, 9 bosses, 80+ upgrades. Reduce them all to zero. No health bars, just raw arithmetic violence. You failed math class. Math didn't forget.

games.name: Unicorn Academy: Island of Magic
games.summary: You are invited to join Unicorn Academy! Create a magical connection with your own unicorn and forge friendship bonds with Sophia, Ava, Layla and the other heroes from the series. Wield unicorn magic and discover every corner of Unicorn Island.
aliases: L'École des licornes : L'Île de la Magie
Academia Unicornio: La Isla de la Magia
Academia Unicórnio: A Ilha da Magia
独角兽骑士队: 魔法之岛
獨角獸學院: 魔法之島

games.name: Steel Gullet
games.summary: Build a massive factory aboard a moving ark. Melt, separate, and refine chaotic scrap using realistic thermodynamics. Process materials by mass instead of items, craft based on material properties, and optimize complex production lines in strictly limited space.

games.name: AsterMaster
games.summary: A beat-driven roguelite shooter on a hex grid. Every step, shot and dodge lands on the rhythm as you dig into a dead mining asteroid — stack weapon mods, chase synergies, break bosses, and haul your ore back out alive. Full controller support, Steam Deck friendly.

games.name: Space Station Designer
games.summary: Design, expand, and manage a network of space stations across Earth orbit and beyond. In Space Station Designer, you’ll take the lead of a private aerospace company, managing astronauts and logistics, unlocking advanced technologies, and shaping the future of humanity in space.

games.name: Grand Theft Auto VI
games.summary: Grand Theft Auto VI je připravovaná videohra ve vývoji od společnosti Rockstar Games. Bude osmou hlavní hrou série Grand Theft Auto, navazující na Grand Theft Auto V (2013), a celkově šestnáctým dílem série.

games.name: Volvy’s Adventure: Reslimed
games.summary: Volvy's Adventure: Reslimed is a spectacular remaster of the original remake of the unreleased action-platformer starring the most famous video game mascot of all time.

games.name: Axyn Adventure
games.summary: Will Axyn discover the secrets of the ancient civilization and will he find the prince?

games.name: Iona's Island
games.summary: Restore a vibrant island paradise atop a giant sea turtle! As the Leshen Iona, wield ancient spells to heal the land and befriend islanders and help them with their quests. Create your own enchanting sandbox style sanctuary. Uncover secrets and reshape a world with accompanied by cozy, lofi vibes.

games.name: Dungeon of Departure
games.summary: an independently developed, pixel art, visual novel set in an original universe which follows the silent, player protagonist and three companion characters as they struggle to find a way out of an increasingly puzzling, underground world.

games.name: Lord of Undead
games.summary: Destroy the castle on the hill in this grim RPG where you play as the Dark Lord. Collect souls, summon an undead army, master dark abilities, craft powerful gear, build your base, and desecrate the lands of a vast open world.

games.name: The Legend of the 4 Elements
games.summary: The Legend of the 4 Elements is a platformer with elemental combat. Control heroes of Fire, Water, Earth, and Air, use unique abilities, overcome challenges, battle dangerous enemies, and restore balance to the world of the elements.

games.name: Flick
games.summary: Shift realities with the flick of a light switch and plunge into the grotesque to uncover your family's twisted past. A psychological horror game where you must balance the light you need to progress with the terrifying nightmares it summons.

games.name: Microscape
games.summary: Heavily inspired by Runescape, Microscape is a tiny community idle game for Twitch streams. Channel owners can add their community to the world. Players then earn playtime by being in these communities.

games.name: G.E.M. Grab & Exit
games.summary: Hand-Drawn Twin-Stick Shooter in space where one must survive the robotic ships onslaught and extract with the loot to exchange for ship upgrades.

games.name: CyberKitty: Neon Merge
games.summary: Suika games have evolved! CyberKitty: Neon Merge is a cozy, yet action-driven, dynamic 2D physics puzzle game for 90s retro, pixel art, and match-3 fans! Instead of watermelons, merge a cast of colourful cats. With the CatCade system, swiftly match kitties to boost your multiplier for mega scores!

games.name: Salt of the Earth
games.summary: An isometric medieval city builder. You hold one manor by charter: lay the roads, work the fields, and raise hovels into town houses by meeting what each household needs. Winters take stores, the Crown takes dues, and raiders take whatever will burn.

games.name: Hold the Dawn
games.summary: Build by day. Survive the horde by night. Hold the Dawn is a 3D wasteland tower defense with unique auto-fighting heroes, tactical towers, zombie waves, and co-op over Steam, LAN, or local play.

games.name: Football Survivors
games.summary: THE FOOTBALL WAR HAS STARTED! Thousands of raging fans are storming the field. Defend against the fan invasion! 50+ unique heroes and abilities, 50+ upgrade items, position your heroes strategically, crush the waves of fans!

games.name: Nightmare Conquest
games.summary: Nightmare Conquest is a game focused on strategy, planning, and build creation. Assemble your team of monsters, position them intelligently, and evolve their abilities to face increasingly difficult challenges. Every decision matters — from the upgrades you choose to how you combine your monsters on the battlefield.

games.name: Circuit Keep
games.summary: Circuit Keep is a grid‑based tower defense game where players build and upgrade circuit‑themed defenses to repel escalating waves of intrusions. The game features a campaign of handcrafted lattices, a research system, and multiple enemy types with unique behaviors. Players manage resources, optimize layouts, and adapt to changing threats across increasingly complex maps.

games.name: Expelled from Paradise: The Stellar Angel
games.summary: The first game in the Expelled from Paradise series: a brand-new sci-fi visual novel. Angela Balzac left the virtual world of DEVA behind and chose to live on the surface. Now, as she builds a life with her partner Dingo, a new case is brought to her door.

games.name: Turbo Turkey
games.summary: Thanksgiving is coming and you're on the menu. Run, jump, and shoot your way through 16 levels of Turkeyland in this collectathon platformer inspired by Banjo Kazooie, Donkey Kong Country and Crash Bandicoot. Collect pumpkins, race time trials, and prove you're no one's dinner.

games.name: Mix Dunk: King of Basketball
games.summary: A new project in collaboration between B.LEAGUE’s professional basketball club Kawasaki Brave Thunders, the idol group AKB48, and the otome game brand Otomate.

games.name: Koganei-sou to Konjiki no Agehachou
games.summary: Sprite's 15th anniversary game. A share house receives an odd purchase offer one day and, around the same time, a new girl with suspicious behavior moves in.

games.name: Ghost Master: Resurrection - Sands of the Damned
Marupoyo: The Round Chick's Adventure
games.summary: A tilt-based platformer game for everyone. Players control Marupoyo’s momentum as he rolls through 120 vibrant levels, avoiding obstacles, exploring, and rescuing his lost siblings.

games.name: Happy Weekend
games.summary: An all ages port of Happy Weekend

games.name: Am I Nima
games.summary: Am I Nima is a psychological-horror game where you must convince your mom that you really are her daughter. Combine words together in your brain and use them to talk. Get her to trust you.

games.name: Doinaka Girls Utopia
games.summary: Doinaka Girls Utopia je hra z kategorie Vizuální novela od studia DESSERT Soft pro PC (Microsoft Windows). Termín vydání: 27. 11. 2026.

games.name: One Night After
games.summary: One Night After je hra z kategorie Vizuální novela od studia Smee pro PC (Microsoft Windows). Termín vydání: 27. 11. 2026.

games.name: Paradise Beyond the Nightmare
games.summary: Paradise Beyond the Nightmare is a 2D exploration horror game where you explore and solve puzzles in a 2D space with depth. You can experience moving both sideways and forwards through eerie paintings.

games.name: Warhammer 40,000: Dawn of War IV
games.summary: Return to the RTS series’ roots with deeply satisfying strategy gameplay. Take command of four unique Warhammer 40,000 factions, including the Adeptus Mechanicus in their series debut! Fight through 70+ epic campaign missions, as well as the replayable Last Stand, Skirmish and multiplayer modes.

games.name: Psycasso
games.summary:
Take on the role of a serial killer who creates paintings with their victims blood! Sell your creations to earn money while trying to avoid capture by the police and other civilians.

In this pixel art adventure you'll play as Psycasso, a struggling gallery artist living in an open world city. By day you'll work a day job to earn money and level up skills, seamlessly blending into society. By night you'll be on the lookout to harvest 'red paint' from one of the 'walking meat-bags' to help you create original 2D art. Sell your artwork to art galleries for huge profits! Become rich from your unique artwork while avoiding capture from the ever growing police presence using stealth techniques and unique traps. Buy property, upgrades, furniture, weapons, discover a bustling city and play a host of mini games in this controversial indie title like nothing before.

games.name: Witch the Showdown
games.summary: Witch the Showdown is a high-difficulty parry-action game where every battle is a boss fight. Build mana through precise parries, then unleash attacks in real time using your cards—this unique combat system defines the experience.

games.name: Loftia
games.summary: Welcome to Loftia, a cozy, multiplayer world where you can build towards a brighter, more sustainable future! Connect with friends both old and new, to farm, craft, explore, decorate, and create a meaningful impact - together.

games.name: Luminleaf Chronicles
games.summary: "Luminleaf Chronicles" is the story of a group of cat girls who set out on an adventure to purify the world's water. In this game, you can choose different characters to go on your own adventures with others.

games.name: Phantom Vice Auto
games.summary: Experience entertainment blockbusters Phantom Vice Auto and Phantom Vice Auto Online — now upgraded for a new generation with stunning visuals, faster loading, 3D audio, and more, plus exclusive content for Phantom Vice Auto Online players.

games.name: Fool King
games.summary: Dethrone the Fool King in this tactical autobattler with asynchronous PvP! Amass your troops, apply powerful upgrades and set your battle formations. Watch your plans come together or fall apart in frantic simulated combat.

games.name: Agromatic
games.summary: Automated farming sim where specialized workers handle all tasks while you focus on strategic decisions. Design efficient layouts, manage supply chains across zones, and optimize your growing operation.

games.name: Project Atlas
games.summary: In a universe where everything is falling into chaos, one person and their new found companion are out to save the universe from total destruction. Experience heart pounding battle action, animal handling skills, survival skills, and even some fishing along the way. Includes solo story mode, multiplayer 6v6 team death match, and a battle royale. Set in the near future where humans battle resource deprivation, and climate change on worlds. Yet off world threats are the real danger! Battle through countless missions with your customizable K-9 companion. Can the universe be saved or was it doomed from the start?

games.name: Ship Miner
games.summary: Action mining game with retro aesthetics and roguelike elements. Collect minerals from procedurally generated asteroids, improve your ship and survive The Anomaly, an unknown entity threatening The Galaxy. Can a simple miner stop The Anomaly and save everyone?

games.name: Blood of Rations
games.summary: Blood of Rations is a WW2 extraction shooter set in 1944 occupied Europe. Deploy alone into solo PvPvE raids, scavenge what the dead left behind, and extract alive — or lose everything you carried in. No minimap, all-diegetic audio, a grid inventory where every slot is a decision, and an 8-second extraction window. Between raids you rebuild the underground bunker you call home.

games.name: Hantu and Hunted
games.summary: Morph into props to survive as a human or hunt as the legendary ghosts of Southeast Asian folklore. Asymmetric horror prop hunt with proximity voice chat. Hide, hunt and escape.

games.name: Ashes of Alice
games.summary: Do not stray off the path. Ashes of Alice is an atmospheric, PSX-style narrative survival game where the world has already ended. Follow a fading blood trail through a desolate, ash-choked landscape, piecing together the final moments of humanity before your vision goes dark for good.

games.name: Plucked
games.summary: Up to 12 players, one pond. A top-down bullet-heaven roguelite where you merge your guns into increasingly stupid firepower, then find out how much of it one duck can hold. Survive the waves, outlive the swarm, quack responsibly.

games.name: Tale of Specters: Joseon 1592
games.summary:
Tale of Specters: Joseon 1592 takes the 1592 war and bends it into alternate-history fantasy. You lead a ragtag company of exiles, defectors, and outlaws across battlefields where magic and steel share the same grid.

Terrain wins fights — along with skills, not just stat sheets
Every map is built on height. Take the high ground, force enemies onto bad footing, and play the four elements — earth, water, fire, wind — off each other. Read the turn order, land the right status effects, and you'll take fights you had no business winning.

games.name: Procession Engine
games.summary: A real-time tug-of-war roguelike deck builder. Your buildings spawn your army. Your cards, blueprints, and imbues decide what that army becomes. Place buildings in your yard, work the belt, and push two lanes until one stronghold falls.

games.name: Ski-E-O! Ski Resort Tycoon
games.summary: Build the cozy ski resort of your dreams in this management game where no two winters are the same. Paint trails onto real mountains, connect lifts, and place the lodges and après bars that keep thousands of skiers warm, fed, and happy.

games.name: Derby Dynasty: Horse Racing RPG
games.summary: Horse stable management and realistic race simulation in one. Draft, lane position and energy management run on real physics — and you ride the race yourself. Buy, train and breed horses to build a bloodline that lasts for generations.

games.name: Silent Authority: Blood & Bourbon
games.summary: Strategy meets action RPG in the 1920s New York underworld of crime. Collect protection money, trade, and expand your criminal empire while leading your crew in brutal tactical combat. Rule the city with cunning diplomacy or pure bloodshed.

games.name: Too Hot to Hold
games.summary: Grab the Ember and RUN! Too Hot to Hold is an up-to-10-player asymmetric party game of hot potato. Tiny Tricksters must pass the burning Ember every 10 seconds, while armed Wardens hunt them down and destroy it. Use abilities, set traps, and scream at your friends in chaotic proximity chat.

games.name: To Be Besieged
games.summary: Defend the war torn civilians with allies against the 1 hour siege until rescue helicopter arrives

games.name: ShootyCraft
games.summary: Massive online space battles with building and crafting. Up to 100 players in an arena. Solo and team game modes.

games.name: BeamNG.drive
games.summary: BeamNG.drive is a sandbox vehicle simulation game built around soft-body physics that simulate realistic vehicle handling, deformation, and damage in real time. The game originated as a spiritual successor to the open-source project Rigs of Rods and was initially released as a tech demo in 2013 before moving to Steam Early Access in 2015. Players can engage in campaigns, time trials, and free roam across various open-world maps, experimenting with vehicle collisions, environmental physics, and user-created mods. The game supports VR, features an integration with the car-building game Automation, and has native modding support with a community repository.

games.name: Bokosuka Wars II
games.summary: Bokosuka Wars won the 1984 ASCII Software Contest; a pioneering simulation RPG. This sequel by the original creator features ideas and systems not realized on the original. Two-Player Co-op play recommended!

games.name: Earth Defense Force 5: Mission Pack 2 - Super Challenge
aliases: EARTH DEFENSE FORCE 5 - Mission Pack 2: Super Challenge
games.summary: This is pure hell. Bottomless despair, all just for the EDF elite. Unseen despair awaits in the second additional mission pack, with ten impossibly difficult missions.

games.name: Floral Flowlove
games.summary: On that day, I saw an angel.

games.name: DayZ
games.summary: DayZ is a hardcore open-world survival game with only one rule: stay alive, no matter what. How long can you survive a post-apocalyptic world? A land overrun with an infected "zombie" population, where you compete with other survivors for limited resources. Will you team up with strangers and stay strong together? Or play as a lone wolf to avoid betrayal? This is DayZ, this is your story.

games.name: Lurkers
games.summary: Lurkers is a chaotic 2D multiplayer sandbox where you can build, battle, and survive! Fight zombies, conquer game modes like Bedwars, and unleash your creativity in a world that’s yours to shape and destroy.

games.name: Sayonara Wild Hearts
aliases: さよならワイルドハーツ
Sayonara Wild Hearts（さよならワイルドハーツ）
games.summary: Sayonara Wild Hearts is a euphoric music video dream about being awesome, riding motorcycles, skateboarding, dance battling, shooting lasers, wielding swords, and breaking hearts at 200 mph.

games.name: Phasmophobia
games.summary: Phasmophobia is a cooperative horror investigation game played from a first-person perspective, supporting one to four players. Players take on the role of ghost hunters who must identify the type of ghost haunting a designated location by gathering evidence using various paranormal investigation equipment. The game features speech recognition, allowing ghosts and certain equipment to respond to words spoken by players. As investigators spend time at the site, their sanity decreases, eventually triggering hunts during which the ghost actively pursues and can kill players. The game includes multiple location types of varying size, twenty-nine ghost types each with unique behaviors and evidence, and a progression system where players earn money to unlock and upgrade equipment. Virtual reality is optionally supported.

games.name: Bike Baron 2
games.summary: Bike Baron 2 is a wild motorbike racer packed with monster jumps and explosive hazards. It mixes platforming and puzzle elements with over-the-top physics and pixel-perfect controls. There's no better way to unleash your inner daredevil than to crash your bike from the safety of your room.

games.name: Mingle
games.summary: Mingle is a hidden object puzzle game where you move through a crowd to find your identical twin. Each match transforms you into someone new, with hundreds of chatty little characters and surprising level twists.

games.name: Dungeon Ward
games.summary: Dungeon Ward revives old‑school grid‑based dungeon crawlers and focuses on fast‑paced combat with flexible character progression. Level up, master powerful skills, and defeat challenging bosses in this action‑packed RPG.

games.name: Earth Defense Force 6
games.summary: Earth Defense Force 6 is the sixth main entry in the Earth Defense Force series and the direct sequel to Earth Defense Force 5, picking up three years after that game left off. EDF 6 is set on a dying Earth where the alien Primer civilization invades once again.

games.name: Call of Duty: Warzone
games.summary: Call of Duty: Warzone is a free-to-play combat game with multiple modes and new gameplay updates. It includes Fortune’s Keep, Endgame (limited time), Battle Royale, Black Ops Royale, and Resurgence, each offering different match types and objectives.

games.name: Castle of Alchemists
games.summary: Defend your castle in this fast-paced tower defense/action hybrid game with stunning pixel art graphics! Play as alchemically enhanced warrior Bellator, set traps, build towers, craft powerful weapons, and defend your home! The fate of the castle lies in your hands!

games.name: Endlight
games.summary: Break through and outlast shifting, twisting, chaos and whatnot. Dodging is for cowards - start smashing.

games.name: Gothic Classic
games.summary:
For the first time, relive this amazing RPG on a handheld console and enjoy the game that revolutionized roleplaying games on the go. Dive into dark times and adventures with great performance and a well adapted UI and controls.

War has been waged across the kingdom of Myrtana. Orcish hordes invaded human territory and the king of the land needed a lot of ore to forge enough weapons, should his army stand against this threat. Whoever breaks the law in these darkest of times is sentenced to serve in the giant penal colony of Khorinis, mining the so much needed ore. You are thrown through the barrier into this prison colony. With your back against the wall, you have to survive and form volatile alliances until you can finally escape.

games.name: Lyssa: Goddess of Rage
games.summary: Various battlefields with random obstacles and different heroes with unique bonuses to hone your strategy skills. Explore the map, defeat powerful bosses, build your story line, accept quests and embark on a journey! Assemble your forces and lead your party to Victory!

games.name: Residiuum: Tales of Coral
games.summary:
Explore a universe rich in personality and full of mysteries.

After the sun went mad and exploded, all that was left of the world was the Auric Earth. A region divided between the Elite with their suited men and their experiments and technologies with the multi-purpose gas Sig, and the less fortunate who must deal with gangs of criminals of various kinds and a hostile environment full of toxic and poisonous substances.

games.name: Palia
games.summary: Palia is a free-to-play life simulation MMO where players take on the role of humans who have mysteriously appeared in a world primarily inhabited by a species called the Majiri. Gameplay centers on village life activities including fishing, foraging, hunting, mining, insect catching, cooking, furniture making, gardening, and ranching. Players work to become members of Kilima Village by gathering and crafting materials, with the adjacent Bahari Bay area offering higher-level resources and server-wide events.

games.name: Buckshot Roulette
games.summary: Play Russian roulette with a 12-gauge shotgun. Four enter. One leaves. Roll the dice with your life. Good luck!

games.name: Beast: Bio Exo Arena Suit Team
games.summary: Immerse yourself in the cosmic adventure of BEAST! A unique 3V3 online shooter designed for all ages. BEAST combines charm and excitement with intuitive controls.
aliases: B.E.A.S.T.: Bio Exo Arena Suit Team
BEAST: Bio Exo Arena Suit Team

games.name: Agent Simulator
games.summary: If you are a sharpshooter, you would be a great fit for us. Within a short period of time, select 3 options from the list and deal with your enemies. Do not forget that the ability of using time efficiently and aiming your targets are crucial. Complete each mission and earn an agent certification.

games.name: Little Kitty, Big City
games.summary: You're a curious little kitty with a big personality, on an adventure to find your way back home. Explore the city, make new friends, wear delightful hats, and leave more than a little chaos in your wake. After all, isn't that what cats do best?

games.name: Doll Defenders
games.summary: You were teleported to Male Doll's multiverse with one goal: to meet some of our heroes. However, you may find them having private moments. Can you complete the challenges, or will your attention be on their sexual performances? Don't lie to yourself! THIS GAME CONTAINS A TRANS MALE CHARACTER!

games.name: Squad Busters
games.summary: Build a vast collection of Supercell characters, each bringing their own special ability to the battle. Wrestle enemies with Brawl Stars' El Primo, or spray bullets with Boom Beach's Heavy. Harvest Trees with Hay Day's Greg, or summon Skeletons with Clash's Witch!

games.name: Elden Ring: Shadow of the Erdtree
games.summary: The Shadow of the Erdtree is a fully-fledged expansion that features an all-new story set in the Land of Shadow. It adds a whole new map with 70 new weapons, ten new shields, 39 new Talismans, 14 new sorceries, 28 new incantations, 20 new Spirit Ashes, 25 New Ashes of War, 30 new armour sets, and new consumables and craftables.

games.name: Archa
games.summary:
As Archa, fight enemies with your scythe Anubis, use your cards, and collect items and shards to raise your score and get the Interdimensional Pumpkins or Carrots in this upcoming Bullet-Hell Platformer!

Archa is a 2D platformer all about movement, combat, exploration, and score! To complete a level, you must gather a certain amount of points, and find the exit. Points are given by collecting and attacking enemies.

games.name: Baradroid: A Gay Visual Novel
games.summary: A choice-driven, high-tech, gay visual novel with elements of dating-sim! Choose your baradroid, Live with him, and... Can you teach a robot the meaning of human love?

games.name: Wilder World: Super Early Access
games.summary: Interdimensional refugees known as the Wilders flee Our Base Reality, which has become an AI-controlled dystopia to Wiami, a digital sanctuary in Wilder World. When the authoritarian FORUM attempts to conquer Wiami, the Wilders strategize a defence.

games.name: Zero Hour
games.summary: Zero Hour is a tactical FPS with online team-based game play that takes place in a variety of fictional locations interpreted in Bangladesh with Real-life scale & resource management. It brings a grounded, close quarter combat experience to the game.

games.name: Warhammer 40,000: Space Marine II
games.summary: The galaxy is in peril. Entire worlds are falling. The Imperium needs you. Embody the superhuman skill and brutality of a Space Marine, the greatest of the Emperor's warriors, with Clive Standen (Vikings, Taken) as the iconic Captain Titus. Unleash deadly abilities and an arsenal of devastating weaponry to obliterate the relentless Tyranid hordes. Hold at bay the horrors of the galaxy in epic battles on far-flung planets. Uncover dark secrets and drive back the everlasting night to prove your ultimate loyalty to humanity.

games.name: The Tag-along Obsession
games.summary: 《THE TAG-ALONG OBSESSION》 is a first-person horror puzzle game. You will play Hui Ting and enter the long-abandoned resort to explore the truth of everything. The props survive as much as possible and solve all the mysteries and connections to her own past.

games.name: Ravenswatch
games.summary: Fallen heroes of old folk tales and legends: you are on the verge of a crucial battle against the Nightmare invading and corrupting your world. A roguelike action game from the creators of Curse of the Dead Gods, playable solo or in online co-op.

games.name: Portrait of a Torn
games.summary: As a young soldier returning to an eerily deserted home, you'll explore enigmatic rooms and uncover a haunting, tragic story. Experience an atmospheric journey filled with suspense, mysterious encounters, and a deep narrative.

games.name: Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024
games.summary: Pursue your dream of an aviation career with Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024. This brand-new simulator is designed to take advantage of the latest technologies in simulation, cloud, machine learning, graphics and gaming to create the most sophisticated, immersive and awe-inspiring flight simulator of all time. To achieve this unprecedented level of accuracy, Microsoft Flight Simulator 2024 is powered by the significantly evolved Asobo Studio engine.

games.name: Path of Exile 2
games.summary: Path of Exile 2 is a next generation Action RPG from Grinding Gear Games, featuring co-op for up to six players. Set years after the original Path of Exile, you will return to the dark world of Wraeclast and seek to end the corruption that is spreading.

games.name: Path of Mystery: A Brush with Death
games.summary:
A completely new title from Imagineer and Toybox Inc., Mystery Walk is the first in a three-part serial drama series!

The game is set in Narumisawa, a charming, fictional summer getaway town that feels familiar, as though you have seen it somewhere before…

The story alternates between the present and the past to uncover the truth behind an unsolved case from 30 years ago.

Told through a prologue, 10 episodes, and a mysterious “?” episode, the mysteries deepen with each chapter.

The fully voiced dialogue, brought to life by a talented cast, will make you eager to continue to the next episode. And there are some unexpected names among the voice actors…

Please immerse yourself in the world of Mystery Walk to the fullest!

games.name: Miniature Land: Four Seasons
games.summary: An escape room game made by hand-building and photographing miniature scenes. Explore a miniature world in live-action and enjoy feeling like you're really there.

games.name: Sottaku
games.summary: Sottaku is a multiplayer video game in which players compete against each other, Geoguessr-style, in order to quickly read or fill in the blanks in cloze or reading sentences, across Chinese, Japanese, and Korean.

games.name: Monster Hunter Wilds
aliases: モンスターハンターワイルズ
games.summary: The unbridled force of nature runs wild and relentless, with environments transforming drastically from one moment to the next. This is a story of monsters and humans and their struggles to live in harmony in a world of duality.

games.name: Asylum
games.summary: An epic supernatural horror adventure and the spiritual successor to cult classic Scratches set in a massive, decaying mental institute. Inspired by H. P. Lovecraft, Hammer Films and twisted Euro Horror from the 80s.

games.name: Iron Saga VS
games.summary: Take control of an assortment of superb mechs and engage in thrilling combat with other enthusiasts on the same battlefield! In addition to original mecha, well-known IPs such as "Mazinger Z" and “Dancouga – Super Beast Machine God” also ready for the mecha war!

games.name: Eternal Fate: A Journey Begins
games.summary: Old-school style RPG to enjoy a nostalgic tale with difficult and fair gameplay that is fully voiced.

games.name: Lizards Must Die 2
games.summary: LIZARDS MUST DIE 2 is a cooperative slasher action game, a high–quality continuation of the SENSATIONAL first part. Insidious lizards attacked the lands of the Rus again. HYPERBOREA is on fire and only the GLORIOUS HEROES can kick the invaders from their homeland.

games.name: Hollywood Animal
games.summary: Make movies, even if someone has to die. Take the helm of a major Hollywood studio at the dawn of sound cinema, and guide it through decades of creative achievements and glamor, debauchery and dark deeds, tough choices and unpleasant compromises.

games.name: Pirate Royalty
games.summary: Pirate Royalty is a free-to-play fantasy pirate MMORPG set on Saltbreak Isle. Players choose from four classes, build their own stats and skills, hunt rare gear, forge gems into equipment, and team up for timed dungeons. It includes PvE, PvP, trading, and a cosmetics-only shop—combat power has to be earned.

games.name: Deck of Haunts
games.summary: Deck of Haunts invites you to become a malevolent Haunted House. Lure humans into your cursed halls, manipulate their fears, and drain their essence to grow your power. Use strategy to build your mansion and expand your dark influence, turning your home into a terrifying, inescapable nightmare.

games.name: Frog Legs
games.summary: A short, single-player horror action game starring Carl, the suburban house frog. Will you be able to conquer arcade challenges, solve puzzles, and Ribbit and Tear your way back to the life you once knew?

games.name: Fantasy Life i: The Girl Who Steals Time
aliases: FANTASY LIFE i: Guruguru no Ryuu to Toki wo Nusumu Shoujo
FANTASY LIFE i: La voleuse de temps
FANTASY LIFE i: La pequeña ladrona del tiempo
FANTASY LIFE i: La ragazza che ruba il tempo
FANTASY LIFE i: The Girl Who Steals Time
games.summary: Fantasy Life i: The Girl Who Steals Time is an RPG life-sim game and the long-awaited sequel to the 3DS classic Fantasy Life. This game will expand on what the original did, blending simulation with traditional action RPG combat mechanics.

games.name: Automate It
games.summary: Automate It is a factory building game that requires clever solutions to its size, power, and time constraints. Solve challenges, build and share your own levels, or open things up in sandbox mode. If you want to build it - Automate It.

games.name: Eriksholm: The Stolen Dream
aliases: 埃里克斯霍姆：被偷走的梦
games.summary:
Experience an isometric, narrative-driven stealth game set in the stunning city of Eriksholm. When Hanna’s brother, Herman, disappears and the police begin to pursue him, her search sets off a chain of catastrophic events that will not only alter their lives but also the destiny of the entire city. Join your allies, outsmart relentless enemies, and use your cunning to uncover the truth behind Herman’s disappearance — where greater powers are at play than you ever imagined.

Follow Hanna’s adventure through the vibrant streets of Eriksholm, a sprawling Nordic city inspired by the elegance and grit of early 1900s Scandinavia. In this world, every shadow offers a hiding place, and every corner hides a new challenge. Allies and quick reflexes are your greatest tools as you unravel the city's secrets and outsmart your pursuers.

games.name: Spirit Crossing
games.summary: Spirit Crossing is a beautiful cooperative life-sim about building friendships and community. Sign up for our Closed Alpha playtest and discover a world where you can connect, escape, and belong.

games.name: Earthion
games.summary:
Earthion is an upcoming aftermarket shooting game developed by Ancient primarily for the Sega Mega Drive. Physical MD versions will be published by SUPERDELUXE GAMES in Japan and by Limited Run Games in North America. The game will also get a 16:9 version for modern platforms.

Earthion is published under the label YKGGG, a brand name covering all the retro-style games developed at Ancient. If Earthion meets success, Ancient will go on the venture of releasing video games designed for retro consoles. A separate version of the game for Arcade was confirmed by Ancient and published by exA-Arcadia, which features a new, exclusive mode that will not be available in the Mega Drive version.

games.name: PhotoLoop
games.summary: PhotoLoop is a casual game about editing photos using an outdated editing software that only has the lasso tool. Make sure to make your edits clean and concise, or you might not be able to pay your rent due in five days!

games.name: Out and About
games.summary: A cozy foraging adventure for anyone who loves the outdoors or wishes they knew it better. Every plant is real: learn to identify 100+ wild plants and fungi and cook 200+ real recipes, while helping a storm-struck town find its feet again.

games.name: Dice Gambit
games.summary: Shape and lead your own fully customisable (and debt-ridden) family of Inquisitors in charge of hunting the chromatic monsters infesting the city. Unlock unique abilities, hang out with eccentric nobles, learn the secrets the city holds while occasionally delivering ice cream!

games.name: Void/Breaker
games.summary: Adrenaline-Fueled Roguelite FPS

games.name: Chark

games.name: Restore the Luminous
games.summary:
Restore the Luminous is a free-to-play digital trading card game in which every card is unlocked the moment the game is installed. There are no booster packs, no gacha and no cards for sale; the only purchases planned are cosmetic.

Two players duel one on one with decks of 40 to 60 cards, built from a single card pool shared by every leader, with a limit of three copies of any one card and no colour restrictions on deckbuilding. Cards are paid for with LP, a resource that comes in five colours: red, blue, green, yellow and black. LP grows and fully refreshes every turn, and its colours are set by discarding cards from your own hand, so deciding what to throw away is as much a part of the game as deciding what to play.

Damage is not a life total that ticks down. It moves cards from the top of the defending player's deck into a damage zone, and a card with a Turnover ability fires that ability for free as it lands there. A player loses when their damage zone fills up. On turns 4 and 7 both leaders evolve at the same time, each drawing an extra card and unlocking the next stage of their own ability.

All four leaders draw from the same card pool, but each has a different innate ability and a different set of numbers: a different opening hand size, a different number of unit slots and a different number of counter slots. The same deck therefore plays differently depending on which leader is holding it.

The game includes solo matches against AI, online 1v1 matchmaking, private friend matches by room ID, and community-run round-robin and bracket tournaments.

You play a common hunter who rediscovers the truth and struggles against the faceless Organization which will stop at nothing to defeat you. games.name: Patricide

Patricide is a sub-form of parricide, which is defined as an act of killing a close relative. In many cultures and religions, patricide was considered one of the worst sins. For example, according to Marcus Tullius Cicero, in the Roman Republic it was the only crime that led a civilian to death penalty.

Always one more round.

games.name: Moto Trial Turbo
games.summary: Moto Trial Turbo is a physics-based 2D arcade motorcycle trial game. Players can look forward to exciting tracks, devious traps, secrets, and even player-created levels! Complete challenging tracks against the clock and compete with players from around the world on the leaderboards.

games.name: Salmon
games.summary: Salmon is a surname. Notable people with the name include: Adam Salmon, American researcher and professor Alex Salmon (born 1994), English footballer André Salmon (1881–1969), French writer Barnett Salmon (1829–1897), co-founder of Salmon & Gluckstein, by 1900 the world's largest retail tobacconist Benoît Salmon (born 1974), French road racing cyclist Cecil Salmon (1885–1975), American agronomist Chris Salmon, British banker, Chief Cashier of the Bank of England (2011–2014) Christine Salmon (1916–1985), American architect and educator Christopher Salmon (born 1978), Welsh politician Colin Salmon (born 1961), British actor Cyril…

games.name: Pistol Cat
games.summary: A cat. A gun. Recoil-powered movement, leg kicks, and a fart thruster. Shoot your way through a living open world town, smash everything in sight, and survive the Blood Moon: all as a small, physics-driven cat with a big pistol.

games.name: Skate Mates
games.summary: A chaotic multiplayer skating game where each player controls one skate! Only epic teamwork and swift communication will get you through the brutal obstacle course! Dodge the blades, jump the canyons, and avoid the lava, because one mistake sends you all the way back.

games.name: Anhedonia: Sanctuary of Ash
games.summary: Dive into a world consumed by the biblical apocalypse. As a fallen priest seeking redemption, battle demonic horrors, cleanse the tormented, and gather what remains to rebuild the Sanctuary of Ash - the faint light in a dying world.

games.name: Goodnight, B
games.summary: Goodnight, B is a single-player 2D puzzle-platformer about a hungry little girl struggling with nightmares. Rotate and place sections of each level to complete them. Explore various environments, meet wacky characters, find secrets, and wall-jump your way towards that coveted midnight snack.

games.name: Wizalign
games.summary: A match-3 adventure RPG where every action happens on the puzzle board. Battle monsters, collect keys, discover powerful dungeon items, manage health and shields, and defeat bosses as you explore overworlds and dungeons inspired by classic adventure games.

games.name: Hacking Into Erebus
games.summary:
Hacking Into Erebus is a hacking game centered on taking control of a spacecraft named USS Erebus.

The ship is stranded on a remote alien planet. The crew is in cryogenic sleep. The player physically navigates inside the ship using robots while simultaneously gaining access to its network systems. The ship's central operating system, ARIA, protects the system but operates aggressively against the player.

The player must manage robots and interact with panels and terminals to successfully take control of the ship's systems.

games.name: Kaperfahrt
games.summary:
Kaperfahrt is an open world pirate sandbox set in a simulated Caribbean during the age of sail. Around 200 AI captains sail, trade and wage their own wars independently of the player, so conflicts and trade routes exist whether the player takes part in them or not.

Players engage in naval combat, board and capture enemy vessels, and command a fleet of up to four ships that fight in formation. Trade runs between five rival houses whose economy reacts to player actions, so blockading a harbour shifts prices across the map. A bounty list of 23 named pirates, each with their own crew and fighting style, forms the long term goal.

Kaperfahrt is developed by Kleinod Games, a one person studio from Germany, and is built in Godot.

games.name: Dumpster Gang
games.summary: Play as a gang of mischievous raccoons in this chaotic co-op sandbox for 1-4 players. Complete ridiculous missions, steal everything you can carry, and outsmart a relentless Exterminator determined to throw your gang behind bars.

games.name: DNA Nemesis
games.summary: Survive in the wildest Battle Royale! Choose from 10 animal species, each with its own unique ability based on its natural attack and defence mechanisms. Master an extreme experience and become the ultimate species. In DNA NEMESIS there are no heroes; only predators and prey.

games.name: Graven
games.summary: A Frankenstein-inspired Gothic RPG. You’re an eccentric physician’s apprentice whose unique skills (and shortcomings) shape every conversation. Explore the city, follow leads, and find your missing mentor and the man you helped raise from the dead. Save them, condemn them, or alter death itself.

games.name: Tinker's Nook
games.summary: Own and run a workshop in a steampunk fantasy world! Craft, fix and sell items to make a living while meeting countless townsfolk and listen to their stories.

games.name: Last Train to Yotsuya
games.summary: Last Train to Yotsuya is a short first-person narrative experience. Explore different locations, observe your surroundings, and interact with the objects around you to gradually uncover a personal story through the details and events of the journey.

games.name: Meltdown Crew
games.summary: Run a barely-stable nuclear reactor with your friends in this online co-op physics chaos game. Fix broken systems, manage radiation, survive power outages, and prevent a total meltdown before everything goes horribly wrong.

games.name: Snackrifice
games.summary: Feed a hungry demon overlord in this 1-4 player roguelike dungeon crawler. Adapt to perilous curses, craft powerful relics and overcome the many faces of Purgatory.

games.name: The Sky Project: Land of Noris
games.summary: Hand-drawn monster collector where every creature lost might be gone forever. Explore four unique planes and train 200+ mana creatures.

games.name: Books & Blood
games.summary: Survive in a post-apocalyptic bookstore in this horror game. Fetch books for your customers to complete your daily quota. Explore the abandoned bookstore, and don't get caught by the horrors stalking the shelves.

games.name: Fall Up
games.summary: Take a leap into a lost world of mechanical wonders and embark on a hopping adventure with our adorable Labi! You need to traverse this cartoonish world with a variety of jumps and moves, meet squishy creatures and clumsy robots and reveal the secrets of this world.

games.name: Aeterna Lucis
games.summary: Aeterna Lucis is the highly anticipated sequel to Aeterna Noctis. Following the gameplay steps of the first entry in the series, Aeterna Lucis is a Metroidvania that combines fast-paced combat, a large interconnected map, secret hunting, optional challenges, and a rich and deep story.

games.name: Akashic Slingshot
games.summary: One weapon. One health. One ███.

games.name: Step Theater
games.summary: Welcome to the "step theater". "Step theater" is a vibrant rhythm game where the story unfolds and the screen comes closer to success with every step you take. Dive in and enjoy this charming, vibrant drama!

games.name: Dragon Quest Monsters: The Withered World
games.summary: In this RPG, you befriend monsters from the DRAGON QUEST series, raise them up, synthesize new creatures, and pit them against other monsters in battle. Join fledgling monster wranglers Bianca and Nera as they set off on the adventure of a lifetime.
aliases: Dragon Quest Monsters 4: The Withered World
DRAGON QUEST MONSTERS: The Withered World
Dragon Quest Monsters : Le royaume de Boisflétri

games.name: Rayman Origins: Enhanced Edition
games.summary:
When the Glade of Dreams is overrun by “nefurrious” Darktoons, the Fairy Council summons Rayman to save the day. Joined by his best friend, Globox, and two crafty wizards, the Teensies, this unlikely team must restore balance before their world fades away like a bad dream.

Enjoy Rayman Origins like never before with 4K resolution, 60 FPS, and modern enhancements, including new quality-of-life features. Discover 60 hidden Relics across the adventure and track your progress in the Snoring Tree.

games.name: Rayman Legends Retold
games.summary: Embark on a bold reimagining of the beloved platformer, with new visuals and a retold story. Play solo or up to 4‑player couch co‑op, explore a mysterious new realm, jam through new musical stages, and more!

games.name: Xenoblade Chronicles 3: Nintendo Switch 2 Edition
games.summary: Traverse massive, fantastical landscapes and master seamless real-time RPG combat that has all been enhanced to run at 4K* resolution in TV mode, and full HD in handheld mode, at 60 frames per second with smoother and sharper cutscenes.

games.name: Sombras: Negative Frames
games.summary: ‘SOMBRAS: negative frames’ is a first person narrative game with a focus on photography and light horror elements. Follow Shiomi, a Japanese-Spanish photography student, as she is spirited away in a dark mirror of her 2000s Japanese town and must confront fragments of her own psyche.

games.name: Death and Tactics
games.summary: A post apocalyptic turn-based strategy game. Permanent death is a primary mechanic, with unique events being unlocked based on how you play the game. And there are many ways to play! Such as: selling the organs of party members you don't like, turning your enemies into monsters, and much, much more!

games.name: Nullbreak Protocol
games.summary: A sci-fi arcade roguelite of fast, escalating runs. Launch your core, shatter every block, survive what the room fires back. Draw stacking protocols to build your run, push deeper into the system, and beat your record — the descent never ends.

games.name: Space Industry
games.summary: Space industry refers to economic activities related to manufacturing components that go into outer space (Earth's orbit or beyond), delivering them to those regions, and related services. Owing to the prominence of satellite-related activities, some sources use the term satellite industry interchangeably with the term space industry. The term space business has also been used. A narrow definition of the space industry typically encompasses only hardware providers (primarily those that manufacture launch vehicles and satellites). This definition does not exclude certain activities, such as space tourism.

games.name: The Industrial Council
games.summary: A cozy AI driven game where you play a journalist in a steampunk fantasy city. Change is coming to Raversul, and with the help of your imp and your newspaper you will play a powerful role in shaping it. Solve mysteries, uncover stories, and shape politics in this revolutionary new game.

games.name: Squid Hunt 1923
games.summary: Experience a unique flow that echoes the early icons of the shooter genre. Captivated by grotesque atmosphere, driven by ever-growing numbers you plunge into portals, eliminate aliens, collect loot and gather experience. At a pace you set yourself.

games.name: Abductables
games.summary: An arcade game about abducting humans, turning them into alien human hybrids to make money and get the highest score possible.

games.name: The Glued
games.summary: The peg doll faces from your childhood bedroom reappear at every turn. Struggle to find a path forward through your own personal hell in this bleak visual novel with light puzzles and point-and-click elements.

games.name: Professor Layton and the New World of Steam
games.summary: Professor Layton and the New World of Steam is an upcoming puzzle-adventure game by Level-5. It is the eighth main game of the Professor Layton series, set one year after the events of Professor Layton and the Unwound Future. The game is scheduled to be released on December 10, 2026 for Nintendo Switch, Switch 2, PlayStation 5, and Windows via Steam.
aliases: Professor Layton and New World of Steam

games.name: Hakuoki Ibun: Berezinskii no Majo
games.summary: A new Hakuoki game for Nintendo Switch, set in 19th century Europe.

games.name: Stage Tour
games.summary: Build your band, hit the stage, and go on tour in Stage Tour, the next evolution of music rhythm games. Rock over 90 officially licensed tracks, unlock over 180 authentic Gibson®, Epiphone® and Kramer® guitars, and experience five game modes, including the all-new roguelite Tour Mode.

games.name: Attack on Titan 3
games.summary: Experience the story from beginning to end in the ultimate culmination of the Attack on Titan game series. The ODM action has been further refined, delivering the most exhilarating and stylish combat the series has ever seen.

games.name: Hoop Dynasty: Rise of a Legend
games.summary: Hoop Dynasty: Rise of a Legend is a single-player basketball career simulator set in an original fictional universe. Create a prospect, choose a College, International, or Pro path, shape skills and mentality through RPG decisions, and earn a role through performance, form, and consistency. Play or simulate games in the Live 2D Match Center while teams, rosters, markets, standings, playoffs, records, contracts, coaches, agents, sponsors, injuries, media pressure, and national-team selections evolve across multiple seasons.
developers: Hoop Dynasty: Rise of a Legend
publishers: Hoop Dynasty: Rise of a Legend

games.name: Caladrius 2: Dark Element
games.summary: A dark gothic world ruled by beauty and darkness... Over a decade after its debut, the infamous Shame Break system returns. Discover striking characters brought to life by acclaimed illustrators, and master enhanced Element Shot and Shame Break systems in this exhilarating 2D bullet-hell shooter.

games.name: Ninja Baseball League-Man: Bases Loaded
games.summary:
Ninja Baseball League-Man: Bases Loaded is an arcade-style beat ’em up that combines baseball and martial arts, this action game has players battling through side-scrolling stages with pitches, swings, grabs, throws, combos, and special attacks. Up to four players can team up in shared-screen co-op to reclaim a stolen trophy.

Expanding on the original arcade release, the game adds a playable character, new stages, an arranged mode with revised enemy layouts, minigames, and newly arranged music alongside the original soundtrack.

games.name: Find Kittens 13: Cave Town
games.summary: Light your lantern, traveler, for a journey into the depths of the earth awaits you! What are you waiting for?! Explore and find cute cats to fill this black-and-white world with different colors.

games.name: Maneki Mania
games.summary: Pet the lucky cat, spin the charm slots and chase the golden koban jackpot. Maneki Mania is a kawaii fortune shrine where you unlock lucky charms, grow your luck and watch the gold pile up. Cute on the outside, casino on the inside.

games.name: Fall off Reach
games.summary: Fall Off Reach is a first-person narrative survival game and the sequel to Drift Into Eternity. Alone in the wreck of the WANDERER IV, explore, repair failing systems, and delay the inevitable as everything keeping you alive collapses.

games.name: Hunter From Hell
games.summary: With your friends, form a team of paranormal experts to unravel the mysteries of the most terrifying places. Armed with sophisticated gadgets like EMF detectors, infrared cameras, and incantation books, your mission is simple: gather evidence of the beyond and survive chilling encounters.

games.name: Demon With a Candy Crisis
games.summary: A quick and easy 3d platformer playing as a demon that needs to quench its thirst for candy. Travel through hell to get to the surface to find someone's secret stash of candy.

games.name: PBA Pro Bowling 2027
games.summary: Dominate the lanes in PBA Pro Bowling 2027! Customize your bowler’s unique style and arsenal with in-depth ball mechanics and Perks. Forge your legacy in PBA Tour Mode and Online Leagues, and defend your title in Online Tournaments and Ranked Play. This is where champions are made.

games.name: Beyblade X Evobattle: Digital Beybooster Vol.10
Beyblade X Evobattle: Digital Beybooster Vol.9
Power Racing Bundle 4
games.summary: Enjoy 4 games in 1 with this irresistible games pack!

games.name: Rest Stop
games.summary: "Rest Stop" is a short story by the American writer Stephen King, originally published in the December 2003 issue of Esquire and collected in King's 2008 collection Just After Sunset. In 2004, "Rest Stop" won the National Magazine Award for Fiction.

games.name: Infinitesimals
games.summary: Infinitesimals is a story-driven, 3rd person action adventure where you play as tiny aliens who stand only 1mm tall. Though a diminutive species, they are technologically advanced and space faring.

games.name: Witchbrook
games.summary: Discover magic and mystery in Witchbrook, a spellbinding witch life-sim for up to 4-players! Start your life as the newest resident witch in the bustling seaside town of Mossport. Make friends, find love, and discover a world filled with wonder and charm on the road to graduation and beyond...

games.name: Port Valley
games.summary: Port Valley is a (not so) classic Point & Click game where a certain choice changes everything. Witness 3 points of view of the same story and find out what's really going on during Port Valley's Election Day!

games.name: The Way of Wrath
games.summary: Forge your path as a Bronze Age tribal chieftain in this epic strategy RPG. Lead your tribe in a fight for survival against all odds as the elements, time, and a relentless foe seek to wipe your people out.

games.name: Last Moon
games.summary: Last Moon is an action RPG which embraces the vibes of classic titles from the 90s. Explore a mesmerising, vast, ruined world riddled with dangers, face tainted creatures and upgrade your abilities to regain peace. The Moon is falling. Will you bring harmony back to the world?

games.name: Rune Fencer Illyia
games.summary: Traverse a massive, ruined and beautiful world in this intense, atmospheric action platformer. Steal enemy abilities and fight them back with their own runic magic and deadly swordplay, as you attempt to find your lost twin sister in the sunken kingdom of Ithos.

games.name: The Lewd Knight
games.summary: Help the girl - a superhero in the fight against evil

games.name: Lost Viking: Kingdom of Women
games.summary: While traveling to the East the Vikings fall into a trap. Ragnald is saved by the accompanying wolf and must find his loved ones. The Viking and his companion are forced not only to survive, but properly manage time, space and energy to achieve the goal.

games.name: Ten Thousand Coins: The Golden Merchant
games.summary: Trade, traverse, and earn coins in this strategy merchant game set in a handcrafted world shaped by secrets and volatile markets. Join Viia, the fox merchant, as she defies the mighty Basilisk Company in the hunt for the truth behind the Golden Merchant.

games.name: Neverlooted Dungeon
games.summary: Venture deep into the Neverlooted Dungeon in search of its legendary treasure, and face its treacherous, deadly traps. Using your creativity and magical items in a highly interactive physics-based world, find your own ways to outsmart the dangers, and be the first to uncover its darkest secrets.

games.name: The Pope: Power & Sin
games.summary: Take on the role of the Pope, strengthen the authority of the Church State, fight for spiritual and political independence from pagans and the renewal of church structures. The rule of Pope is a torrent of numerous scandals, excesses and signs of moral corruption in the authorities of the Church.

games.name: RevenBlade
games.summary: RevenBlade is a 5v5 third-person hero shooter with a focus on melee combat, mechanical outplays, and mobility with lots of verticality.

games.name: The Cabbage Effect
games.summary: A cartoon-pop-surrealistic twin-stick shooter with brawl elements that takes place in an apocalyptic narrative.

games.name: Skyclimbers
games.summary: Build your kingdom, choose your class, and tame monsters in this Multiplayer City-Building RPG that takes place in a procedurally generated anime-themed universe.

games.name: Divided Land
games.summary: Join the fight for survival in a vast medieval open world. Explore, hunt, craft powerful gear, raid and plunder enemy villages, or forge your own path. As darkness falls, the dead awaken - prepare your defenses or seek shelter. Team up with allies in co-op PvE or face the wilderness alone.

games.name: Your World
games.summary: Your World is a VR open-world survival game with building and crafting. Explore a stylized world, gather resources, and create your own unique world. Survive in the wilderness, manage resources, and expand your domain. Can you turn chaos into a thriving world?

games.name: Heart of Muriet
games.summary: Your faction is in your hands in this 4X real-time strategy game. As a powerful mage, build thriving settlements and diverse armies to discover the secrets and stories at the heart of Muriet.

games.name: Treasure Islands
games.summary: Treasure Islands: Tax Havens and the Men who Stole the World (2011) is a non-fiction book about the secretive role of offshore banks and tax havens in global economic affairs. The book was written by Nicholas Shaxson, a political analyst and associate Fellow of the Royal Institute of International Affairs. It was first published on 6 January 2011. The publication is promoted by the Tax Justice Network.

games.name: Disc Creatures World
games.summary: Embark on a grand adventure through a world full of mysteries, uncovering ‘Discs’ to collect your own party of creatures! Engage in strategic battles, enjoy an assortment of collectables, and meet unique characters along the way. A monster taming RPG with a blend of nostalgia and novelty!

games.name: Pocket Wheels
games.summary: In Pocket Wheels, anything is possible! Well, almost anything. In this 3D precision platformer, jump through barrels, fly like a bird, and land... Well, hopefully not in the lava.

games.name: Gravity Blasters
games.summary: Gravity Blasters is a fast, fun and addictive multiplayer artillery action game that is recreating the classic artillery style of aiming and shooting by adjusting the angle and power.

games.name: Eternity Guards
games.summary: The main idea of the game is a fantasy alternative to Valhalla. Scandinavian mythology is a thematic focus - the same style, ornaments and atmosphere where heroes fight for a place in eternity, there will be only one.

games.name: Meteora
games.summary: Meteora jsou monastýry na vrcholcích slepencových skal v oblasti Thesálie v Řecku, poblíž města Kalambaka. První lidé osídlili skály v místě dnešní Meteory až v průběhu byzantského období. Mniši a poustevníci se tu začali usazovat až od 11. století, ale teprve o tři století později začaly vznikat první byzantské monastýry (správný český výraz pro klášter východní [tj. pravoslavné čili ortodoxní] a řeckokatolické církve).

games.name: Insect Worlds
games.summary: Immerse yourself in the world of insects. Explore fascinating forests and learn about their way of life. Complete quests and mini-games, fight or collect resources and cards. Admire the microcosm from a completely different perspective and learn new facts about plants and insects.

games.name: Eden.schemata();
games.summary: EDEN.schemata(); is a sci-fi mystery adventure game featuring hand-drawn animations and narrative devices only possible in a video game format. Investigate a locked laboratory cut off from the rest of the world. Depending on what you find out, you may change the very nature of the game itself.

games.name: SacriFire
games.summary: SacriFire is an upcoming RPG boasting a unique combat system, elaborate pixel art, and music by genre legend Motoi Sakuraba. Ezekiel Ridan, a young priest, struggles to keep his faith as the world he loves is threatened by a war between gods and demons. The adventure begins!

games.name: Building Relationships
games.summary: Experience life as a house in this silly adventure game! Play as a building as you roll, jump, and wave-dash across a cozy island. Meet eligible structures, romance them, and experience a bizarre, yet oddly familiar story.. or go fishing instead (though we replaced fish with cars to make more sense)

games.name: Espiocracy
games.summary: Espiocracy is an espionage grand strategy game where you lead the intelligence agency of one of 74 playable countries. Rewrite history from the shadows as you influence ideologies, stage coups, and wage proxy wars. Subterfuge takes center stage as you establish a new world order.

games.name: HeartLinks: A Puzzle Called Love
games.summary: Solve puzzles with the power of friendship! Each student you befriend gives you a unique item that lets you unlock new areas and explore a wacky anime school! To deliver a confession to your crush, can you clear every obstacle? Can you overcome your feelings? Can you solve the puzzle called love?
aliases: DokiToki: Time Slows Down When You're In Love

games.name: Mad Chess
games.summary: Mad Chess is a turn-based strategy game that vastly expands on the classic game of chess. Explore a colorful fantasy world, recruit up to 20 unique factions, fight-off an alien invasion in a single-player story mode or battle your friends online!

games.name: Yuha's Nightmares
games.summary: This is a simulation game about the nightmares that our main character Yuha suffers from. You will explore the surrealistic world that is full of unexpected events. The deeper part of Yuha's consciousness is depicted through the flip side of the 3D world.

games.name: Midnight Laundry
games.summary: Midnight Laundry is a short first-person horror game where a long night at the laundromat takes an unexpected turn.

games.name: Imperial Grace
games.summary: Imperial Grace is a visual novel about romance, medieval intrigue, and political strategy. Will you rule with your head, or your heart?

games.name: Jury Trial
games.summary: Start your legal career in a law simulation RPG set in a divided and often unjust fictional country. Create your own attorney, study case files, uncover evidence, shape the jury, and fight for the verdict in court. Play the campaign or create, share, and download cases with the in-game Case Editor.

games.name: Explory Story
games.summary: Run around on the surface of many different stories. You can interact with the text, and the text can interact with you! There are boss battles, collectibles, a song, puzzles, and much more!

games.name: Check x Mate
games.summary: A fantasy visual novel set in a magical world of chess. Gameplay consists mainly of decision making and chess puzzles that represent what is happening in the story. There is a beginner difficulty for those new to chess and expert difficulty for those who seek more of a challenge.

games.name: Super/Human Identity
games.summary: An RPG/Visual Novel hybrid where your choices affect both your own fate and the fates of your companions. Dynamic relationship system, LGBTQIA+ inclusive romances, and Quick Time Event superhero action.

games.name: The Mysterious Cat Tower
