Thus, you'll need to search for vital elements necessary for life: Carbon, Hydrogen, Nitrogen, Oxygen, Phosphorus, and Sulfur. But beware, danger lurks on this unknown land, and your survival will depend on your ingenuity and skills. Traps abound, and you'll need to strategize to make it through.

Regularly, you'll have to shelter your character to escape ionic storms. Exploration will allow you to acquire new skills and enjoy more autonomy, speed, and gliding. Your biggest challenge? Managing your energy to avoid extinction.

games.name: Trizna
games.summary: “Trizna” is a classic plot-driven 2.5D metroidvania filled with intense battles utilizing the unique features of weapons, evasions, parries, and counterattacks. Explore the mysterious and eerie realm deeply intertwined with pagan beliefs, with blade, magic and a keen mind.

games.name: Byte Breach
games.summary: Co-op (1-4) sci-fi horror: Breach AI megacorps. Hack the world with an integrated digital overlay & execute skill-based data heists. Face escalating AI security - evasion is life. Can you make the breach?

games.name: Mecha Simultactics
games.summary: Mecha Simultactics is a multiplayer tactical party fighter with simultaneous-turn-based combat, customizable mechs, anime-inspired battle replays, and online PvP.

games.name: Permanent: Hope & Vacuum
games.summary: Psychological horror, puzzles, platforming, adventure, dungeons, action, intrigue and a terrifying story are all terms that should be used to try to define the essence of «Permanent: Hope & Vacuum».

games.name: Cosmic Holes Junior
games.summary: Imagine an alien Sudoku where the numbers are elements. Figure out which element to place on the grid, where, and when!? In order to maintain balance, each element must harmonize with the others. “Aliens don't play Sudoku—they play COSMIC HOLES!” For adults and children.

games.name: Love and Demons
games.summary: Dive into the fearsome demonic world! Step into the shoes of Max, a lazy prince who will be accompanied by three odd girls. Can you find a way to get him back home?

games.name: The Tale of Mara & Moa
games.summary: Mara and Moa have made a terrible mistake and now they need to find the Spirits of the Forest to save their village. Explore a world full of secrets with dynamic and fast-paced combat, alternating between the two characters and channeling the powers of the Sun and the Moon.

games.name: Veil of Madness
games.summary: Veil of Madness is a first person psychological horror deckbuilder, inspired by H.P. Lovecraft's Beyond the Wall of Sleep. Explore the depths of Sophia's consciousness, collecting and upgrading cards that are your only means of combat against the creatures born from her subconscious.

games.name: Estilhaço
games.summary: Immerse yourself in a world where technology blurs the boundaries of reality, solve puzzles, or escape from a relentless monster. Are you ready to face the horror lurking in the shadows?

games.name: Price for Freedom: Gold and Sand
games.summary: Gold and Sand is an erotic-CRPG with turn-based combat. Beautiful hand drawn art elevates this character driven game where you will explore the unique world and guide characters as they discover each other and themselves in fully animated erotic scenes.

games.name: Hope Timbre
games.summary: Guide a mysterious creature through imaginary realm at night, or help two siblings awaken their broken world during the day. In dreams, you traverse the colorful environments and solve puzzles to find various hope instruments. Later, use them to summon the spring and escape the never-ending cycle.

games.name: Airsoft Online
games.summary: Airsoft Online offers a realistic virtual airsoft experience for veterans of the community and beginners alike. Take part in team-based multiplayer battles, with customizable weapons and realistic physics.

games.name: Critical Upload
games.summary: Embark on a fast-paced action journey through space, discovering new weapons and abilities through acquisition and research to better each run. Invite friends to experience it with you!

games.name: Serial World
games.summary: Something strange is happening in Bricktown, and Milo’s on a mission to get to the bottom of it! Leave your home behind as you explore a series of dungeons with the help of your Anima - unusual creatures with unique personalities, abilities, and evolutions - to solve this mystery once and for all.

games.name: Food Devils
games.summary: You're the last chef in a post-apocalyptic world. Attract adventurers with monstrous food, make them sign contracts with the Food Devils and organize expeditions to collect wicked ingredients! Customize your characters, build the perfect restaurant and plan every move in this Tactics-RPG Roguelite.

games.name: Skyblivion
games.summary:
Skyblivion is the ultimate fan-made experience for the Elder Scrolls IV: Oblivion, bringing the game into the newer engine of the Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim. This process combines Oblivion’s impressive award-winning open-world that is renowned for its incredible gameplay, memorable quests, and expansive world space with the advancements in gaming that have been made in the last two decades. Set in the Elder Scroll’s Third Era, during the cataclysmic Oblivion Crisis, you must help to restore the Imperial throne and repel the demonic Daedric invasion.

Skyblivion will feature the remastered entirety of Oblivion’s mainland, Cyrodiil, from the wintery slopes of the Valus and Jerall Mountains to the swamps of Blackwood and warm-beachy shores of the Gold Coast. Skyblivion will bring the return of many classic Oblivion mechanics like spell crafting, a complete class and attributes system, underwater combat, and NPC disposition.

In addition to recreating Oblivion’s systems and porting them into the Elder Scrolls V: Skyrim’s engine the project has taken great care in providing new improvements and additions. Skyblivion offers fans remastered graphics, weather, and lighting, an expanded soundtrack, new gameplay mechanics, and even a limited selection of bespoke minor quests with original voice acting to further flesh out barren areas of Oblivion—all for free!

Once Skyblivion is released in 2025, fans will have access to the entirety of Oblivion’s pre-DLC world space, systems, and quests available for play. But that’s not the end of the project! Following a period of bug-fixing and community-supported updates the project development team will move on to working on Oblivion’s nine additional content releases plus the Shivering Isles expansion.

With Skyblivion you experience the best of both worlds: The complex and detailed RPG experience of Oblivion paired with Skyrim’s newer systems, graphics, and quality of life improvements. Will you close shut the jaws of Oblivion once more in 2025?

games.name: Revelation of Decay
games.summary: Zombies have taken over our homes! Pick up guns, organize a brave team, and fuck up those monsters! Farm land, scavenge a large apocalyptic world, and fight various of zombies! Modify your weapons, defeat scaring bosses, and finally uncover the truth behind the zombie outbreak and save our home!

games.name: Ultra Mushroom
games.summary: Hey! Wanna rise to the top at a festival stall? "Ultra Mushroom" is a high-energy game where you run a mushroom stall at a three-day festival and see how much you can earn. Gather mushrooms in the mountains by day and sell them at night. The key? Rhythmic banter and ultra mushrooms that bring joy!

games.name: Kai
games.summary: KAI is a game of Exploration and Adventure between the sidereal space and underwater depths. Skillfully lure and guide groups of fish to solve puzzles, access new areas and uncover the truth behind the mission entrusted to you, Akira, and the other crew members aboard the ship.

games.name: Earthborne
games.summary: Explore, craft, fight and develop an automated technological civilization complete with airships and robotic drones!

games.name: Benny's Backrooms
games.summary: A co-op horror where you and your friends (if applicable) explore a seemingly infinite expanse of eerie creature-infested liminal spaces, armed only with a glorified vacuum and specialized equipment to help you locate and extract a rare substance in the name of science.

games.name: Contract Cafe
games.summary: A letter from your Master brings a mysterious girl into your life. But the first thing you need to face is a café that could go out of business at any moment. Amidst your efforts to rescue the café and navigate peculiar customers, secrets about the shop begin to surface...

games.name: Dangerous Connections
games.summary: 1987. The Soviet Union is cracking from within. As special agent Dan Morris, navigate a world of shifting loyalties, covert operations, and ideological fractures in this story-driven Cold War FPS.

games.name: HyperFatal
games.summary: AIR STRAFE, ROCKET JUMP, and SURF your way through dimensions in this HYPER-intensive skill-based movement shooter of old. The onslaught of foes in your way are invading worlds, and the only way to stop them is to show you will be FATAL.

games.name: Jordi & Oslo: The Lost Tail
games.summary: Jordi & Oslo and the Lost Tail is a humorous point and click adventure game. Explore beautiful watercolour- painted locations, interact with quirky characters, and solve witty puzzles to help Jordi and Sigrid investigate the disappearance of their missing friend Oslo.

games.name: Malvinas: La Ultima Carta
games.summary: The last survivor of a battalion (a teenage soldier) must protect the last letter of his fallen comrades. Undergo the hunger, cold and violence the Argentinean soldiers had to endure during the war on the islands.

games.name: Cozy Dungeons
games.summary: Explore deadly dungeons, clear them out of enemies and renovate them in Cozy Dungeons, a one-of-a-kind adventure/interior design game!

games.name: Stop The F
games.summary: Stop The F is a first-person puzzle. Use the camera capable of capturing objects from reality into subspace and bringing them back. Use various filters that expand the camera's abilities.

games.name: Potion Punch Rivals
games.summary: Potion Punch Rivals is a multiplayer shopkeeping time management game. Cook, mix, dash, and serve in this wholesome online multiplayer cooking battle arena!

games.name: Bleakwood
games.summary: Absolute power corrupts absolutely in this roguelike deckbuilder that desecrates the very foundation of chess. Grow stronger with each run by unlocking cards, improving units, and making sacrifices - will you choose to defile your morals to reclaim what is yours?

games.name: Playable Alpha
games.summary: As researcher with great ambitions, and lack of talent, you are sent to a newly discovered planet far away from civilization. In this VR first person survival, you will need to build an outpost and survive the hostile environment. While exploring the planet, unveiling its secrets.

games.name: 1 AM Moscow Time
games.summary: A 2D adventure about rescuing magical creatures in Moscow and the role of a design bureau employee in this whole story.

games.name: Junxions
games.summary: Answer your true calling as a traffic engineer in Junxions! Featuring comprehensive simulation, construction, and management tools, use careful planning to build roadways, railways, and walkways, and the complex interactions between them.

games.name: Battle Vision Network
games.summary: Battle your way to victory in this cosmic tactical color-matching game. Recruit your ultimate team, equip them with powerful abilities and stun your opponent with overwhelming combos. Every tournament season is unique in this puzzle-battle roguelike.

games.name: Petal Runner
games.summary: Hop on your bike and join Cali and Kira as they ride across the sun-soaked city of Sapphire Valley and become Petal Runners! Make deliveries, meet new friends, play minigames, and discover a solarpunk, pixel art-powered open-world RPG about life, loss, and what we carry with us.

games.name: Curilemu
games.summary: Curilemu is an adventure-horror game inspired by the myths and legends of Chilean Patagonia. Immerse yourself in a haunting world filled with Lovecraftian horrors and ancient mysteries. Fight colossal beasts and discover what is behind the plague to heal this island and restore the cosmic balance.

games.name: Path for the Seeker
games.summary: Path For The Seeker is a detective adventure in which a young nun investigates the disappearance of a famous inventor in a city on the border of two worlds.

games.name: Gummy Nightmares
games.summary: Step into the enigmatic world of Gummy Nightmares as a little boy who wakes up in a mysterious amusement park with no memory. Explore, solve puzzles, and uncover lost memories while evading sinister plushie robots. Use weapons, set traps, and find hideouts to survive and reveal the truth.

games.name: Skylark 64
games.summary: A 64-bit 3D Collect-a-thon Platformer where you play as A flying squirrel who can glide, run, jump and roll in open non-linear levels collecting Acorns, Soul Leaves and 7 pieces of armor with unique power-ups! You can even play with a friend in Split-Screen Co-op!

games.name: Free Stars: Children of Infinity
games.summary: Free Stars: Children of Infinity is an open world space game, and the upcoming sequel to The Ur-Quan Masters (also known as Free Stars: The Ur-Quan Masters or Star Control II). The game began development in 2021 under Pistol Shrimp, a new studio co-founded by Star Control creators Fred Ford, Paul Reiche, Ken Ford and Dan Gerstein. As the copyright holders of the original story, Reiche and Ford intend to continue the saga from the previous games' events.

games.name: Whiskers Wonderland
games.summary: *Whiskers Wonderland™* is a horror adventure in a decaying hot dog joint with a dark past. Play as *John Lostheart* to uncover family secrets while evading *Mr. Whiskers*, a twisted animatronic cat, and searching for his missing sidekick, *Dr. Mouser*. Explore, dodge traps, and survive—if you can.

games.name: Five Laps at Freddy's
games.summary: Welcome to Five Laps at Freddy's, The premier animatronic kart racing circuit featuring your favorite and lovable Fazbear friends! Sponsored by Fazbear Entertainment

games.name: Backrooms
games.summary: Explore an abandoned liminal space. Uncover dark secrets through eerie exploration and environmental storytelling. Evade unpredictable supernatural entities and face psychological horror. Will you reveal the truth or become another lost soul?

games.name: Sloppy Forgeries
games.summary: Sloppy Forgeries is a fast-paced competitive painting game. Practice your skills by butchering iconic masterpieces in one of the few drawing games that measures accuracy pixel-by-pixel in real-time.

games.name: Heart Dungeon
games.summary: Heart Dungeon is a 2.5D Roguelite about defeating monsters and strengthening your heart. Leo is a boy who receives a new game from his mother and finds himself immersed in it, transported to a virtual world that manifests things from his reality within this fantasy.

games.name: Sigils of Nightfall
games.summary: Sigils of Nightfall is a roguelike deckbuilder that combines dungeon crawling with elements of the award-winning RPG, Mörk Borg. Embark on a dark journey, improve your character, and survive the horrors that will unleash the world's end.

games.name: Mizuki and the Crimson Moon
games.summary: Journey through a yokai-filled Japan in this 2D Action Platformer! Control Mizuki, a carefree and playful kitsune, as she investigates evil events happening around her village. Use her signature ability of teleportation to overcome obstacles and defeat enemies in this unique platformer adventure.

games.name: To Kill a God
games.summary: Craft your skill tree in this action roguelike where you must utilize skill and creativity to unleash devastating builds, all for one purpose. Break the Cycle. Kill a god.

games.name: Polyaris
games.summary: Survive the Arctic in this first-person single-player game. Move by skis and boat, stay warm, dry, and hydrated, loot what's left behind, fight enemies, and escape the lonely north by any means. For fans of The Long Dark and other similar survival games.

games.name: Brutalist
games.summary: Find your way through an abandoned concrete world full of mysteries and dangers. Beware of radiation and various enemies. The world is polluted and your suit needs oxygen replenishment. Finding a green paradise where you can still breathe will not be easy, will you cope?

games.name: Blightwreck
games.summary: Stuck at the bottom of the sea floor, escape a sunken ocean liner in this handcrafted 2D METROIDvania! Find powerful upgrades, and fight strange bosses. You may be isolated from your shipmates, but you're not alone...

games.name: Fruit of Choice
games.summary: Casual arcade game. Stay on the move and survive for a long time. Dash to dodge, attack, and explode bombs!

games.name: Cosminers
games.summary: Cosminers is a 1-4 player co-op FPP sci-fi building and mining game with survival elements based on day/night cycle. As a space miner kill various aliens on procedurally-generated planet's undergrounds. Craft and upgrade your tools, weapons & base to get countless hours of thrilling gameplay.

games.name: Impious
games.summary: You have been brought here for your sins. A dark turn-based RPG with roguelite elements inside an underground indoctrination center. Loot, craft and equip with a Diablo-style itemization system. Fight by managing your impulses and find your way out while making decisions and building your character.

games.name: Guns are Funs
games.summary: Guns are Funs is an arcade game that combines elements of a shooter, runner, and tower destruction. Immerse yourself in the world of toy soldiers who wage fierce battles for power and influence in the room. Bright dynamic battles, unique missions, and a variety of game modes await you.

games.name: Tempus Triad
games.summary: In Tempus Triad, dive into an ancient first-person horror scenario where a scientist is thrust into an era where huge predators dominate the land.

games.name: Shop Crush
games.summary: Shop Crush is a shop-owner simulator and visual novel set in the early 2000s. Stock a wide variety of goods, haggle with shoppers, and manage your reputation. Get to know your regulars and peel back the illusions tied to each persona as you slowly uncover the horrifying truth.

games.name: Star Child
games.summary: Star Child is an explosive new action-adventure set on a sinister alien planet. Fight numerous aliens and formidable bosses, wield powerful explosives and destructive laser weapons, find secrets and unlock new abilities as you progress. Can you survive your dangerous mission?

games.name: Iso-Core
games.summary: Farm, craft, build, and explore a Beautiful isometric pixel art world. Explore new places and find new biomes to expand your list of items, buildings, and recipes.

games.name: Effective Immediately
games.summary: All intergalactic travel passes through the orbital relay checkpoint. Verify ID discrepancies, repair vehicle systems and struggle against ethical dilemmas as you negotiate a shifting political landscape. Report for duty, Effective Immediately.

games.name: Nocturnal II
games.summary: Ignite your sword and explore the dark depths and towering heights of a forgotten island that consumed itself long ago.

games.name: Dungeons & Furries
games.summary: ✨What's more alluring than the charm of fantasy worlds? Answer: the same, but with sex. The more sex and magic, the better. Choose your character’s gender, solve match-three puzzles, enjoy the fully voiced animations, and find out how your story ends!✨

games.name: Dawn of Defense
games.summary: Dawn of Defense blends RTS, Tower Defense, and Roguelite progression. In a last defense, lead your tribe against the Empire: Command warriors in battle, fortify defenses, and build an economy as you fight to reclaim your ancestral homeland.

games.name: Gravitee Wars
games.summary: Battle across the galaxy in this turn-based space artillery game. Use the gravity of destructible planets to launch your shots at the enemy until only one team remains.Unlock new gear for your team members in the single player campaign and online multiplayer modes.

games.name: Solar Voltage
games.summary: After a huge solar storm destroyed their ship and left them stranded, help Volt and her crewmates escape the dangerous planet filled with deadly robots and a mysterious AI.

games.name: Dungeon Baller
games.summary: Pinball meets RPG in this fast-paced roguelike. Launch tiny heroes, battle bumper enemies, and choose your fate through mystery doors. Wield hundreds of powerful items and defeat bosses to reclaim your soul in this retro-inspired reimagining of pinball, where every bounce is a battle.

games.name: Chemist Wanted
games.summary: “Chemist Wanted” is a crafting game with a difference. In this lab simulator, you use real chemistry to create specific compounds. Set up your equipment, run the experiment and create your products. The higher the purity, the more money you will earn!

games.name: Mini Worlds
games.summary: Mini Worlds is a cozy building toy about creating tiny cities on a small world. Build and decorate with no goals or timer.

games.name: Airsoft Range
games.summary: Join an Airsoft free for all with no rules of engagement make friends betray your friends collect loot for an edge and more

games.name: Wire Throne
games.summary: Upgrade your ride and unleash devastating firepower to take down Wire Throne! One life, one car in this roguelite top-down looter shooter!

games.name: Trifoil
games.summary: A puzzle game about drawing lines that cross, merge, and interact in unique ways. Uncover secrets, decipher symbols, and trace paths that satisfy every rule.

games.name: Gaming Raiding
games.summary: Third-person shooter games

games.name: Umblight
games.summary: Descend through the corrupted underworld in Umblight, a gearpunk roguelike deckbuilder about merging your cards together. Build a deck of shadow and light cards strong enough to survive, but is it enough to reach the bottom of the world?

games.name: Barkour
games.summary: BARKOUR is a fast-paced action platformer with a stealthy twist, starring Agent T.H.U.N.D.E.R. - a tail-wagging master of parkour, high-tech gadgets and getting into trouble. Jump, sneak and fight your way through a spy adventure packed with action, canine chaos and delightfully absurd surprises.

games.name: CrisisX
games.summary: Immerse yourself into a realistic open world experience and find your way out in the ruins of a dying world. Survive the threats from the Infected, the living and most importantly, the wilderness. Fight or cooperate with others, and build your own territory. Build your own new post-apocalyptic world.

games.name: Croak
games.summary: Croak is a nimble -and challenging- precision platformer featuring an innovative grapple mechanic. Use the prince’s tongue to dash and bounce around through hundreds of hand-crafted rooms. Manipulate the environment as you traverse distinct biomes, each with unique gameplay mechanics and bosses.

games.name: Galactic Economy
games.summary: Your road to financial freedom leads to the stars. Acquire strategic sectors, manage complex loans, and mitigate systemic risks to grow your passive income. A gritty sci-fi tycoon strategy game where every decision determines your path to galactic domination.

games.name: Psycho Dead
games.summary: A third-person survival horror game that you play as a girl with psychic power who tries to escape from a secret lab and is pursued by deadly stalkers.

games.name: Shadows of the Werewolf
games.summary: Step into a thrilling and cinematic horror adventure where a couple falls victim to a ruthless werewolf and other nightmarish creatures. Unravel the dark secrets behind these horrors, fight for your life, and escape the terror under the looming full moon!

games.name: Match In Peace
games.summary: Match in Peace is a pair-matching real-time roguelike. Monster pairs are hiding inside cursed tombstones, match them to unleash their unique effects. Use special Stone cards, powerful Statues and magical Potions to defeat haunting enemies ahead.

games.name: Cain & Iddo: Break Week
games.summary:
Cain the dog and Iddo the hyena are two plucky 24-year-olds navigating life alone in the East Coast American metropolis of Westside City. Their zany misadventures don't turn out exactly as planned, wacky unforeseen circumstances arise, and hijinx ensues...

Cain works as a barista at the local mall's Starbuzz franchisee. Due to requirements from higher Starbuzz management, his boss Sergio has to give Cain a week off work for the summer. Cain and Iddo have decided to get some bucket list activities done over this week-long break... but you can probably guess that finishing that list is not going to be as simple as it seems.

games.name: Aetherian Chronicles
games.summary: Aetherian Chronicles is a 3D Casual SideScroller MMORPG focused on interaction with AI controlled players. Explore, train, party up, make friends and trade with real people or AI controlled players! Customize your character to your hearts content and choose your own way to experience your adventure!

games.name: Agni: Village of Calamity
games.summary: Agni, an investigator from a covert Indonesian police unit who defied orders and ventures into a remote village despite ominous warnings. What begins as an unauthorized investigation quickly plunges Agni into a horrifying reality

games.name: Yumezame no Kasetsu
games.summary: Yumezame no Kasetsu je hra z kategorie Simulace / Adventura pro PC (Microsoft Windows). Termín vydání: 2026.
developers: さめさめサメーション
publishers: さめさめサメーション

games.name: Dragon's Brew
games.summary: Dragon's Brew is a board game cafe simulator! Serve customers while fulfilling takeaway orders and delivery requests and build up your reputation in the vibrant seaside town of Pebblebrook. Source and grow your own ingredients, craft a variety of seasonal recipes, and expand your board game collection. Discover and unlock 100+ board games, each with its own effects and bonuses. Pair them with specific menu items to trigger unique effects and create powerful synergies that enhance your cafe’s operations and profits.

games.name: The Depths of Despair
games.summary: Slower-paced souls-like RPG with classic MMO progression, skills and ability bar. The world is grim and unforgiving, steeped in despair. Heavy punishment and consequences are naturally present.

games.name: Inazuma Eleven Re
games.summary: The story that started Inazuma Eleven will be revived in a remake!

games.name: ArcheAge Chronicles
games.summary: Explore Auroria, a vast and vibrant world brimming with rich lore and thrilling action. ArcheAge Chronicles delivers an immersive experience that will capture players' hearts, whether they are newcomers to the setting or seasoned adventurers.

games.name: Tanuki: Pon's Summer
games.summary: The Tanuki Festival is just a month away, and the shrine is in disrepair. Follow Pon, a well meaning, if a bit lazy Tanuki with a part-time job at the Post Office, as he works to restore the shrine before summer ends. Deliver packages, make friends, and get the shrine ready for the big festival!

games.name: Depth Loop
games.summary: A werewolf game set in a deep-sea lab, where the survival of humanity is at stake—does justice lie with humankind or the werewolves?

games.name: Spook-A-Boo
games.summary: Spook-A-Boo is a ghost hunting couch co-op game for 1-4 players. Play with friends and family to seek out and capture ghosts hiding in plain sight. Detect, scan, hook and trap all the troublemaking ghosts and have a spook-tacular time.

games.name: Akaku Forest
games.summary: Akaku Forest is a game that blends puzzles, platforming, and thrilling boss battles in a Metroidvania-style format. You take control of Aki-Maku, a courageous forest spirit. Use your torch to solve puzzles or face off against your enemies. Save the forest!

games.name: Nerd: Tracing Dayline
games.summary: A communication-themed adventure game starring a self-conscious teenage girl. Set in the quiet after-school hours of an ordinary high school, you’ll collect “topics” and use them to deepen your conversations.

games.name: Entwine
games.summary: A first-person psychological horror videogame. In St. Agnes’ Forest lay the death of Man, and inside, a tortured mind. Explore disturbingly real environments and solve intricate puzzles in a hand-crafted nightmare. “At the end of my life, I find the devil”.

games.name: Stratagem Lost
games.summary: Brave perilous turn-based strategy encounters and uncover dark conspiracies in a broken world. Draft your team of unique characters and have them learn skills from each other. Welcome to hard times—can you recover what's been lost?

games.name: Hark the Ghoul
games.summary: Slash, kick and magick your way through an adventure brimming with secrets and curious encounters! HARK THE GHOUL offers a meticulously handcrafted world to explore.

games.name: Ten Ten
games.summary: Ten Ten is a unique game that combines shooting, puzzles, and bullet-dodging.

games.name: Killer Chat: Extended Edition
games.summary: Killer Chat is a dark satire romance chatsim where you date serial killers. Pretend to be a serial killer, get inspiration for your book, fall in love, and try not to call the cops through a whirlwind six months with your murderous beau of choice. Who knows? You might find your happily ever after... or headline the news as a gruesomely lovesick corpse. It's honestly up to you.

games.name: Looppip
games.summary: Master time control with Looppip in a challenging platformer puzzle game! Rewind 3 seconds into the past to overcome traps, save beehives, and restore the balance of nature.

games.name: Sepulchron
games.summary: Trapped within Astor Manor, you have 72 hours to escape with your life. Solve challenging puzzles by day, endure deadly supernatural assaults by night, and uncover the truth behind the curse threatening your survival.

games.name: Problem Solver Club
games.summary: Solve school problems, face problematic girls

games.name: Beyond Astra
games.summary: Lead your civilization in a galaxy brimming with life and intrigue. Seamlessly explore and expand across uncharted worlds, from their surfaces to the stars. Forge your destiny in this sci-fi 4X offering a unique blend of grand strategy, planetary city-building, and RTS combat.

games.name: Alex's Journey to the Grave
games.summary: Two people meet in a strange, critical moment; changing their lives forever. An intimate visual novel exploring the nature of love, fate, tragedy, and the will to live on.

games.name: Owl Force
games.summary: Lead the legendary Owl Force and your wingmates on an epic journey defending the galaxy against the nefarious Darktail Order. Take on missions, upgrade your ship, and engage in heart-pounding battles to uncover the hidden secrets of the universe.

games.name: Wild Haven
games.summary: A short, relaxing nature builder about restoring a broken world. Start with a small shrine, clean up the pollution, and expand your powers as you build. Strategically place wildlife and plants to restore the ecosystem and watch your forest grow!

games.name: The Infectious Madness of Doctor Dekker 2
games.summary: An FMV game where YOU are a psychiatrist trying to solve a double murder whilst treating the unusual patients of the recently deceased Doctor Dekker. Ask questions and link answers to determine their fates, and your own!

games.name: Animal Use Protocol
games.summary: In this first-person, narrative-focused survival horror, you play as Penn, a hyper-intelligent chimpanzee. Hunted at every turn, your only chance of survival lies in scavenging, crafting, and exploring Anchorage Station. An epic story awaits. Be quick and quiet. Time is running out...

games.name: Nonolith
games.summary: The NONOLITH consumes you. Copy and paste the world around you to discover the secrets of this ancient, enigmatic structure. You are very powerful, you just don't know it yet.

games.name: Blades & Battles
games.summary: Relive the era of beat 'em ups in a new legend! Wield your sword as Arthur or Lancelot and fight side by side in epic battles inspired by the classic Golden Axe, now in 3D with pixelated 2.5D graphics and full of retro action.

games.name: Manipulus
games.summary:
Manipulus is a thrilling deck-building, choose-your-own-adventure game with rogue-like mechanics and perma-death. Trapped by mysterious forces, you are made to relive your past, guiding a band of survivors through perilous times.

As a Manipuli general, form strategic defensive lines and manoeuvre your followers to activate wild abilities to defeat the oncoming monsters and lead your band to safety. Re-play your cards, re-live your actions, and fight to keep your refugees alive in this dark and captivating adventure.

It's time to FORM THE MANIPULUS!

games.name: Don't Wake the Beast
games.summary: In Don't Wake the Beast, a roguelite stealth game, you’ll sneak through ever-changing dungeons to steal precious treasures guarded by deadly beasts. Use your trusty grappling hook to evade traps, outsmart enemies, and solve puzzles. But beware—each treasure you claim makes escaping more dangerous!

games.name: Void Dungeon
games.summary: Dress up your hero and dive into chaotic co-op dungeon runs. Void Dungeon is a 2D hack & slash ARPG where you battle relentless monsters, craft powerful builds, and explore dangerous rifts solo or with up to 4 players.

games.name: Rottenroots
games.summary: In this haunting visual novel, you become Salem - torn between forbidden love and regime loyalty. Make split-second decisions that transform his personality in a solarpunk dystopia. With multiple paths and endings, your choices define who Salem becomes in a world where being different is dangerous.

games.name: Haunted by Femboy
games.summary: In this sandbox visual novel, you unexpectedly inherit a mysterious mansion from your estranged father. After discovering an ancient book, you find that you are now haunted... by a Femboy?! Build your relationship with him while discovering the mysteries kept within the mansion.

games.name: Nox Mortalis
games.summary: Nox Mortalis is a retro-style open world survival game where you must gather resources, craft essential gear, and explore sinister dungeons. Face hellish creatures and fight to survive in this world.

games.name: HitTube
games.summary: HitTube is an open-world roguelike looter shooter, play solo or in 2–4 player co-op! You're a post-apocalyptic streamer who fights for donations while streaming your survival. Shoot, loot, trade and use magical cards to gain superpowers in a procedurally generated world!

games.name: Scorched Warfare
games.summary: This is a strategy action war game set in a fictional fantasy world. You play as a warmaster, commanding troops in battles. Use the roguelite system to customize your gameplay style: will you be a one-man army, standing against thousands, or a mastermind tactician controlling the battlefield?

games.name: Expedition: Into Darkness
games.summary: Brave forbidden dungeons in a quest for knowledge and treasure in this medieval PvE co-op extraction looter. Craft weapons, customise gear and join forces with up to four allies. Survive the ruins together—or lose everything you carry.

games.name: Chi Project
games.summary: Sci-fi fantasy visual novel, turn-based RPG, and murder mystery -- all in one!

games.name: Pebbles Quest
games.summary: The Princess has been kidnapped by evildoers! It is now Pebbles Quest to breach the Castle, face a gauntlet of traps and trials, all to rescue his one true love.

games.name: Karting of Banban
games.summary: Grip your steering wheel and join your favorite Banban characters in the race of a lifetime! Drift around tight corners and zoom through locations both old and new. Use power-ups and boosts to dodge your opponents and claim first place!

games.name: A Tiny Wander
games.summary: An exploration mystery adventure where the setting and narrative become the riddle. Hurry through the night, lantern in hand. And occasionally respite with a cup of coffee. Explore, discover, gather insight from interactions, delivering your parcel to the farthest reaches of the forest.

games.name: Life of a Lonely Indie Game Developer
games.summary: "Create the games you want, at the time you want, and live doing only what you love." In this realistic life simulation game, an independent game developer dreams of such a life, struggling with money and time while paying taxes until death. Whether this life is happy or truly lonely, you decide.
aliases: 孤独的独立游戏开发者的一生
孤独的獨立遊戲開發者的一生

games.name: Steampunk Shinobi
games.summary: Steampunk Shinobi is a roguelite action game set in a Steampunk/Medieval Japan-inspired world. Play as a lineage of Shinobi, where each death passes the quest to the next generation. Procedurally generated maps evolve with your actions, making every playthrough unique!

games.name: Pararecords
games.summary: As a counselor in a mysterious facility, you are to examine children with strange powers and fill in their "Paranormal Records". In this story-based, choice-driven game, you will have to pry open your subjects' minds... but what you find inside them could prove dangerous.

games.name: Pinbleton Park
games.summary: Pinbleton Park is a small open world cosy adventure game where the whole world can transform into a giant pinball table. Help the villagers, rescue lost spirits, craft new pinball elements, and take down the corporation bent on destroying the forest!

games.name: Cosmorons
games.summary: The Overlord demands you Conquer the Universe! Grab your friends in a 1-4 co-op roguelite shooter and deploy as grappling robot Drudges. Battle the alien swarms, complete missions and destroy the Cosmos! Stack outrageous upgrades to build the Ultimate Drudges or delve deeper into the Universe!

games.name: Take Us North
games.summary:
Take Us North is a narrative adventure survival game that follows the journeys of migrants and asylum seekers on their way to cross the US-Mexico border.

Inspired by real-world stories, Take Us North aims to foster greater awareness and empathy about some of the most crucial global issues of our time.

games.name: Feltopia
games.summary: Feltopia is a cozy, cinematic platformer set in a fully wooly world. Objects can be needle-felted and manipulated to solve puzzles and traverse through whimsical landscapes.

games.name: Flexible Frosty
games.summary: A short and icy GameBoy-style puzzle platformer featuring Frosty, a cute little penguin who can not jump like other penguins.

games.name: RPG Chess
games.summary: A turn-based RPG, except it’s also chess! Instead of capturing, your pieces fight in battles based on stats, levels and abilities. Build your team and battle friends or CPU's in 1v1 matches!

games.name: Snake in the Dark
games.summary: Sure, you've played Snake. But this is Snake like you've never seen before? Snake in the Dark is a total re-imagination of the timeless arcade and puzzle game classics like Snake, Sokoban, and Boulder Dash. Fun gameplay you know delivered with more puzzling twists than you expect!

games.name: Iseikan Renai Guide: Interplanetary Love Guide
games.summary: This PC game is a love simulation game set in the distant future where interstellar travel has become commonplace. Slavery, crime, violence... Interact with unique aliens and form close relationships with them in a world where anything is possible, where high technology and low technology coexist.

games.name: Ask Gear Re:Boost
games.summary: A new, straightforward RPG! Hot scenarios and battles that go right to the heart of JRPGs. For those of you who still feel your youth in the RPGs of the PS1 and PS2 generations, this is the game for you.

games.name: Deprision
games.summary: DEPRISION is a first-person survival horror game where you are the subject of a classified mental manipulation experiment. Explore environments distorted by memories and trauma, survive a system that adapts to your personal fears, and endure traumatic threats.

games.name: The Patient: Can You Escape?
games.summary: The Patient is a tense first-person escape game set in an atmospheric 1930s German sanatorium with subtle horror Elements. Explore the mysterious location, solve cunning puzzles, and hide from the doctor using a refined stealth system, while uncovering the disturbing truth about yourself and this eerie place.

games.name: Golf With Your Friends 2
games.summary: Golf With Your Friends is back, and this time it means fore. Up to 12 players, Chaos Mode, a new level editor, and enough questionable shots to end any friendship.

games.name: Already Dead
games.summary: Classic 90's style survival horror, reimagined for VR.

games.name: Work In Progress
games.summary: It’s your first day in office and half of the staff is already on burnout... Here is your gun, your contract. Now go fire some people.

games.name: Unearther
games.summary: Journey into different places and environments in search of resources and valuables. Make tools and equipments, survive the dangers and lurking monsters. Craft your way of living and discover the unknown world hidden in plain sight.

games.name: Dream Bar Simulator
games.summary: Become the Owner of Your Own Dream Bar! Create unique cocktails. Manage bar resources, buy alcohol and consumables. Expand and customize your bar, buy furniture and interior items, create the most comfortable atmosphere for your clients. Hire unique employees.Reach the top of the bar industry.

games.name: Star Life
games.summary: Star Life is a space sandbox RPG where you start on a planet and carve your own path. Develop skills through "learn by doing," influence dynamic economies, schedule your life with the "Life Planner," and face the challenges of space. Balance risk and survival in a universe shaped by your choices.

games.name: Syntaxia
games.summary: SYNTAXIA is a dream-dark adventure game that allows you to rewrite reality itself by changing the words that describe it. Use your creativity and intuition to escape. Which path will you choose?

games.name: Froggo's Adventure: Drifting Sky
games.summary: Drift across magical worlds of dreams and wonder as Froggo 🐸, who can jump, run or tongue his way through the obstacles. Drifting Sky is not only a simple, yet magical 2D platformer, but also a strange and bizarre videogame where you never know how things would progress.

games.name: Bat Galaxy
games.summary: Half on-rails shooter, half exploration-driven adventure. Zoom into a world where billions of bullets surround you and your handy punch feature can send enemies flying.

games.name: Elflock
games.summary: Immerse yourself in a fairy tale, where your actions shape the story! Become a princess, navigate the murky political landscape, forge an alliance with the Fae, or turn your back on them. Make decisions that could save your kingdom, or destroy it if you misjudge the circumstances.

games.name: Catfall
games.summary: Taking a cat on a spaceship? Great idea, as long as everything goes according to plan. It's a short road from fun adventures to sudden problems. And who knows? Maybe now the fate of the entire crew depends on one little fluffy hero... After all, cats always land on their paws, don’t they?

games.name: Nightmare Circus
games.summary: Nightmare Circus is a platform video game developed by Funcom and published by Tec Toy for the Sega Mega Drive. The game was first released in April 1996 on the Sega Channel in North America by Sega, and physically released on cartridge in Brazil sometime that same year. It was also released on the Sega Channel in Europe the following year.

games.name: The Gambit Lost to Time
games.summary: Become a time-travelling goddess entrusted with saving the world in this roguelike tactical RPG! With powers capable of altering time and terrain - serve one of three distinct, warring factions, and unite them over many timelines to break free from a time loop of doom.

games.name: Project TurboBlast
games.summary: Drift, boost, and spin around corners at BLASTING SPEEDS in this stylish Singleplayer + Multiplayer Arcade Racing game, Blending the familiar drifting of Kart racers and tight responsive handling of classic Anti-Gravity racing games. With a focus on being easy to pick up but difficult to master.

games.name: The Dropouts
games.summary: Heist your own school to get the exams' answers and discover why so many students have disappeared in Noirmont High. Spooky and nostalgic.

games.name: Re:Ver Project - Tokyo
games.summary: "Re:VER PROJECT TOKYO" co-developed by Toei Animation and indie developer Nestopi, is a survival suspense adventure game set in modern Tokyo depicted in pixel art. Yukinori Amane whos falsely accused of a crime, uses his survival skills to evade the police and uncover the real culprit.

games.name: Null Path
games.summary: Your skill, patience, and ingenuity will be tested in this homage to precision platformers! Traverse various biomes, from caves to volcanic wastelands and mysterious towers. Each environment with it's own deadly traps, puzzles, and challenges designed to push you to your limits.

games.name: Bugboy
games.summary: Catch, train and battle creepy crawlies and uncover the secrets of Spider Town in this retro Gameboy-style RPG.

games.name: CitaDrill
games.summary: Captain a giant drill-city in this roguelite citybuilder. Dig deep into an infested planet, collect resources, expand your city under the dome, upgrade your drill, and protect yourself against waves of fearsome creatures together with your mettle and paw-some cat crew.

games.name: Three Verses3
games.summary: THREE VERSES is a first person dungeon crawler / typing game based on poetry. Having shed your corporeal form, you must now escape purgatory by completing the simple task of delivering verses from deities to struggling poets.

games.name: Dragon Realms
games.summary: Be the dragon! Customise, upgrade, and dominate a vast fantasy world. Destroy castles, battle foes, gather treasure, and rule Dragon Realms!

games.name: Zaleste
games.summary: Shmup collaboration between Compile Heart and M2.

games.name: Pico Drift
games.summary: Explore the city as your ultimate racing arena. Dodge traffic, outsmart the cops, and challenge your friends. Experience official campaign tracks and game modes, or create your own playgrounds. This is your world - drive it your way

games.name: Baba Yaga
games.summary: A turn-based roguelike game of strategic combat and sinister magic. Decimate the king’s loyalist forces, grow your powers, and discover the reimagined origin story of Baba Yaga, the most feared witch of Slavic folklore!

games.name: Liminal Point
games.summary: Classic Survival Horror. Drawn to Ashen Point by a cryptic voicemail, Lyra returns to the island where her band’s story ended in tragedy. Shrouded in fog and prowled by horrors, confront deadly creatures, explore the desolate town, and reveal the truth behind the night that changed everything.

games.name: Croak Crusader: The Champion of Canada
games.summary: Do you dare save the Land of the Maple Leaf? Croak Crusader is a fast-paced, momentum-based action platformer featuring tight controls, explosive combat, and a versatile grapple mechanic.

games.name: Gretel's Honesty
games.summary: A comic-like visual novel, expressing a new story based on the fairy tale “Hansel and Gretel”.

games.name: Melt Away
games.summary: People end up forgetting about the dead.

games.name: Sangra
games.summary: Classic survival horror with a modern feel. Solve puzzles, search for items, manage your inventory, and pray you'll return to the safe room alive in this decaying twisted facility consumed by a mysterious metallic corruption.

games.name: Biofactory
games.summary: Build your living factory using organs and fleshy biomachines. Combine your pulsating machines to automate and scale up production. Mine, harvest, produce and assemble weird materials in a grimdark biopunk setting. You are an evolving hive-mind brain, driven by one instinct: The factory must grow.

games.name: Vice: Magic City Mayhem
games.summary: Vice: Magic City Mayhem is a retro action-adventure game where you fight, collect new items, and upgrade your character as you make your way through bustling nightclubs, scenic beaches, and raptor-infested yachts.

games.name: The Lightkeeper is Gone
games.summary: The Lightkeeper Is Gone is a retro-styled horror adventure set in the 1930's on a lone island. Take on the job of keeping the lighthouse while discovering the story of those that came before.

games.name: Near the Sun: Chapter 1
games.summary: God's punishment burns the earth to ashes, and eventually consumes the underground world as well. A stylish 2D stealth action game where how you explore determines your fate. A boy carries his sister on his back and races through the underground world.

games.name: Tower Deckfense
games.summary: Tower Deckfense is an exciting blend of tower defense and deck building. Build your deck strategically, upgrade your towers, and equip them with powerful modifiers to discover the best combinations and devastate your enemies.

games.name: Nightborn
games.summary: Fight, sneak, or charm your way through a gothic modern New Orleans as a Vampire detective of your creation. Unravel a vast centuries-old conspiracy involving Vampire factions, Werewolves, and far stranger horrors. Try to survive as a Nightborn without losing yourself to madness or damnation.

games.name: Super Debt
games.summary: Money is your life in SUPER DEBT! Fight to survive with an arsenal of wildly different weapons and upgrades. In this intense and challenging Twin-Stick Bullet-Hell Roguelike everything costs money, and we mean everything!

games.name: Tape Us Out
games.summary: Tape Us Out is an asymmetric, online co-op puzzle game. Players are sucked into a VHS tape and must face challenges of logic, coordination, and communication within the universe of old movies to find their way back to reality.

games.name: Deepspace Emporium
games.summary: Deepspace Emporium is a gritty shopkeeping sim set in the depths of a sprawling space station. As a former scavenger turned merchant, you trade in goods of varying legality—all while facing rising rent. Navigate a divided society, balance faction demands, and dodge authorities as you try to survive.

games.name: Ashes: Epoch
games.summary: Ashes: Epoch is a fan campaign being made by a fellow named Roobly. Vos gave him archive access so expect to see a lot of polished up cut content, including some stuff you oldhead Zdoom forums guys might recognize.

games.name: The Barkeeper
games.summary: A stylized top-down 3D bartender simulator. Your task is to quickly make cocktails & drinks according to recipes in a given time. Success depends on tactics, space planning and your adaptation speed. Ready for the challenge? Then grab your shaker and shake!

games.name: RockBeasts
games.summary: A rock-and-roll management RPG where you guide a 90s grunge band from garage obscurity to stadium glory. Set up gigs, manage egos, and navigate the music industry in an alternative America inhabited by larger-than-life anthropomorphic characters. Make it big without selling out.

games.name: Poem Ex Machina
games.summary: Anime style, Ride X Fight, fast paced game.

games.name: Cryptage
games.summary: A real-time action roguelite, you are a wizard venturing into a crypt full of monsters and buying new staffs and skins to improve yourself! The game has endless mode.

games.name: Mortal Quest
games.summary: A survival-adventure game about a mortal who's been transferred to a demon-infested island.

games.name: With Dream
games.summary: This is a story about two doctors who travel back in time to fulfill the last wish of a dying old man.

games.name: Fungiman 2
games.summary: Just another adventure with your friendly neighborhood fungus — nothing to worry about… probably?

games.name: The Final Fragment
games.summary: A GxG coming-of-age visual novel. Nina sucks at choosing. But when a mysterious incident happens at the arts academy, will she muster the courage to choose–or will she let someone else decide on her behalf?

games.name: Missi
games.summary: Missi is a cozy point & click game in a watercolor hand-drawn world. Find hidden objects and solve puzzles using clues in sketches of past adventures. Try to trick the Mushroom Spider and the Crow King by collecting all medicinal herbs for the sick little mouse.

games.name: Where Noble Plans Lie
games.summary: Build-up your territory, your team of advisors, and your reputation as you bring every other noble to ruin at the behest of the Vampire Queen. Make the kingdom yours in the city-builder and turn-based RPG: Where Noble Plans Lie!

games.name: Bless You Again
games.summary: Lily” is a magician and a homunculus. She challenges a dungeon named “Tomb of Blessings” in search of a certain blessing! The player controls a character faithfully reproduced from the cel animation and defeats many monsters in search of a powerful blessing.

games.name: Off-Score: A Game of Songs
games.summary: A surreal music puzzle game that transports you into the stories of our original fusion-jazz songs. Through a mysterious vinyl player sitting on a songwriter’s desk, explore the magical worlds that unfold along with the music and lyrics.

games.name: Clawsome
games.summary: Help Clawby find unique friends in this wholesome adventure! Collect cute figurines with the help of Clawby to create colorful dioramas in this cozy claw machine game.

games.name: Fate's Masquerade
games.summary: In this animated manhwa-inspired romance fantasy, toy with princes behind their perfect masks. Fall in love? Maybe. Make them fall for you? Absolutely. You are unpredictable, audacious, and just unhinged enough to make history. Heroine or villainess? Why not both?

games.name: DigSite
games.summary: DigSite is open-world archeology sandbox game located in Egypt where you dig, clean and document artifacts you find. Donate rare artifacts to a museum and build your legacy as a legendary archeologist.

games.name: Gig Crawler
games.summary: WardCorp is hiring. The pay is good. The dungeons are not. Co-op extraction roguelite, every contract hits different!

games.name: Rhythm Hotel
games.summary: Rhythm Hotel is open! Grab your camera and capture Einstein’s secret identity! Next door, Socrates is in a heated debate with a stubborn donkey. Don’t panic! It’s our special rhythm challenge — fall behind the beat and you might get kicked into a dimensional rift by the donkey!

games.name: Surge Generations
games.summary: Surge Generations is a complete overhaul of Shadow Generations with the goal of replacing everything Shadow-related with Surge, such as voice lines, cutscenes, animations, and more.

games.name: Lacey's Flash Games
games.summary: These are the REAL girls’ games. In the mid 2000s, Charlie (Charchar887), discovers the Laceys's Flash Games and their disturbing secrets. Step into the virtual world to uncover the whereabouts of the missing website creator, Rocio Yani, and explore all the games and activities with Lacey!

games.name: Death In Your Dice
games.summary: Roll the dice… or cities die. Learn lethal rules, twist outcomes, accept the cost. One bad throw calls the bombs. Win to delay death. Lose to become a murderer. Every choice reshapes your ending. Fate is loaded. Your turn is encoded?

games.name: Angelic Agency: Soul Salvation Unit
games.summary:
"Angelic Agency: Soul Salvation Unit" is a mystery adventure featuring a public security duo tackling supernatural cases.

Players take on the role of Tsujitsuma, a member of the "Angelic Agency" investigating "Ghosturbance Cases." The game progresses through three phases: (1) Conversation Part, (2) Deduction Part, and (3) Salvation Part.

Players navigate these phases to uncover the truth behind each incident.
aliases: 天使機構執行部魂救済課

games.name: Rootbound
games.summary: A physics-based action adventure about a plantling’s quest to save its home from a mysterious blight. Equipped with your sentient backpack, you venture into a broken world. Meet lost souls, solve ancient puzzles, fight dangerous monsters, and uncover the secrets of a long-forgotten civilization.

games.name: 100 Cats Philippines
games.summary: Find 100 Cats hidden in Philippines! Can you find them all? 😺

games.name: Appulse
games.summary: An intense top-down shooter roguelite inspired by pinball mechanics. Master every shot with precision in the heat of the battle, and protect your mothership from waves of invading robots. Upgrade your equipment and conquer spaceships to win the war!

games.name: Metal Coffin
games.summary: War has been raging for decades with no signs of it stopping. Take your chance in bringing an end to it in this high focus strategy game. Manage your troops, your supplies and protect your flagship at all costs and you might just be able make it to the capital of the nation.

games.name: Animas
games.summary: Animas is a first-person psychological horror experience that plunges you into the dark secrets of the Blanco family. Explore a cursed house in the Venezuelan mountains, where time unravels to reveal decades of sectarian rituals and familial tragedies.

games.name: Ice on the Edge
games.summary: Become a coach in ICE on the EDGE, a figure skating simulation game. Train your athlete, master skills, and craft the perfect routine to win. Face fierce rivals and experience a dramatic story carved on the ice. Can your guidance lead them to the highest stage?

games.name: Recital of the Heart
games.summary: Battle and befriend new and familiar characters alike in this Adventure/Action game filled with discovery and whimsy. Experiment with an array of abilities and modifications as you explore a mirror world and unlock its secrets to reach the princess.

games.name: Moonbrella
games.summary: A 2D platformer Metroidvania with deep movement and no jump button. Upgrade your umbrella to explore an abandoned planet and ascend to the moon.

games.name: Phase Zero
games.summary: Phase Zero is an unfinished shooter video game that was being developed by Hyper Image Productions and would have been published by Atari for the Atari Jaguar. Set in the future on a terrestrial planet, the player takes on the role of a newcomer to the Phase Zero squad, piloting a hovercraft to fight rival corporate states. The player is tasked with various objectives while fighting enemies in multiple missions. Phase Zero was the first project by Hyper Image, a game company led by Jeremy Gordon, Matías Duarte, and brothers Otávio Good and Paul Good.

games.name: Ghost Sector
games.summary: Ghost Sector is a survival horror game where you play as M-07, a prototype machine trapped in a cybernetic facility during lockdown. Outwit the automated defenses, search for answers uncovering secrets, solving puzzles, and upgrade your abilities while preserving your finite energy.

games.name: Wanted 3D: Dead or Alive
games.summary: Grab your bandolier and saddle up for Wanted 3D, a UZDoom-powered Spaghetti Western FPS! It's time to settle the score with your former gang and reclaim what is rightfully yours. Are you ready for the wildest showdown the Wild West has to offer?

games.name: Crimson Frontier
games.summary: Crimson Frontier – a fast‑paced top‑down shooter in the world of cyberpunk with the vibe of 90s action movies in single player mode, like super‑macho who crushes every enemy standing in his way.

games.name: Hero's Hand
games.summary: Embark on the ultimate Poker-Based Roguelike RPG Adventure! Hero’s Hand packs a strategic punch! Become the Knight of Spades & save the land of Cardunia! The game features hand drawn animation, humorous fantasy monsters, & addictive turn-based poker combat that keeps you coming back for more!

games.name: Digimon Alysion
games.summary: A new Digimon TCG game being developed for mobile.

games.name: Unravel Trigger: Cold War
games.summary: The sequel to Unravel Trigger: Prelude to War.

games.name: Raev: Kingdom on the Distant Shores
games.summary: From a humble campfire to a multi-city kingdom, lead with grace in RAEV: Kingdom on the Distant Shores: a unique kingdom builder where every decision shapes the fate of your fox citizens and the legacy of your continent-spanning kingdom. With a freeform building system, no grids, no limits.
aliases: RAEV: Kingdom on the Distant Shores

games.name: Dark Mass
games.summary: Dark Mass is a fully underwater horror game. Explore the ruins of a sunken manor and flee from a curse trapped within for centuries. Your choices will decide if you escape or join the lost souls of the abyss.

games.name: Memory Adventures in the Jungle
games.summary: A pleasant breeze of ease and casual fun ... or a satisfying challenge and strategy - you decide how you want to play the game ! Also, a lot of cute animals !

games.name: Melted Time
games.summary: Candle, your path is full of puzzles. Can you handle it? Hurry, your time is already melting away.

games.name: Uppercute
games.summary: Uppercute is a 3D action platformer where, with the help of your sister and the use of your runner skills, you’ll dive into people's minds, face challenging opponents and retrieve valuable information to solve the mystery of your brother's disappearance.

games.name: Night Blood W: Cutthroat Wolf
games.summary: "Nightblood W: Cutthroat Wolf" is a cyberpunk action role-playing game. You will play the role of an ambitious gang cadre. Your goal is to challenge and eliminate the rebellious Frey Gang alone, prove your strength, and eventually reach the top of the gang to control the entire city.

games.name: Speak of my sin
games.summary: Speak of My Sin is a word reasoning game - players are supposed to find the truth of the cases, restore the story in a number of interrelated cases and finally detect the identification of “me”, speaking out “my” sin.

games.name: Striker!
games.summary: STRIKER! is a retro-inspired football-golf game set across 40+ levels. Control your team of Strikers and shoot your ball over a wide range of different courses and mechanics.

games.name: Fatal Dopamine
games.summary: Play as a nameless gambler who arrives at a mysterious gambling table, constantly challenging different opponents. At this table, the stakes are not money but life itself.

games.name: Nephelia: Through the Clouds
games.summary: Take control of your own airship, hire people for your crew, help them on their personal stories, follow the trail of a whimsical inventor of the colonisation era, trade, fight, discover, and try to stay afloat.

games.name: Cereal Reaper
games.summary: Cereal Reaper is a top-down turn-based RPG with a heavy focus on exploration. Talk and fight your way into finding the greatest breakfast item of all time.

games.name: Soviet Spooky Tales: Green Eyes
games.summary: A nonlinear pixel art visual novel set in the 1980s Soviet Union, inspired by Soviet children's spooky stories.

games.name: Immortal Boy
games.summary: A 2.5D Turn-Based RPG where you battle enemies with Minigames! - And also emotional abuse.

games.name: Hydraulic Slam
games.summary: In this turn-based, tactical tennis simulation you build, control and improve your own tennis robot. Play on grass, clay and hard courts and balance your energy, precision and condition throughout the match. Maintain and develop your robot between matches.

games.name: Digital Legacy of Zero
games.summary: Battle with creatures you collect to defeat the evil Ruler of the Digital World. Hack and slash through enemy domains, upgrade your basement to achieve ultimate evolutions, and summon legendary beasts. Unlock powerful upgrades with devastating combos to conquer the Digital World.

games.name: Galago
games.summary: As night falls, a galago — also known as a bush baby — ventures into suburbia, searching for elusive golden fireflies. But the world is perilous for one so small… Galago is an exploration-platformer, blending puzzle-solving, survival, and mystery.

games.name: The Duskbloods
games.summary: An online multiplayer PvPvE game where players vie for supremacy among themselves and against challenging foes. Play as the "Bloodsworn"; a group that has transcended human strength thanks to their special blood, and throw yourself into a violent fray for "First Blood" as the twilight of humanity approaches. The moontears will flow for one and one alone.

games.name: Drownlight
games.summary: Drownlight is a city-building survival simulator set in a flooded world. Build and expand your city around a lighthouse, manage resources, and make moral decisions that shape the fate of the survivors. Secrets lurk in the raging waters, and if the lighthouse goes out, the city may be lost forever.

games.name: Groda
games.summary: GRODA is an intense arcade experience, blending nerve-wracking action with precision platforming and rogue elements

games.name: Spot Zero
games.summary: Spot Zero is a mission-driven anime action RPG where you lead a squad of Human and Yokai investigators through monster-controlled zones, securing outposts and pushing the frontline, with each character fighting in a distinct style from blade clashes to TPS mode and elemental bursts.

games.name: Pelican Post
games.summary:
Pelican Post is a cozy narrative game about delivering mail to a town of unique characters and helping to regain a lost sense of community.

You play as Pepper, a young pelican who recently moved to Port Pleasant to take a job as the town's mailman. Through your job, you'll get to interact with and get to know the townsfolk and help them out.

"Small acts of kindness" is pretty much in the job description.

games.name: Fantasy World Manager
games.summary: Create a vast, living fantasy world: heroes, creatures, quests and events; cultures, religions and factions; overworlds, interiors and dungeons-filled with stories, wars and choices.

games.name: Drug Schedule
games.summary: Build your empire! Cook and make illegal drugs, expand your cartel, and outsmart rivals and law enforcement. Play solo or team up in co-op to dominate the underworld! Your empire, your rules. Rise to power! Don't get high on your own dope!

games.name: The Calling
games.summary: An anime-inspired free-to-play PvP arena shooter where every match is shaped by your build, strategy, and creativity. Customize your abilities, adapt to dynamic weather and day-night cycles, and outplay the competition in fast-paced battles.

games.name: Ikuma: The Frozen Compass
games.summary: Embark on a haunting journey into the cold in this narrative adventure - either alone or with a friend. IKUMA tells the story of Sam, a teenage boy who finds himself stranded in the Arctic with his dog. He must face not only its harsh environment, but also something lurking deeper in the shadows.

games.name: Flooded Burials
games.summary: Flooded Burials is an adventure game about exploring a sunken tower. Lower the water levels by completing stages, and find out what lays at the bottom of this strange structure as you explore further down it's depths.

games.name: Rain98
games.summary: Tokyo, 1998. A rain that never ends and a girl who wants everything to end. Two lonely youths will change the world with their choices.

games.name: Insectile
games.summary: Collect cute bugs with puzzling shapes and powerful abilities in INSECTILE, an RPG with a unique, tile-based battle system. Explore a giant garden tracking down and assembling your party of little creatures, then call upon them to shape the perfect attack!

games.name: In a World After People
games.summary: This is the story of humanity and a robot reaching their “end.” A lonely yet beautiful post-apocalyptic pixel-art narrative adventure, following a robot that awakens after humanity’s extinction until the moment it shuts itself down. Experience a rich and memorable journey lasting around two hours.

games.name: Beak Island Visitor Center
games.summary: You’re Beak Peak National Park’s first Ranger! Between quirky locals and bustling visitors, it’s always buzzing. Enjoy a slow coffee stroll or keep things tidy on patrol. Beak island is now in your hands.

games.name: Magical Girl Critical Deluxe
games.summary: "If magic doesn't work,then you beat with stick!" Action game in which a magical girl is transferred to another world and struggles

games.name: Do Not Play
games.summary: "DO NOT PLAY" " is a point-and-click horror adventure. Even if you reach the "truth" that lies beyond playing, we take no responsibility for any phenomena that occurs there. Please handle with extreme caution.

games.name: Clean Start
games.summary: Clean and organize other people’s homes while uncovering emotional stories through the objects you find. Discover each room’s unique history, dig up secrets, and feel the satisfaction of tidying up the space in this wholesome, casual puzzle game about new beginnings in a foreign country.

games.name: Dreadmoor
games.summary: DREADMOOR is a dark first-person fishing adventure game set in a submerged world, rotting from a past catastrophe. Fish in murky waters, upgrade your boat, craft survival gear, and fight monstrous creatures that lurk under the water and on the land.

games.name: Dicewood
games.summary: A tiny pack of tiny creatures was lost in the woods. The food was scarce, they had to choose who will be left behind... Fight through the dark forest and save all the creatures.

games.name: Hyperfight 2
games.summary: Your meter is your life. Use it wisely or risk it all in this brand-new take on 2D fighting. This is the next evolution of HYPERFIGHT!

games.name: Slain 2: The Beast Within
games.summary: A brutal gothic hack-and-slash where steel and savagery collide. As Prince Akran, wield the sentient blade Bathoryn, embrace your werewolf fury, and battle through a dying world against the forces of Vroll. The quest begins now.

games.name: Ember & Blade
games.summary: Become the immortal hunter and stand against the archdemon Asmodeus. Cut through bullet-hell swarms, clash with Souls-like bosses, and harness celestial blessings that reshape your powers each run. The demons are rising—raise your sword.

games.name: Tales of Tuscany
games.summary: A choose-your-own-adventure RPG with fast-paced bullet hell battles! Play as a small chaotic sheep named Lambypoo, gaslight enemies into joining your party or defeat them for EXP as you save your cousins, rebuild your village, and BAAA loud enough to destroy everything in the overworld.

games.name: Cozy Beach
games.summary: 🏝️ Cozy Beach is a wholesome game set on an beautiful tropical island where you can fish and explore, solo or with friends. Catch and collect fish, go swimming, search for treasure, craft tropical drinks, or just hang out and chill!

games.name: Potion in Motion
games.summary: Brew potions, cast spells, and master alchemy in a fast-paced potion shop where magic and language intertwine. Experiment with weird ingredients, and manage quirky customers while avoiding failures! Every potion is a puzzle, but will you perfect your craft or turn your shop into a disaster zone?

games.name: Sugar Sling Showdown
games.summary: Sling candies and fling sugar bombs at your friends in this tongue-based, chaotic, physics party game. Play against each other or join forces against enemies. Win rewards and use them to build your own ToffeeTown in a candy-coated world.

games.name: Splash Girls
games.summary: Splash Girls is an exhilarating shooting action game in which you must save girls who have grown gigantic due to a mysterious virus. Players wield a vaccine-firing gun and a massive syringe to stand against the rampaging virus. The only thing that can save these giant girls is your extra-thick injection!? An flashy rescue mission of extraordinary scale and intensity is about to begin.

games.name: Questing
games.summary: A satirical love-letter to classic 16-bit adventure games, about a chosen hero who never wanted to be chosen.

games.name: The Spirit Engine DX
games.summary: The Spirit Engine DX is a complete rewrite of the cult classic indie title from 2003 by Mark Pay. Instead of using a traditional turn-based system, an auto battler with real-time pausing is opted to allow players to switch tactics at their own pace without constant menu prompts.

games.name: Cucina Stellata: Starred Cuisine
games.summary:
Gastronomy meets horror in an unsettling narrative experience set in 19th-century Romagna, Italy.

Step into the shoes of a solitary writer and gourmet, inspired by the historical figure of Pellegrino Artusi, as a midnight snack spirals into the unexpected.

Cucina Stellata ✦ Starred Cuisine isn't your typical horror game: no frantic chases or cheap jump scares, but rather a thick atmosphere of tension, disturbing themes, and chilling twists that will linger in your mind long after the credits roll.

games.name: Demon Bluff
games.summary: The cards lie! In this single-player social deduction game, demons have infiltrated your village and disguised themselves as allies. Every card you turn over is either a friend or a foe. Can you see through their bluff?

games.name: Eternal Palace Sakura
games.summary: Sharpen your blades and step into the Eternal Palace Sakura, a dream labyrinth haunted by restless yokai. Battle through ever-shifting realms in this anime-inspired 3D action roguelite, mastering fluid combat and exploring endless floors of the palace!

games.name: Catena
games.summary: Catena is a surname. Notable people with the surname include: Alejandro Catena (born 1994), Spanish footballer Elena Catena (1920–2012), Spanish academic Gerardo Catena (1902–2000), American mobster Laura Catena (born 1967), Argentine vintner, physician and author Marina Catena, Italian soldier and United Nations official Michela Catena (born 1999), Italian footballer Paulus Catena (fl. 353–362), Roman notary and investigator Tom Catena (born 1964), American physician and humanitarian Víctor Andrés Catena (1925–2009), Spanish screenwriter and film, television and theater director Vincenzo Catena (c. 1470–1531), Italian painter

games.name: The Shadow Syndicate
games.summary: The Shadow Syndicate is a stylized noir stealth-action game set in 1930s Brooklyn. Sneak, fight, and uncover a dark conspiracy using supernatural powers. Explore a vibrant city, play mini-games, and solve mysteries in this thrilling cinematic experience.

games.name: Deus Mantle
games.summary: Craft, build, fight monsters, discover new technologies and explore an infinite procedurally generated world! Delve into unknown worlds to uncover ancient secrets and return home.

games.name: Plush Party
games.summary: Get ready to challenge family and friends in PLUSH PARTY, the ultimate party game for all ages! Customize your cat, escape the claw, and be the last plushie standing!

games.name: Project; Virai: Doomer's Life Escape
games.summary: Help a doomer girl make her VTuber persona popular and escape her depressive routine. If you can.

games.name: Exovia
games.summary: Exovia is a physics-based mining and automation sandbox in space. Survey asteroids, engineer zero-G logistics without conveyor belts, and design complex Newtonian factories. Turn floating chaos into perfect order and experience true inner peace as you solve one satisfying problem and then the next.

games.name: Cappy & Tappy: Temples of Peril
games.summary: Follow Cappy & Tappy through their block-stacking, platforming, worldwide adventure! Stack massive blocks as Tappy to help Cappy explore, survive and escape. Play with a friend or juggle both roles solo to escape crumbling temples packed with devious traps, colossal bosses, and mysterious idols.

games.name: World of Dogs
games.summary: A high-velocity emergent shooter set in a city paid to bleed and built to fall. God is laughing.

games.name: L8r Sk8r
games.summary: L8R SK8R is a 3D platformer inspired by the classics of the fifth generation but with a unique twist that will make you feel like a speedrunner.

games.name: Monolith's Dreamers
games.summary: A captivating 2D puzzle game where strategic thinking is essential. Explore the world of the Monoliths, outwit the traps guarding the ruins, and help the inhabitants. Solve puzzles that block your progress by collecting and redistributing energy.

games.name: Vikings Dynasty
games.summary: Embrace viking life and earn Valhalla’s blessing. Survive in the harsh norse environments and praise the Gods. Become a Jarl, control every aspect of your village and protect your community at all costs. Build and customize ships and explore the fjords in the unforgiving world of Vikings Dynasty.

games.name: Bloodstone Rising
games.summary: Bloodstone Rising is a high-intensity co-op FPS roguelike. Gather your fellow space dwarves, mine resources, forge upgrades, and fight off relentless zombie hordes as you reclaim your ancestral kingdom.

games.name: Escape the Baby Alarm
games.summary: Parenthood as told through a cozy, psychedelic, puzzle adventure. Solve hand-drawn escape room-inspired puzzles inside a baby alarm. Find your way out through mashed peas, pacifiers and sleepless nights. Funny, heartfelt, and beautifully illustrated.

games.name: Sucks To Be In The Sticks
games.summary: A teenage vampire getting hooked on blood in a world that traded it for energy. See the absolute worst of what humans do to one another in every drop. It destroys you. You hate it. And yet, crawl back for more. A narrative adventure about a rather short eternity.

games.name: Tarvos Desolation
games.summary: Survive on a hostile moon full of nightmares! Face hordes of monsters, explore mysterious locations, and uncover secrets that may save your life. Will you find a way to escape, or will you be consumed by the darkness of Tarvos?

games.name: Drakefall
games.summary: Explore the World of Drakefall in this roguelike deckbuilder. Build your deck, piece together the broken world, and journey through swamps and mountain peaks with a familiar playstyle.

games.name: Diner Simulator
games.summary: Run your own cozy diner solo or with friends! Cook, serve, clean, and manage the chaos in this fast-paced restaurant sim. Expand your café, customize your menu, and turn kitchen mayhem into delicious fun — or total disaster!

games.name: Exo Helljumper: Descent X
games.summary: Enter the chaotic world of Exo Helljumper: Descent X, filled with mutated foes and lurking dangers. Combine items and strategy to conquer relentless levels. Face unique foes and formidable bosses, test your cunning and skills, and feel the thrill of battle as you push beyond your limits!

games.name: VoidWalker: Call of Insomnia
games.summary: Immerse yourself in the world of dreams and discover its secrets, enjoying every moment thanks to photorealistic graphics

games.name: Whiskers and Wizardry
games.summary: Mr. Sparkle’s tale has gone wrong. To escape the nightmare, you must combine runes to craft your own spells and survive relentless bullet-hell chaos.

games.name: Project Horizon
games.summary: Project Horizon was a 1959 study to determine the feasibility of constructing a scientific / military base on the Moon, at a time when the U.S. Department of the Army, Department of the Navy, and Department of the Air Force had total responsibility for U.S. space program plans. On June 8, 1959, a group at the Army Ballistic Missile Agency (ABMA) produced for the Army a report titled Project Horizon, A U.S. Army Study for the Establishment of a Lunar Military Outpost.

games.name: Sekira
