games.summary: Lost Call is a top down pixel art 2D Zelda inspired game with a metroidvania style map. Take off on a quest through an abandoned and ruined town to stop your phone from ringing all the time, and learn more about the characters who still remain within it.

games.name: A Little Less Desperation
games.summary: When a peaceful farmer is abducted by an alien, he cannot imagine how this experience will turn him into a hero that needs to save the galaxy. Suddenly, alien abduction is funny again.

games.name: Artemis VR
games.summary: As an Artemis astronaut, face the challenges of space flight in the newest manned system that will take humanity back to the Moon thanks to NASA resources and consultation in terms of Artemis MIssions. Manage the mission using VR glasses.

games.name: Trypan
games.summary: TRYPAN - A survival horror experience centered on exploration, resourcefulness, and sheer will to survive. Investigate your father's disappearance in the abandoned town of Stagmon.

games.name: Oddinary Farm
games.summary: Stuck on an alien TV show where your death is entertainment, you must escape a variety of bizarre islands filled with riches and deadly creatures before impending doom consumes you.

games.name: Serenity
games.summary: Serenity (born October 29, 1969) is an American former pornographic actress who worked with Wicked Pictures and Hollywood Video. In 2002, she was ranked one of "The Top 50 Porn Stars of All Time" by Adult Video News. She also worked as a reporter for various news channels and is an outspoken advocate for animal rights.

games.name: Caten Village
games.summary: As war erupts between the Dominion and the Kingdom Iori, from the borderlands, is drawn into the chaos This is a story-driven traditional turn-based RPG, where players embark on an adventure across a war-torn continent, and witness conflicts that will change the fate of the entire world

games.name: Quest for Choices: Ivan's Tale - Chapter 0+1
games.summary: Quest for Choices: Ivan's Tale is a choice-driven visual novel. From his present perspective, Ivan uses VR and a brain‑computer interface AI to revisit memories. Inside the simulation, he influences his past self to make different choices—and the AI instantly simulates new life paths.

games.name: When I’m Not Drawing
games.summary: In this cozy life-simulation RPG, you play as a young woman who moves to a new city to pursue her dream of becoming an artist. Manage your schedule, balance life and career, explore the city, and meet new friends. Live a fulfilling year on your own, at your own pace.

games.name: Tangles 2
games.summary: On the remote island of Scirine, Majed, a young biology intern, arrives at Al-Bayan Research Center, expecting scientific breakthroughs. But his journey turns into a descent into mystery as he uncovers terrifying truths, where reality blends with illusions, revealing more secrets with every step.

games.name: Wrong Treatment
games.summary: Wrong Treatment is a psychological horror survival game where the protagonist's mind becomes the main setting.

games.name: Hellwire
games.summary: A mathematical hell for 2-4 players where only the thrill matters — our law is ETERNAL GAMBLE. You're a DEMON among demons — play cards, gamble your mind, and smash faces. Luck won't save you.

games.name: Which Sea Is This?
games.summary: Which Sea Is This? is a local co-op sea adventure where you control a single ship together. Trade, explore, pirate, and argue about directions — because nobody knows where you are.

games.name: Stray Night
games.summary: Experience a puzzle-build roguelite hack-and-slash adventure. As a stray cat in a nightmare, strategically combine puzzle blocks to customize skills and defeat inner trauma. Overcome the walls of loneliness and discover your true identity through fast-paced combat and permanent progression.

games.name: Kayotica
games.summary: In Kayotica, you play as April—a clever but manipulative student caught in a web of friendship, rivalry, and dark crimes. What begins as ordinary campus life quickly turns into a mystery of betrayal, hidden truths, and a shocking murder. Can you solve the mystery, or will you become the next victim?

games.name: Fly Cowboy Online
games.summary: Fly Cowboy Online- is a massive free-to-play multiplayer online game centered around a faction war for strategic resources amidst the ruins of civilization. Fierce aerial battles in the devastated world of Naviika await you-conquer the skies or burn trying.

games.name: They're Gonna Get In
games.summary: They're Gonna Get In is an RTS/Roguelite where you play as an advisor to the ruler of a failing kingdom. Your enemy mirrors you. A wall will fall. The only question is whose breaks first.

games.name: Never Clean
games.summary: A minimalist game about collecting strange and absurd trash. Walk around, pick up items, sell your finds, unlock upgrades, and complete your collection. Play to relax or compete with others for the best time. It costs no more than an everyday small purchase and stays with you forever

games.name: BloodSpiller
games.summary: BloodSpiller is a retro-action platformer that blends classic visuals and game play with modern flair and attitude.

games.name: American Cooking Simulator: Multiplayer
games.summary: Team up in chaotic co-op shifts at Joe’s Freedom Burgers! Cook with guns, serve hungry customers, and travel across a totally normal, definitely accurate version of America in the most patriotic cooking sim of all time.

games.name: Yami Mura
games.summary: Emica awakens in her city's train station, compelled to walk through darkness and the anxiety of being stranded in a strange world. She must escape by solving puzzles.

games.name: Choom
games.summary: Choom is a fast-paced cyberpunk roguelike shooter blending side-scrolling action with bullet-hell chaos. Upgrade weapons, choose powerful buffs, and fight through shifting levels where death means starting over and adapting fast.

games.name: Takeover 2
games.summary: Take to the streets solo or with a partner in this fast paced, high-impact arcade beat ’em up. Takeover returns with refined gameplay, upgraded visuals and a pulse-pounding new soundtrack.

games.name: Rural Cat Trails
games.summary: Explore Nanoha Town, in the Japanese countryside, during the cherry blossom season as a cat. Use unique cat actions like Wall Jump, Dig, Paw Swat and Wiggle Butt Dash to make your way to Sakurana Shrine, a place of memories with your late Grandpa.

games.name: Mad Mojo
games.summary:
Think Inscryption meets Pokémon.
Mad MOJO is an action-packed monster-catching deckbuilder with a hidden layer of fourth-wall-breaking psychological horror. Hunt for the legendary Prime MOJO using poker-inspired hands, real-time parries, and game-breaking elemental Tokens. But beware of the MOJO hiding just beyond your reach...

games.name: Fleshborn
games.summary: Flesh born is a short incremental game where you are tasked to clean a facility by burning down fleshy growths.

games.name: Nexvultus
games.summary: Nexvultus dives into a co-op horror experience where you seal fractures in reality to contain a collapsing world, to prevent the escape of what's looming on the other side.

games.name: Dreem Ascension
games.summary: Explore the Dreemscape Darklands and uncover it's dark secrets in this story-driven survival horror boomer shooter.

games.name: City God Alice
games.summary: Cursed with only a year left to live, serving her in this City God temple is the only way you can stay alive long enough to uncover the truth behind the curse.

games.name: Grim Path
games.summary: A card-driven strategy roguelike where every step is a choice. Descend into dark dungeons, battle monsters, face various encounters, and collect powerful items in fast, easy-to-pick-up runs filled with meaningful decisions.

games.name: Beat Weaver
games.summary:
3D multi-track rhythm action with space-time bending mechanics that reward your style as much as your precision. Hit notes and switch tracks to add instruments to the mix. Become a remix machine, enter the flow state and uniquely approach each song of a highly replayable, genre-defying soundtrack.

Each journey through a song creates a unique mix driven by your choices. Improvise new routes and string together perfect combos. Fling yourself across tracks or dare to perform multiple instruments simultaneously.

Groove to a vibrant, eclectic soundtrack (made by humans, not machines) composed & selected for a never before seen synergy between music and gameplay.

games.name: CornerQuest
games.summary: Corner Quest is a cozy idle auto-battler that lives in a small window on your desktop, following the journey of a solitary mage you work, study, or browse.

games.name: Skeleboy
games.summary: Skeleboy is a Breakout-like action Rogue-lite game. Guide Skeleboy through Hell, upgrade his skulls to perfection and save the bones of the dead Princess! Be the Skeleboy you always wanted to be.

games.name: Involuntary Fighting Simulator
games.summary:
An absurd, unique, and simple auto battler that is full of over the top violence and silliness. You will manage, equip and train your volunteers to compete at the highest level!

Unlock, purchase and customize your volunteers with over 50 items that have randomized values using the color system everyone loves! Weapons will range from the standard sword and maces to power tools and adult toys. Plenty of purely cosmetic items are available to get those volunteers looking just right!

games.name: Mitch
games.summary: Mitch is a short form of the masculine given name Mitchell. It is also sometimes a nickname, usually for a person with the surname Mitchell. It may refer to:

games.name: Kittenpire
games.summary: Epic, character-focused tower defense where upgradable cats fight giant, monstrous mice.

games.name: ToMyX
games.summary: ToMyX is a narrative arcade action game that blends Visual Novel storytelling with fast-paced action, puzzles and emotional confrontations. Inspired by the developer's real past relationships, players must survive a surreal TV game show where memories become gameplay and every chapter ends with a Final Judgment.

games.name: BASED
games.summary: BASED is a co-op platformer where you combo the Moon to the sky every night. Master movement and weapons to rise the Moon in one piece. Who knows what secrets you'll find on your way up. Join B.A.S.E.D. tonight!

games.name: Hoa 2
games.summary: Hoa 2 will transport you to a beautiful world. Explore, interact with nature, solve puzzles and seek to bring life back to a special friend.

games.name: Veils of the Past
games.summary: A psychological mystery where every clue reshapes reality. Unravel the link between a vanished woman and your missing sister, only to discover four entirely different truths, each revealing a new world, a new enemy, and the price of remembering.

games.name: By Sword & Road
games.summary: Minimalistic RTS game about logistics and war! On this battlefield, supply lines are everything - cut them off and your enemies will wither, or use special abilities to gain the advantage. The game features an original story campaign and skirmish challenges. Conquer your enemies by Sword & Road!

games.name: Frontier Control: Invasion
games.summary: Frontier Control: Invasion is a Real-Time Strategy survival game in which you play the commander of a human space colony under the attack of outer space robots. Build your base, train your colony, and fight herds of enemies and bosses.

games.name: Tokens
games.summary: A deckbuilder roguelike that flips the rules with double-sided tokens. Line them up to trigger powerful Harmonies, forge synergies with Arcanes and Effigies, and face Mister Mirage’s exciting challenges.

games.name: Invisum Piscium
games.summary: An atmosphere-driven walking simulator where you explore familiar yet unsettling spaces, interact with fragmented conversations, and influence partial changes in the world through small actions, observation, and quiet choices that shape how the experience unfolds.

games.name: The Witch and the Hundred Knight Mobile
games.summary: An upcoming mobile game based on The Witch and the Hundred Knight series.
series: The Witch and the Hundred Knight

games.name: Gata Guressi
games.summary: Learn to communicate with the people of Hierre by speaking their languages and understanding their cultures in this sci-fi translation game. Use your translation skills to navigate Kallay Tirridor, uncovering its dark secrets while solving the sudden disappearance of your brother.

games.name: Car For Sale Together
games.summary: Car For Sale Together is a co-op car trading simulation where you and your friends build a dealership from scratch. Explore the town, find cars, negotiate deals, complete side activities, uncover mysteries, and grow your shared business together.

games.name: Brush Burial: Bruiseland
games.summary: You are a hunter of men, and your quarry is numerous, armed, and afraid. Bind and break them. This is a first-person immersive sim with tightly interconnected environments, sleek and sadistic melee combat, and over a hundred cosmetics to unlock.

games.name: Thornetica
games.summary: Thornetica is a strategy rpg and slice of life visual novel that revolves around the university’s theatre club. Engage in classic strategy combat, choose who to cast as each role in the play when these kids jump on stage to perform. Take the time to unwind, bond and play minigames in the backstage!

games.name: Blighten
games.summary: Blighten is a survival horror fps set in an abandoned facility overrun by mindless creatures infected by the Blight. Scavenge for resources and do whatever it takes to survive the industrial hellscape you're isolated within.

games.name: Kitman
games.summary: KITMAN is a 1-4 player sports management simulator set in the backrooms of a stadium. Run the team by running the locker room. Clean the team’s boots, patch jerseys, mop floors, and when no-one is looking… sneak into the gaffer’s office and fix the game plan!

games.name: Lull: Rest After Crying
games.summary: A horror action-adventure in which a young girl carrying a baby on her back attempts to escape a mysterious facility twisted by endless renovations.

games.name: A Toast for the End Times
games.summary: In a blasted world teeming with undead, a barkeep and a young girl run the Time's End Tavern, a lone oasis amidst this barren wasteland. In a desolate landscape ravaged by Zombies and Raiders, that one drink they love, and a few kind words, help everyone remember why it's all worth it.

games.name: Love WMC
games.summary: Love WMC is a visual novel game based on music games. It tells a series of stories about the protagonist who came to a small county town to study alone due to family conflicts, and accidentally got involved with four female protagonists because of an arcade music game.

games.name: Pikku Adventure
games.summary: A challenging puzzle adventure about learning an alien language. Explore a strange world and meet its cute inhabitants. Decipher the language and earn their trust. With every word learned, you will uncover more secrets. Can you solve the mystery of this world and decide the fate of the Pikku?

games.name: Gently Packed
games.summary: Gently Packed is a relaxing cozy sim where you step into the shoes of a cashier working in a charming, cartoon-style supermarket! Your main task is to scan products and pack them thoughtfully, considering shape, weight, and fragility. The better you serve your customers, the bigger the tips you'll receive! But that's not all - as the owner of a franchise for a major corporation, you'll also manage your store, upgrade it, and pay off the loan you took to start your business.

games.name: One Song, One Life
games.summary: “One Song, One Life” is a rhythm adventure game where the music and story change based on the notes you hit. Take control of Sumire Kirishima, a girl striving to become the ultimate net artist and perform alongside her idol. Your performance will shape her destiny—one song, one life.

games.name: Nakano Jinkaku Ishoku Kenkyuushou
games.summary: Nakano Jinkaku Ishoku Kenkyuushou je hra z kategorie Point-and-click / Adventura od studia Men-ya Spice Tokyo Shiten pro PC (Microsoft Windows). Termín vydání: 2026.
developers: 麺屋すぱいす 東京支店
publishers: 麺屋すぱいす 東京支店

games.name: Car Mechanic Simulator 2026
games.summary: Build, repair, and grow your automotive empire — now also in co-op mode! Run a workshop together, fix cars, and expand your collection. Hundreds of configurations, thousands of parts, and full customization await!

games.name: The Internal
games.summary: A time-based action roguelike where you battle twisted simulations of your co-workers and climb the corporate ladder before the clock hits 1700.

games.name: Murderplanet
games.summary: Fight to the death in the arena-based action roguelike game show, Murderplanet. Craft a build of ridiculous and broken synergies to weave and cleave through hordes of enemies. Survive each wave, stake out Capture Points, earn heaps of cash and further customize your runs for maximum arcade chaos.

games.name: Storm The House Collection
games.summary: Defend your base, upgrade your arsenal, and survive the siege! The iconic Storm the House trilogy of fixed-position shooters returns from the golden age of Flash, now preserved and better than ever.

games.name: Cup Or Die
games.summary: Survive in a creepy bar playing beer pong against terrifying opponents in roguelite style. Throw the ball into cups with various effects, collect weird items and passive cards, choose doors, play mini-games. Miss a shot — drink. Every cup you drink can give a bonus or kill you.

games.name: Spinbot
games.summary: A roguelite drenched in 00's competitive shooter vibes. In Spinbot, you trade your soul for cheats. Wipe out waves of bots and upgrade your "wordprocessor.exe" with some amazing features.

games.name: Daydream Drifters
games.summary: Dungeons, enemies, items — everything is randomly generated in this roguelike stealth horror. As events occur over time, hiding alone is not enough—you must be ready to fight. Explore three seamlessly connected random dungeons and survive the daydream. And when you awaken, what will you see…?

games.name: Surface
games.summary: A Linear first person exploration adventure. The game is about exploring detailed and creepy liminal environments without monsters or puzzles, you simply walk and look around.

games.name: Azimuth
games.summary: Azimut (z arabského السمت (as-samat), znamenající “směr”) je úhel, který ve vodorovné rovině svírá určitý směr se severním nebo jižním směrem. Azimut slouží k určování polohy pozorovaného objektu a navigaci.

games.name: VPetlings
games.summary: Raise your own virtual pet right on your desktop. Choose your favorite, take care of your companion, play together, train for battle, and help them evolve! They will always be there, keeping you company while you work, play, or browse.

games.name: Escape the Doom
games.summary: Master control of your Hypercraft as you race through time to escape the impending Doom. Fly fast and dodge hazards in this endless runner unlike any other.

games.name: Instruments of Power
games.summary: Build powerful spells in this tactical RPG, then send disposable avatars into battle to unleash them. Explore ancient sites of power, devastate foes with your magic, and acquire forgotten knowledge. But where does true power come from?

games.name: Automa
games.summary: A VR action-adventure with deep physics-based interactions, systemic gameplay, and a gripping near-future mystery as a rogue AI overruns a Southeast Asian city. In a near-future city seized by AI, you made a deal to save your family—but at what cost?

games.name: Lost Entry
games.summary: Lost Entry is a horror game where you search the Deep Web for information while avoiding enemies that adapt to your actions. Your goal is to survive the night and complete the task your employer gives you without getting murdered by a bunch of Deep Web killers.

games.name: Payday: Aces High
games.summary: Mask up as one of The Aces, an elite group of heisters with access to bleeding-edge tech, black-market toys, and weapons no sane dealer would list. Framed by business titan Warren Jupiter and thrown in jail, the time has come for you to hit him where it hurts: banks, museums—hell, even his so-called “untouchable” penthouse.

games.name: Windwalkers: Below the Storm
games.summary: Lead high-risk surface rescue operations across a storm-scarred Earth. Power your rover, tools, and modular pack with limited energy resources as you recover survivors, salvage critical supplies, and help reclaim the world above.

games.name: Echoes
games.summary:
Immerse yourself in a first-person psychological horror experience where every choice matters. Explore a cursed environment shaped by echoes of the past, uncover hidden truths, and reconstruct fragments of a forgotten story.

As you progress, your decisions and interactions will influence the outcome, leading to multiple possible endings. Solve observation-based puzzles, interpret subtle clues, and confront the unsettling presence that lingers in the environment.

games.name: Crystal Vein
games.summary: The "Crystallization" a disease where crystalline veins course through the body, eventually encasing it entirely in crystals. A girl, afflicted by this illness, embarks on a journey to find a place of salvation. A 2D action adventure game about loss and coming of age.

games.name: Castle Away
games.summary:
The realm’s surface is cursed by demons. While you are exploring, you discover some sort of crown. As you pick it up, the ground begins to tremble and the surface starts to rise. You find yourself on a massive, floating keep...

Castle Away is a roguelite autobattle castle builder, where you scavenge for goods, slay monsters, and enhance your keep. Adapt your castle's layout to the materials you find and the enemies you face. Try a new build every run!

Features:

Deep Customisation: Find 50 different Structures with 3 upgrade tiers, 30 Banner types and 30 different Boons, all with unique rules to build killer synergies.

Challenging Enemies: Face off against 20 Monsters and 5 massive Demon Bosses.

Encounter Variety: Discover Shops, Henchmen, Shamans, Towns, Cities and more.

5 Distinct Realms: Navigate through five worlds to find all Ancient Seals.

Roguelike Replayability: Random encounters, multiple endings, and procedural loot ensure fresh runs.

games.name: Tiles of War
games.summary:
Tiles of War is a turn-based tactics game where players fight for control of a map by capturing territories and defeating enemy units. Each tile on the map can be captured to become part of your territories, and more territories means more money, and more money means better troops to fight your enemies with.

With 18 different commanders of 3 different factions, each faction with their own campaign, you will face challenging battles in a variety of scenarios. And if that's not enough, and you want to prove the world, you are the best, then the competitive multiplayer mode, with an elo ranking system awaits you.

games.name: Crime Scene Cleaner: Biohazard
games.summary: Step into a world of toxic conspiracies and industrial sabotage in Crime Scene Cleaner: Biohazard. An ambitious fuel baron has unleashed a dangerous “miracle” fuel – Chernoxide – claiming it will revolutionize the American fuel market forever. The substance, however, is highly toxic, and when radical eco-terrorists sabotage the baron’s operations, radioactive chaos spreads across the city. Your job is to clean up the aftermath, stop the contamination, and hide the true dangers of Chernoxide from the public before the truth comes out.

games.name: SeverSoul Xookeeper
games.summary: Keep the entities fed, pacified and contained every night within a dark decaying facility. Can you survive each shift in this intense point & click horror?

games.name: HiroBot: Clean & Restore
games.summary: HiroBot: Clean & Restore is a relaxing single-player game you can enjoy at your own pace. Clean up dirt, dispose of trash, and restore objects. Reach every nook and cranny with your jetpack, and experience the satisfaction of bringing grimy areas back to life!

games.name: Onii-chan Continue!: Secret Love With Yuri
games.summary: Yuri lives with her big brother, Hayato. Though she looks like a model student in public, in reality she likes to laze around at home and play video games. Though they sometimes argue, she loves her big brother. As Hayato accepts another game challenge from Yuri, so begins his trouble-filled days...

games.name: Gothic Steel
games.summary: Gothic Steel is a grimdark, retro, survivor-like, wave shooter. Command a heavily armed tank against the horde, assemble your crew, and forge an unstoppable war machine.

games.name: [Redacted]
games.summary: Get ready to massacre monsters, race your rivals, and combat corpses of your fellow guards as you race to escape Black Iron Prison in the critically acclaimed roguelike, [REDACTED].

games.name: Shothop
games.summary: Shothop is a violent retro boomer-shooter blending fast-paced movement mechanics with brutal combat. Utilize movement mechanics, cleanse the robot invasion, and restore the portal defense network. Reboot the grid. Survive the shift.

games.name: Kanun 1919
games.summary: An action-adventure game set in a dieselpunk world. You are an imperial courier tasked with investigating the disappearance of a special cargo in the sealed-off city of Turov. Uncover its dark secrets and face the unknown. The fate of the city—and perhaps the entire world—rests on your shoulders!

games.name: Pastry Pile Up
games.summary: Drop and merge pastries to create bigger, more delicious treats! Serve your sweet creations to adorable cat customers to earn coins. Use your coins to fully customize your cozy bakery, and compete on the global leaderboard to achieve the highest score.

games.name: Please Fix the Mess
games.summary: Clean up chaotic interiors, remove trash, repaint walls, and redecorate messy spaces, sometimes with a few suspiciously bodies lying around.

games.name: The Glory Dungeon Raider
games.summary: Enter the depths of a treacherous dungeon in The Glory Dungeon Raider, a fast-paced 2D roguelike where every run is a new challenge! Arm yourself with various weapons, and face off against deadly creatures. Do you have what it takes to survive?

games.name: Murino: The Fog Is Coming
games.summary:
Murino: The Fog Is Coming is an atmospheric first-person horror game about the life of a courier in the endless district of Murino, where apartment blocks disappear into the fog, familiar routes stop being reliable, and an ordinary delivery job slowly turns into a fight for survival.

The player lives in one of Murino’s apartments, in Building P-352, and works as a courier. Each day begins as routine - accept an order, leave the apartment, pass through entrances, courtyards, and service corridors, reach the destination, and return home. But in Murino, even the simplest job quickly becomes dangerous. The buildings seem to stretch on forever, the courtyards all look the same, and the Fog and the Samosbor make every familiar path less and less safe.

games.name: The Last Opening
games.summary:
Play chess against Death. One move at a time.
Survive the cold, gather what you can, and shape a world where every action echoes on the board.

games.name: The Last Errant
games.summary: The Last Errant is a challenging, turn-based tactical deckbuilder where every move counts. Build your deck, master unique classes and variants, manage your sanity, evolve and mutate your cards, shape your playstyle through meaningful choices, and outthink your enemies on a grid-based battlefield with extreme replayability.

games.name: GlagStone
games.summary: GlagStone is a story-driven city-builder set on a mysterious island between warring nations, brought to life in a stark black-and-white style. Rebuild a fading settlement, guide its people through hardship, and uncover secrets hidden in diaries, ruins, and the depths of the lake.

games.name: Beyond Yardwork Simulator
games.summary: Gardening has never been this rewarding! Use a full arsenal of tools – from lawnmowers to pressure washers – to transform properties and earn money to renovate your own home. With intuitive mechanics and beautiful visuals, it’s the perfect stress-free relaxation for everyone.

games.name: Woe Reigns Unending
games.summary: Lead a cursed party through a ruined world in this grimdark side-scrolling RPG. Build your team, master tactical combat, and unleash forbidden powers to survive an endless parade of nightmares. Decide what, if anything, is worth salvaging from a world that has been reduced to ashes.

games.name: Canvas Attack!
games.summary: Step into the bohemian world of early 20th-century France in Canvas Attack! This roguelike deckbuilder transforms the act of painting into a tactical puzzle battle. Fill empty canvas cells before despair overwhelms you, and juggle your finances and sanity to survive.

games.name: World Inverted
games.summary: The sky lies beneath our feet. Above stretches a vast plane. From it hang forests of inverted buildings, linked by narrow corridors and pipes. They stand in silence, like upside-down obelisks pointing toward the eye of the sun. This game reveals an upside-down world through words and unique visuals.

games.name: Echograve
games.summary: Ensure the safety of the underground city. Manage the system through the terminal. Listen and watch carefully. It seems to have already made its way inside...

games.name: Heroic Musical Chairs
games.summary: Battle friends and family in an heroic, high-stakes game of musical chairs ! On your couch or online, with easy-to-handle controls, play cartoonish sports wizards in dozens of wacky and merciless arenas. Fight and race with bravery, player, and you shall become the true ruler of the one chair.

games.name: My Hero Academia: United Survival
aliases: 僕のヒーローアカデミア UNITED SURVIVAL

games.name: Lurking
games.summary: Lurking is a first-person survival horror game set in a building infested by giant spiders. Search for tools and weapons to fight back and survive. Find a way out before you're eaten alive.

games.name: Wheelie Bad
games.summary: Pilot a wheelchair together and prove you're the superior driver. In this chaotic game, every single crash is definitely your partner's fault. Adapt as the game constantly introduces and mixes new mechanics. Survive the madness, or drive solo to show you were the carry.

games.name: Bunker 1024
games.summary: Manage a bunker. Protect survivors. Outsmart a rogue AI. Bunker 1024 is a first person survival management game where you craft tech, maintain critical systems, and deliver aid as time grows thin - all while Lumina 6.0 studies your patterns and actively works against your routines.

games.name: Non Eternals
games.summary: A single-player command action RPG with MMORPG-style combat. Features a quirky system where placing skill commands next to the UI boosts their power! Rescue the creators from the Dark Lord, who manifests their inner darkness as monsters!

games.name: Alchemia Rogue: Mia and the Mystery Labyrinth
games.summary: Join Mia, an apprentice alchemist, in the Alchemy Roguelike RPG. Alchemy brings new layers of strategy to traditional grid-based, turn-based roguelike gameplay. Gather materials, transmute them into powerful items, and conquer the dungeon!

games.name: Russian Village Business
games.summary: Become a young entrepreneur who arrives in the Russian countryside and opens a village shop. Buy and sell goods, upgrade your store, and make this village great again - just like in the good old days!

games.name: Disquieted
games.summary: Disquieted is a hand-drawn action platformer set between a dreamlike Naples and an underground world distorted by anxiety. As Connie, fight, dodge, choose power-ups, and face the demons hiding beneath the city.

games.name: Hostyle
games.summary: HOSTYLE follows agent Cryptic's job interview to become an assassin for the most corrupt company on earth. This fast-paced 3D platformer combines stylish movement options alongside a futuristic but nostalgic Y2K aesthetic.

games.name: Pokor
games.summary: Pokor is a story-driven roguelike tactical turn-based card RPG. Players take on the role of Heart, commanding a deck of playing card soldiers to engage in turn-based battles against enemies as they venture deeper into a vast, pale, and ever-changing palace to uncover the truth and the true self.

games.name: Inkremental
games.summary: Inkremental is a short incremental game about splattering paint across canvases by bursting blobs of color. Revisit iconic artworks with a humorous twist, unlock upgrades, and take down quirky mini‑bosses as you bring each masterpiece to life.

games.name: Brotato: Primal Dread
games.summary: Brotato is a top-down arena shooter roguelite where you play a potato wielding up to 6 weapons at a time to fight off hordes of aliens. Choose from a variety of traits and items to create unique builds and survive until help arrives.

games.name: Too Deep To Quit
games.summary: Grab your gear and your friends for a hilarious, golden-age co-op adventure! Dive into cursed temples, hunt for the ultimate treasure, and work together to stay alive. Beware of everything and everyone... after all, only the survivors get to split the gold!

games.name: CrackSword
games.summary: A lo-fi fantasy slasher hand-drawn in colored pencil. Sketchy swords, weird physics, surreal magic cards, and ragdoll puppets with a serious grudge against their master.

games.name: Financial Freedom
games.summary: Why can't games teach as much as books? I read 50 business books and trainings and made a short funny game about a businessman's journey. Follow the story from a factory worker 🧑‍ to a millionaire!

games.name: Drunk Woodcutter
games.summary: Chop wood, drink beer, hack yourself in the kneecap. A physics-based incremental sim about splitting firewood, increasingly ridiculous equipment, and bad judgment.

games.name: Pufflings: Journey Through a Fantasy World
Backpack Alchemist
games.summary: Manage your own cozy medieval alchemy shop! Pack your limited leather backpack with rare potions, odd ingredients, and magical relics. Solve satisfying grid-based inventory puzzles to fulfill customer orders and become the realm's greatest alchemist.

games.name: Atrum
games.summary: Atrum is a dark fantasy, third-person roguelike where you play as a powerful mage descending into darkness. Fight challenging enemies and bosses across corrupted realms and collect magical items to shape your build before the darkness consumes you.

games.name: Deeper Still
games.summary: A really hard immersive sim set in a dystopian and nihilistic world. To complete each level, start with a plan by choosing weapons, paths and abilities. Die. Find a better plan. Die again. Repeat until you finish the level. Then replay the levels to find new creative ways to beat them.

games.name: Hack Fate
games.summary: Hack Fate is a fast-paced, cyberpunk pixel-style hack-and-slash action game. In a flash of lightning, control time and space, switch identities, and deliver swift, fatal blows to all enemies. But if it's the heavens you're up against? Then you shall hack fate itself.

games.name: Aliens Go Home ReRun
games.summary: Brick-breaking and SHMUP elements combine in this 2.5D remake of the 2017 title Aliens Go Home Run, with new stages, characters, and more! Play ball... Again!

games.name: Icarus-Bolt
games.summary: Icarus-Bolt is a single-player open-world platformer set in on an off world mining colony, where something has gone terribly wrong.

games.name: What We Bring
games.summary: What We Bring is a cozy puzzle game about the objects that shape a life. Organize, sort, and pack through the years, choosing what items to carry forward. The items you keep shape the character’s future, influencing the path they take in a branching narrative story.

games.name: Jirai-kei Girl: Vengeance
games.summary: “I'll show you what happens when you make me angry.”The heart of Jirai-kei Girl, betrayed by her beloved boyfriend, is torn between love and hatred.Her overflowing emotions eventually take the form of a “revenge drama.”[Take down the other woman and corner the boyfriend who betrayed you!]

games.name: Tango District
games.summary:
Tango District is a puzzle style cyberpunk city-builder where every move is a balancing act.
Grow your district by buying buildings from powerful corporations, but don’t let them take over as you fight to stay financially afloat.
Shape your city’s identity through smart placement, as buildings adapt to nearby structures, boosting your fame and population in unexpected ways.
Keep citizens on your side by making bold, sometimes outrageous decisions during events, or risk corruption spreading through your streets. In a city where power, money, and reputation collide, every choice defines your future.

games.name: Half Left
games.summary: Trapped inside a quarantined research complex, a wheelchair-bound nurse must survive a curse beyond human comprehension.

games.name: You're Nuts!
games.summary: Escape from a decaying industrial maze where logic is the only way out. Scout for shortcuts, scavenge parts to craft upgrades and make sure to come back to your safety hub each day to protect your cover. A cozy co-op adventure for 1-4 sentient robots. Can you find the key and reach the exit in time?

games.name: Infinitory
games.summary: Infinitory mixes city-building, automation, and tower defense in a in a rogue-lite top-down game. Expand your base vertically in limited space, a strategic planning challenge. Automate resources to produce ammunition and upgrades, crucial for stopping waves of enemies on procedurally generated maps.

games.name: One Coin Museum
games.summary: Explore, collect, and curate your very own cozy museum! In One Coin Museum, sail across vast oceans to uncover treasures with your claw. Display them to attract visitors, and grow your reputation. Upgrade your boat to travel farther and discover the world’s hidden wonders.

games.name: The Adventures of Graham
games.summary: A sci-fi retro Metroidvania. Help Brigadier General Graham recover his gear, defeat enemies, and complete his mission.

games.name: Master of Chaos
games.summary: Pulverize your enemies for underestimating this cute little wizard by counter attacks, deflecting projectiles, unleashing face-melting ultimate abilities and building insane combos boosting your power until you are strong enough to beat the boss or break the game - Either way you win.

games.name: Banneret
games.summary: A Banneret was the name of an officer or magistrate of Rome towards the close of the 14th century. The people of Rome, and throughout the territory of the church, during the disputes of the antipopes, had formed a kind of republican government; where the whole power was lodged in the hands of a magistrate called Senator, and twelve heads of quarters called Bannerets, by reason of the banners which each raised in his district. By the end of the 14th century the Conservators, had succeeded the Bannerets, and were set in a fair way to become the effective representatives of the people.

games.name: Ritterschlag
games.summary: Ritterschlag is a medieval autobattler: choose from ten classes and defend your hard-earned hop brew for 20 nights against vile rabble. Pick items every night and level attributes to create unique builds with which to smash the bandits' faces in.

games.name: Megapain
games.summary: A dynamic retro shooter with intense arena battles and co-op mode! Gear up with pistols, assault rifles, and rocket launchers to annihilate hordes of mutants solo or with friends. Every arena is a new challenge, every firefight is pure action! Inspired by the FPS shooter legends of the '90s-'00s.

games.name: Don't Forget the Phone
games.summary: Experience a point & click time management game that puts your multi-tasking to the test. Complete all of your tasks before sunrise, but watch out for anything that may have escaped the lab below.

games.name: Doom ChessMaster
games.summary: The end has come. Who will save us? You are the "Player" surviving in ruins. No chosen heroes—only the strong remain. Gather them, plan carefully, use gear to change fate. Truth lies in the wreckage. Dare you play?

games.name: Construction Simulator: Evolution
games.summary: Dig into the next exciting evolution of the Construction Simulator series and experience the biggest construction playground ever. Control numerous licensed machines, take on manual labor, and master both construction and demolition.

games.name: Skingdom
games.summary: Create your own ski realm in Skingdom, a ski resort construction and management game! Arrange your resort, draw your slopes and build your lifts, hotels and shops. Take care of your budget, hire staff and invest in upgrades for your ski resort to reach the top of the mountain!

games.name: The Mystery of Doomsday Valley
games.summary: Mind-controlled squirrels! Alien abductions! Monsters in the forest! Are the rumors true - or is it just an elaborate hoax? Help Maya Harper unravel this comedy point 'n click mystery and escape Doomsday Valley alive.

games.name: Hitoriasobi
games.summary: Cute and a little strange? "Hitori Asobi" is a deck-building roguelike x 3D board game. "This is a game where you ■■ the people you hate!" Surrounded by lots of wonderful things, Rinachi, a very happy girl, decides to play a special game devised by her dear friend Poco...

games.name: Project Accipiter
games.summary: "We’re elite, undefeated, and ready for anything. But uoohhh~ zombies?! Nobody trained us for this!" Join Squad Accipiter in their story and face the chaos in this isometric zombie apocalypse!

games.name: Fractured: Snowpine Strangers
games.summary:
Fractured - a psychological episodic horror that exposes the true nightmare of our world.

Fractured: Snowpine Strangers tells the story of Matt, a freight train driver. The endless clatter of the wheels could drive anyone insane, but Matt finds a strange comfort in it. Until this run.
Days before Christmas, he's called in for one more haul. He has no choice but to leave his family behind. This time, the distance feels different. This time, he's not alone on the rails.

Will he make it back?

games.name: Life of a Cockroach
games.summary: In Life of a Cockroach you play as a cockroach whose main priority is to survive. Explore an urban environment from a whole new perspective in this open-world 3D adventure filled with challenges, tasks, and dangers. Discover hidden places, master your skills, and become the ultimate survivor insect!

games.name: Whispers of the Tallgrass
games.summary: An atmospheric first-person survival horror set in an abandoned industrial wasteland overtaken by tall grass. Listen closely to the mysterious sounds of the night, hide from a relentless predator, scavenge for key items, uncover the secrets of this place, and find a way to escape.

games.name: Overserved: Food Fighters!
games.summary: Overserved: Food Fighters is a fast-paced multiplayer party brawler for 1–8 players. Pick an adorable critter, dash through chaotic arenas, and hurl food-themed projectiles at your rivals in frantic matches with full cross-play across every platform.

games.name: Fuman Ghoul
games.summary: A two-week story about a girl whose stress summons monsters. Dodge obstacles, defeat enemies, and make it to school on time in this fast-paced action adventure.

games.name: By the King's Command
games.summary: Build up your little kingdom, strategically placing buildings to generate gold in defensible locations, then defend against invaders in brutal real-time tactics.

games.name: My Beautiful Faraway, Please Don't Be Cruel to Me
games.summary: A dreamlike, half-remembered nowhere. Quietly wander through it, solve opaque puzzles, meet strange figures, and uncover the subtle threads of melancholy from which this place was born.

games.name: Reshine
games.summary: Gently restore old objects by cleaning away layers of dust, rust, and time. Reshine is a minimalistic, relaxing experience: use a range of tools to watch years of grime disappear before your eyes. No management, no pressure - just you and the satisfaction of bringing vintage treasures back to life.

games.name: KeelOver
games.summary: KeelOver is a crazy physics party game where weight rules everything. Your pirate ship is a giant scale, tilt the deck by hurling heavy loot at your rivals, customize your pirate, and keep your balance… or end up as shark bait!

games.name: Tamitos: Tale of Understanding
games.summary: A story-driven platformer where you experience the world through autistic and neurotypical perspectives. Explore a magical world, rescue Tamitos frog creatures representing emotions, and solve meaningful puzzles that teach empathy, understanding, and the beauty of seeing the world differently.

games.name: Secret Files: Tunguska - Remastered
games.summary: The award-winning adventure classic returns as a remaster with modernized visuals and updated technology. Join Nina and Max on a globe-spanning investigation filled with puzzles, conspiracies, and danger - and uncover the secret of Tunguska that changes everything!

games.name: Crikeymas
games.summary: Crikeymas is a fast-paced platformer where you take control of a (seriously kinda gross-looking) reindeer who somehow ended up as Santa's errand boy, smashing your way through brutally fun levels.

games.name: The Outpost: Outer Frontier
games.summary: Lead the forces of a human empire in a brutal squad-based RTS. Capture territory, secure vital sectors, deploy fortifications, and unlock new units and upgrades mid-battle to outmaneuver and crush the alien threat.

games.name: On the Rocks
games.summary: Run a bar in a toxic wasteland - scavenge the wasteland, brew what you find, serve who you must. In a world gone to ruin, the last bar standing is yours to run.

games.name: A-01's Voyage.Logs
games.summary: Humanity has perished. You are an AI incapable of self-termination, sailing into the void. Trapped in terminal wakefulness, chew on your own endless, redundant processing power and face the ultimate decay of the universe alone.

games.name: Astro Amigo
games.summary: ASTRO AMIGO is a story-driven sci-fi adventure game where you explore a strange Wisconsin town, investigate its secrets, play mini-games, and make story-shaping choices as young Austin searches for his missing dog, Amigo.

games.name: Lag Kills
games.summary: Desperate and out of options, you break into what you thought was an empty house, but little do you know the owner is home, and you're his prey. LOOT, HIDE, SURVIVE and ESCAPE alone or with a friend.

games.name: Hellforged
games.summary: Hellforged is a loot-driven, extraction bullet-heaven game. Fight through demon-infested maps, pre-craft your build, hunt powerful gear, and combine abilities into epic synergies. Every run is a tense heist. Safely extract epic gear mid-battle or risk it all for greater rewards!

games.name: Railway End
games.summary: This is a spot-the-difference game with a railway theme. By comparing photos, find the anomalies in the scene to guide the protagonist to the end of the railway. There is no text in the game.

games.name: Chess 2
games.summary: This project was inspired by Oats Jenkins' video on Youtube titled "I Made a BETTER Chess". In their video, they revised the pieces and rules. This project is that idea, turned into a video game!

games.name: Panema
games.summary: Build. Roll. Bend Luck. A dice-builder roguelike of blessings, curses, and Yahtzee.

games.name: Star of Games
games.summary: Ever dreamed of creating a genre-defining masterpiece? Star of Games is a next-gen simulation management game centered on game dev. You'll act as an aspiring developer, starting from a humble garage startup and embarking on a glorious journey—from recreating classics to forging your own legends.

games.name: In Us
games.summary: The devil wears a human face. Unmask and exorcise it—with friends. A 4-player co-op horror game where you hunt demons lurking in a village. Observe behavior, detect environmental shifts, and use items to expose the truth. But beware: should you misjudge, the consequences will be severe.

games.name: Orblins
games.summary: Orblins is a Marble-Matching Roguelike inspired by classic marble shooters like Zuma and Luxor. Create game-breaking builds with endless marbles and upgrades to defeat a host of Orblins and bosses. Choose from a large cast of characters or create your own custom class to personalize your run.

games.name: Get to Work, Gnomes! Christmas Factory
games.summary: Run a chaotic Christmas gift factory with mischievous gnomes! Get to Work, Gnomes! Christmas Factory is a short management game where you prepare gifts for children before Christmas. Package gifts, build production lines, manage gnomes, and assign tasks to turn a workshop into an efficient factory.

games.name: The Guidelines: Hotel Napoli
games.summary: "High pay. Simple tasks. Room and board included." Monitor "anomalies" through hidden CCTV cameras scattered throughout the hotel rooms. You must accurately judge and report whether a situation requires a mere cleaner, the intervention of law enforcement, or... something far beyond.

games.name: Flowers to Honey
games.summary: A cozy incremental where you choose how your bees evolve, plant flowers, guide your hive, and grow a thriving honey empire.

games.name: Menhera Maiden
games.summary: A ‘Landmine × Yuri' Visual Novel. To complete your master's thesis, you are forced to interact with these landmine girls—a decision that may well prove to be the most disastrous of your life. Your dialogue and choices will not only shape your relationships with the heroines, but also your thesis.

games.name: Courier Beware
games.summary: Deliver to haunted places, solve paranormal mysteries, and struggle through the daily grind in this horror life sim adventure.

games.name: Stellar Fixer
games.summary: Step into the grease-stained boots of a debt-ridden Patcher in a gritty industrial space station. Diagnose critical failures, strip panels with your automatic vortex drill, and replace complex components to bring massive ships back to life. Restore power, clear the smoke, and pay off your debt.

games.name: The Reflection
games.summary: The Reflection explores the connection to an alternate dimension that contains all the matter of the world inverted. From the surface, there appears to be simply a reflection of light, but submerging into the water reveals that this world is completely tangible, mirroring the world perfectly.

games.name: LabyrinTheam
games.summary: Welcome to the Labyrintheam Tavern! Where we serve riddles that will test your wit and ingenuity. In this game, you will team up to escape from rooms filled with mysteries. Use your brains to open the door that will help you escape. Good luck to you!

games.name: Trouble in Potion High
games.summary: Something has gone very wrong in Potion High. As an outside specialist for "hopeless cases," you must fight your way through corridors overrun by interdimensional creatures. Restore order using potions and your own pocket laboratory. Can you contain this chaos?

games.name: High Rollers: Dice Drop Duel
games.summary: Challenge your friends to high stakes arcade puzzle action in High Rollers: Dice Drop Duel! There's something for all types of players with a variety of solo, multiplayer and online modes.

games.name: My Helpers
games.summary: My Helpers is an experimental horror game that hides a group of virtual… "assistants" inside your machine. Find them by combing through your real files, exploring weird applications, and using your computer in ways you may have never expected - and remember: this is just a game.

games.name: Murder Meet Cute
games.summary: Look, just because I’m paid to fix computers, doesn’t mean I’ll sit here and listen to your life story. So what there’s been murders? Do I look like a detective?

games.name: ZeroPrompt
games.summary: The internet is dying. You're a verification operator. Filter out AI impostors from humanity's last clean network. Interrogate live LLM agents that think, lie, and bribe in real-time. Use investigation tools to detect deception. Every verdict shapes the internet.

games.name: Bait Ball Party
games.summary: A real-time billiard brawler for up to 6 players. Play as mini characters to dominate the scoreboard, sabotage your friends with power-ups, and punch them to win.

games.name: Rich Flavors
games.summary: Rich Flavors is a game in which you deliver "goods" to "customers" and get paid in "coupons". Can you collect enough to buy your dream cake before your contract ends?

games.name: Trigonometric Equations
games.summary: Trigonometric Equations is a strict side-scrolling rhythm game. Solve the trigonometric equations to fly through fleeting points and curves perfectly!

games.name: Rotten Chamber
games.summary: Rotten Chamber is a single-player social deduction puzzle game. The player faces a circular council of city officials, each with a unique role and identity. Some officials are corrupt and disguising themselves as honest civil servants. Through reading role-based testimony and applying logic, the player must identify and arrest the corrupt officials without wrongfully accusing the Mayor, whose arrest immediately ends the case. The game features 45 hand-designed levels across 3 acts, an endless mode, custom seeds and 15 unique roles with distinct mechanical and narrative identities.

games.name: Warota: I Live Next to The Demon King's Castle LOL
games.summary: 【Village-Building Action RPG】 Saved by a goddess, you arrive in a ruined world ruled by the Demon King. Gather resources, build your village, swap hats to change classes and give villagers their roles. But one night, the Idol Demon King holds a Live next door...and monsters come pouring in!?

games.name: Sirin's Feather
games.summary: The Bird of the Dead has taken your beloved. How many times will you have to die to bring her back? Gather companions, uncover their secrets, and shape the story in a world where pagan myths come alive.

games.name: Treasures of the Goblin King
games.summary: Treasures of the Goblin King je hra z kategorie Adventura od studia JohnPeppermint pro PC (Microsoft Windows), Xbox One, Nintendo Switch, PlayStation 4. Termín vydání: 2026.

games.name: Above Land: Rhapsody
games.summary: A chaotic 1-3 player co-op action roguelite above the clouds. Grab a toy. Save the world.

games.name: Calame
games.summary: In this turn-based tactical RPG, renown can change the course of a war. Lead Kenmare and the Panthers against the King of Light, shape the Chronicle through your choices, and wield the Legend to turn battles around.

games.name: CitySpotter
games.summary: Spot unique buildings hidden across large procedurally generated cities. Every map is different, with dynamic weather, animated streets, and relaxing sounds. Play at your own pace or challenge yourself to find every target faster each time.

games.name: Front Page
games.summary:
Front Page is a 1-bit narrative game where you play as the editor-in-chief of an independent newspaper and you are in charge of publishing daily front pages.
Through a story with multiple endings where choices have consequences, you decide the direction your newspaper is taking by picking the articles from a pool that changes every day.

games.name: Scattered
games.summary: Scattered is a short adventure where you explore a tropical island as a cat in search of a litter of hidden kittens. Discover paths to remote locations, dig up pirate treasure, and seek out perfect sleeping spots. Upgrade your skills and show them the way back home.

games.name: Stellaris: Willpower
games.summary: Shape Minds, Rule the Stars. In a galaxy defined by borders, belief knows no limits. In Stellaris: Willpower, your Ethics evolve into powerful ideologies that can reshape entire civilizations.

games.name: Static Between Stations
games.summary: Static Between Stations is a narrative-driven RPG in the dying city of Patchwater. Explore, negotiate, scavenge, craft or try your best to avoid conflict. In a fight for survival adaptability is your only advantage.

games.name: Murazu 2
games.summary: Fast-paced precision platformer where you help Murazu, a factory android girl, escape a long abandoned facility. Dash through obstacles, launch yourself like a rocket, optimize your movement and route, and reach the finish as quickly as you can!

games.name: Whatever It Takes
games.summary: Whatever It Takes is a hardcore first-person Action RPG in a dark fantasy setting. As a fallen god, master elemental magic, absorb enemy powers, and engage in tactical duels. Use a harpoon for traversal and shape the Omnisphere’s fate through your choices. Reclaim your throne. Whatever it takes

games.name: Mars Colony Simulator
games.summary: Build humanity's first home on Mars. Mine resources in first person, construct life-sustaining domes, grow lush vegetation, and launch rockets to reconnect with Earth in this immersive colony-building simulator.

games.name: Dark Watching Chapter 2
games.summary: After the door opens, you find yourself in the shopping mall. At first, everything is quiet, but after a while, you discover dead bodies. You ignore them and continue searching for your sister..

games.name: Vampire: The Masquerade - Oaths and Ashes
games.summary: Two vampires — an ambitious Kindred and a wretched Thinblood. Their fates clash in this Visual Novel set in the World of Darkness, where your arsenal extends beyond just words — from political machinations to forbidden Alchemy. Claw your way to power and leave your bitemarks on Berlin's underworld.

games.name: Red Rising
games.summary: Fight for dominance with up to 6 players in the official digital adaptation of the award-winning board game. Assemble a hand of followers, chain together powerful combos, and lead your house to victory in this clash of cards set in the dystopian world of Red Rising.

games.name: Lightfold
games.summary: Play as a cat weaving through light and dark in this minimalist puzzle game. Push light sources and solid blocks to craft shapes from cast shadows. Plan your routes, manipulate overlapping silhouettes, and recreate specific shadow patterns to unravel tranquil puzzles in a serene geometric world.

games.name: Hordestomp
games.summary: A third person survivors like with aiming and shooting. Mow down up to 10,000 enemies on screen at once!

games.name: Rise of Sorcery
games.summary: A narrative card-based RPG where every choice shapes your destiny. Master magic by assembling occult whispers, but beware: each spell permeates your body. Manage your magical impregnation or risk the Darkism. Balance your power before magic consumes you.

games.name: BoomScroll
games.summary: Evaporate endless hordes of creatures as you scroll your way to freedom! Grab upgrades, build your arsenal, and scroll at the speed of light to make it as far as you can!

games.name: Unhost
games.summary: Unhošť (německy Unhoscht) je město v okrese Kladno ve Středočeském kraji. Rozkládá se na rozhraní Křivoklátské vrchoviny s Pražskou plošinou zhruba 7,5 kilometru jižně od Kladna a 21 kilometrů západně od centra Prahy. Ve městě žije přibližně 5 300 obyvatel.

games.name: 999Seconds!Survivors
games.summary: Reject boring stat stacking! We've restructured the gameplay with limited talent resources—talent combinations are just as important as character selection! With 200+ items and 40+ pieces of equipment, what insane builds can you create? —Depth! Difficulty! And high replay value!

games.name: E.C.H.O.S
games.summary: E.C.H.O.S is a narrative-driven first-person sci-fi game. Several centuries after Earth’s civilization was destroyed by an unknown cosmic force, humanity begins to awaken. Journey through virtual and real worlds, uncover the truth of a new age, and decide the future of civilization.

games.name: Ophelia´s Paradise
games.summary: Mystical Horde-Survivor. You are the hero who defends paradise against hordes of adversaries. On your journey, you will unleash legendary powers in a mystical world and discover unique items.

games.name: Step Into the Dark
games.summary: Dive into the grim depths of the underworld, fight with its ferocious inhabitants, and determine your own fate in this classic first-person aRPG with immersive elements, created for fans of the genre.

games.name: The Kingsward
games.summary: Explore an open-world RPG with isometric ARPG combat, a flexible hybrid class system, and an epic story with satirical humor. Create your own build and seek the legendary Kingsward.

games.name: Rabauken: Spirit Resort
games.summary: Build a spirit resort. Research. Expand. Idle. Crowd-control spirits. Repeat. An automation game designed to be played on the side.

games.name: President Simulator
games.summary: Become President of the USA: sign absurd decrees and balance your policies to avoid being called a "sellout." Communicate to gain popularity, manage interviews, and face press conferences. Everything falling apart? Press the red button.

games.name: The House Always Wins
games.summary: Build a top-tier business solo or in co-op (1–6 players). Start from scratch, keep the slot machines spinning and deal with chaotic events like vandals and alien invasions. Grow your fortune and show everyone why the house always wins.

games.name: Skatebound
games.summary: An action-packed 2.5D skateboarding RPG with stats, progression, and skate spots galore

games.name: Vossarium
games.summary: Escape a twisted facility where reality bends around you. Sneak past The Guardian, use a camera with a reality shifting lens to break the laws of physics, befriend strange entities lurking inside, and uncover the dark truth of Mira Voss's life.

games.name: River Drift
games.summary: Paddle in sync or sink together. River Drift is a chaotic co-op rafting game where you and a friend fight wildlife, repair your raft mid-river, and survive deadly branching routes. Teamwork is optional, panic is guaranteed!

games.name: Pill After Pill
games.summary: You’re a pill-dependent driver with paranoid schizophrenia, forced to escort a skeletal mafia boss across hostile territory. Your real enemy isn’t the gang chasing you — it’s the fear slowly consuming your mind. Drive, Shoot, Take Pill after Pill after Pill after Pill after Pill after Pill after...

games.name: Green Mist Over Portland
games.summary: A detective noir puzzle deduction game. Explore a non-linear timeline during the cold war on a globe-trotting adventure following a trail of spies from a quiet English harbour town to a frozen Finnish fishing village and the corridors of an intelligence service rotten at its core.

games.name: Kage
games.summary: Anime MEGABONK with friends. Unleash anime-style techniques — shout them to activate their true power! Fight hordes of enemies, hunt massive bosses, gather rare loot, and craft insane builds in a fast co-op action game for up to 4 players. Upgrade your village. Become a legend

games.name: I Chew, Therefore I Am
games.summary: A narrative-centric game dedicated to overthinkers. A whimsical cosmic road trip to find your cow, and deal with the thoughts you can't stop chewing on.

games.name: Twinkle Seek
games.summary: Go search for sparkles to the ends of the world!

games.name: Senior Survival Club
games.summary: In a zombie apocalypse, a grandmother takes a chainsaw to find her grandson. Defeat slow, persistent zombies, collect gear, and strengthen with exercise. Advance through ever-stronger hordes, reclaiming youthful power in this survival action game.

games.name: Curse of the Crimson Stag
games.summary: Curse of the Crimson Stag is a story-driven mystery thriller in which you explore a blurred line between supernatural occurrences and past tragedy. Uncover what led to the abandoning of the once luxurious Whiteroot Hotel. Local myth tells of a wrathful spirit known as the Crimson Stag…

games.name: Runback
games.summary: Fight, upgrade, and fight again! Runback is an online roguelite party fighter where the phrase ‘best-of-five’ takes on a whole new meaning. Spend points between fights to evolve your character, turn the tide, or simply cement your dominance over your friends!

games.name: Veriventure
games.summary: Craft intricate levels from a variety of pieces to create traps, puzzles and combat. Play through the story, access online levels, or make and share your own in this 3D dungeon maker.

games.name: Letterally
games.summary: Letterally is a deck-building roguelike where you craft words and your deck of letter tiles. Build powerful synergies, collect game-breaking items, and outsmart rule-bending bosses in this turn-based strategic word game.

games.name: The Call Button
games.summary: It's a psychologial observation-based horror thriller. Every day you wake up in a hospital bedroom. You notice anomalies? Take your pills. You think it's safe? Use the call button. But survive long enough, and you must face your interactive nightmares...

games.name: Exipath
games.summary: A survival horror game about liminality and depersonalization, telling the story of Scarlett Shinohara as she descends into warped recollections of her past in order to uncover her own future. Navigate treacherous rooms through in-between time while avoiding the nightmares of days gone by.

games.name: Elecade
games.summary: Strike down rampaging machines with chain lightning. Elecade is a 1-bit action game with incremental upgrades, where you power up and climb to the top of a space facility.

games.name: Infogrind
games.summary: Manage a bank of supernatural artifacts and secret information in a cyberpunk future. Solve mysteries in this new reality, explore the world, navigate the balance between influential corporations that want to rule this new world!

games.name: There’s Something Wrong With the Hero’s Choices
games.summary:
It's supposed to be a simple novel game, but the "choices" are just plain weird!?
A wildly unconventional text adventure game where twists beyond your imagination await!
Guide the hero's party to the Dark Lord by making one bizarre choice after another!

games.name: Grim Dice
games.summary: Dark medieval times. Face off in an online PvP Farkle-like duel where dice combos become damage and greed can cost you victory. Choose a hero, collect items, and defeat your opponent. Risk, strategy, and luck decide who survives.

games.name: Samurai Bringer: Rampage
games.summary: SAMURAI BRINGER - RAMPAGE - is a deck-building auto battler where you strategically form your squad by arranging samurai units and combining weapons and abilities to suit your tactics. Build your own unique formation and unite the land under your rule!

games.name: Dungeon Sweeper Plus
games.summary: Expand the world map by uncovering surrounding tiles, aiming to complete your in-game Encyclopedia. Just be careful not to step on dungeon tiles (landmines)!

games.name: Numbers Go Up
games.summary: The 2048 roguelike deckbuilder. Stack game-warping mods and tile enhancements on a systemic board, chain merges, and compete online for the highest score.

games.name: Null
games.summary: Pending IP Transfer

games.name: Damnation84
games.summary: Damnation84 is a fast-paced FPS game that uses impulse and propulsion weapons as a means of movement and combat. In this devastated world, eliminate enemies in sequence and complete the levels before your oxygen runs out. You are the last hope, survive and cause damnation.

games.name: The Little Crumb
games.summary: The Little Crumb is a cute management sim set in a toy-like world. Bake and serve handcrafted treats, customise your character, befriend quirky wooden locals, and grow your shop into a warm, thriving bakery.

games.name: ForMind
games.summary: FORMIND (forest model individual-based) is an individual based forest gap model that is able to simulate the growth of species-rich forests. It was developed in the late 1990s to simulate forest dynamics of tropical forests.

games.name: Carnholt
games.summary: Craft a deck of wild creatures and powerfull spells, fight in tactical battles and kill a God that refused death. Carnholt is a deckbuilder roguelike where victory will only come to those ready to bargain with ancient powers.

games.name: Echoes of the Flame
games.summary: Two parties. Alternating perspectives. A story-driven 2.5D turn-based RPG. Master strategic combat with flexible ability builds, unravel the world's deep lore using "Key Words" you discover, and see their fate unfold.

games.name: Airskipper
games.summary: Run through stages in this fast-paced action precision platformer. Rack up a combo and maintain it throughout the stage to score big at the end, or create your own stages and share them with others!

games.name: Mouse: P.I. For Hire Story DLC
games.summary: A brand new adventure for Jack Pepper awaits in the first Story DLC for MOUSE: P.I. For Hire…

games.name: Split Brain Samsara
games.summary:
You and your friend are locked in the same body!
In this co-op adventure, learn to control the same character, venture into your spiritual realm, and unravel the machinations of the Samsara megastructure!
Communication will be key!

games.name: Dendron 64
games.summary: With the help of a custom emulator, a lost 90s puzzle platformer game has finally been restored. Explore the secrets of the dam, find out what happened to your friends, and save the valley from the monster lying in its depths.

games.name: In:Dark Recall
games.summary: "I'm sure you'll find me." IN:DARK RECALL is a deep sea diving action game. You wake up at the bottom of the sea, as the target you'd been hired to eliminate.

games.name: Dice Chess
games.summary: Dice chess can refer to a number of chess variants in which dice are used to alter gameplay; specifically that the moves available to each player are determined by rolling one or more ordinary six-sided dice. There are many different variations of this form of dice chess.

games.name: Sectron
games.summary: Sci-fi turn-based strategy on procedurally generated planetoids. Expand your base, deploy and upgrade units, negotiate alliances, and conquer each unique world. Simple rules, deep tactics. Easy to learn, hard to master.

games.name: The Great Beyond
games.summary: "The Great Beyond" is a song by American rock band R.E.M., written for the 1999 film Man on the Moon. It was released as a single the same year for support of the film's soundtrack album. On the soundtrack, there is some dialogue from the movie at the end of the track; meanwhile, the single version is a radio edit, with the bridge omitted. "The Great Beyond" reached number three on the UK Singles Chart in January 2000, the band's highest-ever chart position in that country, and it was nominated for a Grammy Award for Best Song Written for a Motion Picture, Television or Other Visual Media.

games.name: Corridor 13
games.summary:
Corridor 13 is a first-person psychological anomaly horror game set inside an endless, abandoned school corridor. Players awaken as a young girl trapped in a looping hallway where every detail may be a warning, every sound may signal danger, and every wrong decision sends them back or kill them.

To escape, players must carefully observe their surroundings and decide whether to continue forward or turn back. If everything appears normal, they move on. If something is wrong, they must retreat. Reaching Corridor 13 requires twelve correct decisions in a row — but as the loop progresses, the anomalies become increasingly dangerous.

Unlike traditional “spot the difference” horror games, Corridor 13 introduces hostile paranormal encounters, environmental traps, chase sequences, unsettling audio cues, and escalating supernatural events. Whispering children, flickering fluorescent lights, flooded rooms, mirror-based anomalies, and humanoid figures lurking in the darkness turn the familiar school setting into a place where memory and perception can no longer be trusted.

Built in Godot by a solo developer from Germany, Corridor 13 is designed for fans of psychological horror, liminal spaces, anomaly games, Backrooms-style atmosphere, and tense first-person horror experiences. The game features 40+ planned anomalies, randomized progression-based anomaly pools, and Endless and Hardcore modes.

games.name: Asema
games.summary: Build a space factory. Mine, harvest, exploit. Manage logistics with railguns, ballistic payloads and gravity-bending haulers. Fight gravity with Focus, climb the tech tree. Expand and explore the solar system in this Newtonian automation sim. Everything is a potential resource - even the Locals.

games.name: Mushrooms vs Engineers
games.summary: Mushrooms vs Engineers is a top-down bullet heaven/hell where you are The Engineer, armed with your trusty nail-gun battle the hordes of Mushrooms over 20 waves until you face the final boss. The enemies you face are affected by your own choice of upgrades in the shop.

games.name: Welcome, [Employee Name]
games.summary:
Welcome, [Employee Name] is a satirical Papers, Please-like game set in a space station control room. You will experience being an employee of a giant corporation (HonkyTonk inc.) that controls everything entering and leaving the space station, sometimes to the detriment of its occupants...
Discover their secrets, help the people trying to make a difference, or not... your choice!

Control and cross-reference: Open manuals, read instructions, compare documents, this is your job!

Multiple story paths: Truck drivers have hearts too, and it seems like the company you work for has some... issues...

Choices have consequences: You have the power to make a difference, or to keep your head low in this big corporation. What choices will you make?

games.name: Angel in Inferno
games.summary: A visual novel that depicts the trials of four young girls who committed crimes during their lifetimes and have since passed away.
developers: ひとりサークル「匙投げ部」

games.name: Re:cord Noah: Fractal of Oblivion
games.summary: An upcoming otome game being developed for global release in 2026 for the Nintendo Switch. It is a collaboration between AmuLit and Soyogi Fractal, a vocal synth project made by Yuki Kaji.
aliases: Re:cord NOAH 忘却のフラクタル

games.name: Dragon and Mahjong
games.summary: Dragon & Sparrow is a mahjong-combat roguelite. Play as three unlikely heroes, escape the endless exploitation games, and fight the goblin corporation that owns the city — across three timelines, all to break free from the Debt of Fate.

games.name: Mystery Adventure The Maid Did It
games.summary: The culprit is—the maid. And the protagonist. your mission is to strike down six unsuspecting guests, one by one. But beware—you must never be suspected before your plan is complete. To escape suspicion, engage in heated debates and refute your opponents. Hide your true identity at all costs.

games.name: Addie Shen
games.summary: Addie Shen is a math based puzzle shooter. Play solo, team up in co-op, or practice your skills to stop the evil PEMDAS minions. Can you save the world with math?

games.name: Handlime
games.summary:
Forget the keyboard! All you need are your hands.

Meet the protagonist of our 2D action-puzzle game "Handlime"—a quirky, hand-shaped slime! Using a webcam, the game tracks your hand movements in real-time, perfectly syncing them with the slime on the screen.

The controls are completely intuitive. Walk by wiggling your fingers as if "tickling" the ground, tilt your hand to move, or make a fist to punch and blast objects away!

games.name: Hermit Computer
games.summary: Hermit Computer is a horror-puzzle game set in 2001. Deep within the Hermit Kingdom, you play as an outsider tasked with extracting critical intelligence using a secretive state-controlled computer operating system.

games.name: Sonnet
games.summary: Sonet (z provensálského sonet nebo z italského sonetto, tj. písnička) je literární poetický útvar, který vznikl v 1. pol. 13. století, vyznačující se přesně vymezenou strukturou 14 veršů a logickým členěním (14 veršů je rozdělených do dvou čtyřveršových a dvou trojveršových slok). V románských jazycích se v sonetech užívá obvykle hendekasylabu nebo alexandrínu, v angličtině jambického pentametru. Poněkud zastaralý český překlad slova sonet je znělka.

games.name: Line Forge BlackSmith
games.summary: A blacksmith shop with a "line" of unique adventurers! Use your memory and timing mini-games to quickly identify each customer's preferred weapon and forge it. In the Battle Phase, your armed customers fight. Power up your regulars (MVPs) and defeat the bosses. Become the busiest blacksmith!

games.name: Dig Too Deep
games.summary: Throw goblins at all your problems in this Action Tower Defense Roguelite. Craft upgrades. Choose Perks. Build defenses. Defend your Base! Angry baddies want to turn you to pulp! Stop them the only way you know how: throwing goblins! Don't miss.

games.name: Winter Whiskers
games.summary: In this cozy snow-cleaning adventure, help bring Winterlight Harbor back to life after a sudden blizzard! Vacuum up snow, turn it into steam, and power the town. Melt icy paths, help your neighbors, and prepare for the Winter Festival!

games.name: The Incentive Program
games.summary: The Incentive Program is a match-3 roguelike about a surreal corporate job that’s hiding something. You’re paid to play, but you won’t win. So rig the odds, exploit the rules, and escape the program.

games.name: The Way of Ping-pong
games.summary: A roguelike bullet-hell shooter where table tennis meets ancient mythology. Wield your paddle to strike enemies with bouncing balls, retrieve them to attack again, and craft powerful builds through strategic upgrades.

games.name: Type & Magic
games.summary: Type words to shape your path, solve puzzles, and explore the ruins of a dead wizard’s castle. Find artifacts to uncover the castle’s dark mysteries. Report everything you saw to your master. Or… don’t.

games.name: Help me Cleaner Sama!: I Got Isekai'd to Clean Monster Girl Basements
games.summary:
This is a comedic fantasy puzzle game that follows an overworked cleaner transported to another world and tasked with clearing dangerous basements for a cast of eccentric monster girls. The story blends absurd humor and visual novel-style dialogue with satire about work, responsibility, and everyday frustrations.

Gameplay focuses on grid-based, turn-based puzzles where players manage limited movement, avoid hazards, and solve stage-specific challenges that vary by character. The game also includes mature themes, unlockable animated scenes, and a gallery mode.

games.name: Mym's Sword
games.summary: Defeat powerful foes and discover a colorful world full of mystery and wonder in this exploratory action platformer! A wandering beast discovers a magic sword, but can she uncover the truth of its origins, and resist the powers that created it?

games.name: Cozy Campfire Club
games.summary: Go camping with other players and setup a cozy campfire. Chat and make friends as you relax by the campfire, customize your campsite, forage in the forest, and cook up different foods in this cute hangout game.

games.name: Celestial Temple
