games.name: Delivery Survivors
games.summary: Delivery Survivors is a survivor-like action roguelite game. Gather powerful relics and weapons, level up your character, create unique builds and slaughter your way through endless minions and bosses in the dungeon.

games.name: Hair Removal Salon Simulator
games.summary: Experience the oddly satisfying world of laser hair removal! Zap through thick beards, manage your customers' pain levels, and build your hairy empire. Will you run a 5-star luxury salon or a house of screams?

games.name: Demon World: Raya's Way of Life
games.summary: In this turn-based RPG, you play as the mercenary Raya, completing missions with cunning, force, or diplomacy. Benevolent choices may come at a hidden cost, while ruthless ones could end up saving humanity.

games.name: Izakaya Izakoza
games.summary: “Izakaya Izakoza” is a deckbuilding roguelike that combines card battles with grid-based strategy. Fully animated, lively characters jump through the battlefield! Live a day that begins with a conversation, flows through food, and ends with a climactic fight.

games.name: Tile Tale
games.summary: Push colorful tiles into the grid creating fields of the same type to gain new tile types. Create different worlds such as jungle islands, wasteland volcano land or even a big city!

games.name: God of Stocks
games.summary: An incremental management game about manipulating the market to get filthy rich. Buy low, sell high, chain absurd combos and earn divine blessings from stock market gods. Will you play it safe or risk everything?

games.name: My Own Hero Party
games.summary: A party-building casual incremental game where every expedition is a race against your stamina. Recruit allies, clear room-based dungeons, gather gold, and grow a custom upgrade tree after being kicked out of the hero party.

games.name: Overbooked
games.summary: In this Roguelike deckbuilder, arrange rooms for eccentric animal guests under overbooking pressure to meet KPIs. Upgrade rooms with furniture, and squeeze in your freeloading Panda Manager at peak capacity.

games.name: Mr. "Bargain Expert"
games.summary: Play as an antique shop owner in this incremental idle management game. Buy low and sell high, appraise and acquire valuable antiques, hire employees to automate the business, expand into new branches, build your own antique empire, and collect rare treasures.

games.name: Blindside
games.summary: Blindside is a Swedish rock band from the southern suburbs of Stockholm. They formed in Stockholm in 1994 as Underfree. In 1996, they changed their name to Blindside and released the Blindside album in 1997 through Swedish independent record company Day-Glo Records. Another album, A Thought Crushed My Mind, came out in 2000. The group received greater attention in 2001 when they toured with P.O.D., resulting in a contract with Elektra. In 2002 they released the album Silence and in 2003 they toured in support of Hoobastank. A 2004 headlining tour suffered equipment theft but then Blindside released About a Burning Fire.

games.name: Chief Bubble Officer
games.summary: Chief Bubble Officer is a turn-based number strategy game about dressing up financial reports. Draw number cards and place them into different reports, combine numbers, raise scores, find the best moves under ever-changing rules, and trigger chain bonuses.

games.name: Click to Obsolete
games.summary: A satirical incremental clicker game. Play as a corporate tech CEO automating all human labor. Build server infrastructure, allocate compute to AI, manufacture robot armies, and lobby politicians to reduce global employment from 8 billion to zero.

games.name: Last Ride
games.summary: A Train Ride to ... where exactly? A short atmospheric Horror Game about an unusual Train Ride where you need to find your way through a Train to see what lies behind.

games.name: Steal & Sell Simulator
games.summary: Steal valuable goods at night and sell them for a profit during the day. Start small, grow your business, and take on bigger, riskier jobs as the police close in. Invest in your shop, unlock new opportunities, and build a more efficient operation with every successful theft.

games.name: Misplaced
games.summary: Misplaced is an archive-sorting and one-stroke deduction game. Draw files from a shuffled archive, sort them into folder nodes on the board, then match each file to its sub-node. When every file is correctly archived, solve the one-stroke puzzle to link the clues and restore the truth.

games.name: Sign It
games.summary: Monteririo, a city steeped in violence and vice, welcomes a young examining magistrate. An appointment from the Crown has effectively exiled you to this southern outpost, a thousand leagues from home. Tell me—is there truly a way back to the North for you?

games.name: Factor Zoo
games.summary: Factor Zoo is a strategy puzzle game blending Sudoku and betting. Pick 5 lucky cells before each round, then solve the board with Sudoku techniques. Revealed numbers form hands—pairs, straights, or five of a kind—to earn multiplier rewards.

games.name: True Nightmare: Diner Loop
games.summary: Immerse yourself in an atmospheric psychological horror with a haunting VHS aesthetic. As a new FBI agent, you become trapped in a looping anomaly inside a secluded roadside cafe. With every room you explore, the nightmare grows, and something relentlessly follows you. Can you escape?

games.name: Mancalero
games.summary: Mancalero is the ancient strategy board game of Mancala, rebuilt as a roguelike deckbuilder. Collect special marbles, stack blessings, discover synergies, and break every table with increasing scores.

games.name: Rebirth TD
games.summary: Defend a dying world and bring it back to life as you play. Grow spirit trees to defeat enemies, releasing energy that spreads across the land, restoring the forest in real time as you push back a world-consuming blight.

games.name: Sleep Walk
games.summary: "Sleep Walk" is an instrumental composition written, recorded, and released in 1959 by American instrumental rock and roll duo Santo & Johnny, with their uncle Mike Dee playing the drums. Prominently featuring steel guitar, the song was recorded at Trinity Music in Manhattan, New York City. "Sleep Walk" entered Billboard's Top 40 on August 17, 1959. It rose to the number 1 position for the last two weeks in September and remained in the Top 40 until November 9. "Sleep Walk" also reached number 4 on the R&B chart. It was the last instrumental to hit number 1 in the 1950s and earned a gold record for Santo & Johnny.

games.name: Half Grip
games.summary: Get hooked on this brutal one-armed rogue-like combat racing game where every action is a gamble. Steer, shoot and reload - each split-second counts as you compete against armed rivals across atmospheric tracks rendered in harsh pixelated detail.

games.name: Covr
games.summary: COVR is a tactical VR shooter built around next-gen visuals, high-stakes solo and co-operative gameplay, unforgiving realism, and intense close-quarters combat.

games.name: Drifters: Blackout Crew
games.summary: Raid ancient alien temples in a PvE co-op extraction shooter built for tactile VR gunplay. Steal energy for your dying mothership, scavenge rare resources, survive the temple’s defense systems, and decide how deep your crew can push before extraction turns desperate.

games.name: Thieves Guild Master
games.summary: Run a thieves’ guild in Arathia, a medieval fantasy city of scheming nobles, hardworking people and rival gangs. Recruit thieves, take risky contracts, and expand your shadow empire in this turn-based guild management strategy game.

games.name: The Derailed: Devour the Harvest
games.summary: The Derailed: Devour the Harvest - a standalone story set in the world of The Derailed. While investigating a mass disappearance, you find yourself at an abandoned factory. Answers lie within - but they come at a high price. Are you ready?

games.name: Idle of the Dead
games.summary: A pixel-art idle zombie RPG that lives in a slim strip above your taskbar. Your survivors fight the horde while you work: loot scrap, forge gear, unlock skills, prestige and push through 4 difficulties. Minimize the apocalypse - or go fullscreen when the boss arrives.

games.name: Kron Wars
games.summary: Kron Wars is a persistent browser-based sci-fi MMO where players trade, mine, build corporations, wage wars, hunt bounties, and control entire sectors across massive player-driven universes with dynamic economies and tactical space combat.

games.name: Shell as Hard as Steel
games.summary: A horror game about an elevator repair technician who, as he ascends, discovers what became of those who never made it back down.

games.name: Shelf-Employed
games.summary: Shelf-Employed is a first-person organization game set inside a chaotic magical warehouse. Sort thousands of packages, master useful spells, and upgrade your workflow as you turn towering piles of boxes into perfectly ordered shelves.

games.name: Paddle Momentum
games.summary: A 1v1 arcade game where you rally the ball back and forth while building momentum. Earn points, unlock upgrades, and grow stronger over time. Between matches, care for and play with your mole—the better you treat it, the more it will help you during matches.

games.name: The Last Lunch
games.summary: A psychological cooking horror game set in a post-Soviet school. Cook meals, explore the school and its surroundings, and uncover the disturbing story hidden behind an ordinary cafeteria shift.

games.name: They’ll Hang You for That Face
games.summary: Tomorrow, you burn at the stake as a "Werewolf". To save your family, you gladly accept a false execution. But after death, you witness them being ravaged in a living hell. Through a time loop triggered by your absolute despair, you must weave the world's kindest lie.

games.name: Backrooms: Primal
games.summary: The infinite yellow complex was created to secretly contain prehistoric specimens whose existence must never reach the public. Trapped in this glitching yellow maze with no confirmed boundary, you must evade uncontained prehistoric predators and find a way out before reality collapses around you.

games.name: Splatchinko
games.summary: Play as a lovestruck alien in this chaotic roguelike pachinko in pixel art! Launch your EYES across hostile planets, unlock bizarre mutations and build devastating combos as you tear through the galaxy to rescue your beloved.

games.name: Tokyo Ramen Drifter
games.summary: A driving roguelite inspired by Japan's 90s street racing scene. Deliver ramen, upgrade your car, and challenge rivals on mountain roads across Japan.

games.name: Sarco
games.summary: Sarco is a first-person horror game built around constant tension instead of jump scares. Maintain visual contact with the sarcophagus to keep it closed and the primordial being contained. But beware: it will adapt. Explore an abandoned complex and find a way to stop the being before it breaks free.

games.name: Hear My Light
games.summary: A short narrative puzzle-shooter about bringing your brother home through a contaminated combat zone by guiding him with drones. He and the enemy are blind and catatonic, responding only to your drones' sounds — so every signal to shoot has to be your tactical decision. Especially when the dead rise

games.name: Dice Looter
games.summary: Roll the dice to collect loot, combine your gear, and discover powerful builds. Dice Looter is a roguelike autobattler where your hero enters battle to become the greatest warrior among mortals.

games.name: Cargo Protocol: Cyberpunk Trains
games.summary: Build a logistics empire in a grim cyberpunk world: lay tracks, optimize production and delivery chains, research technologies, and expand your influence. Corporations are the new gods, and the Market decides who survives.

games.name: Job Burnout
games.summary: Psychological horror game about your lovely work. Absurd humor, incompetent management, pointless tasks, weird coworkers, and monsters that show up in the office after the workday ends.

games.name: Zaibaly
games.summary: Horror-comedy boomer shooter, fantastic reimagining of a real-life experience of living under the constant threat of aerial assault

games.name: SCP: Darkwater
games.summary: A psychological horror game inspired by SCP-1128. As a young woman trapped in a surreal loop, explore your bathroom and submerge yourself in the bathtub to enter a terrifying ocean dimension inhabited by a colossal entity lurking in the depths.

games.name: Jeep Horror
games.summary: Drive a traditional jeepney through the dark Philippine streets, picking up commuters under the cover of night. But some passengers aren't human. Watch for doppelgangers, serial killers, and mythological monsters. Collect weird fares, manage your cabin, and try to survive the night shift.

games.name: Project Tomorrow
games.summary: A base-building survival game with terraforming and crafting. Earth lies poisoned and abandoned ten thousand years after invasion. Awaken from stasis, defend your fragile foothold, and restore a dead world so humanity can live here again.

games.name: Disaster Crew
games.summary: Disaster Crew is a co-op game about friends taking strange jobs in dangerous places. Explore unpredictable worksites, build what the client asked for, and face weird hazards together.

games.name: Disaster Crew
games.summary: Disaster Crew is a co-op game about friends taking strange jobs in dangerous places. Explore unpredictable worksites, build what the client asked for, and face weird hazards together.

games.name: Legion Hunters
games.summary: Command your squad in a strategy-MMORPG. Unlock over 200 champions and 10 races, upgrade your castle, and gear up to dominate global rankings. Prepare for the war to come!

games.name: Folder Folder Folder
games.summary: A relaxing incremental game about cleaning up your desktop. Sort files into folders, meet the locals, upgrade your tools, and go from manually sorting files one by one to cleaning up hundreds at a time. Immerse yourself in an atmosphere of tranquility where no one will hurt you. No one.

games.name: Ambience
games.summary: MS Ambience is a cruise ship operated by Ambassador Cruise Line. The vessel was delivered to Princess Cruises in 1991 by the Fincantieri shipyard in Monfalcone, Italy as Regal Princess, sailing on their North American routes. After 2000 she was deployed on the company's Australian routes, then later in the Mediterranean and Baltic seas. In 2007 Regal Princess was transferred to P&O Cruises Australia, underwent major refurbishment, and was renamed Pacific Dawn, operating from Australia to South Pacific destinations. Her renaming coincided with P&O's 75th anniversary in Australia.

games.name: Octbuster: Video Rental Store Cleanup
games.summary: Octbuster is a cozy organization game about closing up an 80s video rental store after hours as an octopus. With the help of your kitten pals, scoop up piles of procedurally placed VHS tapes with real tentacle arms and sort over 10,000 of them however you want. No timer, no score, no way to lose.

games.name: 99 Nights In The Apocalypse
games.summary: Survive 99 nights in the world’s worst apocalypse. Scavenge by day, build a questionable camp, and try to survive the night as escaped asylum patients, deranged staff, and things much worse come looking for you.

games.name: Carnosis
games.summary: Carnosis is a horror dungeon crawler set in a grimdark empire filled with mutated monstrosities and war machines. Sever enemy limbs, steal the flesh of defeated foes, and chain devastating status combos to butcher your way to the emperor.

games.name: Marble Mill
games.summary: An idle game where every coin is a real collision. Build a marble mill, watch it grow into a roaring machine — and finish it in one satisfying evening. 100% achievements in ~3 hours, endless sandbox after. An idle game that ends.

games.name: Streamer vs. Chat
games.summary: Streamer vs. Chat is a next-level interactive game where a Twitch streamer competes directly against their viewers. By typing chat commands, viewers influence matches in real time, triggering combat actions, mini-games (like Marbles and Quiz), and effects like flashbangs or screen changes. Featuring leaderboards with a points system, it transforms traditional livestreams into an unpredictable, competitive, and chaotic experience.

games.name: Dice Hoarder
games.summary: Dice Hoarder is a cozy organizing game where you restock a mysterious dice shop. Sort every die in the shop, match them into complete seven-piece sets, and uncover what is hidden behind your new job.

games.name: Abort Sequence
games.summary: Scour your desk, find the right pages and decipher their content to find the defusal codes in this fast-paced puzzle experience! Beat multiple difficulties, optimize your solving strategies and find the right codes among thousands of possible combinations!

games.name: Pray Your God!
games.summary:
Pray Your God! is a retro-styled comedy game about founding a cult and guessing numbers.

The player names a cult, recruits a flock and then prays: they pick a number from one to a hundred, and an Inquisitor picks one after them, with a die that does not cheat.
A wrong guess costs a follower and earns a fresh piece of paperwork; a correct one triggers one of 16 endings, each with its own animation, its own obituary and its own achievement, assigned at random. Runs last two to four minutes.

The whole game is played through a text interface drawn in a Commodore-era palette.

games.name: Grass Cutter 9000: Director's Cut
games.summary: Grass to cut, guys to meet and things to eat. Get upgrades, increase your currency and explore different locations in this short incremental Video Game.

games.name: Nostalgia Game Shop: Tidy Up
games.summary: In Nostalgia Game Shop: Tidy up you will have to organize more than 4000 copies of games from your childhood and put them in the right shelves. Relax with the nostalgic atmosphere and check out what games you can recognize. Pick up, sort, organize. Repeat!

games.name: Leadville
games.summary: Leadville je město v centrální části Colorada, ve Spojených státech amerických. Nachází se v okrese Lake County. Město leží v severní části údolí řeky Arkansas, v nadmořské výšce 3 105 m. Leadville má rozlohu méně než 3 km² a žije zde okolo 2 600 obyvatel. Leadville bylo založeno v roce 1878 jako horní město, bylo jedním z center okolního těžebního průmyslu. V okolí města se těžilo stříbro, v širší oblasti zlato, olovo, zinek, mangan a molybden.

games.name: T-Shirt Kingdom
games.summary: Driven by boundless creativity, this is an idle game where every visual element—from the storefront to the battlefield—is yours to design. Paired with a deep strategic core that spawns endless idle and combat builds, T-Shirt Kingdom places the art of creation and warfare entirely in your hands.

games.name: Idle Squares
games.summary: Claim tiles one by one in this cozy idle fantasy strategy game. Harvest resources, unlock upgrades, and prestige to grow stronger, then automate it all. No single path to victory. Click your way across each map or play hands-free. Clear every tile, complete every map, and conquer the whole Atlas.

games.name: Sanitarium Enhanced
games.summary: The timeless psychological horror point-and-click adventure Sanitarium returns with new enhancements. Originally released in 1998 and named Adventure Game of the Year, Sanitarium Enhanced adds full controller support, quality of life improvements, and never-before-seen bonus materials.

games.name: Theocracy
games.summary: The prophecy is clear: you have one hundred years to unite the Aztec tribes and prepare for the Spanish invasion. Theocracy is a unique blend of RTS, grand strategy and city building. Develop towns, raise armies, cast spells and conquer provinces - build an empire that can change history.

games.name: Borrowed Sight
games.summary: A mysterious epidemic violently killed millions in hours. Sealed inside a darkened van, your only connection to the silent, altered city is a damaged remote-controlled car. Navigate using coordinates, angles, and camera feeds to uncover the truthwithout drawing the attention of what remains.

games.name: Scawy Game
games.summary: Kenguin Sting, a failed horror writer, buys a cheap asset-store house to write his masterpiece. His only job: feed the cats. And keep Grandma on her pills. And survive 4 days and 4 nights. An absurd parody horror game.

games.name: Stay in Your Lane
games.summary: Stay in Your Lane is a single-lane real-time tug-of-war strategy game. Build your economy, unlock units, spells, and upgrades, then summon an army that fights on its own. Outsmart your rival in campaign, skirmish, or online battles.

games.name: Hunter's Journey: Nightmare Hunting - Collector's Edition
Schedule: Rehab Business
games.summary: Play in co-op at the worst rehab center in town. Manage patients, deal with disasters, and try to help everyone recover without losing control.

games.name: Cable Arrange
games.summary: Every room has one outlet on the wall, two to eight appliances, and cables that do not reach. Plug power strips into power strips, run extension cords across the floor, and turn on everything in the room. An isometric puzzle game with no timer, no score, and no way to fail.

games.name: Farmbound
games.summary: An addictive idle farming simulation where you build a massive agricultural empire from a single wheat plot. Harvest crops, adopt cute animals, automate production, unlock powerful skills, and prestige to multiply your yields into astronomical profits.

games.name: My Fairy Princess
games.summary: My Fairy Princess is a life sim set in an Eastern fantasy world, featuring multiple endings. You take on the role of a parent, raising your daughter in a fabled realm of spiritual beauty and tranquility. How will you guide your daughter into an uncertain future?

games.name: Unclaimed: Loot or Junk
games.summary: Unbox. Sort. Collect. Become a master of discovery by exploring unclaimed packages. Complete every set, from vintage gadgets to "Golden Junk". Sell piles of everyday items to buy new shipments and hunt for truly rare treasures. What will you find in the next box?

games.name: Message From Aliens
games.summary: In year 2057, Earth received a large number of mysterious symbols from space. Who are they? Where are they from? And more importantly, what are they talking about?

games.name: Minato
games.summary: Minato (japonsky 港区, Minato-ku) je jednou z 23 (speciálních) čtvrtí města Tokio v Japonsku. V Minatu žije přibližně 260 tisíc obyvatel. Jeho celková rozloha činí 20,34 km². Na území Minata se nachází 49 ambasád. Sídlí zde i mnoho významných společností, např. Animax, Dentsu, Fuji Xerox, Mitsubishi Heavy Industries, Ltd. a Mitsubishi Motors Corporation, Morinaga & Co., Ltd. a Morinaga Milk Industry Co,. Ltd., NEC Corporation, Nippon Television, Sony a Toshiba.

games.name: Diplomacy is Not an Option: Fog of War
games.summary: Fog of War is a DLC for the Diplomacy is Not an Option. In the new story campaign, you’ll build cities, conquer strongholds, and defend against waves of enemy hordes in epic battles. Continue the story of the Ironbrow dynasty and help the young Prince save the long-suffering Samreignia.

games.name: World of Slime
games.summary: World of Slime is a casual MMORPG where you capture, collect, and grow with all kinds of slimes. Find new slimes through field capture, synthesis, and fishing, then take them with you into battles, exploration, and puzzles.

games.name: Wurst and Glory
games.summary: Wurst and Glory is a competitive dueling game for noble athletes. Settle royal disputes through SAUSAGE COMBAT. Every duel offers 3 random sausages—pick one new to add to your arsenal. Master floppy meat physics, counter foes, and duel for honor, glory, and sausages.

games.name: TapRacer
games.summary: Two keys, strictly alternating, as fast as you can. TapRacer is a drag racer with real vehicle physics: torque curves, clutch slip, tire temperature, weight transfer. Burnout, launch, four shifts — and the quarter mile is over.

games.name: Eldritch Wildlife Tours
games.summary: Eldritch Wildlife Tours is a cozy, lovecraftian 2-player co-op exploration and adventure game where one player charts a course to cosmic sea creatures based on collective sightings and takes promotional photos while the other safely steers a tour boat full of paying passengers.

games.name: Meow Star Archives
games.summary: In this 2D puzzle game, you need to restore the cats' severely damaged memory archives to stop their souls from fading away. No timers, no pressure. Just enjoy the satisfaction of each piece falling into place, and the cozy moments spent with adorable cats.

games.name: Sugar Lies
games.summary: That love tastes like a sweet lie. A young man who hates lies. A girl who lives by them. A short visual novel about a classic summer boy-meets-girl romance.

games.name: Quadrillion Carrots
games.summary: Harvest an absurd number of carrots! Start with your bare hands, unlock powerful tools and helper robots, explore six farming zones, catch living carrots, survive explosive ones, and turn manual labor into harvesting chaos.

games.name: What Goes Up
games.summary: A chaotic co-op physics-building game where you stack, balance and jury rig gigantic junk towers to ridiculous heights for collection using the power of grav guns and friendship before the clock runs out

games.name: Pulse Drive
games.summary: Tap to the beat to build speed! Pulse Drive is an arcade racer with rhythm.Casually enjoy a ride through original dreamlike environments, challenge yourself to complete all the tracks, or challenge your friends on the leaderboards!

games.name: Merge Day: Office Girls
games.summary: Merge Day: Office Girls is a casual merge puzzle and dating sim game set in a bustling office! Combine various items, complete daily quests, and unlock romantic visual novel stories with charming female colleagues. Build relationships, discover their secrets, and enjoy the daily grind!

games.name: Argot's Laboratory
games.summary: Argot's Laboratory is a 1-bit science simulator that puts you in control of a high tech lab. Modify, inspect, and evolve strange creatures, all while trying to not to lose your job! Can you complete the genetic tree before time runs out or will your boss finally snap?

games.name: Re:Red
games.summary: Stay on the path, Little Red. Spot anomalies in an uncanny, looping forest to reach Grandma’s house with your basket of goodies intact. If safe, press forward. If not, turn back immediately. Trust your paper map, explore strange new areas, and most of all, watch out for the Big Bad Wolf.

games.name: Build & Putt
games.summary: Build the course, sabotage your friends and be the first to putt the ball! Go fast to be first, or play it smart and rack up points by taking fewer shots. Place obstacles, traps and use powerups to sabotage them. But remember, they might also be plotting to sabotage you.

games.name: IllumaNet
games.summary: Build a living network across the dark. In this strategic incremental game, connect distant stations with pulse bridges, turn every cycle into Data, and manage limited Grid Power as you scan the unknown and expand into strange new biomes.

games.name: First-Person Jigsaw
games.summary: Play jigsaw puzzles from a first-person perspective! Sort, organize, and assemble huge piles of pieces at your own pace. Chill out solo or play online with up to 16 players. Import your own images to create custom puzzles, then play them yourself or share them online.

games.name: Revertices
games.summary: Directed by one of Cuphead's developers, Revertices is an action combat sidescroller where you will be forced to fight the corrupted remains of your friends: your duty is to reset the cycle at all costs, but in doing so you doom yourself and your companions to repeat the same horrors.

games.name: Bloom Busters
games.summary: Bash & blast mutated creatures, restore infested gardens and defend the once-peaceful Bloomland in this frantic solo or local co-op action arcade game. Gather resources, grow flowers, feed animals, complete garden chores, and master handcrafted levels with adaptive difficulty.

games.name: SinEater
games.summary: Climb and parkour through procedurally generated towers of memories in search of your own sins in this third-person exploration platformer. Survive in the world after the second great flood. Manage resources and needs, scavenge and trade with fellow sin-eaters.

games.name: Bombs vs Bots
games.summary: Bombs vs Bots is a chaotic action game featuring physics-based destruction and light environmental puzzles. As a support engineer for Cola Corp, you are tasked with defeating an army of AI-powered bots that have taken over the company's new headquarters.

games.name: Feastfall
games.summary: Feastfall is a cooking roguelike deckbuilder. Plate ingredient cards into recipes, stack game-breaking charm synergies, and feed ravenous monsters. This is not a kitchen sim. It's a life-or-death gamble at the dinner table — and the house is starving.

games.name: The Third Surveillance Bureau
games.summary: Watch the monitors, spot anomalies, and protect citizens in the dead of night. The Third Surveillance Bureau is a 2D horror game centered on surveillance. Cycle through camera feeds, report irregularities in time, and uncover a reality far more terrifying than monsters.

games.name: Cortesia Rising
games.summary: Cortesia Rising is a space captain simulator that combines tactical ground combat, crew & ship management, and broadside naval combat in a hand-crafted Sci-Fi universe, developed and self-published by an experienced team of industry veterans and artists.

games.name: 5-star Taxi
games.summary: A fast-paced arcade taxi game where time is your greatest enemy - find shortcuts, deliver passengers, tear through a destructible city, escape the police, and earn a perfect 5-star rating before your shift ends.

games.name: SE3 Protocol: Last Drop
games.summary: CE-III Protocol is a horror puzzle RPG set in an SCP-inspired world. An amnesiac girl wakes in the darknessfrail, timid but not alone nor defenseless. Face deadly entities: observe, evade, exploit or simply eliminate them. Lead her through this surreal nightmare, and uncover the secret behind it.

games.name: Demon Crisis
games.summary: A classic On-Rails Shooter, compatible with every modern USB lightgun with live recoil. Hide in cover to avoid hits and reload, then emerge to shoot your way through a horde of bloodthirsty demons.

games.name: RippleLoop
games.summary: Chain together stone skips in this relaxing incremental game. Launch, bounce across the water, upgrade, and go further with every throw. Buy new upgrades and powers to become the best stone skipper.

games.name: Dino Crisis 2
games.summary: A port of Dino Crisis 2 originally released on the PlayStation, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

games.name: Cubic Color Confusion
games.summary: A puzzle game where a unique color-cycle mechanic requires you to think ahead. Every move affects the state of the puzzle, opening new paths while closing others. Conquer increasingly mind-bending levels as you find order in apparent chaos. Can you sort out the confusion?

games.name: Ratchet & Clank
games.summary: A port of Ratchet & Clank, originally released on PS2, enhanced with up-rendering, rewind, quick save, and custom video filters.

games.name: Saros: Zenith
games.summary:
Saros: Zenith adds Overlord Rush, a brand new mode where you can take on the powerful Overlord enemies from the main game back-to-back, go for a high score, and compete with players around the world using integrated leaderboards.

This update also brings "Eclipse Layers", a new game+ mode which allows seasoned enforcers to put their skills to the ultimate test. After clearing Saros, players can return to the beginning and take on a more challenging version of the game. You can rise to meet these trials with even more progression options and new Carcosan Modifiers to customize your experience. There are also new secrets and trophies to discover.

New accessibility features, including High-Contrast visuals, gyro aiming with the DualSense wireless controller, and the toggleable "Slow Game Speed" option have been added.

games.name: Good Job
games.summary: Take charge of a business that no one could put on their resume. Manage the girls at the underground massage parlor, delight customers with herbal blends, expand your e-commerce business, and grow your empire without drawing too much attention!

games.name: Fibbtry
games.summary: A Poolcore atmospheric exploration game. Wander freely, drift in thought, until you're ready to wake and carry this rain back into the real world.

games.name: Palm City
games.summary: A first-person co-op action game set in a sunny open city. Play solo or with friends, explore the streets, plan heists, and escape with the loot. Use vehicles, the environment, and physics to your advantage when even the best-laid plan descends into chaos.

games.name: Myriad
games.summary: Myriad is a star themed 2D falling blocks puzzle roguelite game. Complete and clear lines with falling blocks or just plain destroy tiles for points until you reach the score. Combo them with new bonuses that you can purchase from the Nebula store to aim for ridiculous heightli

games.name: False Myth 2
games.summary: The true sequel to False Myth— a true classic JRPG × beautiful-heroine adventure! Rouge, the agile assassin, sets off with his companions to uncover the truth behind the mysterious girl Sylphina, weaving the most heartrending and fiery “Tale of Hearts.”

games.name: Dino Cleanup
games.summary: Toxic goop has spread across the dinosaur land! Use the power of the vacuum to clean your way through multiple levels, being rewarded for fully cleaning. Make new dinosaur friends you save along the way and uncover the ancient secrets around the source of the goop.

games.name: Eightfold
games.summary:
Eightfold is a poker-based deckbuilding roguelike. Players build hands from a deck of playing cards, with hands scored to defeat Bosses using standard poker rankings (pairs, straights, flushes, and so on). Runs are structured around selectable decks, each of which modifies core rules — altering hand size, discard counts, scoring conditions, or deck composition. The game features 22 decks, drawing on a circus and stage-performer theme (including Juggler, Sword Swallower, Tumbler, Contortionist, and Mime decks) alongside decks based on illusion and misdirection (Magician, Mentalist, Escape Artist, Cardist).

Additional systems include card enhancements, which apply permanent modifiers to individual cards, and curses, which introduce a drawback in exchange for a offsetting benefit. Progression is run-based, with players building a strategy across a sequence of acts using the cards, enhancements, and curses acquired along the way.

games.name: Verse of Birth
games.summary: Your words rise as allies in this roguelike tactical battler. Collect "Logos" whose form and abilities are shaped by the words you type, craft a build that's yours alone, and fight your way through the dungeon in turn-based auto battles!

games.name: Nyancrement
games.summary: Nyancrement is an incremental game about a cat that has wandered into a mysterious world. Collect coins with cat punches, strengthen relics, and steadily increase the value of each punch while working toward the 10 billion coins needed to return home.

games.name: Highways & Co.
games.summary: Do you hate building cities but love managing traffic? Design the perfect road network in this traffic simulator. Build interchanges, roundabouts, bridges, and tunnels with powerful road-building tools. Keep traffic flowing, solve congestion, and avoid a pile-up!

games.name: Escape From Argos 7
games.summary: A retro computer incremental game about escaping a hostile alien planet. Explore an old desktop, gather resources, install programs, unlock upgrades, automate your progress, and find a way off Argos 7.

games.name: Kebab Dynasty
games.summary: Build and run your own kebab restaurant in a single-player management simulation. Set prices, hire staff, serve customers, keep the shop clean, upgrade the interior, and turn a small counter into a thriving food business.

games.name: Void Keeper
games.summary: A scientist locked a dangerous discovery inside her own mind. Dive in, break through her defenses and recover the memory.

games.name: Needle In a Haystack
games.summary: They say finding a needle in a haystack is impossible. Time to prove them wrong. Clear millions of pieces of hay from an old barn, upgrade your tools, sell what you collect, and search every last pile until that tiny needle finally shows itself.

games.name: Game Market Mayhem
games.summary: Game Market Mayhem is a cozy organization simulator where you sort 5,120 scattered game boxes according to their genres and platforms. Transform a massive pile of boxes into the perfect game store. Fill the shelves, unwind, and enjoy the satisfaction of everything being in order!

games.name: Basic Parade or: "you should be depressed."
aliases: BASIC PARADE or: "you should be depressed."
games.summary: Socially underdeveloped Lisa found solace in books... Until her eyes fell out. You take the role of Henry, the therapist assigned to guide Lisa through her depression. There's just one problem: she isn't depressed.

games.name: Blue Bite
games.summary: Your "fingertips" will save the world! "BLUE BITE" is a fully voiced 3D romance action adventure set in a world inhabited only by women. Six heroines are threatened by the mysterious disease "bluebite", and the only cure is... your "massage"! Explore the 3D world and save the girls!

games.name: Dark Are the Crypts: The Lost Idea
aliases: Dark Are The Crypts: The Lost Idea
games.summary: Dark Are the Crypts: The Lost Idea is a psychological exploration horror set in surreal, weirdcore-inspired liminal spaces. Use your camera to solve environmental puzzles, fight enemies, and uncover the secrets hidden within the fractured mind of a tormented artist.

games.name: Meowmunitions Survivor
games.summary: Meowmunitions Survivor is a bullet-heaven arena shooter with the unique augmenting system incorporated from Meowmunitions.

games.name: Ame Nochi Hare Onna
games.summary: Co-developed by Game Freak and CHRONOGATE, Ame Nochi Hare Onna is set in modern-day Japan, depicting magical girls called Hare Onna (“Sunshine Girls”) who transform weather into magic to lift people’s spirits. Together with their cute cloud-themed partners Kumorin, their mission is to bring clear skies and brighten up Japan.

games.name: Dice Knight
games.summary: Craft a unique set of dice, encounter monsters, and discover items of great power in Dice Knight!

games.name: TidyUp 2000
games.summary: A cozy desktop organizing simulator where you sort thousands of scattered files into their correct folders. Upgrade your computer as you organize more files and turn a messy desktop into a perfectly sorted one.

games.name: Unclouded
games.summary: Unclouded builds upon the simplicity of a minesweeper with some basic resource-management mechanics to create an engaging, replayable, singleplayer experience that feels both fresh and familiar.

games.name: Dylio's Adventures
games.summary: Imagine waking up transformed into an armadillo after fleeing an indescribable trauma. Step into Dylio's shell and venture through dimensional portals and perilous paths to recover the treasures stolen by a mysterious crow… and uncover the truth behind your transformation.

games.name: Tales from the Watchtower: The Conjurer
aliases: Tales from the Watchtower - The Conjurer
games.summary: An episodic psychological horror game set in La Mancha, the rural heart of inland Spain and land of Don Quixote. Inspired by real events near the mysterious Watchtower of Ciudad Real, each episode explores current legends and local folklore where reality and myth blur.

games.name: Bombernaut 67
games.summary: Bombernaut 67 is a physics demolition game with chaotic and satisfying destruction.Select your explosives, aim carefully, and blow apart everything standing between you and the objective.

games.name: Dimension Contortion Lover!!
games.summary: 由CRYSTALiA开发的最新力作，一款近未来风格的战斗恋爱视觉小说。 你将扮演魔术师后代的男主人公“崩月槐”潜入“学园”，探寻真相。

games.name: The Hollowing
games.summary: You’ve taken a maintenance job, flying between the inter-settlement comms towers in the megastructure. Land, fix, on to the next job. What could go wrong? The Hollowing is a narrative first-person horror flight sim from the creator of Lorn's Lure.

games.name: Mosaic of Life
games.summary: Mosaic of Life is a picross/minesweeper hybrid featuring an ENORMOUS single puzzle that retells the history of life on Earth.

games.name: Camping Keeper
games.summary: Build your campground from the ground up: tent sites, cabins, showers, pools, and the pipes and power lines behind them. Watch autonomous campers live, complain... and review you. Set prices, hire staff, and climb from a muddy one-star field to a five-star resort.

games.name: Adrorium
games.summary: Build your ship, defend against drone waves and explore hundreds of sectors filled with stations, asteroids and planets with lots of POIs. The ship systems can be controlled via consoles with several hundred buttons. Craft equipment and blocks, loot the POIs and disabled drones.

games.name: Beautiful Light
games.summary: Beautiful Light, a PvPvPvE tactical first-person extraction shooter where 6 squads of 3 operators are tasked with entering, securing, and extracting an artifact in a hostile, horrific environment. Face other operators and player-controlled anomalies, but beware: mistakes can risk your life and gear.

games.name: Firearms Factory
games.summary: Firearms Factory is a WWII strategy game focused on weapon manufacturing and logistics. Starting in 1939, you manage a German war factory, expanding control over key regions by supplying battlefronts. Balance production, logistics, and territorial defense on the path to nuclear weapon development.

games.name: Catacombs of the Yokai
games.summary: Catacombs of the Yokai is an indie single player psychological survival horror game in which you must explore the twisted depths of randomly generated catacombs filled with enemies inspired by Japanese/Taiwanese urban legends and myths.

games.name: Unreal Engine The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
games.summary: A fan recreation of The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time with updated graphics, made using the Unreal Engine.
aliases: The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time Fan Remake
Unreal Engine 4 The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time
The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time by CryZENx

games.name: Ending Tau
games.summary: Ending Tau is an action roguelike where you morph your body parts with curses that completely change the game. Walk, fly, teleport, or dig your way across the jungle. Explore unique mechanics with endless mix-and-match upgrades, unravel a beautiful pixel art land, rebuild your village, and End Tau.

games.name: Goman: Stuck in the Avici Hell
games.summary: Goman is a Infinitely looped scroll style battle action game.

games.name: Ascendant.com
games.summary: Ascendant is a squad-based tactical FPS with serious balls. Each match is different, with game-changing events and adrenaline-fueled battles. Set in a dynamic BioPunk world where everything wants to kill you; fight to extract resources, and get out with more than just your dignity.

games.name: Nanovoid
games.summary: NANOVOID is a 2D tactical space shooter that puts you in command of your own modular spaceship. Engage in intense, physics-driven battles, strategize with ship customization, and outsmart your enemies

games.name: Ascendance
games.summary: Ascendance is an upcoming space strategy game in which the player takes control of a civilisation taking its first steps into into space. It features a massive game world, a deep simulation of civilisations, and real-time strategy space battles.

games.name: Containcorp
games.summary: An absurd Corporate Horror & Logistical Management Sim where you contain & milk anomalies for tremendous profit. Construct your facility across multiple floors, design containment areas, employ brilliant minds to study anomalies. Contain, Research, and build a machine of Profit.

games.name: Dragonscale Monastery
games.summary: Discover the secrets of dragon breeding. Survive harsh winters, limited resources, hunger, cold, and many other adversities. Experience unique survival city-builder in the world of Dragonscale Monastery.

games.name: Ardem
games.summary: The zombies ended the world. You're going to switch it back on. Ardem is an open-world zombie survival game in an immersive handcrafted world. Restore electricity, rebuild vehicles, construct your base, and permanently reshape the world. Solo, co-op, or on up-to-64-player PvE, PvP, and RP servers.

games.name: Arcane Arena
games.summary: Arcane Arena is an intense multiplayer action game chosen from diverse spellcasting classes, each with unique abilities. Engage in team-based combat, and dominate the battlefield. Unleash devastating spells, manipulate time, summon creatures, and harness elements to emerge victorious.

games.name: Draculesti
games.summary: Drăculești is a villain-focused reimagining of the classic novel Dracula that shines a light on the shadowy figures of Renfield, Dracula's Brides, and Dracula himself. Be enthralled by the residents of Castle Dracula, and thrill at a dark narrative with strong LGBTQI+ themes.

games.name: Drinkrime
games.summary: Jin, a talking liquor bottle with supernatural powers, has given you a mission. Face DRINKRIME's cast of unique characters and force them to confess their crimes. Interrogate them together and make those wrongdoers come to terms with their guilt!

games.name: Lost Isle
games.summary: Castaway on an island built upon the corpse of a dead god. Build settlements, master melee, archery, and magic. Choose your fate in huge multiplayer PvP and PvE conflicts to begin your story of survival, betrayal, and conquest.

games.name: Mononoke no Kuni
games.summary: Restore villages, purify yokai, and reclaim a lost world in this Japanese-inspired action-adventure set in an otherworld inhabited by Mononoke. Journey through the corrupted Mononoke no Kuni, recover the stolen soul of Musashi the Shiba Inu, and set out on a grand adventure to return home.

games.name: Level Up Your Body
games.summary: LUYB - Hit objects to the beat, dodge obstacles. Enhance strength, endurance, coordination, reflexes. Elevate in a virtual world.

games.name: Elodya
games.summary: Explore the continent of Elodya and unravel its mysteries, alone or with friends, as you gather, craft, battle, learn about its inhabitants, flora and wildlife, and send your discoveries back to your homeland!

games.name: Mana Quest
games.summary: What can you do when you've been isekai'd by mistake and you're just a regular person? You become an entrepreneur! Take over a shop and get rich while building up your harem of monster girls in this comfy +18 hentai RPG!

games.name: Dark Dive: The Last Tropic
games.summary: Join the ranks of skilled duppy detective in a Caribbean town where danger lurks at every corner. Catch or fight monsters, build your deck, and uncover the secrets of the town's mysterious mines in this captivating RPG with turn-based combat and gripping story elements.

games.name: Kiosk Simulator
games.summary: Kiosk Simulator is an action-packed, comedic take on the hustle of running a big-city kiosk and the nostalgia of reaching that lone open kiosk on a rainy late night.

games.name: Healthy Hero: Tower Defense
games.summary: Healthy Hero is a Tower Defense game with roguelike elements, where the player protects a hero from attacking junk food. You need to build and upgrade defensive towers to stop the enemies. The levels become increasingly challenging with new types of junk food and waves

games.name: Poly Beats
games.summary: Poly Beats is a 5K vertical-scrolling rhythm game where you don't need to be perfect to have fun. Dive into our OST, decorated like they're animation, or jump into multiplayer for Tug of War, Free-For-All with power-ups, or ranked async 1v1s - where you compete at your pace, not by the clock.

games.name: War Trigger
games.summary: Destroy, smash and blast your way to victory! Use advanced weapons and vehicles to dominate the battlefield.

games.name: Wandering Cat
games.summary: Guide a cat on a culinary journey in "Wandering Cat": explore, make friends and tackle adventures with humor. Are you ready for a meowtastic cat adventure?

games.name: Hours After Midnight
games.summary: Dive deep into a roguelike survival quest against Rettam'diov, the Consumer of Worlds. Progress, earn experience, refine characters, and uncover potent tools. Face relentless hordes alone or amplify the thrill, teaming up cross-platform in our distinctive co-op mode.

games.name: Korga's Arena
games.summary: We combined a Roguelite Deckbuilder, a Turn-Based RPG, and a bloodthirsty orc battle-mage, to create Korga! Craft your Deck, enhance your Weapons, and forge your Gladiator Emblem to customize your playstyle.

games.name: Dungeons and Diners
games.summary: Dungeon and Diners: A Culinary Adventure Awaits! Dive into dungeons with your friends, hunting for exotic ingredients to bring back to your bustling diner. Choose to team up with up to 4 players or enlist the help of adventurers for both dungeon delving and diner duties.

games.name: Watch Out For Goblins!
games.summary: The world's most accurate goblin simulation! Run and jump a ragdoll goblin through this hilarious physics adventure! Gobland is in trouble! Find the lost cogs, restore power, and become goblin royalty! Alone- or with a friend in split-screen, there's no stopping the BIG GOBLIN ENERGY!

games.name: Pool of Madness
games.summary: A Lovecraftian roguelite pool. Shoot some balls. Unleash horrors from beyond. Go insane. Try again.

games.name: Paper Play VR
games.summary: Experience creative minigames as the world's biggest paper playground unfolds right in front of your eyes! We have crazy games, difficult challenges and a heartwarming story for you and your friends, so come and join the party!

games.name: The Whims of the Gods
games.summary: The Whims of the Gods is a city-building game where you can play solo or join forces in co-op to shape an ancient civilization, manage people and resources, face divine challenges, and survive under the ever-watchful gaze of the gods.

games.name: Permafrost
games.summary: Permafrost is a story-driven survival sandbox set in a frozen, post-apocalyptic world. Discover a vast lore-rich open world, alone or in co-op with up to 4 players. Explore, scavenge, craft, and build a network of shelters to outlast the cold.

games.name: Croakwood
games.summary: Welcome to Croakwood, a relaxed town-building and management game where tiny frogs settle into life in the wild woods. Design and create structures, plan and decorate your town, explore an ancient forest filled with secrets, and guide a charming frog community as it grows.

games.name: Stormforge
games.summary: Stormforge is an open-world survival crafting game for 1 to 8 players. You are Stormforged, with the ability to brave and harness power from magical storms. Explore, fight, forage, craft, build, and defeat bosses in this epic, fantasy game. Survive the Storms and thrive!

games.name: Meowmentum
games.summary: Run, young Meowcolyte - finish the elders' speed trials and prove yourself worthy of wielding Meowmentum! Harness your paw-kour skills, dash through magic orbs, and race against the world!

games.name: Fate Trigger
games.summary: Fate Trigger is a 3D Anime-style, hero-based tactical shooter powered by UE5, available across multiple platforms. Dive into a dynamic world of floating islands, become a sharpshooter with extraordinary special skills, and engage in thrilling, spectacular life-or-death showdowns!

games.name: Detective of the Dead
games.summary: You are a dead detective in the Mexican afterworld trying to find your killer. Undercover you prepare unique tacos to make suspects confess. Find clues and solve puzzles. Step into the shoes of your dog, Xolo, and do magical things. Save the Día de los Muertos.

games.name: Tartaros
games.summary: Jump into 3D retro-stylized adventure full of puzzles and mysteries that needs to be uncovered in story inspired by greek myth of Persephone and her escape from the Underworld.

games.name: Into the Fire
games.summary: Race an exploding volcano in this high-risk extraction survival. Rescue survivors, manage scarce resources, survive fire anomalies, and carve escape routes through ash and lava. Bring them back alive, before the island buries you.

games.name: PACS: Post Apocalypse Courier Service
games.summary: Can you build delivery vehicles to survive the post apocalypse? Go it alone or with up to 4 friends as you navigate treacherous environments, make deliveries, customise vehicles, scavenge for parts, and grow your delivery business!
aliases: PACS - Post Apocalypse Courier Service: Co-op Delivery Simulator

games.name: Don't Kill Rumble
games.summary: A chaotic physics-based King of the Hill party brawler for up to 6 players. Punch, dash, and sabotage your rivals using powerful artifacts in deadly arenas full of traps and total mayhem.

games.name: Blackfrost: The Long Dark 2
games.summary: A year after the Aurora’s appearance & the world went dark, the people of Harmont & its vast wild environs struggle to survive the Quiet Apocalypse. Survive alone or with others against a host of new hazards & a fresh new survival sandbox from a pioneer of the genre. Live together. Die alone.

games.name: County of Fortune
games.summary: Build an entire medieval county, not just a city. Found villages across a wide, varied landscape, weave trade along rivers and roads, and guide mayors, noble houses, and cultures as your region comes to life. A city-builder on a much bigger scale, no two counties are alike.

games.name: Gods, Death & Reapers
games.summary: An innovative ExtrAction RPG set in an afterlife where mythology is real and the gods are dead. Fight through PvPvE, PvE, or as a party to claim valuable loot and bring balance to the shattered realms.

games.name: Uncursed
games.summary:
Uncursed is a co-op pirate adventure where you rescue lost souls, loot shiny treasures, items and uncover secrets so dark even your torch might quit. Survive deadly dungeons, face unpredictable weather, and the occasional chaos caused by your crewmates—all while gathering loot to buy a ship, buy cool gear, and maybe splurge on a new hat.

Your crew's goal is to buy and repair a ship to reach more distant waters and shed light on the threatening secret.

Explore the surrounding islands alone or in a team, collect valuable items and the souls attached to them. Every day you can take part in a new adventure in the procedurally generated dungeon, which rewards you with valuable treasures if you survive its terrifying creatures and cunning traps.

games.name: Train World Driver
games.summary: Take the Driver’s Seat in Train World Driver! Control iconic locomotives from steam engines, diesel beasts, and modern high-speed marvels in this casual, fun game. Complete missions, deliver passengers or cargo and explore stunning environments.

games.name: Steel Runner
games.summary: Steel Runner is a VR vehicle crafting sandbox game using physics. Create your own unique vehicle by combining various types of blocks, then ride it to enjoy free exploration, adventure, and combat in an open-world environment. Shape your ideal vehicle and explore this vast world!

games.name: Hexiv
games.summary: Hexiv is a strategy deckbuilder about surviving on a lush but hostile planet. Use cards to build, explore and feed your crew while battling a determined adversary to unlock the mysteries of this genre-blending roguelike!

games.name: Colonisator
games.summary: Set sail for an uncharted New World. Explore unknown islands, build thriving colonies and compete with rival factions in a living world where every voyage, battle and decision spreads rumors that shape your reputation, economy and diplomacy.

games.name: Valerie
games.summary: Valerie is generally a feminine given name, derived directly from the French Valérie (a traditionally female name). Valéry or Valery is a masculine given name in parts of Europe (particularly in France and Russia), as well as a common surname in Francophone countries. Another, much rarer, French masculine form of the name is Valère. Both feminine and masculine forms of Valerie have derivatives in many European languages and are especially common in Russian and other Eastern European languages. The masculine form is not always a cognate of the feminine; it can have a distinct etymology.

games.name: Slowly Sliding Ducks
games.summary: Placid Plastic Duck in multiplayer? With races, minigames, and a shared pool for up to 50 players? Yes! Chill with friends and become the pool’s most distinguished duck!

games.name: Order of Renewal
games.summary: Order of Renewal is a multiplayer fantasy indie RPG game with co-op and PvP. Detailed combat system with realistic swordsmanship, physical interaction, unusual, and fresh mechanics will require tactics and skill in every battle.

games.name: Leaforia
games.summary: Run your own farm, craft unique items, and battle your way to success. Pay off your debt to the city, befriend the locals, and maybe even find true love. Raise animals, train your loyal dog, and ride across the land on horseback.

games.name: Frostrail
games.summary: Through the frost, death follows the tracks. Dive into a ruthless survival FPS, solo or co-op. Explore, scavenge, craft and fight to endure a frozen, corrupted world. Operate and upgrade your steam-powered train through an unforgiving wasteland, where every choice is a matter of survival.

games.name: Gear Up Einstein!
games.summary: A strategic roguelite auto-battler for 1-3 players. Travel through time, recruit historical figures, and gear them up with badass equipment for ridiculous combos. Master tactical missions solo or with friends. Ready to save the world?

games.name: Creature Containment
games.summary: Creature Containment is a hardcore base-building Action RPG. As a fresh Militia Commander, you've been tasked with infiltrating and wiping out an underground goblin infestation. Manage your base, equip your Operators, and fight hordes of creatures in the depths below...

games.name: The Mirrion
games.summary: Dive into a harsh open world where every choice can mean the difference between life and death. Explore untamed lands, build shelters, hunt, craft tools, and defend yourself from threats. Nature, weather, and unexpected events will test your will to survive.

games.name: Bitgun Survivors
games.summary: The first of its kind open-world vampire-survivors game. Explore a dynamic environment, encounter random events, and adapt to survive a zombie outbreak. With upgrades and challenging gameplay, test your skills and adaptability to increase your chances of survival.

games.name: ApocaShift
games.summary: ApocaShift is a solo-developed extraction looter that throws you into high-stakes expeditions across the wasteland, where survival hinges on the gear you carry, the base you build, and the few allies you can count on.

games.name: Bully Ball Brigade
games.summary: Simple mini games for all, roguelike for the experienced.

games.name: There Are No Ghosts at the Grand
games.summary: Inherit a crumbling English hotel and restore it by day—while battling ghosts by night. With a sardonic cat, a talking power tool, and a twisting supernatural plot, this is a musical mystery unlike any other. Will you be able to hold it together while everything around you falls apart?

games.name: Misty Valley: A Cozy Fishing Tale
games.summary: Welcome to Misty Valley, cast your line, sail to hidden islands, and uncover secrets of the sea. Befriend charming villagers, tend your farm, and explore a world full of wonder, mystery, and gentle adventure. Your story begins where the mist meets the tide.

games.name: Spectral Protocol
games.summary: Spectral Protocol is a psychological horror game where you’re trapped in a mysterious facility. Play solo or in two-player co-op, find hidden buttons, and escape terrifying creatures. Danger is everywhere ! will you survive or become another lost test subject?

games.name: C.L.U.C.K.
games.summary: An online co-op horror game for up to 4 players. Explore surreal, monster-infested realms and interact with fully physics-based objects. Grab the chickens and bring them back to the train. Survive and complete your quota - or face the Colonel’s wrath.

games.name: Block Beast
games.summary: Build the strongest Beast and claim your title as "King Of The Jungle!" With thousands of possible combinations, which Beast will reign supreme in this fast paced Auto-Battler

games.name: Gluttony
games.summary: Nestřídmost či obžerství (Gula) je v nejužším slova smyslu systematické přejídání, v širším významu (ve kterém je v rámci křesťanství bráno jakožto jeden ze sedmi hlavních hříchů) pak nadměrná konzumace nejen jídla, ale též dalších požitků. Zahrnuje pak i různé nežádoucí závislosti: závislost na drogách, počítačových hrách, workoholismus atd. Jako její protějšek mezi ctnostmi je uváděna střídmost. Na počátku 14.

games.name: BoB: Battle of Bots
games.summary:
Are you ready for a bot-breaking battle?
Dive into the world of BoB - Battle of Bots and test your skills against an endless tide of robotic foes. How long can you survive? How powerful can you become? There's only one way to find out. Download now and join the battle!

games.name: Magnavis
games.summary: Set in the depths of the Red Seas, Magnavis is a 1-4 player co-op submarine horror survival game. Manually operate grotesque ship systems powered by living organs, weld catastrophic leaks, and survive with your crew in an abyss where unknown terrors lurk in the absolute dark.

games.name: Destiny Code
games.summary: Beautiful girls and thrilling card battles, all in one RPG! As factions clash over the relics of a lost civilization, the fate of the world — and your companions — hangs on your choices. A dramatic tale where your strategy and decisions shape destiny!

games.name: Trade Anchor
games.summary: Amidst powerful alien empires, you are among the first humans in this corner of the procedurally generated galaxy. Trade and explore. With no combat, your success hinges on mastering complex alien economies and navigating intricate politics. Can you carve out a place for humanity in the cosmos?

games.name: We Build Below
games.summary: A roguelite, co-op factory builder that is set on an alien planet. You're part of an rag-tag mining team trying to get rich. Meet the daily quota to keep your mining permit and defend against dangerous parasites to stay alive.

games.name: The Tavern at the End of the Road
games.summary: A souls-like deckbuilder in first-person 3D where each run is a new life told by a mysterious innkeeper. Journey to the north, Errant, and travel the Road to become Legend. A replayable mystical experience with tactical combat in a world that remembers your choices.

games.name: Delve Down Under
games.summary: Delve Down Under is a bullet hell rogue-lite set in wartime Australia, 1941. Play as mutated Aussie heroes battling Nazi occult forces and Dreamtime horrors. Dodge, shoot, and slash through chaotic combat, collect powerful relics, and strategize your way through procedurally generated dungeon runs.

games.name: Hips N Noses
games.summary: HIPS N' NOSES is a café management simulation! In a sleepless world, Mela is the only one who dreams. She runs a café that restores lost memories. Serve guests by day, battle in nightmares by night to collect the memory flower, customize your café, and become the most renowned owner!

games.name: Oedo Developer
games.summary: “Oedo Developer” is a city builder featuring Ieyasu Tokugawa's Edo. Story and free play modes are available, the first offering a history based city building experience, and the second allowing you to freely develop the lands. Plan, build, distribute, and learn as you make the Edo of your dreams!

games.name: Gang of Frogs
games.summary: Sail through the galaxy as a fearless outlaw frog. Plunder loot, upgrade weapons, eat flies and fight through hordes of monstrous bugs in an intense 1-4 player co-op shooter.

games.name: Eastwynne
games.summary: Play as either Ester or Sye as they navigate college and life in Eastwynne. A city filled to the brim with magic, high society life, the best of the best businesses, and real estate. Maybe not the best people, but you got everything else.

games.name: Cybrid: Survivor
games.summary: CYBRID: Survivor - is a single-player shooter with survival elements. Use your entire arsenal, fight hordes of robots, mine resources and unlock powerful upgrades as you clean up the streets at night. You are alone, against everyone!

games.name: Sombie
games.summary: Sombie offers action packed PvP, and PvE in an always online MMO. loot, kill, die, repeat. Explore an endless randomly generated world with your friends. Offering a unique spin on the Zombie survival genre, built from the ground up.

games.name: Gatekeeper of the Yin Dynasty
games.summary: Gatekeeper of the Yin Dynasty is an independent game with a fantasy fairy tale theme, and the core gameplay focuses on "identifying fakes and identifying monsters". Every decision you make is not only about the safety of the people in the city, but also about the profound impact on the entire city

games.name: Relentless Dark
games.summary: I'm just a dude who got bored and wanted to make a fun but scary coop zombie game. If I can do it you can too! It's always been my dream to develop and release a game one day - even if it sells just one copy 😊 Thanks again for all of the amazing feedback so far! Can't wait to play this with you all

games.name: Protocol Paradox
games.summary: Protocol Paradox is a fast-paced roguelike shooter blending twin-stick combat, anomaly-based weapons and branching lore. Survive procedural sectors, customize builds with weapons and passives, face concept-driven bosses, and replay for new revelations.

games.name: Cold Steel
games.summary: Cold Steel, Inc., is an American retailer of knives/bladed tools, training weapons, swords and other martial arts edged and blunt weapons. Founded in Ventura, California, the company is currently based in Irving, Texas, after an acquisition by GSM Outdoors in 2020. Cold Steel products are manufactured worldwide, including in the United States, Japan, Taiwan, India, Italy, China, and South Africa.

games.name: Crystallium
games.summary: Crystallium is a furry-themed rhythm game where you build a team of warriors to fight monsters. Vanquish corruption from the dungeons and unearth the ancient mystery that has faded from everyone's memory.

games.name: FriendOS
games.summary: FriendOS is a singleplayer/online bullet-hell RPG set within a virus-infected computer. Customize your Friend and team up with others to fish, socialize, and explore the depths of a dying operating system.

games.name: Ruin and Rebirth
games.summary: Ruin and Rebirth is a fantasy open-world factory building game with creature taming and breeding. In this playable creation myth, bring life back to a surreal, shattered, post-divine apocalyptic world where the gods have died.

games.name: Ittzy Fearless
games.summary: Ittzy Fearless is a difficult physics-based action game. Play as Ittzy the fire spirit and use your swift moves and devastating strikes to tackle chaotic waves of enemies, projectiles and explosions.

games.name: Tabula
games.summary: A mind-bending, level-based puzzler about overlapping computer windows to create traversable, top-down landscapes. Delve into the heart of an unusual operating system, one folder at a time!

games.name: World In The Abyss
games.summary: The aliens have caused the oceans to rise, plunging the world into the abyss. Survive, craft, and explore this mysterious underwater world. Build your base, defend it against relentless waves of enemies, and dive deep to uncover the secret that could stop the alien invasion once and for all!

games.name: Time to Die
games.summary: Time To Die is a strategic roguelike dice-builder. Choose your heroes to fight relentless enemies in turn-based combat where time is your enemy.

games.name: Rift Fishing
games.summary: Rift Fishing is a multiplayer chatroom-focused fishing game. Fish through rifts into other worlds to catch mysterious creatures and artifacts. Make friends worldwide, paint together, and jam by the cozy campfire.

games.name: Furry Defenders​​
games.summary: In Furry Defenders, where the Demon Clan covets the Dragon Veins and incites war among all races, you will play as Cynton, the Dragon Bloodline Warrior. Rally your allies and set masterful traps at crucial passes to outsmart the looming threat of the Demon Army.

games.name: Crimson Freedom
games.summary: A classic RTS with modern look - Crimson Freedom is a gripping real-time strategy game featuring a thrilling campaign experience. Set on 22nd-century Mars, the game follows the epic struggle of ideologies battling for supremacy over the red planet.

games.name: Don Pepe y sus globos
games.summary: Become a water balloon champion in Don Pepe & his Balloons, a projectile based arena fighter for up to 4 players!

games.name: SteelGuard
games.summary: Pilot customizable mechs in an epic battle against hordes of enemiesor dive into intense PvP battles where precision aiming can turn the tide, or let your mech's auto-firing system handle the heat of combat. With rogue-lite elements, each run offers a unique challenge and opportunity for growth.

games.name: Last State
games.summary:
Last State is a hardcore wilderness survival simulation where every decision shapes your fate. You're alone in the post-collapse wilderness with nothing but your skills and determination.

Scavenge abandoned settlements. Craft tools from raw materials. Hunt for food. Build shelter against the elements. Trade with strangers or fight them. Every action drains your resources. Every mistake can be fatal.

The wilderness doesn't care about your plans. Storms will destroy your shelter. Wildlife will compete for resources. Injuries will slow you down. Starvation, dehydration and freezing temperatures are constant threats.

games.name: Treasure Rush: Phantom Infiltration
games.summary:
After you save your friends from the Tower Cave, things in Chairwood don’t calm down at all. People start going missing, whole houses turning quiet overnight, and nobody knows what’s going on. Every clue you follow keeps pointing back to Phantom Corp. They’re acting like nothing’s happening, but everyone knows they’re involved.

So now it’s up to you and your friends to go inside their facility, figure out what they’re doing, and stop it before the whole town ends up gone.

games.name: Realms at War
games.summary: Realms at War is a turn-based strategy game inspired by chess, where fantasy factions clash in PvP and PvE battles. Equip your forces, adapt to rogue-like challenges, and conquer diverse realms filled with ever-changing foes and environments.

games.name: Tattered Banners
games.summary: Lead your mercenary company in a turn-based tactics RPG set in a living, simulated world shaped by your actions. Raid, bribe, steal, spy, assassinate, lay siege, and more - and watch the consequences ripple through and change a realm at war.

games.name: Pistonica
games.summary: Pistonica is the pure steam and mechanical factory automation game, challenging your resource management skills. Explore the tropical island first-person, research tech, mine for minerals, build contraptions and trade goods - all because of a strange radio signal.

games.name: Sakura Arms: Radiant Duels
games.summary: Sakura Arms is a unique on-the-spot deck-building card game. Choose two Megami, combine their martial arts, anticipate your opponents tactics, and build a 10-card deck after seeing both sides selections.

games.name: Backseat Champions
games.summary: Manage your driver in short, tactical races. Rapidly choose from dozens of upgrades each race. Use tire compounds to shape your strategy. Machine-learned drivers make every race unpredictable. Can you become the Champion?

games.name: Atlanta TD
games.summary: Atlanta TD is a roguelite tower defense game where the armies of the underworld descend onto the Four Spectacular Realms in waves as it falls unto the remaining Gods to protect the city of Atlanta!

games.name: Goojeegoop
games.summary: Click ClIcK CLICK your way through endless rounds of enemies in an exciting new point and click roguelike and become insanely strong! Click on enemies to unlock new slots, increase your level and create crazy and spectacular builds!

games.name: Keybort
games.summary: Keybort is a clean and fluid idle / clicker game where you progress by pressing keyboard keys.

games.name: Riff Hammer
games.summary: RiffHammer is a rhythm-driven hack-and-slash where you annihilate enemies to crushing metal beats. Wield genre-infused weapons, rage through procedurally generated dungeons or handcrafted scenarios—and import your own music if metal isn’t your thing.

games.name: Heartlines
games.summary: Heartlines: A choice-driven FPS. Under an angel's threat, you have 10 days to kill the demon hiding among 5 friends. Who is the victim? With 10+ endings, every choice leads to salvation or hell. Will you obey the light or find the truth?

games.name: Distant Visitant
games.summary: Survive the alien arrival in Distant Visitant, a top-down open-world sandbox. Master talents from marksmanship to cooking while managing hygiene and hydration. Adapt to seasons where winter freezes crops and lakes. Craft, build, hunt, and find survivors. Prepare for them, this is just the start.

games.name: Signal Hill
games.summary: Signal Hill is a city 2.2 mi2 (5.7 km2) in area in Los Angeles County, California, United States. Partially high on an eponymous hill, the city is an enclave completely surrounded by the city of Long Beach. Signal Hill was incorporated on April 22, 1924, roughly three years after oil was discovered there. As of the 2020 census, the population was 11,848, up from 11,016 at the 2010 census.

games.name: Fire & Crown: A Romantic Tale of the Hundred Years' War
games.summary: A historical visual novel about faith, power, and impossible love. Fire & Crown takes place during the Hundred Years’ War, where you must choose between duty and desire as France tears itself apart. Be the reason someone lives—or dies. History may have never loved anyone, but you still might.

games.name: Pursuit of Mercantile Power
games.summary: Pursuit of Mercantile Power is a single-player economic sim with light RPG. No money spawns—money only moves. Control the village’s cash flow, use proposals and loans, buy shares, and take over enterprises to seize GuYuan’s commercial order.

games.name: Santa's Legacy
games.summary: Step into Santa's boots and manage the most magical workshop on Earth! Build, craft, and deliver gifts before Christmas morning in this cozy holiday management adventure. The spirit of Christmas is in your hands!

games.name: Papy Panic
games.summary: Papy Panic is an indie driving game where players control quirky vehicles, navigating through chaotic environments with physics-based jumps and obstacles. It includes a standard single-player experience and a dedicated interactive Twitch Mode designed for live streamers.

games.name: Project Damascus
games.summary: A first person adventure platformer, focused on exploration with time based mechanics and puzzle elements. Enter the ruins of the Kingdom of Pharygia. Swiftly traverse its dillapidated, intricate infrastructure to delve further into the depths of iniquity, in order to cast light on hidden truths.

games.name: Chronia: The Rotcore
games.summary: Chronia: The Rotcore is a medieval themed turn-based RPG set in the fantasy land of Tinotella. You are a newbie mercenary, travelling across the land to find your origin. Part with teams, slaying monsters, achieving quests... It is your choice to shape your own journey.

games.name: Genderman
games.summary: A short, intense psychological horror. Tear up the notes before Genderman finds you — between dark humor, madness, and fear. Meme or nightmare? You decide.

games.name: Bloodfront
games.summary: Bloodfront is a top-down dark fantasy survival game where you build a village by day and defend it from endless demonic hordes by night. There are no second chances. When the village falls, the run ends.

games.name: Banana Keeper
games.summary: One Banana Keeper, and up to seven friends as Evil Monkeys hiding among NPC monkeys. A multiplayer hide & seek game about blending in, eating bananas, and avoiding being revealed. Will you fool the Banana Keeper or reveal all evil monkeys around NPCs?

games.name: Trucker 2056
games.summary: Trucker 2056 is a narrative trading RPG featuring a point-and-click driven plot and card-based combat. Heavily inspired by late 80s and early 90s classics by Origin and MicroProse.

games.name: Orson, P.I.: Midnight at the Grand Hotel
games.summary: Twelve guests at a Chicago hotel plot to steal millions in jewels. Stop them before midnight strikes.

games.name: Dawn Girl
games.summary: Dawn Girl is a third person 3D anime beauty girl shooting zombie survival game, which takes you into a world attacked by zombies. Players will play as a lonely girl, searching for hope and survival in this shattered world.

games.name: D' Mär Lucidium: Grimmgart
games.summary: Begin your journey amid the chaos of the newly reignited War of Divinity and write your own story in this first-person open-world RPG. Express your personality, choose your combat style, and explore the dangerous, living world of Grimmgart.

games.name: Starboys
games.summary: Third-person arena shooter where gravity is a weapon. Run on walls, fight on ceilings, and flip mid-air to outplay friends in fast 1v1–4v4 matches (up to 8). Customize your Starboy and build arenas with the in-game editor.

games.name: Field of Heroes
games.summary: Swords, sorcery – and soccer. Assemble your friends and get on the Field of Heroes, the wildest, most radical online sports brawler ever. Sharpen your weapons, focus your spells, and SCORE!

games.name: Hexistence
games.summary: Hexistence is a Tower Defense Roguelike Deckbuilder. Expand a procedural map, build towers, and cast spells while managing your hand in real time. Optimize your resources to survive increasingly demanding waves!

games.name: The Legend of California
games.summary: The Legend of California is an open world, action-survival shooter set on the mythical Island of California during the gold rush era. Explore a vast, untamed frontier and forge your legacy alone or with friends.

games.name: Seed
games.summary: SEED is a 24/7 persistent society simulator MMO where your characters live, work, and die even while you’re offline. Collaborate with thousands of players in a single-shard world to build economies, interact with and manage your Seedlings, and shape the laws of a new planet.

games.name: Hyperlane Highway
games.summary:
