Hyperlane Highway is a VR roguelike arcade shooter where your body is the controller. You physically lean to surf a hoverboard through neon faster-than-light transit tunnels. No thumbstick needed, no motion sickness, nothing between your intention and the lane. Kill enemies, build combo, go faster. Die, come back stronger.

You are a Way Rider: a sponsored celebrity operative clearing rogue AI constructs from the galaxy's collapsed FTL network. Every run is a live broadcast. Every death is a media event. Between runs you spend Sponsorship Credits on permanent upgrades in your Ship Hub, ensuring the next ride starts stronger.

Strategic depth comes from a deep roguelike build system. Dual-wield energy weapons and shape each run using 40+ randomised Sponsor Mod cards, stacking synergies like chain lightning, explosive rounds and shield reflection. Mid-run slow-motion Pitstops let you buy, sell or recycle upgrades via rival corporate faction vendors before re-entering the chaos. Killing enemies builds a heat combo that physically increases your travel speed. Skill directly controls pace, rewarding aggression without punishing casual play.

games.name: Vaunted
games.summary: The score of a lifetime hangs in the balance – can three cut-throat criminals look past their differences to pull it off? A story of bullets, bravado, and brazen lies unfolds across a galaxy of treasure hunters and crime syndicates in this sci-fi tactical RPG.

games.name: Kodas Nereus
games.summary: Don your VR headset and descend into the abyss. Kodas Nereus combines true-to-life oceanographic data with hyper-realistic diving mechanics. Navigate pitch-black wrecks, monitor living reefs, and uncover history preserved on the seafloor. No fantasy monsters—just you, your rebreather, and the deep.

games.name: Liar's Lift
games.summary: Liar's Lift is a 3-8 player social competition. Use the elevator's emergency phone to communicate and solve challenges. Lie or play fair to earn points across multiple rounds. No one dies, but only one winner exits. In this lift, your reputation is the only thing at stake.

games.name: The Void
games.summary: Only brought to life by scarce sparks of Color, the bleak, grey Void is a peculiar place. The player gets to explore it, get to know the Sisters, Brothers, and other weird creatures inhabiting it, and learn the ways of Color, harvesting it and drawing sigils that change the world around them.

games.name: Ecliptica
games.summary: Ecliptica is a first-person open-world colony survival simulator with a fully dynamic economy. Set on a hostile alien planet, you'll found corporations, fight for resources, and build a sustainable future—or be wiped out by ruthless nature, politics, and competition.

games.name: Castaway Diary: Portal to the Unknown Isles
games.summary: Castaway Diary is a bright and charming anime-style survival adventure. Are you ready to escape to a relaxing island life with a group of lovely girls?

games.name: Northgard Battlegrounds
games.summary: A city-building auto-battler set in the Viking world of Northgard, where every building you place shapes your clan’s fate. Develop your village, claim the Gods’ blessings, and send your warband to battle against rival players! Every move counts, only one clan will stand.

games.name: EasyCraft Online
games.summary:
EasyCraft is an online idle RPG set in the world of Valoria, where players take on the role of adventurers tasked with rebuilding a fragmented civilization. Choose from three classes: Warrior, Mage, or Archer, each with three advanced subclasses, and embark on a journey of battles, exploration, and conquest.

The game features real-time turn-based manual combat, automated resource gathering battles, over 200 items with random rarities and attributes, item crafting, resource gathering, equipment enchanting, and durability systems. Explore the Crypt, dangerous dungeons filled with monsters and rare rewards. Interact with NPCs like Doll, Mira, Thalos, and Varen in a village that serves as your base of operations.

Features include guilds with collective abilities, a PvP arena, a player marketplace, a pet system, quests, competitive rankings, real-time chat, daily rewards, and appearance customization. Play directly in your browser or through the desktop application.

games.name: Iron Inc.
games.summary: Iron Inc is an interplanetary factory automation game where you colonize, build, and fight on planets across the galaxy while developing inter-planetary logistics systems. Create massive bases and engage in combat on the ground and in space.

games.name: Revenant Maze
games.summary: A first person, action-roguelike that centers around going fast. Enter a procedurally generated maze filled with prototypes intent on defeating you. Only to turn the tides and become the monster yourself.

games.name: Lunadun: Lunatic Dungeon
games.summary: You choose a favorite and walk beside them. But those you left behind — where do they go while you're gone? Lunadun: Lunatic Dungeon is an emotional VN where choices shape the fate of four characters. 'The ones you loved, the ones you ignored — you don't get to walk away from either of them.'

games.name: Beards vs. Claws
games.summary:
Beards vs. Claws is a fun, chaotic first-person sandbox shooter set in a fully destructible world environment where the battlefield is never static, and every match reshapes the map.

Everything in the world can be destroyed, mined, or built upon in real time - from the ground below to the walls and towers above.

Dig tunnels to flank your enemies, carve out trenches for cover, or build bridges and platforms to gain the high ground. The terrain is a tool, a weapon, and a strategy all at once.

As players fight, dig, and build, the environment is constantly reshaped by rocket explosions, bridges and newly carved tunnels throughout the map.

games.name: Deckzin
games.summary: Deckzin is a dungeon crawler deckbuilder with roguelike and RPG elements. Play as fantastic heroes, build and refine legendary decks, adapt to encounters and events in fast-paced runs, defeat powerful bosses, and keep the world’s last light alive.

games.name: Hollowed Oath
games.summary: Hollowed Oath is a fantasy MMORPG set in the beautiful yet fractured world of Orrathis. Players assume the role of an Oathsworn, choosing three classes to define their own path customizing each ability they choose. Adventure, explore, collect, craft, and battle to uncover the truth behind your Oath.

games.name: Tears Apart
games.summary: Tears Apart is an action roguelite built around consecutive dash attacks called Tear. Upgrade each one of them to create devastating combat cycles, and defeat creatures of the Void.

games.name: Crown's Trial
games.summary: Crown's Trial is a fantasy souls-like boss rush where you step into a different world with each battle, fighting against legendary heroes from across time.

games.name: The Little Land
games.summary: The Little Land is a strategy god-sim where you play as a god worshipped by the Littles. Command the forces of nature, protect them from danger, and watch as they gather resources and expand their village.

games.name: Stick N' Sheep
games.summary: Join the woolly madness! A chaotic 2 to 8 player party game where an avalanche of crazy minigames awaits you. In a colorful cartoon world, push, betray, and survive to become the smartest… or luckiest sheep!

games.name: Terminal War
games.summary: Terminal War is a grounded, team-based third-person shooter set in a fractured America during the late 1990s. Engage in intense combat across war-torn cities, forgotten towns, and contested territory where every bullet, every strike, and every decision counts.

games.name: Contract Cooks
games.summary: We're a staffing agency. We send cooks to kitchens. The cooks are you. Today, a bubble tea kiosk. Tomorrow, an economy flight galley. Contract Cooks is a co-op cooking roguelite where you go where the agency sends you and try not to get fired.

games.name: Office Manager
games.summary: Build and manage your own office empire. Design buildings, find tenants, negotiate contracts, and keep them happy. Research new technologies, expand your business, and handle unexpected events in a living office world.

games.name: Saw: Genesis
games.summary: A century before Jigsaw, survival demanded sacrifice. Experience the thrilling world of SAW first-hand in a new 3v1 multi-player horror game where three Accused must work together to escape a maze of traps, while one Judge orchestrates their rehabilitation.

games.name: Voxenvale
games.summary: Voxenvale is a cozy blocky online realm builder where players jump, build, decorate, and visit each other's cubic worlds.

games.name: Cargo Crush Zero
games.summary: Push blocks. Crush enemies. Survive the void. Cargo Crush Zero is a roguelite grid-action game set aboard a derelict space station. Outmaneuver alien creatures by sliding cargo blocks across a zero-gravity field — one wrong move and you're cornered.

games.name: Stronghold 4
games.summary: Wood needed! Return to the green roots of Stronghold in this narrative prequel to the original 'castle sim'. Immerse yourself in a cinematic campaign, hone your siegecraft with new mechanics in skirmish mode and customise your castles with a wide selection of castle pieces and cosmetics.

games.name: Eidol
games.summary: Craft living statues from Oak, Stone, and Steel. Infiltrate a corrupt guild as you rise through the ranks in this hand-drawn dark fantasy card game set in an ancient world. Every eidol you build is a reflection of your mastery.

games.name: One More Dig!
games.summary: Grab your equipments and dive deep! One More Dig is a pirate-themed mining adventure. Master your stamina, unearth cursed treasures, and upgrade your gear with dubloons. The greatest haul is always just one more dig away—how deep will you go before the tide turns?

games.name: Farming & Supermarket: Clicker
games.summary: Click, harvest, and build your own retail empire! In Farming & Supermarket: Clicker, process raw crops into valuable goods, design your store, and sell to customers. Start with a simple click and grow into a massive supermarket tycoon!

games.name: Sakimori
games.summary: "Sakimori, find and purify the Cursed Objects disrupting the boundary." Explore shunned ruins and observe invisible threats. With Tsukino Saku, a spirit sentinel, survive where Utsushiyo (living) and Kakuriyo (spirit) intersect. Purify Cursed Objects in this Japanese survival horror action.

games.name: Incog-Confine
games.summary: Identify. Plan. Scavenge. Repair. Escape or die, alone or with allies. Survive the dystopian lands and brutal storm till your last breath.

games.name: Castles & Castellans
games.summary: Castles & Castellans is a hybrid of real-time strategy and third-person action. Rule from the castle-building RTS view - construct, manage, and fortify against looming threats. Then step into the castellan’s boots in TPP, fighting side by side with your soldiers atop the very walls you built.

games.name: State Z
games.summary: State Z is a post-apocalyptic open-world survival game where you'll have to survive threats from human NPCs, zombies, other players, and your own needs, all within a 64 km² map with 100% exploration. Build your own base, hunt, gather resources, cultivate a farm, maintain vehicles, and trade with communities for rewards. The choice is yours: join your friends, trust strangers, or be alone wolf. It's all in your hands.

games.name: Dwarf the Dungeonist
games.summary: Turn-based dwarf puzzle crawler: Solve tricky mechanics, explore mysterious dungeons, and survive the depths.

games.name: Basement Server Simulator
games.summary: Build a basement hosting empire solo or in co-op. Buy and place servers, install server apps, set your prices, accept time-limited customer contracts, and balance power, internet, heat, and hardware failures as you expand your operation.

games.name: Skye
games.summary: SKYE is a relaxing explorative game where you venture into a world inspired by the Western Isles. Fly around the captivating islands, help the locals with their troubles, and set the fastest time in races while absorbing everything around you through the painterly environment.

games.name: Evons
games.summary:
Evons is a strategic collectible card game where two players clash on a 7x7 grid to seize control of the battlefield. Build your 60 card deck, summon monsters forged from six elements of fire, nature, earth, water, electric, and dark, and aim your arrows to flip your rivals to your side.

Spend your credits wisely. Unleash devastating abilities like Firestorm, Resurrection, and Shockwave, then chain reaction after reaction into game breaking combos. Every arrow is a threat, every cell a battleground, every turn a gamble.

Fill the board. Break your enemy. Rule the grid. Easy to learn, hard to master, impossible to put down.

games.name: Paddle Cats
games.summary: Paddle Cats is a cozy two-player couch co-op fishing adventure where two cats share one boat. Paddle together, explore the waters, catch fish and bring your haul back to camp.

games.name: Hell Of War: Combined Arms
games.summary:
Hell Of War: Combined Arms is a tactical FPS/RTS hybrid set in modern combined-arms combat. Players observe the battlefield through a command drone, locate enemy forces, issue orders to infantry and armored vehicles, and call artillery and rocket support.

During battle, players can take direct control of an infantry commander, an armored vehicle, an FPV drone, or a drop drone. Missions focus on coordinating units, capturing control points, managing support resources, and using destructible buildings and vegetation to change the battlefield.

games.name: A.S.S. (Amazing Slot Survivor)
games.summary: Spin the slot machine. If luck is on your side, your power explodes. Level up fast, collect items, and build your loadout. Hunt down “Spawners” that endlessly create monsters, survive the bullet hell, and clear stages. Overwhelm enemies with insane growth driven by luck and choice.

games.name: Market Manager Simulator
games.summary: Build and manage your own market. Fill the shelves, set prices, serve customers, manage online orders and grow your business. Hire employees, check stocks and turn your market into a large business.

games.name: Sails
games.summary: Plunder, craft and live the pirate’s life. This is a multiplayer pirate survival game where you mine, craft, trade and plunder to survive. Form alliances with other players to strengthen your crew and wage war on your enemies. Fight to keep what’s yours before others take it.

games.name: Aquaculture Simulator
games.summary:
Aquaculture Simulator is a management simulation in which the player operates an indoor recirculating aquaculture facility. Two parallel economies run in the same hall: rainbow trout are raised to weight and sold by the kilogram for thin but predictable margins, while koi are valued by grade based on pattern, colour and body conformation.

A young koi does not reveal its final quality. The game presents a range of possible outcomes that narrows as the fish matures, forcing the player to decide whether an animal is worth feeding for up to two years before its value is known. Fish consume feed daily, so keeping low grade stock erodes profit.

Water chemistry underpins both operations. Oxygen must be held within a corridor, as insufficient levels suffocate fish while excessive levels cause gas bubble disease. Ammonia rises with overfeeding, and a single temperature control separates the two species. Customer orders arrive as email on an in game terminal with a calendar and banking application, and missed pickup dates cost both money and reputation.

games.name: Liminoid
games.summary: Liminoid is an immersive first-person exploration game set in dream-like liminal spaces. Explore, admire and progress throughout surreal landscapes and labyrinth structures that should not exist.

games.name: The Tram
games.summary: Discover tram driving on routes inspired by Eastern and Central Europe of the 2000s. Realistic physics, demanding weather and operating conditions, and a richly detailed city turn every trip into a true driver’s challenge.

games.name: On Love, On Monsters
games.summary: On Love, On Monsters is a Frankenstein-inspired story with an emphasis on love in its many forms. Play as three characters with alternating POVs; the Doctor, The Priest, and The Exile. Bond with allies and enemies, avoid raising suspicion in the town of Blackmoore, and learn what it means to love.

games.name: Card Make Arena
games.summary: Create. Build. Duel you CardMakeArena is a next-generation card game where you craft your own cards from scratch—then face a real opponent across the table. Design everything freely: effects, targets, timing, even the artwork. Then bring the deck that's yours alone… and it's you and me.

games.name: Endless Bounce
games.summary:
Endless Bounce is a roguelite pinball game where you build the table yourself.

Between stages you buy bumpers and marks in the shop and place them on the playfield by hand. Drag two bumpers together to combine them into something stronger, find the synergies, and reach the score target before the clock runs out. There are 50 stages across 5 worlds, with a boss every ten that steals your bumpers, and an endless mode once you clear stage 50.

Every run is different: randomized shop offers, over 40 items with as many combinations, and 6 unlockable balls that each change the rules. Between runs, 40 talents in 10 branches make the next attempt stronger.

games.name: Limp Mode
games.summary:
Limp Mode is a driving survival game with simulation-leaning handling, deep tuning and an OBD diagnostic scanner as its central tool. Cars wear out, leak and fail in ways that can be diagnosed and repaired: when a warning light comes on, the player reads the fault codes to find the failing part, clears them to limp on a little further, or disables systems outright to trade reliability for power. Handling is built on slip-based tire physics, weight transfer and drift behaviour, and the workshop that serves as the player's base includes a proving ground with a track editor for shaking down a build before taking it out.

Beyond the solo campaign - a thousand-kilometre drive down the highway to reach the player's grandfather - the game offers drift servers for up to twenty players, with a public server browser and a festival pit lane where players build and decorate their own pit box. Cars are persistent across every mode and keep their condition, damage and odometer reading, with a service history recording every repair. Parts can be stripped from wrecks, and the world persists after a death, so abandoned wrecks and emptied containers stay where they were left. The dead still hold the cities and are dangerous to meet on foot, but they are weather rather than the subject. It can be played solo or in co-op for up to four players.

games.name: Gravhounds
games.summary: GRAVHOUNDS is a 1–4 player co-op action builder. Drop into hostile planets as a pack, build and defend your base in physics-driven mayhem, and extract with everything you can carry before you become alien chow! The longer you stay, the greater the danger... and the rewards.

games.name: Ocean Cargo Manager
games.summary: A classic maritime business simulation about cargo ships, ports, commodity trading, and route planning. Build your shipping company, navigate markets inspired by real-world trade structures, and make long-term management decisions.

games.name: Rise of the Merchants
games.summary: Rise of the Merchants is a medieval city-building, economic, political, and trade simulation set in a persistent online world. Start with a small settlement in your county, develop it into an influential city, and establish a trade network that extends far beyond its borders.

games.name: Dadi Kingdom
games.summary:
You are the king. Pass judgment on your people, ride into your own realm sword in hand, and decide who hands you the power to do it. You will not rule forever. Father an heir before your time runs out, and leave behind a dynasty worth remembering.

Dadi Kingdom is a medieval action RPG where you rule and fight. Every day new cases land before your throne: release, gold fine or dungeon. Your verdicts follow you. Outside the walls, the kingdom waits: the Far Lands, the cathedral of Sanktum, the desert bastion, the pirate bay, the ash forests and the mage ruins of Thyrn. Stone golems, lizardmen and dark mages stand in your way.

games.name: Calpria
games.summary: Calpria is a 3D arcade space shooter . The game combines fast-paced bullet hell combat with deep progression, wingman system and strategic partner customization. Developed by Lunakardo Games and released exclusively for Google Play Games for both PC & Android Devices

games.name: The Final Witness
games.summary: The Final Witness is a first-person psychological horror detective game where every case tells a different story. Explore a haunted family mansion, uncover hidden truths, analyze conflicting evidence, and identify the true killer before the darkness consumes your sanity.

games.name: Claim Denied
games.summary: Co-op comedy horror, where you are a special department of Quark.Inc corporation investigating a series of mysterious incidents on a spaceship.

games.name: Fluxgates
games.summary: A roguelike where every run is a factory you wire together on a canvas. Draft nodes, connect them into a production line, then press Run and find out. Each room demands more than the last - build the combo engine that keeps up, or stall three ticks from the target.

games.name: Trenchblocks
games.summary: Dig, build, and destroy in a cute yet violent voxel shooter! Battle in Capture the Flag where you construct forts, dig trenches, or tunnel under enemy bases with full voxel destruction.

games.name: Beautiful Freaks of the Desert
games.summary: A hyper brutal SPEEDRUN-FPS with a stylized boomer-shooter aesthetic, that requires lightning fast reactions as well as strategic thinking in mapping out the best run through the bite-sized levels. But all of this is just the beginning of the trip...

games.name: Alien Agent X
games.summary: Players can obtain materials and exchange them for corresponding characters, costumes, weapons, actions, etc. Supports body adjustment, taking photos, scene scanning, player chain connection.All multiplayer online. Currently in the early access most Unreal the scene will be changed later.

games.name: DevilConnection
games.summary: Punish the little bastard demon and being punished too! Cemo-Summoning Adventure Game

games.name: Idle Casino Empire
games.summary: An idle casino tycoon where you build the floor, then rig it. Turn casino psychology into upgrades. Play blackjack, roulette, and slots in Owner Mode. Use the Owner's Edge to cheat: nudge reels, peek at hidden cards, read marked cards. Eight venues, a prestige loop. The house is you.

games.name: Touhou Chronicle of Youkai Prayers
games.summary: "Touhou Chronicle of Youkai Prayers" is a Touhou fan-made roguelike action game.Due to a Kedama incident in Gensokyo, Flandre Scarlet eagerly takes the initiative to resolve it. Or rather, she's actually just causing chaos, definitely not trying to solve anything!

games.name: Cellscape
games.summary: Experience life as a microbe in a dynamic, living ecosystem. Hunt bacteria, dodge hazards and predators, and divide as many times as you can!

games.name: Built by Force
games.summary: Merge Titanfall-style gunplay with Satisfactory base-building and Minecraft exploration in a living, randomized world. Transform at will, master a single-resource economy, and join with up to 11 friends to face adaptive AI enemies.

games.name: Wizard 64
games.summary: Destroy incoming enemies as a flying wizard. Collect points to grow stronger. Unlock new weapons and abilities, and use different builds to defeat endless monster hordes.

games.name: CyberQuest
games.summary: Explore CyberQuest, where your decisions define you. Journey from a novice freelancer to a skilled hacker. Choose your path: white hat, black hat, or hacktivist, and embrace the cyber challenge!

games.name: Crash and Conquer
games.summary: A thrilling, Carmageddon/Twisted metal-inspired roguelite game blending high-octane driving and action with strategic elements.

games.name: Final Fantasy XIV: Evercold
games.summary: Prepare for Evercold, the sixth expansion pack in the ever‑expanding world of Final Fantasy XIV Online.

games.name: Polymorphite
games.summary: Polymorphite is a rhythm-adventure hybrid game that fuses keyboard-and-mouse rhythm dodging gameplay with a deep narrative following three concurrent Tokyo residents as a bizarre serial murder case unravels the fabric of reality; and the question of what it means to be “human” becomes more important than ever before.

games.name: Cytokine Storm
games.summary: Cytokinová bouře, také nazývána jako hypercytokinemie, je fyziologická reakce, při které dochází k nekontrolovatelnému uvolňování prozánětlivých cytokinů. Za normálních podmínek jsou cytokiny důležitou součástí přirozené imunity a uplatňují se jako signální a regulační molekuly. Nadměrné množství cirkulujících cytokinů v oběhu však může vést k orgánovému selhání a smrti.

games.name: One Billion Ducks
games.summary: An incremental journey about duck hunting with your canine companions. Shoot rare ducks, sell them, upgrade your abilities, and collect one billion ducks to combat world hunger!

games.name: Joint Venture
games.summary: Joint venture (též joint adventure, joint enterprise či česky společná firma) je forma spolupráce dvou či více osob, které spolu realizují nějaký projekt. Charakteristickým rysem této spolupráce je smluvní základ (ať již výslovný nebo implicitní), všemi členy této skupiny sdílený společný zájem, dělení zisku nebo podílení se na ztrátě rovným dílem mezi členy a rovnost všech členů co do výše hlasovacího práva.

games.name: Long Shadow
games.summary: Guide one family across centuries of collapse, evacuation, settlement and interstellar expansion. Preserve memories, establish laws, command crews, inherit ships and face the Afterless as every choice becomes part of history.

games.name: Hellcrown
games.summary: You are dead. But your ghostly hand still commands. Hellcrown is a roguelite strategy game where every run unfolds into a chain of random stories, sieges, and consequences.

games.name: Brave Billiards
games.summary: 《Brave Billiards》is a strategy action game that combines billiards physics, roguelike building, and fantasy monster battles. Aim, charge, and strike to launch the cue ball across the table in combos, defeat monster balls, collect relics and skills, and create your own adventure style.

games.name: Hardcore Cyborg
games.summary: Take on the roll of a cybernetic soldier on a mission to destroy the enemy force before your world is consumed by an all encompassing corruption.

games.name: Roll or Die
games.summary: The roguelike dicebuilder. Build your dice bag and go as far as you can in this underground casino! Earn chips, place your bets, combine unique dice, and create absurd synergies as you advance through increasingly exclusive rooms. Bet it all, challenge your luck, and reach the top — or die trying.

games.name: Stranded in the Abyss
games.summary: Stranded in the abyss is a shoot-em-up in a unique sci-fi sci-environment where you command a massive squad of ships in an endless war Against an evil rebellion. Shoot command and bomb your way through hundreds of enemy fighters, capital ships, and skirmishes.

games.name: Armatus
games.summary: ARMATUS is a third-person roguelite shooter set in the demon-infested ruins of Paris. As the last supernatural warrior of an ancient order, armed with powerful firearms and incredible celestial powers, scour the city in search of a lost gateway to heaven - the Sunless Gate.

games.name: Stellarch
games.summary: Stellarch is a deterministic, provably-fair trading-card game on the Hive blockchain. Draft a seven-card team of Fighters across eight elemental affinities and let a seeded combat engine resolve the battle; every match replays byte-identically from its seed, so any result can be verified. You own your cards on-chain, and a smart deck beats a deep wallet. Fair, not free. The alpha is ongoing at stellarch.io.

games.name: 13Z
games.summary: Go solo or team up with up to three friends in online co-op for this fast-paced, anime-inspired action roguelike. Master stylish hack and slash combat, craft overpowered builds, and conquer mythological trials to claim the title of the thirteenth Zodiac.

games.name: Danganronpa 2x2
games.summary:
A new killing game begins in the same setting and with the same characters as Danganronpa 2: Goodbye Despair. A brand-new scenario with different victims, culprits, and tricks! Reveal the truth by shooting down contradictions in a Class Trial and uncover the culprit of a murder.

The original scenario from Danganronpa 2: Goodbye Despair, with revamped visuals and presentation for modern consoles, is also included.

games.name: Terranigma
games.summary: Thematic boldness. Stunning character design. Excellent music. Smooth gameplay. Terranigma had it all... except a modern re-release. Now, the beloved action JRPG classic is back for the first time since 1995!

games.name: Ananta
games.summary: Take on the role of an elite Agent within the A.C.D. (Anti-Chaos Directorate) embarking on an exhilarating adventure through a world that breaks all the rules. Meet a variety of interesting characters, jump into exciting combat, solve challenges and safeguard the balance by overcoming threats to humanity, all while enjoying unparalleled freedom to traverse and discover Nova City on a journey to find out who you really are.

games.name: Stranger Than Heaven
games.summary: A fifty-year, action-adventure saga of men with nowhere to go and their desperate struggle to find a home. Use extreme violence to survive, and musical talent to thrive as a showman across five cities and eras of modern Japan.

games.name: TankRat
games.summary: A dying world, flesh given way to steel. Swarms of corrupted mech-monsters roam a desolated land. Search and destroy, scavenge and dismantle, rebuild yourself from the wreckage. What you take becomes what you are. Survive the wasteland. Make it to Highpoint.

games.name: Wingspan: Bird Pack - Birds of the U.S.A.
Fit Boxing: Touken Ranbu - Shutsujin! Exercise Honmaru
Cogito: Requiem
games.summary:
Cogito: Requiem is a 2D action game where you dash freely through a harmony of music and sound effects.

The setting: a world where humanity has migrated into the digital realm and vanished, leaving behind only the SI—artificial intelligences who once had humans as their masters. As Cogito, you race through this world where their remnants linger, set on "ending" the SI that have fallen into error.

games.name: Wandering Sword
aliases: 逸剑风云决 (中日英韩文版) - A Tale of a Young Swordsman
games.summary:
The hit pixel-art RPG set in the world of Chinese martial arts is finally coming to PlayStation!
Play as a young swordsman gravely injured after being caught in a violent conflict.
Having narrowly escaped death, you set out on a journey to master the martial arts and fulfill your destiny as a true hero in a vast wuxia world.
Includes Original DLC
All DLC released on other platforms is included:
“Immortal Trails Across the Blue Sea”
“Mount Pack: The Supreme Steed”

games.name: Fallgrade
games.summary: Bend gravity. Twist architecture. Survive the impossible. A first-person exploration game set in an analog concrete nightmare, where reality shifts around you and Karl waits for your next mistake.

games.name: Fate/Extra Record
games.summary:
The “Moon Holy Grail War” begins anew…

The setting is a Spiritron virtual world called “SE.RA.PH.” built on the moon. Masters and Servants team up and fight for survival in pursuit of the “Holy Grail,” an omnipotent wish-granting device, in the Moon Holy Grail War which begins once again…

This is a remake of Fate/EXTRA, the first Fate series RPG originally released on July 22, 2010, now revamped for modern hardware with an expanded scenario, refreshed character graphics, and dramatic command battles utilizing a highly strategic deck-building system.

games.name: Tropico 7
games.summary: Get rich or die trying! In Tropico 7, you step into El Presidente’s shiny boots again to build your island nation and – literally – move mountains. As glorious leader you guide your loyal citizens (and your Swiss Bank Account) through the ages toward untold prosperity.

games.name: Until Dawn 2
games.summary:
Ready to die for likes? Join a team of ambitious ghost hunters as they chase their next viral hit on a remote island haunted by a woman’s chilling story of demons and ghostly phenomena.

When the tale begins to manifest in terrifying ways, the group will have to fight their own fear—and anything else that gets in their way – to get off the island alive. Their lives are in your hands. Make every choice count.

games.name: Metroid Ravenous
games.summary: It’s eat or be eaten! Take control of Samus Aran, a renowned bounty hunter ambushed by unknown attackers and marooned on an unfamiliar moon. Gather your arsenal, navigate a maze of corridors, hunt down powerful bosses, and use your newly awakened Metroid instincts to devour your foes. You’ll need to strike quickly and aggressively with beams, missiles, and more—lest you become the enemy’s next meal.

games.name: Aria Blue I: Natsuoto
games.summary: Aria Blue I: Natsuoto is a coming-of-age fantasy visual novel that depicts the summer of nine boys and girls. The game will be released in multiple installments, with each installment focusing on one protagonist and two heroines, together weaving a single story that unfolds over the same period of time.

games.name: Shell Soldier
games.summary: " Shell Soldier " is a high‑octane first‑person shooter set in a bleak dystopian future. Featuring frenetic firefights against a diverse range of enemy combatants, each employing unique tactics and weaponry, and offering a wide arsenal of lethal tools at your disposal.

games.name: Sorrow: Rise of Divinity
games.summary: An open-world action survival game combining fast-paced battle royale, competitive deathmatches, trophy hunting, and intense missions—where strategy and skill determine your fate.

games.name: ConOps21: Subversion Protocol
games.summary: Neo-London remembers nothing. The Dominion made certain of it. You are Cipher Reeve — the man their erasure failed to take - and the buried Signal you've touched carries the memory of everyone they erased. A psychological techno-thriller where truth is contraband and every choice is recorded.
aliases: ConOps21: Subversion Protocol — Book One: Black Signal

games.name: Voidhold
games.summary: A sci-fi horde-survival roguelite. Lead a four-soldier fireteam, a combat dog and an eagle-drone against endless escalating waves. Chain run-altering synergies, push through 10 biomes, and hold the line at the edge of the void.

games.name: Vanguard Exiles
games.summary: Blending deep board game strategy with auto-battling mastery, and designed by Richard Garfield (creator of Magic: The Gathering), lead your Squads over an ever-changing dieselpunk battlefield where no two games are ever the same. Think ahead, adapt fast, outwit your opponent and claim victory.

games.name: Astonishia Story
games.summary:
Follow Lloyd von Reuental on his quest to recover a stolen relic and regain his honor in this tale of prejudice, manipulation, and duty. The Elven Queen is set on claiming the powers of an ancient god, and it'll be up to you to stop her!

Astonishia Story is an updated version of the classic Korean RPG, featuring enhanced visuals and refined mechanics. Master grid-based battles, recruit mercenaries, and do whatever it takes to see your duty through, even if that means saving the world in the process.

games.name: Coven: All Powerful
games.summary: A chaotic spell-slinging party brawler where Sages clash in ever-changing magical realms. Stack wild enchantments, unleash devastating spells and combos, and outlast your friends in fast, unpredictable battles full of pure arcane mayhem.

games.name: Aftershock
games.summary: When your own mind becomes the enemy, can you protect the one who matters most?

games.name: Demi and the Fractured Dream
games.summary: In this action adventure, play as Demi and venture through the wondrous world of Somnus. Tasked by a mysterious voice, you must destroy the legendary Accursed Beasts to save the world. Use your attacks and abilities to slay enemies, solve puzzles, and uncover the truth behind an ancient history.

games.name: A Date with Death 2: Remnants
games.summary: Train, chat, and flirt your way through the Underworld in this romantic story-driven chat simulator. Create your own Grim Reaper, connect with your team through text and video calls, and decide who you are when the past no longer defines you in a sequel to A Date with Death!

games.name: Every Wednesday
games.summary: When Hideki steps inside for the first time, he does not yet realize that this is where he will finally stop feeling invisible after a long time. Meet new friends alongside him, uncover their stories, and support them through life’s challenges. They might even help you rewrite your own story …

games.name: Liminal City: Axiom of Maria - Chapter One
games.summary: Liminal City: Axiom of Maria is a 3D Metroidvania set in Seoul — a ghost city run by AI after humanity's population collapse. Explore a twisted Seoul and discover new abilities.

games.name: Alchemist
games.summary: A magic-focused action battle* RPG where research and alchemy shape your path through combat encounters, puzzles, and challenges across diverse locations.

games.name: Yeommae
games.summary: Yeommae is a point-and-click game about traditional Korean shamanism. Investigate objects, witness past memories, and solve puzzles. Uncover the truth through the four senses and untangle the twins' twisted fate at the hands of the Mudang.

games.name: Lunar Crypt
games.summary: Journey through the spirit world to exorcise the twelve zodiac animals and save Chinese New Year in this zero-gravity precision platformer inspired by Chinese mythology and folklore.

games.name: C3 Nightfall
games.summary: Collect relics. Combine their powers. Forge magical weapons. Fight monsters from beyond the skies in a third-person medieval fantasy adventure. Survive the night, harvest Cosmic Crystals, and reclaim the King's castle from the creatures that fell from the comet cloud.

games.name: Shatterswarm
games.summary:
Shatterswarm is a narrative-driven 2D space shooter that combines direct ship combat, fleet command, tower defense, and base building into a strategic colony survival experience. Command Captain Hope's hero ship as you defend Earth's last bastion, The Citadel, against the relentless Voxan Empire.

Take control of your hero ship in intense 2D space combat while simultaneously building and managing a fleet of ships, constructing defensive networks around your citadel, and managing resources to survive wave after wave of alien invaders. Every decision matters as you balance offensive capabilities with defensive structures, all while facing unique enemy types that require different strategies to defeat.

The game features a diverse roster of challenging enemies, each with distinct mechanics: parasites that hack into and take control of your own ships, motherships that spawn smaller vessels, deflectors that fire your projectiles back at you, and robotic enemies that latch onto your ships and tear them apart. Face off against epic multi-phase boss battles against Voxan commanders Gordox, Gudrak, and the dreaded General Mortex.

With its perfect blend of action, strategy, and base building, Shatterswarm offers a unique short game experience where tactical thinking and quick reflexes are both essential for survival. The Citadel's survival depends on your strategy—will you focus on overwhelming firepower, impenetrable defenses, or a balanced approach?

games.name: Metro 2039
games.summary: METRO 2039 is the next landmark FPS from acclaimed storytellers, 4A Games. Journey into the dark heart of post-apocalyptic Moscow in a harrowing conflict for the very soul of the Metro.

games.name: Muramasa: Revenant Blades
games.summary: Vanillaware x Marvelous present an action RPG for the ages. Hack and slash your way through a world of restless spirits and Demon Blades. The tales of six fabled protagonists of Japan's Genroku era, each with their own unique fighting style, are about to unfold.

games.name: Sagas of Lumin
games.summary: Sagas of Lumin is a single-player, semi-open-world action RPG. Master dragon riding as you soar across the skies, engage in thrilling aerial battles, and explore a vast world. Seamlessly switch to ground combat with swords, spells, and firearms. Find your path in this fallen realm.

games.name: Wild Life
games.summary: Become the heroine Maya - strong, beautiful and able to call upon her wings, her tribal heritage - in this gripping Adult Action-RPG. Roam the world from fertile forests to dry and sun-soaked deserts, spread your wings and cut through the skies of a world torn by greed and vanity. Find your own way to ensure your survival and embrace the possibilities of fighting and sex.

games.name: Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis
games.summary: Tomb Raider: Legacy of Atlantis is a reimagining of Lara Croft’s 1996 genre-defining game with visuals powered by Unreal Engine 5, modern gameplay, and new surprises that honor the spirit of the original.

games.name: Wake Up
games.summary: Experience a shattered and surreal dream filled with fascinating riddles, where your only guide is an elusive butterfly. Can you make the journey and wake up?

games.name: God of War Laufey
games.summary: God of War Laufey is an upcoming action-adventure game in development by Santa Monica Studio and to be published by Sony Interactive Entertainment. It is scheduled to be released on February 16, 2027, for the PlayStation 5. The 11th installment in the God of War series, it will be the first mainline game in which series protagonist Kratos is not the main character, instead featuring his wife Laufey, also known as Faye, a powerful Jötnar who had died just prior to the events of God of War (2018).

games.name: Romancing SaGa 3: Destinies United
games.summary: Experience a full remake of Romancing SaGa 3, featuring fully realized 3D graphics, refined gameplay systems, new musical arrangements, voice acting, and more. Choose from eight different protagonists and embark on a turn-based RPG adventure as you uncover the fate of the Child of Destiny.

games.name: Yu-Gi-Oh! Tag Force GX
games.summary: Duel Alongside Your Partner and Forge Your Own Future!

games.name: Persona 4 Revival
games.summary: Who’s on Air? Legend has it that a mysterious broadcast known as the "Midnight Channel" appears only on rainy nights. The day after it airs, a corpse is found in Inaba, a quiet and peaceful town in rural Japan suddenly thrown into turmoil. To uncover the truth behind these chilling mysteries, you and your friends form an investigation team to unravel the secrets of the Midnight Channel and the bizarre murders. As your adventure unfolds, you face off against "Shadows," eerie manifestations of individuals' darker selves. Together, you awaken a hidden power called "Persona" and embark on a journey to prevent more tragedies while uncovering the truth behind the chaos.

games.name: Yuna and the Spirit Forest
games.summary: A 2D pixel-art metroidvania where you fight using elemental spirits instead of basic attacks. Explore, collect, and solve puzzles in a magical forest.

games.name: Fable
games.summary: Become the Hero you want to be in an immersive open-world action-RPG where each choice shapes your journey, reputation is everything, and fairytale endings are never guaranteed.

games.name: Atelier Karia: The Night Kingdom & the Guide of Memories
games.summary: Atelier Karia tells the story of Karia, who has no memories, as she faces her past. New features add to the strategy of battles and depth of alchemy. Synthesized items take on new roles during exploration, and ingredients can be eaten to gain effects.

games.name: Hyrule Warriors: Age of Calamity - Definitive Edition
aliases: Hyrule Warriors: La era del cataclismo – Edición definitiva
games.summary: Experience the events of the Great Calamity with higher resolution visuals and smoother performance on Nintendo Switch 2!

games.name: Blossoming Yandere
games.summary: You've moved into your first apartment. A girl gazes at you, craving your love. What are you to do when you're the center of someone's world? Make choices, explore your new home, piece together a mystery, and be careful. Your actions and words have consequences.

games.name: Let's Build a Dungeon
games.summary: Manage a game studio making the world’s greatest MMORPG. Hire designers, coders, and testers, create a fantasy world, then welcome hundreds of virtual players. If they get bored they will cancel their subscription and your investors will have your head. You can even play the game you create.

games.name: No Rest for the Wicked
games.summary: "No Rest for the Wicked" is the sixteenth and final episode of the third season of The CW television series Supernatural, and the show's sixtieth episode overall. Written by series creator Eric Kripke and directed by Kim Manners, the episode was first broadcast on May 15, 2008. The narrative follows the series' protagonists Sam (Jared Padalecki) and Dean Winchester (Jensen Ackles)—brothers who travel the continental United States hunting supernatural creatures—as they attempt to save the latter's soul from damnation. Having made a year-long demonic pact in the previous season finale, Dean has just one day left to live.

games.name: The End of History
games.summary:
"The End of History" is a sandbox-style strategy RPG set in a medieval-inspired world.

As the protagonist, you leave your foster parent's home one day and embark on a journey as an unknown wanderer.

In a world where the motives of numerous NPCs intertwine, and cooperation and betrayal collide,

you become a part of this world and can live freely as you choose.

games.name: The Legend of Khiimori
games.summary: The Legend of Khiimori is a system-driven game where you explore the untamed land of 13th century Mongolia as a brave courier rider. Breed and train horses with specialized abilities to explore every aspect of this diverse and fascinating landscape.

games.name: 007 First Light
games.summary: 007 First Light is a thrilling espionage action-adventure game from IO Interactive. Players follow James Bond as a young, resourceful, and sometimes reckless recruit in MI6's training program and discover an origin story of the world's most famous spy.

games.name: Tremble of Towers
games.summary: Tremble of Towers is a CO-OP tower defense game where you can build any structure with any resource. Countless of combinations are waiting for you and your friends to be discovered in order to protect your beloved Goal Stone from all kinds of enemies in various maps!

games.name: Kiipluu
games.summary:
Kiipluu is a hardcore stealth adventure set in a brutal Neolithic world.

Every encounter is a tense survival puzzle. Study patrol routes, use tall grass, shadows, sound, and terrain to stay hidden. Set traps, strike from ambush, or slip past unseen. Being discovered can quickly become fatal.

When stealth fails, combat is fast, brutal, and unforgiving. Weapons are primitive. Injuries matter. There are no easy victories.

Along the way, Kiipluu is haunted by dreamlike spirit journeys and visions of his father, a legendary hunter whose shadow looms over every choice. Your decisions shape who survives, who is lost, and what kind of person Kiipluu becomes.

This is a story of fear, survival, and growing up in a world that wants you dead.

games.name: Join Us
games.summary: Start a doomsday cult of your very own! Recruit followers, build your compound, customize your cult’s beliefs, and defeat enemies in this 1-4 player co-op, action-packed, open-world survival experience. Can you survive the Apocalypse?

games.name: Seasons Turning
games.summary: A farming/life sim focused on exploration and immersion. There's no stamina bar and no broken tools. Aside from the genre's norms, it has four puzzle-filled dungeons, secret locations, irrigation, gene splicing, mafia kittens, and one rusty, well-loved bicycle. Save whenever. Play at your own speed.

games.name: The Concrete Sutra #1
games.summary: A post-apocalyptic world. Two friends haven't seen each other for 5 years are heading back home on a bike. The first episode of an epic action jrpg by yeo.

games.name: Cassette Beasts 2002
games.summary: Record, battle, and fuse with 250+ beasts as you adventure alongside diverse companions in this monster-collecting RPG. Set in London in 2002, play in single-player or online to unmask an enigmatic occultist who threatens the realms of man and beast! When worlds collide, take the leap beyond!

games.name: Hearts Gone Black
games.summary: Hearts Gone Black is a top-down survival horror game where you scavenge abandoned homes and gather or mine resources in open world, fight infected, manage survivors, build a base, and endure a broken world where weather, hunger, sanity, and moral choices slowly wear you down.

games.name: A Trans-Siberian Tea
games.summary: A journey through the carriages of a Trans-Siberian train buried in the snow to reveal the identity of a legendary gentlewoman-thief as you speak with the frozen corpses of the passengers.

games.name: Raid Haven
games.summary:
Raid Haven is a strategy, wave-based survival game focused on building fortified bases and defending against ever-more-powerful raids. Gear up your pawns with powerful weapons and armour, adapt your defences, and survive wave after wave of increasingly dangerous enemies.

Build walls, traps, killboxes and defences to create an impenetrable fortress.

Face different raider archetypes every wave, each with their own strengths and tactics. Adapt your defences and strategy to survive whatever comes next.

Choose powerful rewards, equip your pawns, upgrade your gear, hire mercenaries, and adapt your defences before the next wave.

Inspired by RimWorld's tactical pawn-based combat, Raid Haven takes that foundation and puts the focus entirely on building, defending and surviving increasingly dangerous raids. Raid Haven is an independently developed game, built from the ground up by a solo developer with a passion for strategy, base building and tactical combat.

games.name: Gasoline
games.summary: Gasoline is frenetic boomer shooter inspired by 1997 classics You wake up in grim hospital with bandages wrapped around your face and an axe in your hand. Fight twisted creatures, hunt for secrets and explore malevolent levels. Can you keep your cool when everyone around you is smiling far too wide?

games.name: Trine 6: Together in Time
games.summary: Trine 6: Together in Time is a co-op puzzle platformer for 1–4 players. Wit, timing, and teamwork collide as you solve perplexing puzzles, engage cunning creatures, and traverse perilous paths in the next adventure through Trine’s iconic fantasy world.

games.name: Wo Long 2: Wings of Ember
games.summary: Born from war's flames, a Phoenix ascends. In this dark fantasy Three Kingdoms action RPG from Team NINJA, players use offensive and defensive Chinese martial arts to fight back against mighty demons on the battlefields of the Three Kingdoms.

games.name: Eternal Anima
games.summary: Yearning for a better future is considered a capital offense in the kingdom of Urvis Ael. After Wade questions this key tenet of his society, he finds himself on the run in an era-spanning adventure that challenges his core beliefs and reveals an unknown world filled with hidden truths. Alongside an eclectic group of new allies trying to survive a dangerous journey, Wade must travel through time to save civilizations of the past from catastrophes and unravel the secrets of a lost history.

games.name: Gundam Rogue Orbit
games.summary: Become the pilot you were born to be. Change humanity’s fate in GUNDAM ROGUE ORBIT, a high-mobility action game that delivers a bold new take on Gundam, blending a fast-paced cinematic story with intense, hard-hitting combat in an all-new universe.

games.name: Byte Bistro
games.summary: Program a little robot crew and bring a neighborhood café to life. Cook, serve, restock, and refine your routines across 24 services. Mix visual programming with hands-on minigames, then keep your kitchen humming in Desktop Companion mode.

games.name: Backrooms: The Savior
games.summary: That's a co-op horror exploration shooter set in the Backrooms. This time, you won’t just hide—grab your weapon and fight back against the entities. Explore classic and original levels, scavenge supplies, rescue survivors, and survive. Ammo is scarce. Noise is deadly. This time, fear goes both ways.

games.name: Road Kings
games.summary: Drive a 40-ton semi hauling cargo across the coastal plains of the American South, managing multiple jobs, trailers, and routes. Grow reputation from rookie to veteran owner-operator, dodging disasters and rivals to become the hero of the open road.

games.name: Altiros
games.summary: Build! Craft! Destroy! Jump on clouds and fight cute monsters in skill-based battles of steel, magic and spirit in this online sandbox adventure set in a fantastical world of sky islands!

games.name: Ash and Flame
games.summary: Ash and Flame is an interactive cinematic thriller set in the dark fantasy world of Erwintal. You are Raynar, a war veteran who takes up his sword once more to face an ancient evil. Your choices shape the kingdom’s fate: ashes… or the flame of hope.

games.name: Bon Voyage
games.summary: "Bon Voyage" is the original series finale of the American comedy-drama series Gilmore Girls. The episode serves as the 22nd episode of the seventh season and the show's 153rd episode overall. Written by David S. Rosenthal and directed by Lee Shallat-Chemel, the episode was originally broadcast on The CW in the United States on May 15, 2007. Gilmore Girls centers on the relationship of Lorelai Gilmore (Lauren Graham) and her daughter Rory (Alexis Bledel). In this episode, Rory gets a job offer, which forces her to cancel her plans to go on vacation with her mother, and the town of Stars Hollow organizes a farewell party for her.

games.name: Name of the Will
games.summary: You are trapped in HOPE, a masked cult where pain is salvation. Every thought is tallied. Every smile is a lie. Conform for happiness, or face your guilt to escape.

games.name: Super Cucumber
games.summary: Super Cucumber is a 16-bit inspired action-adventure game filled with tight platforming, unlockable abilities and plenty of secrets to discover. Traverse more than six towers and overcome dozens of levels, fight your way past devious bosses and become the greatest Aardvark Superhero in the world!

games.name: Pineview Drive: Rising Storm
games.summary: For years, Lisa has been haunted by dreams of a burning mansion. When she recognizes the place from a late-night television documentary, she decides to uncover the truth behind the nightmare in this story-driven first-person horror adventure.

games.name: Nine Rounds Rapid
games.summary: Blast your way to freedom, solo or with a friend in online or local co-op, through a possessed, fragmenting space station. Upgrade abilities, mod your weapon builds, and manipulate time to defeat the station's nine gatekeepers. Power up, progress, and learn the ugly truth with every escape attempt.

games.name: Squid Grid
games.summary: A squid-squirting, tentacle-bending puzzle game in a steampunk ocean

games.name: Wild Wild Eden
games.summary: Survive a primitive fantasy world in Wild Wild Eden, an open-world survival crafting game where monsters are family. Pet, feed, and protect your companions. As a tribal chief, raise your monster friends, build a thriving base, and explore a harsh yet heartwarming world together.

games.name: Simulacro
games.summary: In this first-person philosophical journey, Poísis, an enthusiastic art student, explores a mysterious island in Greece. As she solves the local puzzles, she uncovers traces of its ancient inhabitants, leading her to question her own reality.

games.name: Bestiario
games.summary: Bestiario is an exciting turn-based combat JRPG based on Spanish mythology and folklore, full of surprises. Should we call it an ÑRPG?

games.name: Shadows of Chroma Tower
games.summary: Choose your faction and fight for control of the Tower! Shadows of Chroma Tower mixes together the best features of Dungeon Crawlers and ARPGs. Choose between steel, wit and magic to face hordes of enemies and huge bosses in PvE dungeons while participating in Asynchronous PvP modes.

games.name: Heaven Crawler
games.summary: Explore The Womb, a forgotten man-made tower built to reach the heavens. Wield Mechanical Arms to overcome deadly enemies and carve your path upward on a deeply personal journey. And remember: Bring her back.

games.name: Dark Queen of Samobor
games.summary: Experience a thrilling adventure through the dark and atmospheric world of medieval Croatia where an evil queen rules from the shadows and her haunted guardians await you. Venture into a dark fantasy tale wrapped in a cinematic action side-scroller with a unique 2.5D style.

games.name: Sick Samurai
games.summary: It's 1972 on Furikyu Island. A jazz-hop record spins up. Your deranged mentor lights his cigarette. Slash every enemy before it burns out. One-hit-kills, no mistakes... well, maybe a few.

games.name: Lords of the Fallen II
games.summary: Lords of the Fallen 2, the highly anticipated sequel to the game released in 2023, is set to arrive in 2026. The team at Hexworks aims to create a sequel incorporating more commercial elements, particularly in visual design, to attract a broader audience of players.

games.name: Shine On, My Little Sun
games.summary: When the Sun fell, darkness covered the world. In the snowy wasteland, the town of Svargo thrived under its faint light. But the Sun did not go out. The small Sun sleeps atop a grim lighthouse. What happens when the Sun awakens, seeking a few days of simple childhood?

games.name: Deadly Rehearsal
games.summary: The rehearsal must be flawless. Every sound, every light timed perfectly. You are one of the best stage manager's after all. Failure is not an option. The play is cursed... and it demands perfection.

games.name: Phi: The Broken Strings
games.summary: Play as PHi in a mysterious world, where emotionally charged levels reveal past wounds, restore balance and reignite fading hope.

games.name: Artius: Pure Imagination
games.summary: ARTIUS is a fast-paced, momentum-based 2D platformer where you play as artists battling to preserve creativity in a world on the verge of artistic extinction! Dash, swing, and smash your way through a vibrant, hand-drawn world in this adrenaline-fueled platformer where art is your strongest weapon.

games.name: Lemonade Apocalypse
games.summary: Make money selling lemonade. Optimise your product. Build your workforce. Sell, sell, sell. But money is not enough. Become president! Fuel climate change! Manipulate geopolitical events! Lemonade Apocalypse is an incremental game about business decisions that are technically legal.

games.name: Anemorie
games.summary: Anemorie is a visually rich, story-driven adventure game that invites players to step into the life of Anna, a young woman on a journey of self-discovery, love, and resilience.

games.name: Game of Thrones: War for Westeros
games.summary: Classic real-time strategy in the world of Westeros. Conquer the Seven Kingdoms solo, or dominate your enemies to claim the Iron Throne in multiplayer skirmish. Command the Great Houses, rally iconic heroes, and rewrite the fate of the realm.

games.name: Out of Words
games.summary: Find your lost voices in a co-op platformer adventure. Together with a friend, via online cross-platform or couch co-op, explore the wild, colorful realm of Vokabulantis as Kurt and Karla in a story about the first time they held hands — where everything you see is crafted by hand.

games.name: Stars of Icarus
games.summary: Assemble your crew and take to the stars in a team-based PvP dogfight. Enter the forgotten arenas of space, master your ship's loadout and strategize with the rest of your ragtag squadron. Victory or death, together.

games.name: Ashfield Hollow
games.summary: Ten years after the outbreak, you’re found unconscious and taken in by a camp of survivors. Learn to fight, scavenge, farm, and craft as you rebuild your life, form bonds, and maybe even find love in this post-apocalyptic life sim RPG.

games.name: Shutter Story
games.summary: Your friend is convinced his house is haunted. Examine his family's photo album to reveal signs of the paranormal, as the horror unfolds in the house around you. Their fate is in your hands.

games.name: Zeroth
games.summary: Zeroth is a run-based action platformer with mechanical depth and interplay inspired by traditional Roguelikes. Learn the rules of Zeroth through hilarious deaths and guide your heroes as they seek to escape the 0th circle of Haell.

games.name: Phase Nexus
games.summary: Phase Nexus is an upcoming fast-paced 2D action-platformer starring speedster Cyanser and teleporter Raviel (once again not playable yet). Think of a fever fusion between Sonic (without the loops), Viewitful Joe, Sparkster/Rocket Knight and Luminous Avenger iX/White Steel X. In terms of mechanics and movement from those games, they blend well surprisingly.

games.name: Ruin: Beast City
games.summary: Assassinate your targets with style, as you uncover a plot of world domination and ancient horrors in this boss fight action game. Dive deep into the dark ruins of the Beast City, where only lunatic killers remain.

games.name: Inquisitor Shepherd
games.summary: Become Shepherd, an inquisitor sent to a suspicious village. Unveil the secrets of a world filled with fear, and make an inevitable choice. In this visual novel mystery, your decisions change the world. Can you survive the desperate horror?

games.name: The Detectorist Guild
games.summary: A cosy village-life RPG set in Yorkshire, England, in 1999. Follow James as he explores a quintessential British village with his metal detector, uncovering lost treasures and slowly unravelling a dark mystery that draws him and his family into its depths.

games.name: The Quiet After
games.summary: The Quiet After is a narrative visual novel where players guide Ava, a survivor navigating a quiet but dangerous world shaped by memory, trauma, and choice. Every decision branches the story, influences Ava’s inner voice, and determines how you survive in the aftermath. The game blends choice-driven storytelling, psychological horror, and atmospheric art to create an emotional narrative experience focused on healing, survival, and the consequences of the past.

games.name: Quantum Quartz
games.summary: Steampunk pixel-art precision platformer where you toggle platforms on and off using colored crystals. With only one active at a time, each grants a different movement ability, changing how you move and how the level works, blending high-skill platforming with spatial puzzles!

games.name: Abismo
games.summary: Abismo is a deep-sea co-op horror game set on the abyssal floor of an alien planet. Descend alone or with up to three friends into shifting trenches, recover classified research, and survive the crushing dark while uncovering an analog-horror mystery buried in corrupted VHS tapes.

games.name: Twisted Grove
games.summary: A non-violent Roguelike Deckbuilder about befriending critters in a magical forest. Assemble unique decks, pet/compliment/smooch your way into the heart of corrupted flora and fauna, and dismantle the capitalist systems tearing down the Grove.

games.name: Make The Dead Dead Again
games.summary: Guns, super-powered DNA, and a whole lot of attitude in a third-person shooter. Fight your way through Lux's world as she hunts for her missing mother, and spend your loot making her (and her base) look absolutely incredible. Because the apocalypse is no excuse for a bad outfit.

games.name: Fossil Quest
games.summary: Fossil Quest is a cozy fossil‑digging life sim where you travel to dig sites, excavate bones, and assemble exhibits to build your own dinosaur museum. Upgrade tools, decorate your home, and curate displays before opening the museum to visitors in a relaxed, collectible‑focused experience.

games.name: Perceptum
games.summary: A psychological horror game where you play as a medium investigating the disappearance of a family. Explore a house with an oppressive atmosphere, close your eyes to hear the beyond, use your mirror to see what should not exist and uncover the truth hidden within its walls.

games.name: Villain: Path of the Necromancer
games.summary: You are an Osteurgo, a lesser necromancer risen from the ashes of the Dark Lord. Raise your empire among desolate mountains, subjugate savage tribes, and spread corruption. Build, conquer, withstand enemy hordes, and claim the empty throne of evil.

games.name: Veiled Shadows
games.summary: Live a month in a rural mountain town, build bonds, and hunt a mystery across two worlds. Manage your days, explore dungeons, and fight turn-based battles to recover what's been lost.

games.name: Cosmo Cargo
games.summary: Cosmo Cargo is an inventory autobattler roguelite game where you fight to preserve the chaos of the galaxy. Collect and combine items in your ship to gain powerful effects and defeat the Administrators.

games.name: Void Hunters
games.summary: Lead fearless rebels in a dark fantasy, turn-based RPG where tactical decisions and strategic squad-building shape every battle against the world-devouring Void.

games.name: SlashZero
games.summary: SlashZero is a 3D roguelike action platformer. As a Timehacker, your job is to travel across timelines and explore a cyberpunk world, use combat skills and strategies to piece together the truth, and take down the Lord of the Void! Is what you see the truth?

games.name: Plagueborn
games.summary: Plagueborn is a 2D action roguelike where you and your allies battle through plague-ridden dungeons. Explore procedurally generated floors, master a wide arsenal of weapons, forge unique builds, and cut down relentless hordes of darkness.

games.name: Deus Exia
games.summary: “Before your planet gets blown into smithereens, take this sword and protect yourself.” Embark on a colorful 2D pixel action adventure in Deus Exia! Slash, parry and combo through four distinct lands. Collect cards and skills to craft powerful builds — then overcome deadly enemies and bosses.

games.name: SnowRunner: Season 20
games.summary: Season 20 of Snowrunner. Included in the Year 5 Pass. Requires the base game SnowRunner to run.

games.name: M.A.Y.A
games.summary: Take on the role of sci-fi warrior Maya. Capture uplinks, master a complex move-set along with weapon upgrades, and survive on a hostile planet.

games.name: Dithered
games.summary: Dithered invites you to a realm forsaken by the clock—a surreal nightmare where you must platform through the jagged shards of a protagonist's trauma. Guided by two bickering birds and hunted by a ticking horror, you must fight your way through a glitching reality…

games.name: Obake Nante Kowakunai JK vs. Gakkou Meikyuu
games.summary: Curious about horror but bad with scary things? This is a not-so-scary horror game made by a developer who feels the same way, created for players who want to enjoy horror without being truly frightened. A pixel-art side-scrolling action adventure with puzzles and light action elements.

games.name: Knightstones
games.summary: Deploy your armies on a war table in this tactical roguelike! Plan your formations, trigger tons of chain reactions, and invest your rewards to rebuild your fallen Order. Be ready… or perish in the final battle.

games.name: Hypnagogia: Broken Dreams
games.summary: A protector submerged, a mirror shattered, and a dreamscape left severed. Unravel a new, surreal dream mystery as you platform, solve puzzles, meet unique characters, and much more in this first-person exploration prequel to Hypnagogia: Boundless Dreams.

games.name: Infamous Keepers
games.summary: Defend your dungeon AND your job! Tower Defense meets Roguelite in Infamous Keepers. Use strategy and some clever trickery to defeat waves of enemies: set up towers and deadly traps, send your employees into the line of fire, and slaughter any intruders left standing yourself.

games.name: Cyber Demon Protocol
games.summary: An antique computer has granted you the ability to summon cyber demons. Seeking power from demons is like dancing on a tightrope, from Lawful Good to Chaotic Evil, how will you choose? Will you collude with the wealthy, politicians, stars, and artists, or change this decadent society?

games.name: Manafinder II
games.summary: Mankind has ended, yet the world moved on. Take the role of Rey in this turn-based RPG and fight ferocious beasts and other existential threats alongside a disparate cast of allies as you seek a new purpose in a world that no longer welcomes you.

games.name: Fear Tall Grass
games.summary: Dark creature-collecting roguelite where humanity enslaves their old gods. Command evolving monsters on the board of Humanity’s final crusade.

games.name: Bravo, Gaspar!
games.summary: "SURVIVE my SADISTIC SHOW. An ACTION ROGUELIKE where your performance with COLLECTIBLE CREATURES serves only to feed me. On my stage, the rule is simple: ENTERTAIN OR DIE!"

games.name: Kerogen
games.summary: Kerogeny jsou polymerní organické látky, které se nacházejí v usazených horninách, například v ropných břidlicích, kde tvoří jednu z forem nekonvenční ropy. Jsou nerozpustné v běžných organických rozpouštědlech kvůli svojí vysoké molekulové hmotnosti (více než 1 000). Každá molekula kerogenu je jedinečná, protože se skládá z náhodné kombinace různých monomerů.

games.name: Dungeonery
games.summary: Crawl your way through the dungeon in this roguelike autobattler. Equip your heroes with epic loot and test their might in battle! Your team might uncover game-breaking synergies and conquer the dungeon… or get wiped out. Probably will, actually. No biggie, there’s always more where they came from.

games.name: Spreadsheets & Dungeons
games.summary: A grid-based turn-based roguelike where you manage a party across a dungeon which is a spreadsheet. Explore each dungeon, level up your heroes, build synergies, scale absurd stats, and survive escalating dungeon pressure through tactical positioning and resource management.

games.name: Bug Bounce
games.summary: A co-op action roguelike where you evolve insect heroes, build absurdly powerful loadouts, crush swarms of enemies, and fling your friends through chaotic physics-based combat.

games.name: Hotel Paraíso
games.summary: Explore this ancient haunted establishment in a game that blends RPG, puzzle, and turn-based strategy mechanics, and investigate the powerful tremor that has unleashed thousands of supernatural creatures, as the dreamlike and the magical intertwine.

games.name: Hyve
games.summary:
The First and Only 2v2 Digital Card Game
Combine cards with your teammate in real-time to create powerful synergies and defeat your opponents in fast-paced 2v2 matches.

games.name: Pair at Sea
games.summary: Manage your own pirate crew and sail across the sea. Take care of the ship morale, drag your sailors from one room to another and raid other ships as you navigate the seas.

games.name: Haunted Cleaner
games.summary: Haunted Cleaner is a relaxing, light puzzle and narrative game about tidying up and decorating the homes of the deceased. Play as a psychic cleaner, uncover the stories left behind and help lingering ghosts find peace. Remember, every place tells a story, you just need to listen.

games.name: Clutch
games.summary: Clutch is a fast-paced arcade racing game which will challenge the resilience of anyone's nerves. You play as a person who has survived a catastrophe of the Large Hadron Collider (LHC), while everyone else in the city has been transformed into a bloodthirsty zombie.

games.name: Astral Dive
games.summary: Join Atlas and his companions in Astral Dive, a charming hand-drawn pixel art fantasy RPG. Experience innovative turn-based combat powered by magic cards, explore wondrous worlds beyond the astral portals, and uncover the secrets of the magic academy.

games.name: Foxfire
games.summary: Full Thrust, Full Inertia, Full Auto! FOXFIRE is a top-down sci-fi survivors-like with space physics and a devastating arsenal of evolving weaponry. Customize your ship and tear through alien swarms as routine recon missions descend into bullet hellscapes.

games.name: Moonlight Pale
games.summary: Juliette follows the ghost of her dead cat into a nightmare where she has to fight and solve puzzles through eerily familiar corridors as she tries to survive and help the rest of the girls trapped inside. Discover the sins buried under St. Birgitta's Female Seminary.

games.name: AmaTisMo
games.summary: A visual novel about depression and self-love. Play as Amatista, a young woman trapped in isolation, as she begins a journey she never asked for. Every choice shapes the story. Fully accessible for blind players.

games.name: Haparoot
games.summary: Step into a dream world. Become the sole source of light in the darkness and Explore an authentic handcrafted landscape in third-person. Solve layered environmental puzzles, discuss some familiar issues and uncover secrets shaping the journey toward balance.

games.name: Starship Bloopers
games.summary: Starship Bloopers is a chaotic co-op space survival game where one wrong move can doom the mission. Play with 2 to 6 crewmates as you traverse space, gather resources, survive disasters, battle aliens and each other's incompetence before the sun goes supernova. Can you keep your SHIP together?

games.name: Cages: Hidden Worlds
games.summary: Cages: Hidden Worlds is an immersive first-person puzzle escape game, where every sound, shadow, and mechanism bring an eerie sense of mystery and impending doom. Solve the workings of complex, original machinery you’ve never seen before and uncover the secrets buried inside them.

games.name: Dead Reckoner
games.summary: Navigate the darkness in Dead Reckoner, a stealth-action submarine game where survival depends on more than firepower alone. Slip through the shadows, elude your enemies, and exploit their weaknesses as a new recruit in a mysterious government initiative that will determine the future of humanity.

games.name: Between the Shelves
games.summary: A cozy bookshop management game where customers step out of classic literature. Curate your shelves, recommend the perfect book, and unlock new items and mechanics as your shop grows into a living collection of stories.

games.name: Cyberwars
games.summary: Cyberwars is a turn-based tactics roguelike. You move infantry, vehicles, helicopters, naval units, and aircraft across hand-built maps, capture cities and factories for production, hold airports and ports to control the air and sea, and use terrain and fog of war to break the enemy line.

games.name: The Disappearance of Emily Crowe
games.summary: A first-person psychological horror built on stealth and dread. Raise your real phone to reveal what your screen can't — hidden threats, impossible paths, and the truth about a sister who vanished 15 years ago. What took Emily never left, and it remembers you.

games.name: Ignitement
games.summary: As a fire shaman, descend into a meditative battle against your inner demons. Wield explosive fire magic in a rogue-lite inferno. Burn through hordes, gather coins, unlock upgrades, and master the flame.

games.name: When the Stars Threw Down Their Spears
games.summary: When the Stars Threw Down Their Spears is a story-rich, retro space shooter inspired by DOS-era space games like Star Control, Solar Winds, and Lightspeed. Blast your way through fast-paced arcade combat; build out modular, upgradable ships; and explore a galaxy torn by war.

games.name: Rebel Roar
games.summary: Build two decks at once in REBEL ROAR, a tactical deckbuilding roguelike where each rebel unlocks a different way to play. Combine an animal deck with a class deck to create Ninja Cats, Hacker Opossums, and hundreds of unique builds as you lead the rebellion through a cyberpunk animal world.

games.name: Elysium
games.summary:
Elysium is a next-generation third-person mmorpg featuring a seamless open world, multiplayer gameplay, survival mechanics, crafting systems, AI companions, and player-driven progression; created by Mercenary Games, Elysium combines the best elements of mmorpgs, rpgs, open-world adventures, strategy games, and social multiplayer experiences into a living universe shaped by both players and artificial intelligence.
Explore vast lands, discover hidden secrets, build your legacy, participate in large-scale events, develop professions, engage in trade, battle powerful enemies, and influence the evolving world around you.

games.name: Pandemonium Line: Flipping on Borrowed Dime
games.summary: An action roguelike deckbuilder with a twist: build your deck out of coins! Fight your way through this hellish train to the driver’s cabin, all while the eyes of a snarky demon are observing you. Although it is thrilled to decide your fate by mere coin flips, you were the one to take its job offer.

games.name: Incyanspace
games.summary: IncyanSpace follows the story of Li, an artificial human, who sets out to find his long-lost original human brother Yuan. Together with surviving New Humans, they stand against Xystem, a dominant force of mechanical lifeforms that controls the surface world.

games.name: Most Scuffed Golf
games.summary: Build the course, then break it. Most Scuffed Golf is mini-golf for 1–4 couch players: each one places a tile in the hole layout, then everyone shoots through the chaos you all built together. Ramps, curves, bridges — and a hole that's always somehow still reachable.

games.name: Gods Play Dice
games.summary: A dice themed roguelike where every roll matters, and your journey will be lead by faith.. Luck isn't on your side, it is the game. Throw dice. Adapt. Survive, and most importantly believe in your dices.

games.name: Deepward
games.summary: Choose 3 heroes from a roster of six, each with distinct weapons, abilities, and playstyles. Build the right squad, switch between heroes on the fly, and fight relentless horrors in this fast-paced horror FPS roguelite set in the 1920s. Descend beneath a god-forsaken place where death is permanent.

games.name: Hellsplit: Labyrinth
games.summary: A rogue-like VR action RPG with brutal, physics-driven medieval combat. Collect seven crystal shards across procedural dungeons. You get one life. No second chances.

games.name: SOKO 1977: Anti-Terror Task Force
games.summary: Take command of a special police task force in 1970s Germany. Uncover terrorist networks, coordinate operations, and make far-reaching decisions. Experience an intense, historically inspired scenario that explores the balance between security, freedom, and the rule of law.

games.name: Billionaire Life Simulator
