games.summary: Wake up in a penthouse. Sleep on a yacht. The alarm clock is a helicopter. BILLIONAIRE LIFE SIMULATOR is the ultimate "what if I had everything" sandbox — pilot private jets, host yacht parties, customize mansions, and live the Instagram fantasy in cinematic Unreal Engine detail.

games.name: Seasons of Books and Keys
games.summary: After class, small problems drift into the library—harmless at first glance, yet hiding secrets and lies. You see the clues, hear every voice, and turn the page yourself as each case unravels. A bittersweet mystery adventure that blends the experience of reading with the feeling of watching a drama.

games.name: Conatus: Forgotten Depths
games.summary: A dark fantasy dungeon crawler where every weapon defines a unique playstyle. Explore interconnected regions, uncover hidden secrets, craft powerful potions and unravel the mysteries of a world built from everything humanity chose to forget.

games.name: Dance of the Butterflies
games.summary: Your twin sister is missing. Under her name, you uncover a deadly system where 50 people compete for a Wish powerful enough to change anything. The price of entry is a piece of yourself, signed away in a contract. Survive. Find her. And try not to lose yourself to the people you meet along the way.

games.name: Crazy Farm: Roguelike Idle Building Game
games.summary: This is the most chaotic farm in the universe. Combine 150+ crazy items to theorycraft game-breaking builds. Trigger massive, automated chain reactions to skyrocket your yields, poop to win!

games.name: I Want to Play the Villain!
games.summary: I Want to Play the Villain! is a theatre-themed logic puzzle game. To create the perfect show, you must match actors to their roles. But every actor has their own ambitions, fears, and wishes. Rearrange the cast, change the story, and use your logic to make everyone happy!

games.name: Town of Tinysville
games.summary: Town of Tinysville is a deck building roguelike set on tiny maps with huge stakes. Strategically place buildings, grow your deck, and master powerful synergies. Enhance your run using unique chance cards, landmarks, and powerful laws that permanently affect your town.

games.name: Capitol Diktatoria
games.summary: In an authoritarian state obsessed with art, work for the Eye of the Network. Run your restaurant, survive rising inflation, outbid rival factions, and collect the most historical art to place your men in the Inner Party and install your candidate as leader.

games.name: Me and You
games.summary: Me and You is a co-op puzzle game inspired by the acclaimed “Baba Is You”. Create, change and break the rules of each level to solve it together.

games.name: Steel Core
games.summary: STEEL CORE is a tactical turn-based strategy about giant mechs defending mining outposts on hostile worlds. Build each mech from parts, fortify your base, and survive an escalating roguelite campaign against an overwhelming alien enemy. Frontier work pays well, for those who survive it.

games.name: Just Another Guild Day
games.summary: Run a guild in a small village bordering the Demon King’s lands. Assign quests, train adventurers, manage loot, brew potions, gather intelligence, and prepare your people to survive the next monster attack.

games.name: Touge: JDM Dealership Simulator
games.summary: An economic simulator set in an alternative Japan. See a car that everyone has written off, read it with your bare eye, haggle with a salesman who remembers every deal, and grow from a single parking space to a corporation to keep it when the country runs out of money in 1990.

games.name: Party's Over: Backyard Cleanup Simulator
games.summary: A satisfying first-person cleanup sim. Collect trash, cash it in, unlock upgrades and new areas, and piece together what really happened last night.

games.name: Nuclear Engineer Tycoon
games.summary: Build a nuclear power plant and manage reactors, generators, and turbines, producing energy to keep the city lit and prevent reactor explosions. Earn resources, research nuclear technologies, build larger and more modern reactors, refine uranium, and create a nuclear energy empire.

games.name: The Ignition Protocol
games.summary: The Ignition Protocol is an incremental, top-down mining game set in space. Mine and haul asteroids in zero-g, build and automate your base, and ignite a new star - the last light in a fading universe.

games.name: No Clean, No Exit
games.summary: A 1-6 player co-op horror comedy about cleaning. Mop the filth out of a procedurally generated house while roaches, bedbugs, and ceiling-crawling spiders try to drag you off. The truck doesn't leave until the place is spotless.

games.name: Elta: Defy All Gods
games.summary: Brawl your way out of corrupted worlds alongside your dragon-god companion in an adrenaline-fueled action-platformer blending free-form melee combat, fluid platforming and sci-fi exploration. Become the champion of your fallen god, Elta.

games.name: Armed-Mageddon
games.summary: Grab some guns, mow down endless enemies and grow insanely powerful! Equip outrageous weapons, level up with game-changing upgrades, and create devastating synergies as you blast your way through the end of the world!

games.name: HopScout
games.summary: HopScout is a cozy logic puzzle game about arranging cute, picky rabbits to keep everyone happy. Take your time solving puzzles, help the rabbit burrow overcome a looming crisis, and discover the heartwarming stories of its adorable residents.

games.name: The Necessary Evil
games.summary: The Necessary Evil is a tactical RPG about making difficult decisions and preparing for the unpredictable. Lead "volunteers" into the dark and rotting recesses of the collective unconscious, colonized and industrialized and plundered for profit. Every decision matters, and every choice has a cost.

games.name: Kayak Photography Sim
games.summary: A meditative kayaking and photography sim. Open water, a slow boat, and nowhere you have to be. Paddle until you feel like stopping, photograph whatever catches your eye, dive underwater to explore what's down there. Nothing chases you. Nothing is timed. You're just chilling and exploring.

games.name: Vital Decisions
games.summary: Take charge of a chaotic emergency room up to 8 players. Examine patients’ vitals, diagnose their conditions, and choose the right treatment. Prioritize emergencies and keep the shift under control as your patients’ conditions worsen around you.

games.name: Diss Diss Discussion
games.summary: When student council president Sakurai fights to make uniforms optional, Hiyama pushes back against her (because Sakurai-senpai looks too good in them!) with nonsensical wit. Hasumi can barely look at what her crush gets himself into... A visual novel about the dumb things we say to get things done.

games.name: Silent Mainland
games.summary: Silent Mainland is a roguelike deckbuilder based on movement and grid mechanics. Players engage in tactical battles on a vast 5x12 battlefield. Facing waves of oncoming monsters, use card-driven movement and positional control to defeat foes in dynamic formations.

games.name: Find The Needle
games.summary: Your a pleasant farmer that dropped a bag of needles into a haystack, now your goal is to find the needle. Incremental game where you build multiple Satisfactory style structures and create real production lines to construct the biggest hay processing and needle finding factory possible.

games.name: Blight Doctors
games.summary: Discover, diagnose, exorcise. You are a plague doctor paranormal investigator living in a rotten, gothic city at the end of an apocalypse. Banish ghosts, cure plagues, treat with monsters... all in co-op and proximity chat!

games.name: The 7th Shift
games.summary: A psychological horror game about working overnight shifts alone in a grocery store. Stock shelves. Clean. Do your job. But you soon realize something sinister is watching. Survive seven shifts to discover why you were really hired and face a choice that will seal your fate.

games.name: Fleshgrinder
games.summary:
Fleshgrinder is an isometric post-apocalyptic action-rpg where every decision has weight.
Set in 2053, six months after the Fleshgrinder virus outbreak transformed 70% of augmented humanity into a hive-minded techno-organic collective.

Features three distinct characters with their own skill trees, optional friendly fire, hardcore permadeath mode, dismemberment physics, randomized mission areas, 30+ unique weapons, 100+armors, augmentations, consumables, ammo types with deep penetration mechanics and tons of loot with highly randomized attributes. NPCs with lots of side-quests and a faction reputation system which determines trade prices, dialogue choices and overall behaviour. Battle 11 unique enemy types through seamless mission areas in a huge persistent world where everything stays as you left it - all to stop the evolution of the Fleshgrinder and save humanity from extinction.

games.name: Hollow Crew
games.summary: Hollow Crew is a survival horror set in the confines of an isolated space station. Its loyal androids have suddenly been turned against you - survive their relentless hunt and contain the emergency, or die trying.

games.name: RoboSquare: Recharged
games.summary: Race friends, crush rivals, and master five chaotic minigames! RoboSquare: Recharged is a fast-paced 16-player online party game where hovering robots dash, jump, and slam opponents off the map. Customize your bot, climb the leaderboards, and claim the crown!

games.name: Team Hero Coder
games.summary: Assemble your team of heroes. Program their strategy with PseudoC or C#. Watch them battle, learn from what happens, and improve your code. Are you game to code?

games.name: Unexpected Tasks
games.summary: Relax with a cozy Time Management adventure. Clear obstacles, gather resources, rebuild the kingdom, and enjoy satisfying progress at your own pace - with or without a timer.

games.name: Ultimate Pet Shop Simulator
games.summary: Build and manage your own pet shop in a first-person simulation experience. Sell pets, place stands, decorate your store, satisfy customers, grow your business, and create the ultimate pet shop.

games.name: Deck Breaker
games.summary: Deck Breaker is a single-player roguelike deckbuilder in which players choose a hero, build a deck during branching quests, combine spells, characters, and artifacts, and preserve selected foil cards across runs.

games.name: Fox Stamps
games.summary: Fill out puzzles to reveal images, and complete your stamp collection in this casual nonogram game!

games.name: Still Breathing
games.summary: Keep your family alive in an underground bunker after the world collapses. Manage scarce resources, explore the ruined city, and make brutal decisions when desperate strangers start knocking on your door.

games.name: Infant God
games.summary: You are the guardian of an infant god. Guide Aistalt through the toxic ruins of the internet. Debate with random users, harvest their ideologies, and sculpt her personality matrix. Will you raise a benevolent savior or a tyrant who deletes humanity?

games.name: Really Illegal Golf
games.summary: A stealth golf adventure in places nobody dared to take golf. Slip past security and line up risky shots. Tee up in cities, beaches, ski resorts, military sites and more. Keep quiet and sink it under par.

games.name: Azur
games.summary: Azur (French pronunciation: [azyʁ] ; Occitan: Asur) is a commune in the Landes department in Nouvelle-Aquitaine in southwestern France.

games.name: Omnivael: Chronicles of the realm
games.summary: Dive into Omnivael's enchanting world on PC! Master magic, embark on quests, and explore diverse realms. Uncover mysteries today!

games.name: Absym
games.summary: Absym is a unique souls-like that challenges you to survive between two dimensions: the decaying Nihilor and the corrupted Absymalith. Fight, explore, and use Rift Dancing to shift between worlds in real time. Every choice draws you closer to redemption... or corruption.

games.name: Farming & Defense: Farmfence
games.summary: Supermarket Simulator meets Farming Simulator—with zombies. Build your store, grow crops, and survive nightly undead attacks in this fast-paced farming defence game. Harvest, sell, and fight to keep your business and farm alive.

games.name: Crime Scene Clean: Paranormal
games.summary: Crime Scene Clean is about Sector 7 hides the supernatural from the world. You’re their cleaner—erasing cursed symbols, demonic traces, and forbidden rituals. No fame, no questions. Just silence, speed and survival. Clean haunted scenes, contain threats, and bury the truth before it spreads.

games.name: PlanetBase 2
games.summary: Colonize the Solar System. Command a group of near-future humans trying to establish a base on Mars and beyond. Grow food, mine resources, manufacture goods and face the challenges these unforgiving worlds will throw at you.

games.name: Abjure
games.summary: Win by emptying your hand. Abjure is a roguelike deckbuilder where the 2 of Spades reigns supreme — draft cards, stack relics, and outplay every opponent in a strategic twist on the Big 2 card game.

games.name: Ghost Justice
games.summary: Lead elite operatives against ruthless cartels in a brutal narco conflict. Coordinate multiple tactical teams, plan ambushes, gather intelligence, and eliminate high-value targets through stealth-driven turn-based combat.

games.name: Fitness Gym Bodybuilding Pump
games.summary:
Interested in boxing, fitness and bodybuilding?
Do you dream of becoming the coolest boxer and knocking out your opponents in packs?
Do you want to be the most powerful in the gym?
Download the game and let's get started!
Here is a game that can make your fingers tremble with tension, performing the next approach!

games.name: Matchward
games.summary: Tower defense empowered by match 3 puzzle strategy. Level up and unlock potentially game-breaking upgrades. Design your own levels and share them.

games.name: Sokogeek
games.summary: Sokogeek is a block-pushing logic game with electrifying mechanics. Help Flux, a robot vacuum cleaner, escape each level by building the energy circuit that powers the exit. The complexity of the puzzles will test your spatial awareness, abstract thinking, and analytical skills to their limits.

games.name: Ninja JajaMaru Yokai Night Parade
games.summary: Ninja JaJaMaru-kun returns in a yokai-filled hack-and-slash action game! Stray into a dungeon party, defeat dancing yokai, master flashy Ninpo, and amass an arsenal of ninja gear! Clear special "Yokai Night Parade" rules for loot, decorate your base for stat boosts and save Princess Sakura!

games.name: UniversiaTCG
games.summary: UniversiaTCG is a strategy game, based around a digital trading card game with solo campaigns, and casual or ranked 1v1, 2v2, and 4 player free-for-all game modes.

games.name: Exodus
games.summary: Exodus: Journey to the Promised Land is a video game released for the Nintendo Entertainment System by Color Dreams through its Wisdom Tree label in 1991. Like all Wisdom Tree games, Exodus was not officially licensed by Nintendo. It was ported to the Game Boy. Exodus is based on Crystal Mines, an earlier game from the company when it was known as Color Dreams. According to the instruction manual, the player controls the biblical figure Moses as he leads the Israelites to the Promised Land, meaning he goes through a labyrinth.
aliases: Exodus: Journey to the Promised Land

games.name: Final Fantasy VII Revelation: Premium Edition
games.summary: This product includes the main game, the Story Expansion Pass, and Early Access, which allows you to play the game 24 hours before its release.

games.name: Final Fantasy VII Revelation: Premium Plus Edition
games.summary: The Premium Plus Edition of Final Fantasy VII Revelation. This product includes the main game, the Story Expansion Pass, and Early Access, which allows you to play the game 24 hours before its release.

games.name: Final Fantasy VII Revelation
games.summary:
As the world teeters on the brink of annihilation, the final battle against Sephiroth begins.
A meteor mars the sky, monstrous planetary guardians wreak havoc across the globe, and the fires of war rage. Now, Cloud and his companions must stand against this chaos to not only decide the planet's fate, but bring a legendary conflict to its conclusion.

In the final chapter of the FINAL FANTASY VII remake project, the scale has never been larger and the stakes have never been higher. Take to the skies and explore a boundless world, fight alongside a fully assembled party, master strategic and dynamic combat, and prepare yourself for the climactic finale.

A vast planet awaits. Everything leads here.

games.name: Final Fantasy VII Remake Series Trilogy Edition
games.summary: The Trilogy Edition of the Final Fantasy VII Remake Series.

games.name: Vapor Strange
games.summary: Explore bizarre procedural generated psychedelic worlds, encounter surreal creatures, experience shifting rulesets, retro aesthetics, and altered music for a wild and truly strange experience.

games.name: Shadow Rush
games.summary: Slay hordes of Shadow Demons in this Action RPG with roguelike elements. Fast-paced combat, quick runs, build experimentation, and re-rolling characters. Spells are collectable, equip-able 'Shards' that trigger when you attack. Can you beat the speed of darkness?

games.name: Wingspan: Bird Pack - Birds of Canada
Melty Blood: Twi-Lumina
games.summary: Melty Blood: Type Lumina is back and better than ever! Refined battle mechanics! New characters join the fray! A tale of conflict stirs once again within a dream.

games.name: Mariachi Legends
games.summary: Mariachi Legends is a brutal, pixel art, combat-oriented Metroidvania set in the heart of Mexico.You play as Pablo Cruz, a detective who has agreed to a deal with Death herself. She has given Pablo the ability to transform into the mighty La Sombra allowing him to fight back against evil.

games.name: Pony Island 2: Panda Circus
games.summary: Pony Island 2: Panda Circus is a phantasmagorical voyage through time, myth, divinity, and video games. Escape the lordly deities of the underworld with your soul, and your sanity, intact. This is not a game about ponies.

games.name: Infinite Hole Sim Remix
games.summary:
Infinite Hole Sim Remix has been remixed to offer a better experience over the original.

Infinite Hole Sim Remix is a ONCE IN A LIFETIME experience, fall down a hole, and keep falling FOREVER!

games.name: Indie Hoverboard Racing
games.summary: An advenure racing game featuring colourful open worlds and racing on hoverboards. Single player and for all ages.

games.name: Paid in Blood
games.summary: Bet your blood in a twisted baccarat game to pay off your mob debt.

games.name: Rogues & Fate
games.summary: A fast-paced two-hero inventory management roguelike. Assemble your inventory and crush bizarre creatures. Break the game with thousands of insane builds to defeat the Fate King in this RPG auto battler.

games.name: Far Cry 3: Classic Edition
aliases: ファークライ3 クラシックエディション
games.summary:
Far Cry 3 Classic Edition has been updated to run smoothly on modern platforms and allow fans and newcomers to experience the single-player Far Cry 3 campaign in stunning detail.

Explore an island playground as stunningly beautiful as it is diverse – from mountain ranges to swampy grasslands and white sandy beaches. Fight your way through the island’s towns, temples, river ports and more.

Encounter a diverse and realistic cast of characters, including one of Far Cry’s most notorious villains: Vaas Montenegro. Dive into this deep and enriching story where morals are questionable and hope is all but abandoned.

games.name: Far Cry 3: Blood Dragon - Classic Edition
games.summary: Far Cry 3 Blood Dragon Classic Edition is THE 80's-style sci-fi cyber shooter, taking place on a bizarre open world island crawling with evil - now on the current generation of consoles.

games.name: Jammer Dash
games.summary: Jammer Dash is an immersive 2D rhythm experience worth all your time!

games.name: Unyverse
games.summary: Unyverse is a sci-fi, action role-playing game (ARPG) created by Afrime Studios. Unyverse delivers an immersive, story-driven gameplay experience for single and co-op players enriched by a deep Afro-Futuristic aesthetic.

games.name: Space Evolver
games.summary: Space Evolver is a roguelite management and genetics game that incorporates real-time strategy game elements. Upgrade your spaceship and technologies, complete missions, and guide the evolution of species.

games.name: Wingspan: Bird Pack - Birds of New Zealand
No Way Back: Dark Horizon
games.summary: Survive on a mysterious island! Battle against the infected creatures of a failed experiment, gather resources, build your base, and uncover the dark secret of the island.

games.name: Squadron 42
games.summary: Take the role of a rookie UEE Navy combat pilot in a cinematic single-player epic adventure set in the Star Citizen universe. Battle in the stars and face-to-face as you seamlessly transition between dogfighting and ground combat. Serve aboard a massive Navy capital ship as your custom character interacts and builds relationships with a living, breathing crew. Cutting-edge performance capture brings unprecedented emotion and life to some of your favorite actors. Powered by StarEngine, Squadron 42 pushes gaming graphics and fidelity to the next level.

games.name: Witches Craft
games.summary: Witches Craft is an adult adventure & crafting game following Selene; A fully trained Hedge Witch and Aspiring Alchemist.

games.name: Touchstarved
games.summary: You were born cursed, with hands that twist the mind of any human you touch. Desperation leads you to the shadowy city of Eridia, where your fate intertwines with 5 monstrous strangers. Each can offer you salvation or damnation. Find a cure for your curse in Touchstarved, a gothic horror romance visual novel.

games.name: Football, Tactics & Glory 2
games.summary: XCOM meets Football Manager. Embark on the career of an unknown coach: tactically outsmart opponents in turn-based matches, earn money and experience, search for talented players, manage a club, build your reputation to get invited to lead the national team, and win the World Championship!

games.name: Daba: Land of Water Scar
games.summary: Daba: Land of Water Scar is a new title from Dark Star. It tells the story of a humanoid clay puppet. When the world is on the verge of collapse, the puppet traces the whereabouts of the water fragments within the ancient city, and throughout their journey of defeating enemies and seeking answers, unravels the story of the world and oneself. The game features various landscapes including abandoned ruins, a magnificent ancient city, gloomy prison, vast rift valley, expansive snowfield, deadly forest, and a floating city. Non-linear levels are interconnected, distinct, and intricate.

games.name: Project Mix
games.summary: Project Mix is a VR anime cyberpunk bartending visual novel. What will you do when you've lost everything you once had?

games.name: Silent Planet: Elegy of a Dying World
games.summary: Silent Planet is an exploration-focused, dark action side-scroller rooted in Cosmic horror. Explore the claustrophobic corridors of a massive underground complex filled with the remnants of technological and biological horrors created by a dead civilization.

games.name: Graytail
games.summary: A small island in the Pacific. The greatest female pilot has vanished. Suffering from severe headaches, our protagonist depends on medication as they search for her, but... What is real and what is hallucination? A Zelda-like mystery adventure to uncover the island's truth.

games.name: Jest Messter
games.summary:
A comedy-mystery otome visual novel.

Oh no! You're stuck with a pun-curse "gifted" by the mysterious Jester, a mythical entity known to bring happiness in exchange for your memories.

Armed with the worst dad jokes known to mankind, you transferred to the prestigious Marney High in hopes to uncover the Jester's identity... and hopefully make new friends along the way!

Luckily, your new classmates are just as weird as you are: a stuck-up scholar, a brainrot-loving memelord, a two-faced actor, a weapon-wielding roommate, and a secretive senior with a dangerous secret...

So be careful who you trust! As sinister plots start to unravel around you and your classmates, you find yourself tangled in their web of secrets and schemes.

And maybe... your pun-curse is the key to solve them all?

Commercial remaster of "The Punniest Pun Messter".

games.name: Zerra's Adventure
games.summary: Zerra's Adventure is a classic turn-based RPG with no random encounters. Explore diverse areas, collect items and treasures to improve your team and defeat the strangest enemies. Level up, learn new attacks, and meet quirky characters on your adventure!

games.name: Piggy One Super Spark
games.summary: PIGGY ONE SUPER SPARK is a single-player action game starring Xiamy, Yuez, and a lost newborn baby they happen to find. Follow the trio in their chaotic but heart-warming adventure!

games.name: Aokaki
games.summary: A disgraced ronin returns to his homeland to find it ravaged by war. Taking up his sword once more, he must battle through the feudal forces of the shogun and take on foes he once called friends. Parry, pogo, and dash your way through a land of insect samurai in this platformer.

games.name: Everbloom
games.summary: Everbloom is a cute and cozy social farming sim set in a world of whimsy - grow buckets of popcorn right on the plant and make chocolate milk by feeding your cows candy bars. Grow, care, build, decorate, and explore the world of Everbloom solo or with your friends.

games.name: Turok: Origins
games.summary: Play as the legendary Turok warriors to face off against ferocious dinosaurs and a terrifying alien threat that seeks to destroy all human life across the galaxy.

games.name: Postal 2 VR
games.summary: POSTAL 2 VR lets you loose in the most chaotic sandbox shooter ever, fully reimagined for VR. Survive a week in Paradise, Arizona—buy milk, return books, or go completely POSTAL with an arsenal of absurd weapons and unpredictable NPCs. The choice is yours…but good luck staying out of trouble.

games.name: Teeko
games.summary: Hop on the perfect mix of platforming and tower defense as Teeko, a cute sloth. Jump, smash, and plant trees to defeat the rampaging gigante masks of Costa Rica’s Día de las Mascaradas festival and their hordes of enemies.

games.name: The Expanse: Osiris Reborn
games.summary: The Expanse: Osiris Reborn is a third-person Action RPG set in The Expanse universe. You’re no hero — just a merc caught in the wrong place at the wrong time, trying to hold your crew together and keep the ship up and running. Your choices will shape your story.

games.name: Postal 2 Redux
games.summary: A ground‑up overhaul of 2003’s infamous open‑world shooter. Part modernization, part love‑letter, POSTAL 2 Redux will hoist every original asset out of the creaking Unreal 1.5 engine and slam it into today’s Unity—delivering the same familiar week in the POSTAL Dude’s life with a merciless glow‑up and a bucket of new toys.

games.name: HellHeart Breaker
games.summary: HellHeart Breaker - the monster girls you date grant you newfound powers, and the girls you don't... are the bosses you fight! In this dungeon-crawler roguelite, you are locked away at the bottom of the Underworld, fighting your way out. If all is fair in love and war - what will you do?

games.name: Son of Thanjai
games.summary: A spoiled prince is betrayed, exiled, and remade into something far more dangerous than a king. Outnumbered and alone, take an empire apart from the inside, with deception, fear, and the Surul Vaal, in a cinematic action-adventure set in an alternate-history medieval South India.

games.name: Daybreak Slam
games.summary: Colorful characters clash in this beginner friendly 2D Fighter. Family friendly themes and aesthetics with simple combat mechanics make Daybreak Slam a welcoming experience for new players to the genre, and allow each character to stand out in their own unique ways that veterans will appreciate.

games.name: Vale's Echo
games.summary:
2D cozy horror adventure that blends dark comedy, psychological storytelling, and surreal art.

In Vale’s Echo, death isn’t the end — it’s your last chance. Players take on the role of Vale, a sarcastic and troubled soul who wakes up on a mysterious train to nowhere. No pulse. No past. No clue. Her only company? Echo — a floating skull full of secrets, charm, and just the right amount of mischief.

As Vale and Echo journey through the underworld to confront Death and uncover Vale’s past, players will meet a bizarre and unforgettable cast of characters — from chatty fish-human hybrids to leech merchants and morally dubious spirits. Each encounter challenges not just Vale’s choices, but also the player’s empathy, humor, and sense of right and wrong.

Gameplay in Vale’s Echo revolves around dialogue choices, unsettling puzzles, and branching narratives that shape Vale’s relationships, memories, and ultimate fate.

Beneath its eerie charm lies a deeply emotional story connecting the surreal with the human — all wrapped in cinematic visuals, melancholic music, and darkly witty writing.

games.name: Alone: Mnemophobia
games.summary: Immerse yourself in a world of nightmares with Alone. A psychological horror game that blends first and third-person perspectives. It will become a part of your mind, just as your mind will become a part of it with every decision you make.

games.name: Fourleaf Fields
games.summary: Welcome to the tiny world of Fourleaf Fields, a cozy farming life sim where you're no bigger than a carrot. Grow towering crops, care for tiny farm bugs, and uncover a web of secrets fueled by gossip - solo or online with friends!

games.name: Black Sailors
games.summary: Command a fleet of formerly enslaved people who became pirates in Brazil’s Bay of All Saints. Challenge colonial oppression, fight for freedom, and rewrite Atlantic history in turn-based tactical naval battles.
aliases: Black Sailors: Bay Of All Saints

games.name: Mega Man: Dual Override
games.summary: Mega Man returns in 2027 with a brand-new entry in the classic action platforming series! Override challenges and blast down legions of robots while springboarding across a new array of futuristic frontiers!

games.name: The Second Reproduction: Reunion
games.summary: A remake/alternative version of the otome visual novel "The Second Reproduction."

games.name: Day Trader Tycoon
games.summary: Play as a day trader gambling on people's pension money and try to beat the stock market. Engage in a comedic story with multiple endings. Meet different characters and get insider info to use for your own advantage. Gamble on cryptocurrency and quickly react to market events.

games.name: Mercy Incore
games.summary: Solo indie hack-and-slash. You are a medieval knight with jet booster and transforming sword. Fight your way through a techno-void. Leech enemies’ lives to survive. Escape — or become a techno-vampire.

games.name: Final Flavor
games.summary: Hone your skills with knives and fire to taste sweet victory... Let them cook! Final Flavor is an old-school dungeon crawler where a diverse party of outcasts slay, bake, and sauté their way to survive. Find the perfect ingredients, following the footsteps of the legendary chef.

games.name: Diviner
games.summary: Explore isometric dungeons and derelict castles, defeat dark foes in first person turn based combat, customize your build and create gear arrangements with a slot based inventory. You have been tasked by the Diviner to rebuild a dead lord’s body by obtaining their organs scattered across the lands.

games.name: Alien Deathstorm
games.summary: Explore a devastated off-world colony that is ravaged by a cataclysmic mega-storm and overrun by bloodthirsty aliens in a desperate fight to survive.

games.name: Crackheads
games.summary: Build junky vehicles, battle your friends with physics-based weapons, and survive absurd co-op challenges in this chaotic multiplayer sandbox.

games.name: Edge on Truth
games.summary:
A story-driven adventure with a mystery atmosphere.
Explore the settlement, gather clues, interact with its inhabitants, and uncover a conspiracy. Your actions shape your relationships with the locals—will they help you, or deceive you? Your choices will determine whether the protagonist can escape, or if his tragic fate will repeat itself again and again.

games.name: Totopia
games.summary: Totopia is calling! Drip in your style and crush 100+ chaotic maps, or smash the Bitrot crisis with Atomon skills! Need a recharge? Visit Pulse Avenue to build, plant, or run a cozy cafe. Cast your fishline, chill, and vibe with quirky Atomons. Your world, your way—join the squad and catch that W!

games.name: Michikusa Wanderer
games.summary: The Demon Lord and the Hero are gone. With no mission to fulfill, no world to save, you hunt as you please, eat as you please, and travel as you please. It’s an RPG where you are free to do anything.

games.name: Take That Mainstage!
games.summary: It's 1992 in Emerald City. The world screams for change. You made the leap, now fulfill your destiny and change the world. Build your band, write real music you perform, manage relationships, and reach the top of the charts. In this hybrid life sim, be the one to Take That Mainstage!

games.name: Headcutter
games.summary: HEADCUTTER is a sci-fi spaghetti western FPS with brutal combat, destructible environments, and lots of gore. Track targets as a space bounty hunter, explore maps with multiple routes, and use the crunchy gunplay to cut their heads off so you can get your money!

games.name: Super Tacky Astro Ranger: S.T.A.R.
games.summary: Play as the tackiest hero in the galaxy in this fast-paced 3D action roguelite. Battle through chaotic arenas, master various weapons, defeat the Morg Leader, and escape in style. Be bold, be reckless. Be a true S.T.A.R.

games.name: Tempus Vitae
games.summary: You are Alex, a time-displaced astronaut unraveling the space station Theia doomed in both the war-torn 2185 and the post-apocalyptic 2385 to find your lost brother. Master an arsenal of time travel abilities and weapons in this sci-fi metroidvania FPS: Tempus Vitae.

games.name: Spyro: A Realm Beyond
games.summary: Wishlist now and get ready for Spyro™’s bold new adventure. Take flight in a brand-new journey through a strange and wondrous realm.

games.name: Skies of Valoria
games.summary: "Skies of Valoria" is a fantasy action Roguelite with dynamic builds and fast combat. Soar the clouds on "Aethelwhale", team up with 4 Valkyries across Valoria, and strike the Demon King's Castle! Harness War Souls for endless combos and summon monsters to sweep away all foes.

games.name: Strect
games.summary:
Control your ship and destroy all the enemies and bases that have appeared through teleportation!
< STRECT > is a score-attack vertical shooter for 1 or 2 players.
Enjoy simple shoot-and-dodge gameplay, rich destruction effects, and tons of hidden features.

games.name: Hotel Is Hungry
games.summary: The world ended. You got a hotel job. Check guests in, serve their orders, and feed the hotel before it decides to feed itself. One wrong room, someone dies. A body horror hotel management game.

games.name: Waifu Bubble
games.summary: Dive into a charming underwater puzzle adventure! Play solo or with a friend, control adorable crabs, and guide a trapped waifu through clever two-layer levels. Solve puzzles, work together, and help her reach the surface!

games.name: Ground Drone Operator: Ground Robotic System Simulator
games.summary: Co-op combat UGV simulator. One drone - several operators. Configure your ground drone for the mission and split roles between platform, weapon station, and equipment. Run robotic assaults, escorts, supply runs, evacuations and raids behind enemy lines.

games.name: Burning Bridges
games.summary: "Burning Bridges (On and Off and On Again)" is a single released by the British rock band Status Quo in 1988. It was included on the album Ain't Complaining. The tune is based on the traditional English folk song "Darby Kelly". In 1994 Manchester United F.C. used the song as the basis for their FA Cup song "Come On You Reds", which reached number one in the UK Singles Chart in May 1994. The song was reprised, in 2014, for the band's thirty-first studio album Aquostic (Stripped Bare).

games.name: Limes 235
games.summary: A historically grounded single-player point-and-click adventure that blends narrative-driven exploration, role-based perspective shifts, and puzzle solving into an emotional rollercoaster of contrasting storylines and moral choice.

games.name: Medieval Dynasty: The Backwood
games.summary: Unleash your imagination with our new free DLC introducing The Backwood! This whole new map will be available in Creative Mode, giving you complete freedom to build, design, and misbehave. Immerse yourself in peaceful serenity or let loose and cause

games.name: Momentigrade
games.summary: A fast-paced 3D metroidvania with a focus on stylish, momentum driven movement. Chain together jumps, dashes, wall kicks, and pole swings as you explore a colorful interconnected city and climb into the clouds. Fight creatures, discover secrets, and see how long you can keep the flow going.

games.name: Ichorian Tales
games.summary: Inspired by the traditional Zelda formula, Ichorian Tales is focused on that old-school dungeon crawling experience! Explore, fight enemies, solve puzzles and obtain new abilities to crack open the dungeon and fight massive bosses!

games.name: Lost Museum: Echoes of the Chromageists
aliases: 失落美术馆 -绘灵拾遗录-
失落美術館 -繪靈拾遺錄-
games.summary: Forgotten masterpieces with stories still left to be told... Lost Museum -Echoes of the Chromageists- is an adventure game that tells the story of Chromageists, beings with strange faces born of paintings. Through their memories, unravel the meaning each piece of art holds.

games.name: Kirby and the World Beyond
games.summary: Get ready to freely explore the World Beyond using Copy Abilities in Kirby and the World Beyond, the latest 3D Kirby adventure, coming to Nintendo Switch 2 in spring 2027!

games.name: Bloodbrand
games.summary: Bloodbrand is a story-rich adventure game where every decision carries a weight. Navigate yourself through perilous situations with persuasion, deception, seduction. Explore the cold winter nights of the medieval realm of Norn and sate your vampiric hunger for murder, or resist it at a great cost.

games.name: Hellkick
games.summary: One kick, one survivor. Hellkick is an early 2000s inspired lightning-fast two-button fighter: divekick your way down the circles of Hell, snap spines in x-ray FATAL KICKS, and duel on arenas that fight back. No combos to memorize! Every single hit is death, yours or theirs.

games.name: Loopfang
games.summary: A snake roguelite where your body is your arsenal. Collect weapon segments, fuse matching neighbors into higher tiers, and reorder them until they react with each other. Then close a loop with your own tail: everything trapped inside dies.

games.name: Kennel Chaos
games.summary: You and your friends run a dog daycare. It goes badly. Feed them, wash them, walk them, and scoop what they leave behind, before somebody props a gate open and eleven dogs discover the front door. Co-op chaos with very good pups.

games.name: Gunmetal Gothic
games.summary: A co-op shooter-RPG with a retro-3D aesthetic. Customize and upgrade your character as you take back the city of Vestige from demonic machines!

games.name: P.O.N.
games.summary: P.O.N. — a realistic first-person stealth-action crime-horror game that lets you see superheroes through the eyes of crime. Players complete missions for a criminal syndicate, staying connected through a tactical tablet. The core mechanic is a super AI that creates tension with its unpredictable and brutal attacks..

games.name: Prospera
games.summary: Prospera is a first- & third person citybuilder set in the Victorian era, blending survival, crafting, strategy, management. Rise to an industrial tycoon as you build, manage, and explore your city. Plan production chains, optimize logistics, and ensure prosperity.

games.name: Age of Legacy
games.summary: In the game, take the role of the fearless gladiator, who must make his way to the very top, which is freedom. There are a dozen unique enemies waiting for you to become stronger and stronger with each victory.

games.name: Dragon Riders
games.summary: A SFW BL/Bara Gacha (without microtransactions), Visual Novel, and Card Battler game. Customizable Love Interests can be Bara Style or BL Style. The main character escapes a dystopian wasteland by bonding with a sentient dragon and becoming a soldier. He must navigate life in his corrupt nation while forming a relationship with another dragon rider. The gacha unlocks 21 different dragons and riders and over 100 cards to add to the battle deck. Gacha credits are earned organically by playing the visual novel and card battler. There is no real-money gambling possible.

games.name: Rangingstrike
games.summary: Master the three weapons that change according to the humanoid robot form and fighter form, destroy the scattered enemy attack targets, and finally defeat the boss standing in your way!

games.name: Sanctuary: Shattered Sun
games.summary: Command vast armies across the surface of a star-encompassing Dyson Sphere in this next-gen RTS. Shatter the map itself with superweapons, freeze oceans to create new invasion routes, and control hundreds of units in your quest to dominate humanity's greatest megastructure.

games.name: Coraland: The Worst Rescuer
games.summary: Coraland is a puzzle adventure game where we follow Joris, a good for nothing rescuer on her first adventure to save Pon-Pon island from imminent danger. The controls are simple and the puzzles have been designed to be accessible for all ages, without outside knowledge to solve them.

games.name: TocoToco
games.summary: TocoToco is an addictive platformer where every jump matters. Explore colorful levels, dodge challenging obstacles, and uncover hidden secrets while testing your reflexes. Easy to learn, hard to master.

games.name: Captain Tsubasa II: World Fighters - DLC Character Pack 1
Captain Tsubasa II: World Fighters - DLC Character Pack 2
Captain Tsubasa II: World Fighters - DLC Character Pack 3
Lurking In Fear
games.summary: Enjoy the love of zombie games without the feeling of being locked down to a story mode! Enjoy a open world zombie era, loot, and explore! OR if you want a change in pace, Play a new round based zombies mode that will keep you loving or Re Loving Round based zolmbies!

games.name: Project Zarya
games.summary: Project Zarya is an open-world adventure set in post-apocalyptic Russia, where every day is a fight for survival. Explore, gather resources, build shelters, craft equipment, and battle the infected alone or with friends.

games.name: Province: Suroste
games.summary: Province: Suroste is a handcrafted retro open-world RPG inspired by classic fantasy adventures. Explore a low-fantasy world, investigate a mysterious murder, fight dangerous enemies, trade with merchants, and uncover the secrets of a living world built entirely by a solo developer.

games.name: Spine
games.summary: Experience Gun Fu like never before with SPINE, an immersive and highly cinematic action game set in a cyberpunk world. Explore the realistic vision of a near-future with a rebellious street artist Redline and her sentient combat implant, Spine, as they challenge a totalitarian AI regime in search of Redline’s captured brother. Participate in epic gunfights against charismatic opponents, while performing spectacular choreography with firearms!

games.name: Crescent County
games.summary: Crash headfirst into this witch-tech open world, drifting and driving on the back of your new motorbroom. Make deliveries, trick out your broom, and race your new friends (and crushes) as the sun sets. Decorate your flat, sort your life out, and discover what it means to find home.

games.name: Purgatory: Blue
games.summary:
A new visual novel led, written and composed by cittan*.

Akito meets his childhood friend, but for some reason, he is the only one who can see and recognize her.

games.name: Threaded Dungeons
games.summary:
A world threaded in death. Can you cultivate a party of four that defies all odds? Make every action count in tactical turn-based combat. Choose your allegiances carefully. Scour dungeons in search of loot and secrets. Resist or acquiesce to tempting whispers in the darkness.

Threaded Dungeons is a turn-based, party-based dungeon crawling RPG.

games.name: Hunter: The Reckoning - Deathwish
games.summary:
Vampires, Werewolves, Witches. What if I told you that the things that go bump in the night are real? What if I told you that you could see them?

Awaken to the truth you’re now a Hunter. Build your character, select skills, and work with a team of allies to investigate the monsters hidden in plain sight, to find their lairs, and to eradicate them. All the while, investigating a story that drags up memories from your past, ones that could change how you see the future.

Welcome to the World of Darkness.

games.name: Orms
games.summary: Orms follows Sam, a boy lost in a surreal world shaped by his fears. Guided by Kira, he must restore a lighthouse to reconnect with his parents. The game is inspired by Machinarium, but crafted in 3D with expanded locations. It blends emotional storytelling with atmospheric exploration.

games.name: Rule the Dungeon
games.summary: Your Report, Your Reality. A pixel-art CRPG where a Dungeon Bureau inspector files otherworldly cases into submission. Evidence shapes success. Keywords forge skills. The clock decides everything.

games.name: Reoxia
games.summary: The story of an astronaut who returns to Earth in the midst of an apocalypse caused by an unknown disease. He mustn't take off the spacesuit to avoid breathing the contaminated air. The devastated world is inhabited by the bloodthirsty infected and mutants, and unknown armed men are hunting him.

games.name: Tsumamigui 3
games.summary:
A censored port of Tsumamigui 3.
That bittersweet memory in his heart, never fading away— Akihito Natsuki, forced by company circumstances to take a long leave, decides to return to his hometown.

games.name: Sleepover
games.summary: Sleepover is a cosmic horror visual-novel about the last two humans alive. After the entire population of Earth mysteriously vanishes, the sole survivor, Yuna, struggles to find meaning in an empty world. After a mysterious girl appears at her front door, the two begin their final night together.

games.name: Tickets, Please!
games.summary: Become a train conductor and run your own train in a relaxing cozy simulation! Check tickets, keep everything clean, repair faults, and upgrade your train. Experience humorous chaos on the rails in a laid-back yet hectic single-player adventure.

games.name: Survive the Shift
games.summary: workplace survival card decision game. Starting as an intern, you must balance boss trust, team popularity, business output, and personal savings. Slacking rules, dinner culture, and bizarre blame-shifting communications turn into choice cards. Swipe once a day to see how many days you can survive.

games.name: Go! Super Awesome Monkey!
games.summary: Play as SAM in Go! Super Awesome Monkey and save the world from AI Tech Overlords in this cute 3D Platformer! Collect pizza slices, coins, & floppy discs by spinning, dashing, and slamming (and more!) in 100+ levels. Play at your own pace: casually explore or speedrun to rise up the leaderboards!

games.name: Relicfall
games.summary: Forge your own class in this Bullet Heaven Action Roguelite. Combine 3 professions to shape a unique skill tree, hunt for powerful loot, and socket relics to create game-breaking synergies. Slay endless hordes and push your build to its limits.

games.name: Dark Island: Faded Memories
games.summary: Ride dragons across forgotten islands. Explore the ruins of a world that fell long ago. Battle monsters and fallen soldiers lurking in the dark. Play solo, or team up with friends in co-op. Nostalgic graphics and style that bring back the magic of childhood.

games.name: Cursebreakers
games.summary: Cursebreakers is an exclusively co-op first-person dungeon crawler. Invite a friend to join for free with Friend's Pass and master sword & sorcery together. Explore a lost castle and delve into a rich dark fantasy world full of monsters, traps and magic. Defeat the fallen queen and break the curse!

games.name: Olaf and the Crowning Hangover
games.summary: Olaf wakes up with a legendary hangover and a missing royal crown. Retrace your drunken rampage across the kingdom to save your head! In this comedic puzzle adventure, fixing the mess creates the maze: every object you repair becomes an obstacle blocking your path.

games.name: ShatterRush
games.summary: ShatterRush is a multiplayer FPS where fluid parkour movement and massive mechs meet fully destructible environments to create flow-state movement combat you’ve been waiting years for!

games.name: DDD: Dice, Dungeons, and Drakes
games.summary: A tactical board-game battler inspired by the classic Dungeon Dice Monsters 'Dice-to-Tile' logic. Solo-developed over 12 months, featuring a unique system where your Summon Dice physically unfold to build the battlefield in real-time.

games.name: Lazy River
games.summary: A co-op adventure at the galaxy's most unregulated waterpark. Some guy peed in the pool, and the pee mixed with the space water and turned everybody into zombies… Except you and your friends. Build a raft, ride down the Lazy River, and escape before you run out of hot dogs!

games.name: Craftopia
games.summary: Craftopia is a game where you can do anything you've ever dreamed of. Thousands of items are categorized by the three eras: Primitive Era, Dragonic Era, Celestial Era. As you progress the game, more items will be available for you to craft!

games.name: Kingdom Come: Deliverance II
games.summary: A thrilling story-driven action RPG, with a rich open world, set in 15th century Medieval Europe. Experience the ultimate medieval adventure - through the eyes of young Henry - as you embark on a journey of epic proportions.

games.name: Into the Dead: Our Darkest Days
games.summary: Texas, 1980. Walton City has fallen to a zombie outbreak. Lead a band of desperate survivors from refuge to refuge by scavenging, crafting, and fighting in a relentless struggle for survival. Plan wisely, stick together, and — above all — keep moving if you want to make it out alive.

games.name: Self Simulated
games.summary: Self Simulated is a fast-paced precision platformer for the Game Boy Color. Play as a robotic version of yourself and navigate over 100 handcrafted levels filled with enemies, hazards, and glitch-filled dangers. Uncover your past and master tight, responsive controls designed for fast retries and fluid movement.

games.name: Goblin Cleanup
games.summary: A co-op cleaning game where you have to clean and rearrange a dungeon before the next adventurers come to complete it again.

games.name: Painted In Blood
games.summary: Trapped in the haunting realm of an artist's twisted nightmare, engage in intense combat with grotesque enemies and monsters, experience unpredictable horror events that unfold dynamically, seamlessly blends classic retro FPS elements with modern elements.

games.name: Cairn
games.summary: Reach a summit never climbed before in this survival-climber from the creators of Furi and Haven. Climb anywhere and plan your route carefully, managing pitons and resources to survive the unforgiving Mount Kami. Discover what Aava is willing to sacrifice to achieve the ascent of a lifetime.

games.name: Homura Hime
games.summary: "Homura Hime" is a third person action game, featuring Japanese anime visuals and intense 3D bullet curtain gameplay. Alongside Homurahime, fight against Demon Girls possessed by deviant "emotions", and get closer to discovering the truth of not only the fallen, but also your own veiled legacy.

games.name: Aether & Iron
games.summary: Immerse yourself in this narrative RPG set in an alternate 1930s where anti-gravitational technology has taken cars, roads, and even New York City into the sky. Muster a crew, master tactical, turn-based combat, and unravel the dark secrets lurking beneath the floating metropolis.

games.name: The Grimm Reapress and the Drearytale Monster
aliases: The Reaper Princess and the Monster of Ishokan
シニガミ姫と異書館ノ怪物
games.summary: This game tells a story of heart-to-heart connections and salvation surrounding Mono, a girl who visits the medical facility “Ishokan” in hopes of saving her older sister, who has been afflicted by the terrifying “Shinigami Disease”; Melhendia, a goat-like creature who seeks to exploit her; and the girls who the disease have transformed into strange creatures.

games.name: Clockfall
games.summary: Master the clock, break the loop. Time is limited and is the ultimate resource in this hybrid Dungeon Crawler packed with phases of village defense. Each run is a fight to earn more time, or unlock new weapons and skills to build your escape.

games.name: Five Nights at Freddy's: Blood & Gears
aliases: Five Nights at Freddy's: Blood and Gears
Five Nights at Freddy's: BLOOD & GEARS
games.summary:
"The past has a voice and its calling you home."

"You hoped you'd never have to return to this place of sorrow, but after 20 years, something has called you back."

Five Nights at Freddy's: Blood & Gears is a complete reimagining of Scott Cawthon's original *Five Nights at Freddy's* game. The game is directed by JDBRYANT and is created by Bloody Fungi, a passionate team of over 30 people.

games.name: Barbie: Horse Ride & Rescue
games.summary: Start your Western horse riding adventure with Barbie at Roaming Hearts Rescue Ranch. Rescue and rehabilitate charming horses, test your riding skills and customize your style as you uncover the mysteries of Moonrise Valley!

games.name: Villion:Code
games.summary:
A new school RPG produced by Koji Okada.
Genome editing ushers in a "new era of life."
To live with the burden of karma. —Is there hope beyond that?

games.name: The Sinking City 2
games.summary: The Sinking City 2 is a terrifying Lovecraftian journey, powered by Unreal Engine 5. Experience a heart-pounding survival horror as you explore the flooded city of Arkham and fight eldritch monsters beyond human comprehension.

games.name: The Wolf Among Us 2
games.summary: The Wolf Among Us 2 is an episodic graphic adventure game. It is a sequel to The Wolf Among Us and takes place six months following the events of the first game. Follow Bigby Wolf in a new story filled with not-so-colorful characters from famous fairy tales.

games.name: Mirror Land
games.summary: This is an optical illusion space puzzle game with an original core mechanism. It uses MAGIC MIRROR to GRAB and RELEASE characters and cooperate with moving the MAGIC MIRROR to complete incredible space puzzles.

games.name: Shironeko Project Infinity
games.summary: Shironeko New Project is a co-op action RPG based on the mobile game Shironeko Project but will have a new story with new characters.

games.name: Nonuple Nine: Asymptote
games.summary: "NONUPLE NINE: Asymptote" is a side-scrolling, narrative Sci-fi adventure game. Control the subject girl and solve the mystery of the building where the same floor loops. With vast scientific insights, can you find the answer for the "meaning of humanity" during this deadly journey?

games.name: State of Decay 3
games.summary: Unite to survive: push back the blood plague to reclaim the land's resources and carve out a life in the zombie apocalypse.

games.name: Anima: Song from the Abyss
games.summary: Song from the Abyss is the new Action RPG set in the world of Gaïa, from the renowned roleplaying book franchise Anima Beyond Fantasy. The game allows you to control two different characters and explore a world full of mysteries. Experience a fluid combat system and a deep story with unforgettable characters.

games.name: Militsioner
games.summary: Every move you make is being followed by a Colossal Policeman. Anger, flatter, disappoint, deceive or even romance him to escape in this kafkaesque immersive sim.

games.name: Ill
games.summary: Unleash your survival instincts. Step into the sinister town, face a growing horror and uncover the unsettling truth behind the town's descent into madness. Are you ready to confront your deepest fears?

games.name: Clock Overwhelmed
games.summary: Organize tasks within your routine, but be careful not to overlap activities and get overwhelmed!

games.name: They Speak From the Abyss
games.summary:
Venture into the Abyss and face strange and horrifying monsters in this bone chilling RPG.

With the spirit Sophia at your side, you must venture into the nightmare-ish world of the Abyss in order to escape. Monsters will block your path, will you be strong enough to conquer them, or will you perish and join the other lost souls who roam the depths.

games.name: Hanoi Puzzles: Magnetrix
games.summary: Assemble magnetic towers by stacking pieces from opposite poles, to enlighten a electrifying hexagonal board.

games.name: Ink Shapes: Book One
games.summary: Rotate stamps to create beautiful watercolor paintings in this relaxing hand-drawn puzzle.

games.name: Neebota: Zeebo's Awakening
games.summary: An open world party-based RPG set in an original fantasy world called Neebota, where Zeebo and his friends hunt for portals from our earth, and in doing so, uncover secret powers, ancient lore of their world and a vast conspiracy across space and time.

games.name: A Wake Inn: Rebooked
games.summary:
They say bad things happen in Silver Inn Hotel. Strange noises. Mysterious flashing lights in the night. Weird figures slithering in the dark.

They say something is about to awake soon. Will you dare to witness it?

A Wake Inn comes for PC in Rebooked version - redesigned, adding new content, additional endings and fully animated models of enemies.

games.name: Constellations: Beyond the Edges
games.summary: After an accident at a space station, you lose all communication with the earth and are no longer able to locate yourself in space, your best chance of returning is to use the space monitoring system to identify known constellations and configure the route back home.

games.name: The Lost Wild
games.summary: True fear is primal. Embark on an evasion-based survival horror experience against nature’s ultimate hunters — dinosaurs. Explore overgrown research facilities nestled in a lush wilderness. Be resourceful as you evade, distract, survive, and unravel the mystery at the heart of the island.

games.name: Rooted
games.summary: In this solo and multiplayer survival game, explore an ancient overgrown world full of dangers. Salvage, build, craft, hunt,.. and try to survive alone or with your friends in an evolving and fascinating post-apocalyptic environment. Powered by Unreal Engine 5.

games.name: Taste of Heaven
games.summary: Become a cook in the realm of spirits. Taste of Heaven is a cooking game with hints of RPG and a nice pinch of quirky humor. In this HD 2D handcrafted game, you will have to manage your customers’ mood and appetite in real time. Discover unique recipes and items in the world where worlds are made.

games.name: The Backworld
games.summary: Experience a non-linear turn-based horror RPG. Navigate through eerie corridors and surreal dimensions, while battling and evading terrifying monsters. Grow stronger by exploring every corner, not grinding battles. Forge your own path to find new colorful worlds, and decide the fate of the universe.

games.name: Alice is Dead: Hearts and Diamonds
games.summary: A complete remake of the classic Flash game trilogy, Alice is Dead. Hearts and Diamonds includes all new art, added puzzles, expanded lore, and plenty of secrets for old and new fans alike.

games.name: Marvel 1943: Rise of Hydra
games.summary:
This narrative-driven ensemble game stars Captain America Steve Rogers, Black Panther Azzuri (T'Challa's grandfather), U.S. soldier and member of the Howling Commandos Gabriel Jones, and leader of the fledgling Wakandan Spy Network, Nanali.

All four characters will be playable at different parts of the story. According to Skydance, players can look forward to "intuitive controls and exhilarating second-to-second gameplay that captures the action and excitement of Marvel, inspired by landmark comics, television, and films, as they navigate this all-new glob-trotting adventure."

games.name: Long Gone
games.summary: Decades after the outbreak, you play as a survivor stranded in an old-world suburban neighborhood. Explore the lives of people Long Gone through their forgotten belongings and uncover secrets as you search for supplies in this 2.5D pixel puzzle platformer inspired by adventure games of old.

games.name: My Wife is a Princess
games.summary: A traitor appeared in the kingdom, and the seal of the demon king was lifted. In order to save the kingdom~the beautiful queen sent a rescue request to the brave...The price was to become the wife of the brave!

games.name: WorldShards
games.summary: WorldShards is a Sandbox-RPG with a levelless progress system. Explore the mysterious fantasy world of Murrlandia, solve its mysteries, and help its tiny inhabitants to rebuild their home!

games.name: Holstin
games.summary: A psychological survival horror game set in an eerie, isolated 90s Polish town consumed by an ominous presence. You’ve come looking for answers, but everyone seems possessed by something foul. Explore the festering town, interrogate locals and fight ungodly manifestations to get to the truth.

games.name: Dig Dig Boom
games.summary: Dig Dig Boom is a mining roguelike where time only moves when you do. Each expedition, the player explores a new cave in hunt for gold, using a variety of tools and their wit.

games.name: Endless Samurai
games.summary: "Endless Samurai" is a roguelite that overcomes death and becomes stronger. You can experience a new battle system aiming at "fusion of turn-based and speedy action".

games.name: Situation Normal
games.summary: A single-player shoot-'em-up precision platformer.

games.name: DecaPolice
games.summary: DecaPolice is a crime-suspense RPG from Level-5, developers of the Layton series. The main character, a rookie detective named Harvard, hunts down criminals in a huge open-world crime-ridden city, traveling back and forth between physical and virtual reality.

games.name: Hanoi Puzzles: Spin Match
games.summary: Inspired by the classic Tower of Hanoi, Assemble towers by spinning pieces to get the right pattern on a hexagonal board with a mysterious and relaxing atmosphere.

games.name: Forge of the Fae
games.summary: Explore a story-rich, mysterious world inspired by Celtic folklore, use crystals to channel powerful magic, and make impactful choices that change the story's outcome. A unique Crystal System and battles with dangerous Fae await in this charming, pixel-style, retro modern RPG.

games.name: WTF: Waifu Tactical Force
games.summary: WTF is an anime movement shooter where every PvP win fuels your long-term progression towards the ultimate mercenary army. Victories earn XP and currency to upgrade your waifu-run Mother Base, unlocking perks & rare waifus you bring back into combat. Assign non-playable waifus to buildings for resources, deploy them on missions, and expand your tactical options. Each system feeds the next: shoot to build, build to upgrade, upgrade to dominate. Wrapped in a visual novel framework, it’s a genre hybrid where management, skill, and waifus drive everything.

games.name: Beyond the Plastic Wall
games.summary: Set off on an adventure set in a sprawling world that blends satisfying, mechanical puzzles with a rich narrative. Explore a stunning pixel-art world, repair intricate machines & meet unforgettable characters in a story about connection, resilience, and life that clings on in a world left to ruin.

games.name: Neko's Rage
games.summary: 2D pixelart action game with many roguelite mechanics and power up. The gameplay is speed and hardcore but very addictive. You play as Nikki a female cyborg in an apocalyptic world rules by mechanicals creatures.

games.name: Clockwork Revolution
games.summary: Clockwork Revolution is a time-bending steampunk first-person RPG. After stumbling across an incredible invention that allows you to travel into the past, you discover the city you call home—the vibrant steam-powered metropolis of Avalon—has been carefully crafted through the alteration of historical events. By traveling back to key moments, your interactions and choices will have a butterfly effect on the deep, narrative-driven world and characters of Avalon, causing them to change and react in unprecedented ways.

games.name: Zehlar
games.summary: Explore a world full of secrets and magic, inhabited by creatures with unique elemental abilities. Ally with them to embark on your adventure, and train alongside your creature companions to become stronger and conquer the challenges of the world.

games.name: Just in Crime
games.summary: Just in Crime is a detective video game in which you play a detective dog and a wizard cat. With a twist; you are able to travel back in time and examine the crime scene a few seconds before it happened.

games.name: Blackout: Zero Point
games.summary: Blackout is a hardcore co-op shooter for up to 4 players. Become a near-future special forces operative and eliminate infected creatures and monsters fused with machines. Complete missions through intense combat and teamwork, and escape the hellish battlefield.

games.name: The God Slayer
games.summary: The God Slayer is an open-world action RPG featuring a highly immersive gameplay system and story experience, allowing players to enhance their abilities through battles and world exploration with the ultimate goal of defeating enemies and saving the world.

games.name: Beaten Path
games.summary: Beaten Path is a turn-based tactical RPG set in a world ruled by fallen gods and ancient machines. Take command of Panna and her companions as they unravel the secrets of time, confronting lost memories, mythic powers, and a looping fate.

games.name: October Nightmares
games.summary: Explore a Montréal neighborhood in the 70s, investigate a supernatural phenomenon that inflicts nightmares on its residents, and delve into the depths of the world of dreams to save their lives. October Nightmares is a point & click cosmic horror game where exploration mixes with puzzle solving.

games.name: Inferius
games.summary: Descend into the underworld of "INFERIUS," a first-person, card-based game inspired by The Divine Comedy. Solve puzzles, battle creatures, and reclaim your soul in an ever-draining health race. Unleash strategic card combat and descend through 9 haunting levels on a journey of redemption.

games.name: Herosbine: The Unknown Island
games.summary: A story-driven open world, action-adventure RPG set on a mysterious island where the player takes on the role of Tim. Tim is living a normal life as a geeky, introverted boy. He is struggling with his identity and the loss of his best friends, and feels out of place.

games.name: Last Hour of an Epic to the Moon RPG
aliases: Last Hour of an Epic TO THE MOON RPG
games.summary: You like RPGs, but don't have time to play it all. . . We like RPGs, but don't have time to make it all. . . So here's (only) the last hour of an Epic RPG !!

games.name: World of Warcraft: The Last Titan
games.summary: The third of three announced expansions of the Worldsoul Saga.

games.name: Kidbash: Super Legend
games.summary: Kidbash: Super Legend is an exciting 2D platformer that blends classic gaming with a modern touch. You'll go on a thrilling adventure through two different phases - the Mountain and the Village. Your goal is to defeat Tao Shen Long, and begin the journey to becoming a Super Legendary Hero.

games.name: Vivarium
games.summary: You wake up and find yourself in an enormous terrarium. Explore, meet characters, and grow your escape - and along the way, uncover the mysteries of the terrarium as well. Vivarium is an adventure game about finding where you belong while surviving in a familiar yet alien environment.

games.name: Kemuri
games.summary: Kemuri summons you into a realm where the unpredictable meets the extraordinary in an urban jungle where mysterious creatures - Yokai- hide amongst the population. Become a Yokai Hunter and use your Fox Window to unravel the mysteries of the city and bring balance to the world. Dive into a thrilling adventure alone or with friends, hunt yokai in style, collect their powers and face even greater challenges.

games.name: Crazy Taxi: World Tour
games.summary:
It's time for crazy driving, crazy adventure, and crazy money! Crazy Taxi is back and going global!

In this new high-octane adventure, follow Axel as he chases down the mysterious masked villains who stole his beloved taxi. Tackle extreme missions around the world all while earning some CRAZY money!

games.name: Tidebound
games.summary: Tidebound is a fishing and inventory management game with a relaxing, casual atmosphere. Catch, sell, upgrade your boat, and sail further to catch more expensive and exotic sea animals. Casual yet engaging, the game offers a sense of progress with tons of equipment and hundreds of species to catch.

games.name: Dark Lessons
games.summary: Trapped in your teacher's home, your only defense against the dark is a flickering candle. Unearth a family’s twisted history and solve puzzles in this Lovecraftian nightmare to find a way out. But be warned: Something else is lurking in the shadows ... and a voice is pleading for your help.

games.name: Vignettes: The Dream City
games.summary: Vignettes: The Dream City is a first-person surreal dream-crawler game featuring turn-based combat, knowledge-based gameplay, non-linear exploration, and souls-like progression. Your dreams are haunted by a strange city, and you feel supernaturally drawn to explore it. What will you find within?

games.name: Outward 2
games.summary: Outward 2 is a challenging action RPG with survival elements focusing on a believable and relatable experience. There is no hand holding, no leveled encounters, no divine gift making you tower over your enemies. Eat your meal, check your map, grab your backpack: a fulfilling adventure awaits.

games.name: Hexplorando
games.summary: Discover the landscape and cultural heritage of Spain in this cozy 3D puzzle game where each region is a puzzle that brings art, territory, and history to life. Unlock heritage elements you can use in a limitless creative sandbox mode, with procedural quests to help you unleash your creativity.

games.name: OCRPG
games.summary: An Arcade Styled RPG with surprises, laughs and horrors at every turn.

games.name: Angel
games.summary: Angel is a rhythm-racing adventure in which digital climate change threatens the eCho network with extinction. Players can propel through digital landscapes, crafting new break beats to infuse a stagnating network with the spark of renewal. Angel imbues the flow state of racing with the complexity of breakbeat music, redefining arcade and combo-based gameplay and enhancing it with a soundtrack from MyraTV and many other breakbeat enthusiasts.

games.name: Code Exit
games.summary: Enter Pantheon, a futuristic city swallowed by darkness and ruled by a rogue AI. Team up with up to 4 players and survive an adaptive pursuer that learns from every mistake. Complete the mission, uncover Minerva’s secrets, and find a way out before the city consumes you.

games.name: Machina of the Farthest
games.summary: "Wouldn't it be awesome to fly?" Travel to the world's end in this warping-boomerang adventure with its beautiful pixel art.

games.name: Drift Boom Boom
games.summary: Drift Your way around 40+ Race Courses, BOOM Fire missiles, shotguns, and more, Boom Blow up your friends in Split-Screen. Just watch out behind you on the final lap!

games.name: Alchemic Beasts
games.summary: Alchemic Beasts is a monster taming RPG adventure where you breed and transmute creatures using alchemy to forge powerful monsters. Join Zeig, a thrill seeking daredevil, as he harnesses his alchemic beasts to defeat the creature known as the legendary Demon King.

games.name: LavaLoop
games.summary: LavaLoop is a music-driven shoot'em up, in a hand-drawn Steampunk universe. Face a mad queen and destroy the planet killing machine. Play as three musician fighters and jump from surprise to surprise in this unique fantasy universe.

games.name: Ties: Soul Link
games.summary:
TIES: Soul Link is an Emotional and Brutal 2D Metroidvania, combining Action RPG elements with Adventure Platformer.
An exciting story of resilience and overcoming fears. Explore incredible cities in a world in decline, set in the year 2097, full of secrets and with brutal and bloody gameplay.

games.name: The Standard Model
games.summary: The Standard Model is a narrative walking simulator/slice-of-life game set in different worlds throughout the multiverse. The player takes on the role of an undergraduate student that gets to explore and experience 5 different worlds on a quantum adventure.

games.name: PVKK: Planetenverteidigungskanonenkommandant
games.summary: Operate your planetary defense cannon to fend off an interplanetary invasion from the comfort of your cozy bunker. You’re here to stay, so obey your superiors, press the right buttons, and sip your daily tea ration - it's good for you.

games.name: Children of Saturn
games.summary:
A found footage coming-of-age story about a group of teenagers growing up under an orange sky.

CHILDREN OF SATURN blends first person adventure gameplay with real video recordings to tell an authentic slice of life story.

games.name: My Time at Evershine
games.summary: Be the Governor of a brand-new settlement on the fringes of the Free Cities, facing the almighty Duvos Empire. Recruit settlers, build infrastructure, tame the wilds, and lead your people to become a new cornerstone for the Alliance in this adventure-packed simulation RPG!

games.name: Holy Horror Mansion
games.summary: The young hero, who lives in a mansion atop the apartment building owned by his grandma, finds a camera in a locked room, encounters a ghost and gets caught up in all kinds of turmoil!

games.name: Sea Sniffers
games.summary: Sea Sniffers is a cozy diving game in which you explore the ocean with your trusty seal companion. Encounter strange creatures and exotic treasures in sunken ships or hidden caves. Discover the deep sea and all its secrets!

games.name: We Grew Up in War
games.summary: Discover the stories of kids growing up in the midst of armed conflicts over the last three decades. Inspired by real testimonies, this narrative adventure follows the lives of children from Bosnia, Syria, and Ukraine.

games.name: My Arms Are Longer Now
games.summary: You are a yucky long-armed thief. Snake through levels, retract like a vacuum cord, or put on a sock to seduce a lonely guard - whatever it takes to pull off the perfect heist!

games.name: Island Keeper
games.summary: Breathe new life into forgotten islands. Pick up trash, recycle it, craft items, and build your own base. As you heal the land, it flourishes into a wild paradise. Explore by walking, riding a boat, or using a submarine, and change a world that reacts to everything you do!

games.name: Rover's Tale
games.summary: A creature-collecting metroidvania, in a world where dogs live on forever amongst the stars as Space Rovers! Become a LAIKA Rover! Catch & research creatures, then use their abilities to explore a new frontier! Upgrade & customize, as you help your canine companions to unravel an ancient mystery!

games.name: The War of the Worlds: Siberia
games.summary:
The year is 1896. The Martian invasion wipes cities and entire civilizations out of existence. Separated from his loved ones, a young student escapes the capital city already conquered by the aliens.
Along with the player, he will have to survive in the distinctive and dangerous Siberia, stand against the forces of the old world, and inevitably confront its new masters.

games.name: Prolegomena to a Hyperdimensional Interface That Will Be Able to Manifest From Three-Minute Interchanges
games.summary: This is a collaborative experiment between you and I. We will participate in a series of interchanges, each lasting three minutes. What will be revealed across our interfaces during that limited time?
aliases: Prolegomena To a Hyperdimensional Interface That Will Be Able to Manifest From Three-Minute Interchanges

games.name: Knock Off: The Battle for Imagination
games.summary: Fight for the fate of imagination in this fast-paced 2D fighter inspired by classic arcade games and 80s/90s action figures. Master air combos, EX moves, assists, and super attacks with a roster of wild off-brand toy legends.

games.name: Virtua Fighter Crossroads
games.summary: The newest installment in the Virtua Fighter series, releasing in 2027.

games.name: Stage Fright
games.summary: From the makers of OVERCOOKED! comes an all new co-operative experience. Take your friend on an amazing adventure as you explore, solve escape rooms, overcome fiendish obstacles and unravel an ancient mystery.

games.name: Intergalactic: The Heretic Prophet
games.summary: Set thousands of years in the future, Intergalactic: The Heretic Prophet puts players into the role of Jordan A. Mun, a dangerous bounty hunter who ends up stranded on Sempiria – a distant planet whose communication with the outside universe went dark hundreds of years ago. Jordan will have to use all her skills and wits if she hopes to be the first person in over 600 years to leave its orbit.

games.name: Glintseeker Island
games.summary: Explore procedurally generated dungeons, uncover exciting secrets, excavate countless treasures, and fight enemies and bosses. Save the island from a mysterious threat below!

games.name: Omega Phenex Commenced Project Six
games.summary: You will become a pilot of the mech “Icarus,” which has tremendous maneuverability. You will enjoy a fight and face large powerful armies and rivals by moving from skimming the surface of the sea to the cloud with Icarus. This game is a high-speed mech shooting game capable of firing massive amounts of missiles.

games.name: Threat Vector
games.summary: Battle across the solar system as annihilation looms over mankind in this action sci-fi horror FPS. Powered by id Tech, THREAT VECTOR delivers classic FPS combat throughout a suite of concise, potent levels infested with deadly horrors… and loaded with enough firepower to destroy them all.

games.name: City of None
games.summary: A metropolis crumbles into ruin as powerful Barons satisfy their greed upon souls lost in time. You are but one spirit, with a wooden body left to rot in the wild…

games.name: Conjunctivitalizer
games.summary: Take on six stages of vertical shooting mayhem full of looney pixel art characters and locales. Gamers who are tired of bullet hell and Compile-like shooters can finally rejoice.

games.name: Satoyama Note: Spring Walk
